# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# Script:        CategoryPicker.py
# Description:   3-level TreeView category picker.
#                TreeViewItems built entirely in Python code.
#                All events wired with += (proven IronPython 2.7 pattern).
#                No DataTemplates, no XAML events.

import clr, sys, os

clr.AddReference('RevitAPI')
clr.AddReference('RevitAPIUI')
clr.AddReference('PresentationFramework')
clr.AddReference('PresentationCore')
clr.AddReference('WindowsBase')

from Autodesk.Revit.DB import (
    FilteredElementCollector, ElementId, Viewport,
    ViewSheet, FamilyInstance, View,
)
from System.Collections.Generic import List as NetList
from System.Windows.Controls import (
    CheckBox, StackPanel, TextBlock, TreeViewItem,
    Orientation,
)
from System.Windows import Thickness, VerticalAlignment, FontWeights
from System.Windows.Input import Keyboard, ModifierKeys
from System.Windows.Media import SolidColorBrush, Color
import System.Windows.Media
from pyrevit import forms

SCOPE_PROJECT   = "Entire Project"
SCOPE_VIEW      = "Active View"
SCOPE_SELECTION = "Current Selection"
SORT_CATEGORY  = "Category"
SORT_COUNT     = "Count (High to Low)"
SORT_LEVEL     = "Level"
SORT_PHASE     = "Phase"
SORT_ROOM      = "Room"
SORT_SPACE     = "Space"
SORT_ZONE      = "Zone"
SORT_WORKSET   = "Workset"
SORT_EDITED_BY = "Edited by"

# Keep old name for compatibility
SORT_NAME = SORT_CATEGORY

ALL_SORTS = [
    SORT_CATEGORY, SORT_COUNT, SORT_LEVEL, SORT_PHASE,
    SORT_ROOM, SORT_SPACE, SORT_ZONE, SORT_WORKSET, SORT_EDITED_BY
]


def get_sort_group_value(doc, element, sort_mode):
    """
    Return the Level 2 group label for an element based on the sort mode.
    Used when sort is NOT Category — groups elements by a Revit parameter
    value instead of by type name.

    Returns a string like "Level 1", "Phase 1", "Workset: Shared" etc.
    Returns "(None)" if the parameter is not set or not available.
    """
    from Autodesk.Revit.DB import LevelId, WorksetKind
    label = "(None)"

    try:
        if sort_mode == SORT_LEVEL:
            # Try the Level parameter first, then LevelId
            try:
                p = element.LookupParameter("Level")
                if p and p.AsElementId():
                    lv = doc.GetElement(p.AsElementId())
                    if lv and lv.Name:
                        return lv.Name.strip()
            except: pass
            try:
                lv = doc.GetElement(element.LevelId)
                if lv and lv.Name:
                    return lv.Name.strip()
            except: pass

        elif sort_mode == SORT_PHASE:
            try:
                p = element.LookupParameter("Phase Created")
                if p:
                    ph = doc.GetElement(p.AsElementId())
                    if ph and ph.Name:
                        return ph.Name.strip()
            except: pass

        elif sort_mode == SORT_ROOM:
            try:
                # Works for FamilyInstance — get the room it's in
                room = element.Room
                if room and room.Name:
                    return room.Number + " " + room.Name
            except: pass
            try:
                p = element.LookupParameter("Room: Name")
                if p and p.AsString():
                    return p.AsString().strip()
            except: pass

        elif sort_mode == SORT_SPACE:
            try:
                space = element.Space
                if space and space.Name:
                    return space.Number + " " + space.Name
            except: pass
            try:
                p = element.LookupParameter("Space: Name")
                if p and p.AsString():
                    return p.AsString().strip()
            except: pass

        elif sort_mode == SORT_ZONE:
            try:
                p = element.LookupParameter("Zone")
                if p and p.AsString():
                    return p.AsString().strip()
            except: pass

        elif sort_mode == SORT_WORKSET:
            try:
                ws_table = doc.GetWorksetTable()
                ws_id    = element.WorksetId
                ws       = ws_table.GetWorkset(ws_id)
                if ws and ws.Name:
                    return ws.Name.strip()
            except: pass

        elif sort_mode == SORT_EDITED_BY:
            try:
                p = element.LookupParameter("Edited by")
                if p and p.AsString() and p.AsString().strip():
                    return p.AsString().strip()
                return "(Not checked out)"
            except: pass

    except Exception:
        pass

    return label

#  VIEW → SHEET CACHE
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def build_view_sheet_cache(doc):
    cache = {}
    try:
        for vp in FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfClass(Viewport).ToElements():
            try:
                try:    vid = vp.ViewId.Value
                except: vid = vp.ViewId.IntegerValue
                view  = doc.GetElement(vp.ViewId)
                sheet = doc.GetElement(vp.SheetId)
                vname = view.Name.strip()  if (view  and view.Name)  else ""
                snum  = sheet.SheetNumber.strip() if (sheet and sheet.SheetNumber) else ""
                cache[vid] = (vname, snum)
            except: continue
    except: pass
    return cache


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#  DISPLAY NAME HELPERS
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def _eid(el):
    try:    return str(el.Id.Value)
    except: return str(el.Id.IntegerValue)

def get_type_group_name(doc, element, category):
    cat = category.Name
    if cat == "Viewports":
        try:
            vt = doc.GetElement(element.GetTypeId())
            if vt and vt.Name and vt.Name.strip(): return vt.Name.strip()
        except: pass
        try:
            if element.Name and element.Name.strip(): return element.Name.strip()
        except: pass
    if cat == "Sheets":
        try:
            n = element.SheetNumber
            if n and n.strip():
                return n.split("-")[0].strip() if "-" in n else n.strip()
        except: pass
    if cat == "Views":
        try: return str(element.ViewType)
        except: pass
    if cat.endswith("Tags") or cat.endswith("Tag"):
        try:
            if isinstance(element, FamilyInstance):
                return element.Symbol.Family.Name.strip()
        except: pass
    if cat == "Title Blocks":
        try: return element.Symbol.Family.Name.strip()
        except: pass
    # ── TEXT NOTES: group by type name e.g. "2.5 (T) Arrow_T25" ──────
    # TextNote type name is the Level 2 group — matches Ideate Explorer
    if cat == "Text Notes":
        try:
            et = doc.GetElement(element.GetTypeId())
            if et and et.Name and et.Name.strip(): return et.Name.strip()
        except: pass
    try:
        if isinstance(element, FamilyInstance):
            return element.Symbol.Family.Name.strip()
    except: pass
    try:
        et = doc.GetElement(element.GetTypeId())
        if et and et.Name and et.Name.strip(): return et.Name.strip()
    except: pass
    return "(No Type)"


def get_element_display_name(doc, element, cache, category):
    cat_name = category.Name if category and category.Name else ""

    def lbl(vname, snum, eid=""):
        parts = [p for p in [cat_name, vname] if p]
        if snum: parts.append("(Sheet No. " + snum + ")")
        s = " - ".join(parts)
        if eid: s += " [" + eid + "]"
        return s

    try:
        if isinstance(element, Viewport):
            try:    vid = element.ViewId.Value
            except: vid = element.ViewId.IntegerValue
            vname, snum = cache.get(vid, ("", ""))
            if not vname:
                v = doc.GetElement(element.ViewId)
                if v and v.Name: vname = v.Name.strip()
            return lbl(vname, snum)
    except: pass

    try:
        if isinstance(element, ViewSheet):
            num  = (element.SheetNumber or "").strip()
            name = (element.Name or "").strip()
            return (num + " - " + name) if (num and name) else num or name or "(Unnamed)"
    except: pass

    try:
        if isinstance(element, View):
            vname = (element.Name or "").strip()
            # Look up the sheet this view is placed on via the cache
            # The cache maps view_id → (view_name, sheet_number)
            # For a View element, its own Id is the key
            sheet_num = ""
            try:
                try:    vid = element.Id.Value
                except: vid = element.Id.IntegerValue
                _, sheet_num = cache.get(vid, ("", ""))
            except: pass
            return lbl(vname, sheet_num)
    except: pass

    # ── TEXT NOTES: show actual text content at Level 3 ───────────────
    # TextNote.Text gives the actual text content e.g. "TYPICAL"
    # Truncated to 60 chars to keep rows readable.
    # Format: "Text Notes - ViewName - (Sheet No. N) [ID] : "TYPICAL""
    if cat_name == "Text Notes":
        try:
            from Autodesk.Revit.DB import TextNote
            if isinstance(element, TextNote):
                # Get the text content
                content = (element.Text or "").strip()
                # Truncate long text
                if len(content) > 60:
                    content = content[:57] + "..."
                # Replace newlines with space
                content = content.replace("\r", " ").replace("\n", " ")

                # Get owner view + sheet via cache
                oid = element.OwnerViewId
                try:    k = oid.Value
                except: k = oid.IntegerValue
                vname, snum = cache.get(k, ("", ""))
                if not vname:
                    ov = doc.GetElement(oid)
                    if ov and ov.Name: vname = ov.Name.strip()

                parts = [p for p in [cat_name, vname] if p]
                if snum: parts.append("(Sheet No. " + snum + ")")
                label = " - ".join(parts)
                if content: label += ' : "' + content + '"'
                return label
        except: pass

    # Annotation (all other annotation elements with valid OwnerViewId)
    try:
        oid = element.OwnerViewId
        try:    k = oid.Value
        except: k = oid.IntegerValue
        if k != -1:
            vname, snum = cache.get(k, ("", ""))
            if not vname:
                ov = doc.GetElement(oid)
                if ov and ov.Name: vname = ov.Name.strip()
            return lbl(vname, snum, _eid(element))
    except: pass

    # Model family
    try:
        if isinstance(element, FamilyInstance):
            fam = element.Symbol.Family.Name.strip()
            typ = element.Symbol.Name.strip()
            name = fam + " : " + typ
            return (cat_name + " - " + name) if cat_name else name
    except: pass

    try:
        name = (element.Name or "").strip()
        return (cat_name + " - " + name) if (cat_name and name) else name or cat_name or "?"
    except: pass

    return "Id: " + _eid(element)


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#  DATA CLASSES — plain Python objects
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class ElNode(object):
    def __init__(self, element, display):
        self.element     = element
        self.display     = display
        self.checked     = False
        self.cb          = None
        self.tb          = None
        self.highlighted = False

class TgNode(object):
    """Level 2 node — type group (Category sort) or Category (param sort)."""
    def __init__(self, name):
        self.name     = name
        self.display  = name
        self.elements = []
        self.checked  = False
        self.cb       = None
        self.expanded = False   # remembers expand/collapse state across rebuilds

class CatNode(object):
    """Level 1 node."""
    def __init__(self, category=None, name=None):
        if category is not None:
            self.category = category
            self.name     = category.Name
            self.display  = category.Name + " (0)"
        else:
            self.category = None
            self.name     = name or ""
            self.display  = (name or "") + " (0)"
        self.tgroups  = []
        self.checked  = False
        self.cb       = None
        self.expanded = False   # remembers expand/collapse state across rebuilds


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#  BUILD DATA
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def _collect_elements(doc, cat, view, scope_ids, sel_by_cat):
    """Collect elements for a category given the scope."""
    if scope_ids is not None:
        try:    k = cat.Id.Value
        except: k = cat.Id.IntegerValue
        return sel_by_cat.get(k, [])
    elif view is not None:
        return list(
            FilteredElementCollector(doc, view.Id)
            .OfCategoryId(cat.Id).WhereElementIsNotElementType().ToElements()
        )
    else:
        return list(
            FilteredElementCollector(doc)
            .OfCategoryId(cat.Id).WhereElementIsNotElementType().ToElements()
        )


def build_data(doc, cache, view=None, scope_ids=None, sort_mode=None):
    """
    Build the tree data structure.

    Category sort (default):
        Level 1 = Category  →  Level 2 = Type  →  Level 3 = Element

    Param sort (Level/Phase/Workset etc.):
        Level 1 = Param value  →  Level 2 = Category  →  Level 3 = Element
    """
    use_param = sort_mode and sort_mode not in (SORT_CATEGORY, SORT_COUNT, None)

    all_cats = sorted(
        [c for c in doc.Settings.Categories if c.Name],
        key=lambda c: c.Name
    )
    sel_by_cat = {}
    if scope_ids is not None:
        for eid in scope_ids:
            el = doc.GetElement(eid)
            if el is None or el.Category is None: continue
            try:    k = el.Category.Id.Value
            except: k = el.Category.Id.IntegerValue
            sel_by_cat.setdefault(k, []).append(el)

    if use_param:
        return _build_data_by_param(
            doc, cache, all_cats, view, scope_ids, sel_by_cat, sort_mode
        )
    else:
        return _build_data_by_category(
            doc, cache, all_cats, view, scope_ids, sel_by_cat
        )


def _build_data_by_category(doc, cache, all_cats, view, scope_ids, sel_by_cat):
    """Category at Level 1, Type at Level 2 (original behaviour)."""
    result = []
    for cat in all_cats:
        try:
            elements = _collect_elements(doc, cat, view, scope_ids, sel_by_cat)
        except: continue
        if not elements: continue

        cat_node = CatNode(category=cat)
        type_order, type_map = [], {}
        for el in elements:
            tname = get_type_group_name(doc, el, cat)
            if tname not in type_map:
                type_map[tname] = TgNode(tname)
                type_order.append(tname)
            dname = get_element_display_name(doc, el, cache, cat)
            type_map[tname].elements.append(ElNode(el, dname))

        for tname in sorted(type_order):
            tg = type_map[tname]
            tg.display = tname + " (" + str(len(tg.elements)) + ")"
            cat_node.tgroups.append(tg)

        total = sum(len(tg.elements) for tg in cat_node.tgroups)
        cat_node.display = cat_node.name + " (" + str(total) + ")"
        result.append(cat_node)
    return result


def _build_data_by_param(doc, cache, all_cats, view, scope_ids,
                         sel_by_cat, sort_mode):
    """
    Param value at Level 1, Category at Level 2, Element at Level 3.
    e.g. Sort by Level:
        Level 1: "E 00 (334)"
          Level 2: "Walls (12)"
            Level 3: individual wall elements
    """
    # group_map: { group_label: { cat_name: [ElNode, ...] } }
    group_order = []
    group_map   = {}

    for cat in all_cats:
        try:
            elements = _collect_elements(doc, cat, view, scope_ids, sel_by_cat)
        except: continue
        if not elements: continue

        for el in elements:
            grp_label = get_sort_group_value(doc, el, sort_mode)
            dname     = get_element_display_name(doc, el, cache, cat)
            el_node   = ElNode(el, dname)

            if grp_label not in group_map:
                group_map[grp_label] = {}
                group_order.append(grp_label)
            if cat.Name not in group_map[grp_label]:
                group_map[grp_label][cat.Name] = []
            group_map[grp_label][cat.Name].append(el_node)

    # Build CatNode list where each CatNode = one group label
    result = []
    for grp_label in sorted(group_order):
        cat_dict = group_map[grp_label]
        grp_node = CatNode(name=grp_label)

        for cat_name in sorted(cat_dict.keys()):
            tg = TgNode(cat_name)
            tg.elements = cat_dict[cat_name]
            tg.display  = cat_name + " (" + str(len(tg.elements)) + ")"
            grp_node.tgroups.append(tg)

        total = sum(len(tg.elements) for tg in grp_node.tgroups)
        grp_node.display = grp_label + " (" + str(total) + ")"
        result.append(grp_node)

    return result


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#  WPF WINDOW
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

class CategoryPickerWindow(forms.WPFWindow):
    """
    3-level TreeView built entirely in Python.
    Each TreeViewItem is constructed in code with a CheckBox + TextBlock header.
    All events wired with += in Python — no XAML events, no DataTemplates.
    """

    def __init__(self, doc, uidoc):
        forms.WPFWindow.__init__(self, 'CategoryPicker.xaml')
        self._doc             = doc
        self._uidoc           = uidoc
        self._all_nodes       = []
        self._visible_nodes   = []
        self._flat_els        = []
        self._last_el         = None
        self._highlighted     = set()
        self._last_sel_ids       = set()
        self._timer              = None
        self._ready              = False
        self._last_loaded_view_id = None  # view id last loaded — used to grey refresh button

        # Wire Click events first — these are safe during init
        self.search_box.TextChanged       += self._on_search
        self.btn_clear.Click              += self._on_clear
        self.btn_refresh.Click            += self._on_refresh
        self.btn_all.Click                += self._on_all
        self.btn_none.Click               += self._on_none
        self.btn_reset.Click              += self._on_reset
        self.btn_close.Click              += self._on_close
        self.Closed                       += self._on_window_closed

        # Populate combos BEFORE wiring SelectionChanged
        # so setting SelectedIndex doesn't fire the handler prematurely
        for s in [SCOPE_PROJECT, SCOPE_VIEW, SCOPE_SELECTION]:
            self.scope_combo.Items.Add(s)
        try:
            has_selection = len(list(uidoc.Selection.GetElementIds())) > 0
        except Exception:
            has_selection = False
        self.scope_combo.SelectedIndex = 2 if has_selection else 1

        for s in ALL_SORTS:
            self.sort_combo.Items.Add(s)
        self.sort_combo.SelectedIndex = 0

        # NOW wire SelectionChanged — any future user changes will reload
        self.scope_combo.SelectionChanged += self._on_scope
        self.sort_combo.SelectionChanged  += self._on_sort

        self._ready = True
        self._reload()
        self._start_selection_timer()

    def _start_selection_timer(self):
        """
        Start a DispatcherTimer that polls Revit's selection every 500ms.
        Because it runs on the WPF UI thread (Dispatcher), it can safely
        update WPF controls without cross-thread errors.
        When the selection changes in Revit, the tree is updated to reflect
        it — ticks/unticks and highlights follow in real time.
        """
        from System.Windows.Threading import DispatcherTimer, DispatcherPriority
        from System import TimeSpan

        self._timer = DispatcherTimer(DispatcherPriority.Background)
        self._timer.Interval = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(500)
        self._timer.Tick += self._on_timer_tick
        self._timer.Start()

    def _on_timer_tick(self, sender, args):
        """
        Called every 500ms.
        1. Check if active view changed → re-enable Refresh button
        2. Check if Revit selection changed → update tree tick states
        """
        try:
            self._update_refresh_button()
        except Exception:
            pass

        try:
            current_ids = set()
            for eid in self._uidoc.Selection.GetElementIds():
                try:    current_ids.add(eid.Value)
                except: current_ids.add(eid.IntegerValue)

            if current_ids == self._last_sel_ids:
                return

            self._last_sel_ids = current_ids
            self._apply_revit_selection_to_tree(current_ids)

        except Exception:
            pass

    def _apply_revit_selection_to_tree(self, selected_ids):
        """
        Update every node to reflect the Revit selection.

        Three states matching Ideate Explorer:
          Element:    True = ticked+blue,  False = empty
          TypeGroup:  True = all selected, None = some selected (black square),
                      False = none selected
          Category:   True = all selected, None = some selected (black square),
                      False = none selected
        """
        for cat_node in self._all_nodes:
            cat_ticked = 0
            cat_total  = 0
            for tg_node in cat_node.tgroups:
                tg_ticked = 0
                for el_node in tg_node.elements:
                    try:    eid_int = el_node.element.Id.Value
                    except: eid_int = el_node.element.Id.IntegerValue

                    in_sel = eid_int in selected_ids
                    if el_node.checked != in_sel:
                        el_node.checked = in_sel
                        if el_node.cb:
                            el_node.cb.IsChecked = in_sel
                        self._set_highlight(el_node, in_sel)

                    if in_sel:
                        tg_ticked += 1
                    cat_total += 1

                # Type group state
                tg_count = len(tg_node.elements)
                if tg_ticked == tg_count and tg_count > 0:
                    tg_state = True    # all selected — tick
                elif tg_ticked > 0:
                    tg_state = None    # some selected — indeterminate (black square)
                else:
                    tg_state = False   # none selected — empty

                if tg_node.cb and tg_node.cb.IsChecked != tg_state:
                    tg_node.cb.IsChecked = tg_state
                tg_node.checked = bool(tg_ticked > 0)

                cat_ticked += tg_ticked

            # Category state
            if cat_ticked == cat_total and cat_total > 0:
                cat_state = True    # all selected — tick
            elif cat_ticked > 0:
                cat_state = None    # some selected — indeterminate (black square)
            else:
                cat_state = False   # none selected — empty

            if cat_node.cb and cat_node.cb.IsChecked != cat_state:
                cat_node.cb.IsChecked = cat_state
            cat_node.checked = bool(cat_ticked > 0)

        self._refresh_status()

    # ── DATA ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _get_sort_mode(self):
        """Return the currently selected sort mode string."""
        return str(self.sort_combo.SelectedItem or SORT_CATEGORY)

    def _reload(self):
        """
        Reload tree data from Revit for the current scope and sort mode.
        Also updates:
          - view_label: shows current view / doc name under the column header
          - btn_refresh: greyed out when Active View scope is already up to date,
                         enabled when the active view has changed since last load
        """
        cache     = build_view_sheet_cache(self._doc)
        scope     = str(self.scope_combo.SelectedItem or SCOPE_PROJECT)
        sort_mode = self._get_sort_mode()

        if scope == SCOPE_VIEW:
            view = self._uidoc.ActiveView
            self._all_nodes = build_data(
                self._doc, cache, view=view, sort_mode=sort_mode
            )
            # Track the view that was loaded
            try:
                try:    self._last_loaded_view_id = view.Id.Value
                except: self._last_loaded_view_id = view.Id.IntegerValue
            except Exception:
                self._last_loaded_view_id = None
            # Show current view name
            try:
                self.view_label.Text = view.Name
            except Exception:
                pass
            # Refresh button grey — already on this view
            try:
                self.btn_refresh.IsEnabled = False
            except Exception:
                pass

        elif scope == SCOPE_SELECTION:
            ids = list(self._uidoc.Selection.GetElementIds())
            self._all_nodes = build_data(
                self._doc, cache, scope_ids=ids, sort_mode=sort_mode
            )
            self._last_loaded_view_id = None
            try:
                self.view_label.Text = str(len(ids)) + " elements in selection"
            except Exception:
                pass
            try:
                self.btn_refresh.IsEnabled = True
            except Exception:
                pass

        else:  # Entire Project
            self._all_nodes = build_data(
                self._doc, cache, sort_mode=sort_mode
            )
            self._last_loaded_view_id = None
            try:
                self.view_label.Text = self._doc.Title
            except Exception:
                pass
            try:
                self.btn_refresh.IsEnabled = True
            except Exception:
                pass

        self._apply_filter()
        self._sync_revit_selection_to_tree()

    def _update_refresh_button(self):
        """
        Called by the timer tick. Re-enables the Refresh button when the
        user navigates to a different view (Active View scope only).
        """
        if not self._ready:
            return
        try:
            scope = str(self.scope_combo.SelectedItem or SCOPE_PROJECT)
            if scope != SCOPE_VIEW:
                return
            if self._last_loaded_view_id is None:
                return
            view = self._uidoc.ActiveView
            try:    current_id = view.Id.Value
            except: current_id = view.Id.IntegerValue

            # If view has changed — enable Refresh button and update label
            if current_id != self._last_loaded_view_id:
                self.btn_refresh.IsEnabled = True
                try:
                    self.view_label.Text = view.Name + "  ← click ⟳ to refresh"
                except Exception:
                    pass
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _sync_revit_selection_to_tree(self):
        """
        Read the current Revit UI selection and pre-tick any matching
        element nodes in the tree. This makes Entire Project mode show
        what's currently selected in Revit, just like Ideate Explorer.
        Also updates the category/typegroup checkbox states to reflect
        partial or full selection (indeterminate / checked).
        """
        try:
            selected_ids = set()
            for eid in self._uidoc.Selection.GetElementIds():
                try:    selected_ids.add(eid.Value)
                except: selected_ids.add(eid.IntegerValue)
        except Exception:
            return

        if not selected_ids:
            return

        # Delegate to the same logic used by the live timer
        self._apply_revit_selection_to_tree(selected_ids)

    def _apply_filter(self):
        """
        Filter and sort the tree.
        Saves expansion states first, prunes nodes by search query,
        rebuilds tree with expansion restored.
        Searches all three levels so unrendered (collapsed) items work correctly.
        """
        sort = self._get_sort_mode()
        q    = (self.search_box.Text or "").strip().lower()

        # Save expansion before rebuild
        self._save_expansion_states()

        if not q:
            filtered = list(self._all_nodes)
        else:
            filtered = []
            for cat_node in self._all_nodes:
                cat_name_match = q in cat_node.name.lower()

                if cat_name_match:
                    filtered.append(cat_node)
                    continue

                matching_tgs = []
                for tg_node in cat_node.tgroups:
                    tg_name_match = q in tg_node.name.lower()
                    matching_els  = [
                        el for el in tg_node.elements
                        if q in el.display.lower()
                    ]

                    if tg_name_match:
                        matching_tgs.append(tg_node)
                    elif matching_els:
                        ftg          = TgNode(tg_node.name)
                        ftg.elements = matching_els
                        ftg.display  = tg_node.name + " (" + str(len(matching_els)) + ")"
                        ftg.checked  = tg_node.checked
                        ftg.cb       = tg_node.cb
                        ftg.expanded = tg_node.expanded
                        matching_tgs.append(ftg)

                if matching_tgs:
                    fcat          = CatNode(
                        category=cat_node.category,
                        name=None if cat_node.category else cat_node.name
                    )
                    fcat.tgroups  = matching_tgs
                    total         = sum(len(tg.elements) for tg in matching_tgs)
                    fcat.display  = cat_node.name + " (" + str(total) + ")"
                    fcat.checked  = cat_node.checked
                    fcat.cb       = cat_node.cb
                    fcat.expanded = cat_node.expanded
                    filtered.append(fcat)

        if sort == SORT_COUNT:
            filtered.sort(key=lambda n: (
                -sum(len(tg.elements) for tg in n.tgroups), n.name
            ))
        else:
            filtered.sort(key=lambda n: n.name)

        self._visible_nodes = filtered
        self._rebuild_tree()

    def _rebuild_tree(self):
        """
        Clear the TreeView and rebuild every TreeViewItem.
        Expansion states are saved on each node's .expanded property
        BEFORE clearing, and restored when rebuilding — so searching,
        sorting or ticking never collapses what the user has opened.
        """
        # ── Step 1: save current expansion states from live TreeViewItems ─
        self._save_expansion_states()

        self.tree.Items.Clear()
        self._flat_els    = []
        self._highlighted = set()

        for cat_node in self._visible_nodes:
            # ── Level 1: Category ──────────────────────────────────────
            cat_tvi = self._make_tvi(
                cat_node.display, cat_node.checked, bold=True
            )
            cat_tvi.IsExpanded = cat_node.expanded   # restore
            cat_cb  = cat_tvi.Header.Children[0]
            cat_cb.IsThreeState = True
            cat_cb.Tag   = cat_node
            cat_cb.Click += self._on_cat_cb_click
            cat_node.cb  = cat_cb

            for tg_node in cat_node.tgroups:
                # ── Level 2: Type Group ────────────────────────────────
                tg_tvi = self._make_tvi(
                    tg_node.display, tg_node.checked, bold=False
                )
                tg_tvi.IsExpanded = tg_node.expanded   # restore
                tg_cb  = tg_tvi.Header.Children[0]
                tg_cb.IsThreeState = True
                tg_cb.Tag   = tg_node
                tg_cb.Click += self._on_tg_cb_click
                tg_node.cb  = tg_cb

                for el_node in tg_node.elements:
                    # ── Level 3: Element ───────────────────────────────
                    el_tvi = self._make_tvi(
                        el_node.display, el_node.checked, bold=False, leaf=True
                    )
                    el_cb  = el_tvi.Header.Children[0]
                    el_tb  = el_tvi.Header.Children[1]
                    el_cb.Tag   = el_node
                    el_tb.Tag   = el_node
                    el_cb.Click               += self._on_el_cb_click
                    el_tb.MouseLeftButtonDown += self._on_el_label_click
                    el_node.cb  = el_cb
                    el_node.tb  = el_tb
                    el_node.highlighted = False
                    tg_tvi.Items.Add(el_tvi)
                    self._flat_els.append(el_node)

                cat_tvi.Items.Add(tg_tvi)

            self.tree.Items.Add(cat_tvi)

        self._refresh_status()

    def _save_expansion_states(self):
        """
        Walk the live WPF TreeViewItems and save their IsExpanded state
        back onto the corresponding Python nodes (.expanded attribute).
        Called before every tree rebuild so expansion is preserved.
        """
        try:
            gen = self.category_tree.ItemContainerGenerator \
                if hasattr(self, 'category_tree') else self.tree.ItemContainerGenerator
            for i in range(self.tree.Items.Count):
                try:
                    cat_item = self.tree.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(i)
                    if cat_item is None:
                        continue
                    # The data item is the CatNode
                    cat_node = self.tree.Items.GetItemAt(i)
                    if hasattr(cat_node, 'expanded'):
                        cat_node.expanded = cat_item.IsExpanded

                    # Walk Level 2
                    for j in range(cat_item.Items.Count):
                        try:
                            tg_item = cat_item.ItemContainerGenerator.ContainerFromIndex(j)
                            if tg_item is None:
                                continue
                            tg_node = cat_item.Items.GetItemAt(j)
                            if hasattr(tg_node, 'expanded'):
                                tg_node.expanded = tg_item.IsExpanded
                        except Exception:
                            continue
                except Exception:
                    continue
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _make_tvi(self, text, checked, bold, leaf=False):
        """
        Build a TreeViewItem with header = [CheckBox  TextBlock].
        Colours match JasonExporter palette:
          Category (bold)  → #1A1A1A SemiBold
          TypeGroup        → #1A1A1A Normal
          Element (leaf)   → #1A1A1A Normal, slightly indented feel
        """
        cb = CheckBox()
        cb.IsChecked         = checked
        cb.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center
        cb.Margin            = Thickness(0, 0, 4, 0)

        tb = TextBlock()
        tb.Text              = text
        tb.FontSize          = 11
        tb.FontFamily        = System.Windows.Media.FontFamily("Segoe UI")
        tb.FontWeight        = FontWeights.SemiBold if bold else FontWeights.Normal
        tb.Foreground        = SolidColorBrush(
            Color.FromRgb(0x1A, 0x1A, 0x1A)   # #1A1A1A — matches JasonExporter
        )
        tb.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center
        tb.Padding           = Thickness(0, 1, 8, 1)

        sp = StackPanel()
        sp.Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal
        sp.Children.Add(cb)
        sp.Children.Add(tb)

        tvi = TreeViewItem()
        tvi.Header  = sp
        tvi.Padding = Thickness(0)
        return tvi

    # ── CHECKBOX CLICK HANDLERS ────────────────────────────────────────

    def _on_cat_cb_click(self, sender, args):
        """Category checkbox — cascade tick and highlight to all children."""
        cat_node  = sender.Tag
        new_state = bool(sender.IsChecked)
        cat_node.checked = new_state
        for tg in cat_node.tgroups:
            tg.checked = new_state
            if tg.cb: tg.cb.IsChecked = new_state
            for el in tg.elements:
                el.checked = new_state
                if el.cb: el.cb.IsChecked = new_state
                self._set_highlight(el, new_state)
        self._refresh_status()
        self._sync_revit_selection()

    def _on_tg_cb_click(self, sender, args):
        """Type group checkbox — cascade tick and highlight to all elements."""
        tg_node   = sender.Tag
        new_state = bool(sender.IsChecked)
        tg_node.checked = new_state
        for el in tg_node.elements:
            el.checked = new_state
            if el.cb: el.cb.IsChecked = new_state
            self._set_highlight(el, new_state)
        self._refresh_status()
        self._sync_revit_selection()

    def _on_el_cb_click(self, sender, args):
        """Checkbox — toggle tick+highlight. Shift = range. Syncs Revit live."""
        el_node   = sender.Tag
        new_state = bool(sender.IsChecked)
        shift     = (Keyboard.Modifiers & ModifierKeys.Shift) == ModifierKeys.Shift

        if shift and self._last_el is not None:
            try:
                i1 = self._flat_els.index(self._last_el)
                i2 = self._flat_els.index(el_node)
                lo, hi = min(i1, i2), max(i1, i2)
                for leaf in self._flat_els[lo:hi + 1]:
                    leaf.checked = True
                    if leaf.cb: leaf.cb.IsChecked = True
                    self._set_highlight(leaf, True)
                el_node.checked  = True
                sender.IsChecked = True
            except ValueError:
                el_node.checked = new_state
                self._set_highlight(el_node, new_state)
        else:
            el_node.checked = new_state
            self._set_highlight(el_node, new_state)

        self._last_el = el_node
        self._refresh_status()
        self._sync_revit_selection()

    def _on_el_label_click(self, sender, args):
        """Text label click — toggle tick+highlight. Shift = range. Syncs Revit live."""
        el_node = sender.Tag
        if el_node is None:
            return
        shift = (Keyboard.Modifiers & ModifierKeys.Shift) == ModifierKeys.Shift

        if shift and self._last_el is not None:
            try:
                i1 = self._flat_els.index(self._last_el)
                i2 = self._flat_els.index(el_node)
                lo, hi = min(i1, i2), max(i1, i2)
                for leaf in self._flat_els[lo:hi + 1]:
                    leaf.checked = True
                    if leaf.cb: leaf.cb.IsChecked = True
                    self._set_highlight(leaf, True)
            except ValueError:
                el_node.checked = True
                if el_node.cb: el_node.cb.IsChecked = True
                self._set_highlight(el_node, True)
        else:
            new_state = not el_node.checked
            el_node.checked = new_state
            if el_node.cb: el_node.cb.IsChecked = new_state
            self._set_highlight(el_node, new_state)

        self._last_el = el_node
        self._refresh_status()
        self._sync_revit_selection()

    def _on_tick_highlighted(self, sender, args):
        """Sync any highlights that aren't yet ticked."""
        for el_node in self._highlighted:
            el_node.checked = True
            if el_node.cb: el_node.cb.IsChecked = True
        self._refresh_status()
        self._sync_revit_selection()

    def _set_highlight(self, el_node, state):
        """Set blue background on TextBlock to match tick state."""
        el_node.highlighted = state
        if state:
            self._highlighted.add(el_node)
        else:
            self._highlighted.discard(el_node)
        if el_node.tb is not None:
            try:
                el_node.tb.Background = (
                    SolidColorBrush(Color.FromRgb(0xE8, 0xF0, 0xFB))  # #E8F0FB JasonExporter hover
                    if state else None
                )
            except Exception:
                pass

    def _clear_highlights(self):
        """Remove blue highlight from all rows (keep ticks)."""
        for el_node in list(self._highlighted):
            self._set_highlight(el_node, False)
        self._highlighted = set()

    def _clear_all_ticks_and_highlights(self):
        """Untick and unhighlight every element across all nodes."""
        for cat in self._all_nodes:
            for tg in cat.tgroups:
                for el in tg.elements:
                    if el.checked or el.highlighted:
                        el.checked = False
                        if el.cb: el.cb.IsChecked = False
                        self._set_highlight(el, False)
            cat.checked = False
            if cat.cb: cat.cb.IsChecked = False
            for tg in cat.tgroups:
                tg.checked = False
                if tg.cb: tg.cb.IsChecked = False

    # ── FOOTER HANDLERS ────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _on_refresh(self, sender, args):
        """Reload the tree for the current Display scope and Sort mode."""
        self._reload()

    def _on_scope(self, sender, args):
        if not self._ready: return
        if sender.SelectedItem is not None:
            self._reload()

    def _on_sort(self, sender, args):
        if not self._ready: return
        if sender.SelectedItem is not None:
            self._reload()

    def _on_search(self, sender, args):
        """Search text changed — refilter preserving expansion states."""
        self._apply_filter()

    def _on_clear(self, sender, args):
        self.search_box.Text = ""

    def _sync_revit_selection(self):
        """
        Push ALL currently ticked elements to Revit's UI selection.
        Called after every checkbox change — gives live selection like Ideate.
        No Transaction needed — SetElementIds is a UI-only operation.
        """
        ids = NetList[ElementId]()
        for cat in self._all_nodes:
            for tg in cat.tgroups:
                for el in tg.elements:
                    if el.checked:
                        ids.Add(el.element.Id)
        try:
            self._uidoc.Selection.SetElementIds(ids)
        except Exception:
            pass   # silently ignore if Revit is busy

    def _on_all(self, sender, args):
        """Tick and highlight everything in visible categories."""
        for cat in self._visible_nodes:
            cat.checked = True
            if cat.cb: cat.cb.IsChecked = True
            for tg in cat.tgroups:
                tg.checked = True
                if tg.cb: tg.cb.IsChecked = True
                for el in tg.elements:
                    el.checked = True
                    if el.cb: el.cb.IsChecked = True
                    self._set_highlight(el, True)
        self._refresh_status()
        self._sync_revit_selection()

    def _on_none(self, sender, args):
        """Untick and unhighlight everything — clears Revit selection too."""
        self._clear_all_ticks_and_highlights()
        self._refresh_status()
        self._sync_revit_selection()

    def _on_reset(self, sender, args):
        """Untick everything and clear Revit selection."""
        self._on_none(sender, args)

    def _on_close(self, sender, args):
        """Stop the polling timer then close the window."""
        try:
            if self._timer is not None:
                self._timer.Stop()
                self._timer = None
        except Exception:
            pass
        self.Close()

    def _on_window_closed(self, sender, args):
        """Safety net — stop timer if window is closed via X button."""
        try:
            if self._timer is not None:
                self._timer.Stop()
                self._timer = None
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _refresh_status(self):
        cat_count, el_count = 0, 0
        for cat in self._all_nodes:
            els = [e for tg in cat.tgroups for e in tg.elements if e.checked]
            if els:
                cat_count += 1
                el_count  += len(els)
        self.status_label.Text = (
            str(cat_count) + " selected  |  " + str(el_count) + " elements"
        )


# Module-level reference keeps the window alive after Show() returns
# Without this, Python's garbage collector would destroy the window
_active_window = None


def main(doc, uidoc):
    """
    Opens the Category Picker as a MODELESS window (Show not ShowDialog).
    This means:
      - Revit's UI thread is NOT blocked — Revit stays live
      - Ticking a checkbox immediately selects elements in Revit
      - Window stays open until user clicks Close
      - _active_window holds a reference so GC doesn't destroy it
    """
    global _active_window
    try:
        dialog = CategoryPickerWindow(doc, uidoc)

        # Show() is non-modal — returns immediately, window stays open
        dialog.Show()

        # Keep a module-level reference so Python doesn't garbage-collect
        # the window object after this function returns
        _active_window = dialog

    except Exception as e:
        import traceback
        print "ERROR in CategoryPicker: " + str(e)
        print traceback.format_exc()

<!--
    CategoryPicker.xaml
    Colours match JasonExporter palette:
      Primary blue:   #1A6EBF  (hover: #155A9E)
      Dark text:      #1A1A1A
      Mid grey:       #6B6B6B
      Light border:   #DEDEDE
      Panel bg:       #F5F5F5
      White:          #FFFFFF
      Hover blue bg:  #E8F0FB
      Window bg:      #FFFFFF
      Font:           Segoe UI 12 (matches JasonExporter)
-->
<Window
    xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
    xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
    Title="Category Picker"
    Width="580" Height="700"
    MinWidth="400" MinHeight="400"
    WindowStartupLocation="CenterScreen"
    ResizeMode="CanResize"
    Background="#FFFFFF"
    FontFamily="Segoe UI"
    FontSize="12">

    <Window.Resources>

        <!-- Primary blue button — matches JasonExporter PrimaryButton -->
        <Style x:Key="PrimaryBtn" TargetType="Button">
            <Setter Property="Background"      Value="#1A6EBF"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground"      Value="#FFFFFF"/>
            <Setter Property="FontWeight"      Value="SemiBold"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="0"/>
            <Setter Property="Cursor"          Value="Hand"/>
            <Style.Triggers>
                <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="#155A9E"/>
                </Trigger>
                <Trigger Property="IsEnabled" Value="False">
                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="#DEDEDE"/>
                    <Setter Property="Foreground"  Value="#6B6B6B"/>
                </Trigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style>

        <!-- Secondary grey button — matches JasonExporter SecondaryButton -->
        <Style x:Key="SecondaryBtn" TargetType="Button">
            <Setter Property="Background"      Value="#F5F5F5"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground"      Value="#1A1A1A"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderBrush"     Value="#DEDEDE"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
            <Setter Property="Cursor"          Value="Hand"/>
            <Style.Triggers>
                <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="#E8F0FB"/>
                </Trigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style>

        <!-- Reset button — red text on grey -->
        <Style x:Key="ResetBtn" TargetType="Button">
            <Setter Property="Background"      Value="#F5F5F5"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground"      Value="#C0392B"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderBrush"     Value="#DEDEDE"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
            <Setter Property="Cursor"          Value="Hand"/>
            <Style.Triggers>
                <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="#FDECEA"/>
                </Trigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style>

        <!-- TreeViewItem — remove default blue selection -->
        <Style TargetType="TreeViewItem">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="Transparent"/>
            <Setter Property="Padding"    Value="0"/>
            <Style.Triggers>
                <Trigger Property="IsSelected" Value="True">
                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="Transparent"/>
                </Trigger>
                <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="Transparent"/>
                </Trigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style>

    </Window.Resources>

    <DockPanel Background="#FFFFFF">

        <!-- ══ HEADER ════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
        <Border DockPanel.Dock="Top" Background="#F5F5F5"
                BorderBrush="#DEDEDE" BorderThickness="0,0,0,1" Padding="10,8">
            <Grid>
                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="80"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                    <RowDefinition Height="26"/>
                    <RowDefinition Height="26"/>
                </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                <Border Grid.Row="0" Grid.Column="0"
                        Background="#1A6EBF" CornerRadius="3"
                        Padding="8,0" Margin="0,0,8,0"
                        SnapsToDevicePixels="True">
                    <TextBlock Text="Display" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                               Foreground="#FFFFFF" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                               FontSize="11"/>
                </Border>
                <ComboBox Grid.Row="0" Grid.Column="1" x:Name="scope_combo"
                          Height="24" FontSize="11"
                          VerticalContentAlignment="Center"/>

                <!-- Refresh button — reloads tree for current scope/sort -->
                <Button Grid.Row="0" Grid.RowSpan="2" Grid.Column="2"
                        x:Name="btn_refresh"
                        Content="⟳" Width="34" Height="56"
                        Margin="8,0,0,0" FontSize="18"
                        ToolTip="Refresh — reload for current Display and Sort"
                        Background="#1A6EBF" Foreground="#FFFFFF"
                        BorderThickness="0" Cursor="Hand"/>

                <Border Grid.Row="1" Grid.Column="0"
                        Background="#1A6EBF" CornerRadius="3"
                        Padding="8,0" Margin="0,2,8,0"
                        SnapsToDevicePixels="True">
                    <TextBlock Text="Sort by" FontWeight="SemiBold"
                               Foreground="#FFFFFF" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                               FontSize="11"/>
                </Border>
                <ComboBox Grid.Row="1" Grid.Column="1" x:Name="sort_combo"
                          Height="24" FontSize="11" Margin="0,2,0,0"
                          VerticalContentAlignment="Center"/>
            </Grid>
        </Border>

        <!-- ══ SEARCH ════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
        <Border DockPanel.Dock="Top" Background="#F5F5F5"
                BorderBrush="#DEDEDE" BorderThickness="0,0,0,1" Padding="10,6">
            <Grid>
                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <TextBlock Grid.Column="0" Text="Search:"
                           Foreground="#1A1A1A"
                           VerticalAlignment="Center" FontSize="11"
                           Margin="0,0,8,0"/>
                <TextBox   Grid.Column="1" x:Name="search_box"
                           Height="24" FontSize="11"
                           VerticalContentAlignment="Center" Padding="4,0"
                           BorderBrush="#DEDEDE" BorderThickness="1"/>
                <Button    Grid.Column="2" x:Name="btn_clear"
                           Content="✕" Width="26" Height="24"
                           Margin="6,0,0,0" FontSize="10"
                           Style="{StaticResource SecondaryBtn}"/>
            </Grid>
        </Border>

        <!-- ══ FOOTER ════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
        <Border DockPanel.Dock="Bottom" Background="#F5F5F5"
                BorderBrush="#DEDEDE" BorderThickness="0,1,0,0" Padding="10,8">
            <Grid>
                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# script.py — Entry point only. No logic here.
#
# WHY we import doc/uidoc from pyrevit.revit:
# pyRevit does NOT always inject doc/uidoc as bare globals.
# The safe, reliable way is to import them from pyrevit.revit directly.
# This works in ALL pyRevit engine modes (CPython, IronPython, etc.)

from pyrevit import revit

# revit.doc    = the current Revit Document
# revit.uidoc  = the active UIDocument (gives us ActiveView, Selection, etc.)
doc   = revit.doc
uidoc = revit.uidoc

from CategoryPicker import main
main(doc, uidoc)

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# Script:        CopyState_script.py
# Description:   Copies the state of a desired parameter of the active view
#                to memory. All picker windows use the CLAUDE.md WPF style.
#                Filter Overrides is intercepted to show our styled checkbox
#                window instead of pyRevit's built-in SelectFromList.
# Author:        Jason Braga
# Last Updated:  2026-03-20

                </Trigger>
                <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="#E8F0FB"/>
                </Trigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style>
        <!-- Checkbox list item: hover only, no blue selected bg -->
        <Style x:Key="CheckListBoxItem" TargetType="ListBoxItem">

            <Setter Property="HorizontalContentAlignment" Value="Stretch"/>
            <Setter Property="VerticalContentAlignment"   Value="Center"/>
            <Style.Triggers>
                <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">

            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style>
"""


# =============================================================================

        ResizeMode="CanResizeWithGrip"

# =============================================================================
# SECTION 3 -- XAML: FILTER OVERRIDES PICKER (checkbox multi-select)
# =============================================================================

_FILTER_PICKER_XAML = """

        ShowInTaskbar="False"

        ResizeMode="CanResizeWithGrip"
        WindowStartupLocation="CenterScreen"
        Background="#FFFFFF"
        FontFamily="Segoe UI"
        FontSize="11">
    <Window.Resources>

    </Window.Resources>
    <Grid Margin="16">

        </Grid.RowDefinitions>

                   Text="Filter Overrides"
                   FontSize="14" FontWeight="Bold"

                   Text="Filters in active view:"

</Window>
""".replace('STYLES_PLACEHOLDER', _STYLES)


# =============================================================================
# SECTION 4 -- ACTION PICKER WINDOW CLASS (checkbox multi-select)
# =============================================================================

class ActionPickerWindow(object):
    """
    Checkbox multi-select list for choosing which state actions to run.
    Follows CLAUDE.md: CheckListBoxItem style, SelectionMode=Extended,
    Select All / Clear All bulk buttons, primary button disabled until
    at least one item is ticked.

    result: list of action name strings (the keys into action_options)
    """

    def __init__(self, action_options, title, description, ok_label):
        self._options     = action_options
        self._checked_ids = set()    # set of action name strings that are ticked
        self.result       = []       # list of chosen action names
        self.cancelled    = True

        self._win        = System.Windows.Markup.XamlReader.Parse(_PICKER_XAML)
        self._lst        = self._win.FindName('lst_Actions')
        self._btn_ok     = self._win.FindName('btn_OK')
        self._btn_cancel = self._win.FindName('btn_Cancel')
        self._btn_all    = self._win.FindName('btn_SelectAll')
        self._btn_clear  = self._win.FindName('btn_ClearAll')
        self._txt_title  = self._win.FindName('txt_Title')
        self._txt_desc   = self._win.FindName('txt_Description')

        self._win.Title       = title
        self._txt_title.Text  = title
        self._txt_desc.Text   = description
        self._btn_ok.Content  = ok_label

        # Build one checkbox row per action, sorted alphabetically
        self._names = sorted(action_options.keys())
        for name in self._names:
            cb               = Controls.CheckBox()
            cb.Content       = name
            cb.FontFamily    = System.Windows.Media.FontFamily('Segoe UI')
            cb.FontSize      = 11
            cb.Foreground    = System.Windows.Media.SolidColorBrush(
                                   System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(
                                       0x1A, 0x1A, 0x1A))
            cb.VerticalAlignment = System.Windows.VerticalAlignment.Center
            # Disable hit-testing on the checkbox itself -- the ListBoxItem
            # intercepts the click and we toggle state manually
            cb.IsHitTestVisible = False
            cb.Focusable        = False
            cb.IsChecked        = False

            item         = Controls.ListBoxItem()
            item.Content = cb
            item.Tag     = name   # Tag = action name string
            self._lst.Items.Add(item)

        # Wire up events
        self._lst.PreviewMouseDown += self._on_mouse_down
        self._btn_ok.Click         += self._on_ok
        self._btn_cancel.Click     += self._on_cancel
        self._btn_all.Click        += self._on_select_all
        self._btn_clear.Click      += self._on_clear_all

    def _sync_checkboxes(self):
        """Push _checked_ids state onto every checkbox in the list."""
        for i in range(self._lst.Items.Count):
            item = self._lst.Items.GetItemAt(i)
            if isinstance(item.Content, Controls.CheckBox):
                item.Content.IsChecked = (item.Tag in self._checked_ids)

    def _update_ok(self):
        """Enable OK only when at least one action is ticked."""
        self._btn_ok.IsEnabled = len(self._checked_ids) > 0

    def _on_mouse_down(self, sender, args):
        """Toggle the ticked state of the clicked row."""
        element      = args.OriginalSource
        clicked_item = None
        while element is not None:
            if isinstance(element, Controls.ListBoxItem):
                clicked_item = element
                break
            try:
                element = System.Windows.Media.VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(element)
            except Exception:
                break
        if clicked_item is None:
            return
        name = clicked_item.Tag
        if name in self._checked_ids:
            self._checked_ids.discard(name)
        else:
            self._checked_ids.add(name)
        self._sync_checkboxes()
        self._update_ok()
        args.Handled = True

    def _on_select_all(self, sender, args):
        for name in self._names:
            self._checked_ids.add(name)
        self._sync_checkboxes()
        self._update_ok()

    def _on_clear_all(self, sender, args):
        self._checked_ids.clear()
        self._sync_checkboxes()
        self._update_ok()

    def _on_ok(self, sender, args):
        # Return ticked names in the original sorted order
        self.result    = [n for n in self._names if n in self._checked_ids]
        self.cancelled = False
        # CLAUDE.md: always close window BEFORE any Revit operation
        self._win.Close()

    def _on_cancel(self, sender, args):
        self.cancelled = True
        self._win.Close()

    def show(self):
        self._win.ShowDialog()
        return self


# =============================================================================
# SECTION 5 -- FILTER OVERRIDES PICKER WINDOW CLASS
# =============================================================================

class FilterPickerWindow(object):
    """
    Checkbox list for selecting which view filters to copy.
    Replaces the pyRevit SelectFromList shown by FilterOverridesAction.copy().

    Parameters
    ----------
    view_filters : list of Revit ParameterFilterElement objects
    """

    def __init__(self, view_filters):
        self._filters     = view_filters   # list of filter elements
        self._checked_ids = set()          # set of filter ElementId int values
        self.result       = []             # chosen filter elements
        self.cancelled    = True

        self._win        = System.Windows.Markup.XamlReader.Parse(_FILTER_PICKER_XAML)
        self._lst        = self._win.FindName('lst_Filters')
        self._btn_ok     = self._win.FindName('btn_OK')
        self._btn_cancel = self._win.FindName('btn_Cancel')
        self._btn_all    = self._win.FindName('btn_SelectAll')
        self._btn_clear  = self._win.FindName('btn_ClearAll')

        # Build one checkbox row per filter -- none pre-checked so user
        # consciously selects which filters to copy
        for f in view_filters:
            cb               = Controls.CheckBox()
            cb.Content       = f.Name
            cb.FontFamily    = System.Windows.Media.FontFamily('Segoe UI')
            cb.FontSize      = 11
            cb.Foreground    = System.Windows.Media.SolidColorBrush(
                                   System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(
                                       0x1A, 0x1A, 0x1A))
            cb.VerticalAlignment = System.Windows.VerticalAlignment.Center
            cb.IsHitTestVisible  = False  # list item handles the click
            cb.Focusable         = False
            cb.IsChecked         = False

            item         = Controls.ListBoxItem()
            item.Content = cb
            item.Tag     = f    # Tag stores the filter element
            self._lst.Items.Add(item)

        self._lst.PreviewMouseDown += self._on_mouse_down
        self._btn_ok.Click         += self._on_ok
        self._btn_cancel.Click     += self._on_cancel
        self._btn_all.Click        += self._on_select_all
        self._btn_clear.Click      += self._on_clear_all

    def _get_filter_id_int(self, f):
        """Get a stable integer from a filter ElementId."""
        try:
            return int(f.Id.Value)
        except AttributeError:
            return f.Id.IntegerValue

    def _sync_checkboxes(self):
        for i in range(self._lst.Items.Count):
            item = self._lst.Items.GetItemAt(i)
            fid  = self._get_filter_id_int(item.Tag)
            if isinstance(item.Content, Controls.CheckBox):
                item.Content.IsChecked = (fid in self._checked_ids)

    def _update_ok(self):
        self._btn_ok.IsEnabled = len(self._checked_ids) > 0

    def _on_mouse_down(self, sender, args):
        """Toggle the clicked row's checked state."""
        element      = args.OriginalSource
        clicked_item = None
        while element is not None:
            if isinstance(element, Controls.ListBoxItem):
                clicked_item = element
                break
            try:
                element = System.Windows.Media.VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(element)
            except Exception:
                break

        if clicked_item is None:
            return

        fid = self._get_filter_id_int(clicked_item.Tag)
        if fid in self._checked_ids:
            self._checked_ids.discard(fid)
        else:
            self._checked_ids.add(fid)

        self._sync_checkboxes()
        self._update_ok()
        args.Handled = True

    def _on_select_all(self, sender, args):
        for f in self._filters:
            self._checked_ids.add(self._get_filter_id_int(f))
        self._sync_checkboxes()
        self._update_ok()

    def _on_clear_all(self, sender, args):
        self._checked_ids.clear()
        self._sync_checkboxes()
        self._update_ok()

    def _on_ok(self, sender, args):
        self.result = [f for f in self._filters
                       if self._get_filter_id_int(f) in self._checked_ids]
        self.cancelled = False
        self._win.Close()

    def _on_cancel(self, sender, args):
        self.cancelled = True
        self._win.Close()

    def show(self):
        self._win.ShowDialog()
        return self


_LINK_PICKER_XAML = ("""
<Window xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        Title="Copy State"
        Width="520" Height="540"
        MinWidth="380" MinHeight="340"
        ShowInTaskbar="False"
        Topmost="True"
        ResizeMode="CanResizeWithGrip"
        WindowStartupLocation="CenterScreen"
        Background="#FFFFFF"
        FontFamily="Segoe UI"
        FontSize="11">
    <Window.Resources>
        STYLES_PLACEHOLDER
    </Window.Resources>
    <Grid Margin="16">
        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
            <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
        </Grid.RowDefinitions>
        <TextBlock x:Name="txt_Title" Grid.Row="0"
                   Text="Select Items"
                   FontSize="14" FontWeight="Bold"
                   Foreground="#1A1A1A" Margin="0 0 0 6"/>
        <TextBlock x:Name="txt_Description" Grid.Row="1"
                   Text="Select items to copy."
                   FontSize="11" Foreground="#6B6B6B"
                   TextWrapping="Wrap" Margin="0 0 0 12"/>
        <ListBox x:Name="lst_Items" Grid.Row="2"
                 Style="{StaticResource StandardListBox}"
                 ItemContainerStyle="{StaticResource CheckListBoxItem}"
                 SelectionMode="Extended"/>
        <Grid Grid.Row="3" Margin="0 8 0 0">
            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="8"/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
            <Button x:Name="btn_SelectAll" Grid.Column="0"
                    Content="Select All"
                    Style="{StaticResource SecondaryButton}"/>
            <Button x:Name="btn_ClearAll" Grid.Column="2"
                    Content="Clear All"
                    Style="{StaticResource SecondaryButton}"/>
        </Grid>
        <StackPanel Grid.Row="4" Orientation="Horizontal"
                    HorizontalAlignment="Right" Margin="0 12 0 0">
            <!-- No IsCancel=True here == prevents IronPython 2.7 auto-close bug -->
            <Button x:Name="btn_Cancel" Content="Cancel"
                    Style="{StaticResource SecondaryButton}"

            <Button x:Name="btn_OK" Content="Copy to Memory"
                    Style="{StaticResource PrimaryButton}"
                    IsEnabled="False"/>
        </StackPanel>
    </Grid>
</Window>
""").replace('STYLES_PLACEHOLDER', _STYLES)


# =============================================================================
# SECTION 5b -- LINK ITEM PICKER WINDOW CLASS
# =============================================================================
# Generic checkbox picker for a list of (display_label, int_key) tuples.
# Used by _copy_revit_links() and _copy_dwg_links() to let the user select
# which specific links or DWG categories to copy to memory.
# All items are pre-checked (Select All default) matching pyRevit convention.
# result: set of int_key values for checked items.
#
# Uses _LINK_PICKER_XAML (no IsCancel on Cancel button) to avoid the
# IronPython 2.7 bug where XamlReader.Parse windows with IsCancel=True
# close immediately when ShowDialog() is called.

class LinkItemPickerWindow(object):
    """
    Checkbox multi-select window for a list of (label, int_key) items.
    All items start pre-checked. User unticks what they do not want.

    Parameters
    ----------
    items       : list of (display_label, int_key) tuples, already sorted
    title       : window title bar text and heading
    description : subtitle shown below the heading
    ok_label    : primary button label

    After show():
      self.cancelled -- True if user cancelled
      self.result    -- set of int_key values for checked items
    """

    def __init__(self, items, title, description, ok_label='Copy to Memory'):
        self._items   = items
        self._checked = set(k for _, k in items)   # all pre-checked
        self.result   = set()
        self.cancelled = True

        self._win        = System.Windows.Markup.XamlReader.Parse(_LINK_PICKER_XAML)
        self._lst        = self._win.FindName('lst_Items')
        self._btn_ok     = self._win.FindName('btn_OK')
        self._btn_cancel = self._win.FindName('btn_Cancel')
        self._btn_all    = self._win.FindName('btn_SelectAll')
        self._btn_clear  = self._win.FindName('btn_ClearAll')
        self._txt_title  = self._win.FindName('txt_Title')
        self._txt_desc   = self._win.FindName('txt_Description')

        self._win.Title       = title
        self._txt_title.Text  = title
        self._txt_desc.Text   = description
        self._btn_ok.Content  = ok_label

        # Build one pre-checked checkbox row per item.
        # Tag stores the int_key directly (no id() -- avoids interning collision)
        for label, int_key in items:
            cb               = Controls.CheckBox()
            cb.Content       = label
            cb.FontFamily    = System.Windows.Media.FontFamily('Segoe UI')
            cb.FontSize      = 11
            cb.Foreground    = System.Windows.Media.SolidColorBrush(
                                   System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(
                                       0x1A, 0x1A, 0x1A))
            cb.VerticalAlignment = System.Windows.VerticalAlignment.Center
            cb.IsHitTestVisible  = False   # list item intercepts click
            cb.Focusable         = False
            cb.IsChecked         = True    # all pre-checked

            item         = Controls.ListBoxItem()
            item.Content = cb
            item.Tag     = int_key
            self._lst.Items.Add(item)

        # OK starts enabled because everything is pre-checked
        self._btn_ok.IsEnabled = True

        # Wire Loaded to shift focus away from Cancel (prevents auto-close)
        self._win.Loaded       += self._on_loaded
        self._lst.PreviewMouseDown += self._on_mouse_down
        self._btn_ok.Click         += self._on_ok
        self._btn_cancel.Click     += self._on_cancel
        self._btn_all.Click        += self._on_select_all
        self._btn_clear.Click      += self._on_clear_all

    def _on_loaded(self, sender, args):
        """Move keyboard focus to the list so Cancel cannot auto-fire."""
        try:
            self._lst.Focus()
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _sync_checkboxes(self):
        for i in range(self._lst.Items.Count):
            item = self._lst.Items.GetItemAt(i)
            if isinstance(item.Content, Controls.CheckBox):
                item.Content.IsChecked = (item.Tag in self._checked)

    def _update_ok(self):
        self._btn_ok.IsEnabled = len(self._checked) > 0

    def _on_mouse_down(self, sender, args):
        element      = args.OriginalSource
        clicked_item = None
        while element is not None:
            if isinstance(element, Controls.ListBoxItem):
                clicked_item = element
                break
            try:
                element = System.Windows.Media.VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(element)
            except Exception:
                break
        if clicked_item is None:
            return
        key = clicked_item.Tag
        if key in self._checked:
            self._checked.discard(key)
        else:
            self._checked.add(key)
        self._sync_checkboxes()
        self._update_ok()
        args.Handled = True

    def _on_select_all(self, sender, args):
        for _, k in self._items:
            self._checked.add(k)
        self._sync_checkboxes()
        self._update_ok()

    def _on_clear_all(self, sender, args):
        self._checked.clear()
        self._sync_checkboxes()
        self._update_ok()

    def _on_ok(self, sender, args):
        self.result    = set(self._checked)
        self.cancelled = False
        self._win.Close()

    def _on_cancel(self, sender, args):
        self.cancelled = True
        self._win.Close()

    def show(self):
        self._win.ShowDialog()
        return self
