```python
# =============================================================================
# SECTION 6c -- PROPAGATE EXTENTS COPY HANDLER
# =============================================================================

def _copy_propagate_extents():
    """
    Store the active view as the HOST view for Propagate Extents.
    At paste time the user picks TARGET views and the propagation runs.

    Only valid on plan/section/elevation/detail views -- same validation
    as the standalone Propagate Extents Override tool.
    """
    active_view = revit.active_view

    VALID_TYPES = [
        DB.ViewType.FloorPlan, DB.ViewType.CeilingPlan,
        DB.ViewType.EngineeringPlan, DB.ViewType.AreaPlan,
        DB.ViewType.Section, DB.ViewType.Elevation, DB.ViewType.Detail,
    ]

    if active_view.ViewType not in VALID_TYPES:
        forms.alert(
            'Propagate Extents is only valid for plan, section, '
            'elevation and detail views.\n\n'
            'Active view type: ' + str(active_view.ViewType),
            title='Copy State'
        )
        return

    try:
        try:
            view_id_int = int(active_view.Id.Value)
        except AttributeError:
            view_id_int = active_view.Id.IntegerValue
    except Exception as e:
        forms.alert('Could not read view Id.\n\nDetail: ' + str(e),
                    title='Copy State')
        return

    script.store_data(
        slot_name=PROPAGATE_EXTENTS_SLOT,
        data={
            'host_view_name': active_view.Name,
            'host_view_id':   view_id_int,
        }
    )

    forms.alert(
        'Propagate Extents host copied to memory.\n\n'
        'Host view: ' + active_view.Name + '\n\n'
        'Now go to the target view and run Paste State > '
        'Propagate Extents to apply.',
        title='Copy State'
    )


# =============================================================================
# SECTION 6b -- ANNOTATIONS COPY HANDLER
# =============================================================================

def _copy_annotations():
    """
    Store the active view's ElementId so _paste_annotations() knows
    which view to collect annotation elements from.

    We don't collect elements here -- we collect at paste time so the
    user can copy once and paste into multiple views in sequence.
    """
    active_view = revit.active_view

    from Autodesk.Revit.DB import (
        FilteredElementCollector,
        BuiltInCategory,
        IndependentTag,
        SpatialElementTag,
    )

    doc = revit.doc
    vid = active_view.Id

    # Tags: use class-based collectors so ALL tag subcategories are captured.
    # OST_Tags only catches generic tags -- wall tags, slab tags, structural
    # tags etc. each live in their own subcategory. IndependentTag covers them
    # all. SpatialElementTag covers room/area/space tags separately.
    try:
        tag_count = (
            FilteredElementCollector(doc, vid)
            .OfClass(IndependentTag)
            .GetElementCount()
        )
    except Exception:
        tag_count = 0

    try:
        spatial_tag_count = (
            FilteredElementCollector(doc, vid)
            .OfClass(SpatialElementTag)
            .GetElementCount()
        )
    except Exception:
        spatial_tag_count = 0

    total_tags = tag_count + spatial_tag_count

    # Non-tag annotations: collected by category (these don't have subtype issues)
    OTHER_CATS = [
        (BuiltInCategory.OST_TextNotes,        'Text Notes'),
        (BuiltInCategory.OST_Dimensions,       'Dimensions'),
        (BuiltInCategory.OST_DetailComponents, 'Detail Components'),
        (BuiltInCategory.OST_Lines,            'Detail Lines'),
    ]

    counts = []
    total  = total_tags
    if total_tags > 0:
        counts.append('Tags (all types): ' + str(total_tags))

    for bic, label in OTHER_CATS:
        try:
            n = (FilteredElementCollector(doc, vid)
                 .OfCategory(bic)
                 .WhereElementIsNotElementType()
                 .GetElementCount())
        except Exception:
            n = 0
        if n > 0:
            counts.append(label + ': ' + str(n))
            total += n

    if total == 0:
        forms.alert(
            'No annotation elements found in the active view.',
            title='Copy State'
        )
        return

    # Store source view id int (stable across Revit versions)
    try:
        view_id_int = int(active_view.Id.Value)
    except AttributeError:
        view_id_int = active_view.Id.IntegerValue

    script.store_data(
        slot_name=ANNOTATIONS_SLOT,
        data={
            'source_view_name': active_view.Name,
            'source_view_id':   view_id_int,
        }
    )

    forms.alert(
        'Annotations copied to memory.\n\n'
        'Source view: ' + active_view.Name + '\n\n'
        'Found:\n  ' + '\n  '.join(counts),
        title='Copy State'
    )


# =============================================================================
# SECTION 6 -- SCOPE BOX COPY HANDLER
# =============================================================================

def _copy_scope_box():
    """
    Copy the Scope Box assignment from the active view to memory.

    Stores both the scope box NAME and ElementId integer.
    Name is used as the primary lookup at paste time (robust across
    sessions and Revit versions). Integer is a fallback.
    """
    from Autodesk.Revit.DB import BuiltInParameter

    active_view = revit.active_view

    sb_param = active_view.get_Parameter(
        BuiltInParameter.VIEWER_VOLUME_OF_INTEREST_CROP)

    if sb_param is None:
        forms.alert(
            'The active view does not support Scope Box assignment.',
            title='Copy State'
        )
        return

    sb_id = sb_param.AsElementId()

    # Get stable int value across Revit 2022/2023/2024
    try:
        sb_id_int = int(sb_id.Value)       # Revit 2024+
    except AttributeError:
        sb_id_int = sb_id.IntegerValue     # Revit 2022/2023

    # Get the scope box element name -- primary lookup key at paste time
    if sb_id_int == -1:
        sb_name    = ''
        sb_display = '(none assigned)'
    else:
        sb_elem = revit.doc.GetElement(sb_id)
        if sb_elem is None:
            forms.alert(
                'Could not read the scope box element from the active view.',
                title='Copy State'
            )
            return
        sb_name    = sb_elem.Name
        sb_display = sb_name

    script.store_data(
        slot_name=SCOPE_BOX_SLOT,
        data={
            'source_view_name': active_view.Name,
            'sb_name':          sb_name,     # primary: look up by name on paste
            'sb_id_int':        sb_id_int,   # fallback: direct Id lookup
        }
    )

    forms.alert(
        'Scope Box copied to memory.\n\n'
        'Source view:  ' + active_view.Name + '\n'
        'Scope Box:    ' + sb_display,
        title='Copy State'
    )


def _copy_filter_overrides():
    """
    Replaces FilterOverridesAction.copy() entirely.

    Replicates the same logic -- get the active view's filters, show a picker,
    then store the selected filter ids using script.store_data with the same
    slot name ('FilterOverridesAction') that paste() expects -- but uses our
    styled window instead of pyRevit's SelectFromList.
    """
    # Get the active graphical view (same logic as FilterOverridesAction)
    active_view = revit.uidoc.ActiveGraphicalView
    if active_view is None:
        forms.alert('No active graphical view found.', title='Copy State')
        return

    # Get filters applied to this view via pyRevit's helper
    view_filters = revit.query.get_view_filters(active_view)
    if not view_filters:
        forms.alert(
            'The active view has no filters applied.\n\n'
            'Apply at least one filter via Visibility/Graphics first.',
            title='Copy State'
        )
        return

    # Show our styled filter picker
    win = FilterPickerWindow(view_filters)
    win.show()

    if win.cancelled or not win.result:
        return   # user cancelled -- silent exit

    selected_filters = win.result

    # Store using the same slot name FilterOverridesAction.paste() reads from.
    # We import the data class directly from the actions module so the stored
    # object is exactly the same type paste() expects to deserialise.
    from copypastestate.actions import FilterOverridesData

    script.store_data(
        slot_name='FilterOverridesAction',
        data=FilterOverridesData(
            source_viewid=active_view.Id,
            filter_ids=[f.Id for f in selected_filters]
        ),
    )

# This section handles copying a viewport's title type and label offset from

# It is only available when the active view is a DrawingSheet.

#   Viewport.GetTypeId()  -- returns the ElementId of the viewport type
#                            (the FamilySymbol that controls the title family).
#   Viewport.LabelOffset  -- a UV (2D sheet coordinates, in feet) that controls

_VP_TITLE_SOURCE_XAML = ("""

    </Window.Resources>

        <!-- Description -->
        <TextBlock Grid.Row="1"

        <!-- Search box: live filter -->
        <TextBox x:Name="txt_Search" Grid.Row="2"
                 Height="28" Padding="8 0"

                      Content="Copy title position"

class ViewportSourcePickerWindow(object):
    """
    WPF dialog that lists all viewports on the active sheet.
    The user picks ONE (single-select) to use as the copy source.

    After show():
      self.cancelled     -- True if user cancelled or closed window
      self.result_vp     -- the chosen Viewport element (or None)
      self.copy_type     -- True if 'Copy title type' checkbox is ticked
      self.copy_position -- True if 'Copy title position' checkbox is ticked
    """

    def __init__(self, viewports):
        from Autodesk.Revit.DB import Viewport as _Viewport

        self._all_viewports = viewports
        self._win    = System.Windows.Markup.XamlReader.Parse(_VP_TITLE_SOURCE_XAML)
        self._lst    = self._win.FindName('lst_Viewports')
        self._search = self._win.FindName('txt_Search')
        self._btn_ok = self._win.FindName('btn_OK')
        self._btn_cancel = self._win.FindName('btn_Cancel')
        self._chk_type   = self._win.FindName('chk_Type')
        self._chk_pos    = self._win.FindName('chk_Position')

        self.cancelled     = True
        self.result_vp     = None
        self.copy_type     = True
        self.copy_position = True

        self._populate(viewports)
        self._lst.SelectionChanged += self._on_selection_changed
        self._search.TextChanged   += self._on_search_changed
        self._btn_ok.Click         += self._on_ok
        self._btn_cancel.Click     += self._on_cancel

    def _vp_label(self, vp):
        """Build 'View Name  [Type Name]' label for a viewport.

        FamilySymbol.Name can throw AttributeError in IronPython 2.7 when
        accessed directly. We use get_Parameter(BuiltInParameter.SYMBOL_NAME_PARAM)
        first, then fall back to the ALL_MODEL_TYPE_NAME parameter, and finally
        try the raw .Name property inside a try/except so we always get a string.
        """
        from Autodesk.Revit.DB import BuiltInParameter
        doc = revit.doc

        # -- View name --------------------------------------------------------
        view = doc.GetElement(vp.ViewId)
        try:
            vname = view.Name if view is not None else '(unknown view)'
        except Exception:
            vname = '(unknown view)'

        # -- Viewport type name -----------------------------------------------
        vtype = doc.GetElement(vp.GetTypeId())
        tname = '(unknown type)'
        if vtype is not None:
            # Try SYMBOL_NAME_PARAM first (works on FamilySymbol in all versions)
            try:
                p = vtype.get_Parameter(BuiltInParameter.SYMBOL_NAME_PARAM)
                if p is not None:
                    val = p.AsString()
                    if val:
                        tname = val
            except Exception:
                pass
            # Fallback: ALL_MODEL_TYPE_NAME
            if tname == '(unknown type)':
                try:
                    p = vtype.get_Parameter(BuiltInParameter.ALL_MODEL_TYPE_NAME)
                    if p is not None:
                        val = p.AsString()
                        if val:
                            tname = val
                except Exception:
                    pass
            # Last resort: raw .Name (may work on some element subclasses)
            if tname == '(unknown type)':
                try:
                    tname = str(vtype.Name)
                except Exception:
                    pass

        return u'{0}  [{1}]'.format(vname, tname)

    def _populate(self, viewports):
        self._lst.Items.Clear()
        search = ''
        try:
            search = self._search.Text.strip().lower()
        except Exception:
            pass
        for vp in viewports:
            label = self._vp_label(vp)
            if search and search not in label.lower():
                continue
            item         = Controls.ListBoxItem()
            item.Content = label
            item.Tag     = vp
            self._lst.Items.Add(item)

    def _on_search_changed(self, sender, args):
        self._populate(self._all_viewports)
        self._btn_ok.IsEnabled = (self._lst.SelectedItem is not None)

    def _on_selection_changed(self, sender, args):
        self._btn_ok.IsEnabled = (self._lst.SelectedItem is not None)

    def _on_ok(self, sender, args):
        selected = self._lst.SelectedItem
        if selected is None:
            return
        self.result_vp     = selected.Tag
        self.copy_type     = bool(self._chk_type.IsChecked)
        self.copy_position = bool(self._chk_pos.IsChecked)
        self.cancelled     = False
        self._win.Close()

    def _on_cancel(self, sender, args):
        self.cancelled = True
        self._win.Close()

    def show(self):
        self._win.ShowDialog()


def _copy_viewport_title():
    """
    Copy the title type and/or label offset from one viewport on the active
    sheet into pyRevit memory under VP_TITLE_SLOT.

    Only available when the active view is a DrawingSheet (the action is
    only offered in the picker when that condition is met -- see MAIN LOGIC).
    """
    from Autodesk.Revit.DB import ViewSheet as _ViewSheet

    doc         = revit.doc
    active_view = revit.active_view

    # Confirm the active view is a sheet
    if str(active_view.ViewType) != 'DrawingSheet':
        forms.alert(
            'Viewport Title can only be copied while a sheet is active.\n\n'
            'Open a sheet and try again.',
            title='Copy State'
        )
        return

    # Collect viewports on the active sheet
    vp_ids = active_view.GetAllViewports()
    viewports = []
    for vid in vp_ids:
        vp = doc.GetElement(vid)
        if vp is not None:
            viewports.append(vp)

    if not viewports:
        forms.alert(
            'The active sheet has no viewports to copy from.',
            title='Copy State'
        )
        return

    # Show the source picker
    win = ViewportSourcePickerWindow(viewports)
    win.show()
    if win.cancelled or win.result_vp is None:
        return

    if not win.copy_type and not win.copy_position:
        forms.alert(
            'Please tick at least one option:\n'
            '  "Copy title type"  or  "Copy title position".',
            title='Copy State'
        )
        return

    chosen_vp = win.result_vp

    # Read the viewport type ElementId (safe across Revit 2022/2023/2024)
    vp_type_id = chosen_vp.GetTypeId()
    try:
        vp_type_id_int = int(vp_type_id.Value)
    except AttributeError:
        vp_type_id_int = vp_type_id.IntegerValue

    vp_type_elem = doc.GetElement(vp_type_id)
    # Safe type name read -- FamilySymbol.Name throws in IronPython 2.7
    vp_type_name = '(unknown)'
    if vp_type_elem is not None:
        from Autodesk.Revit.DB import BuiltInParameter as _BIP
        try:
            p = vp_type_elem.get_Parameter(_BIP.SYMBOL_NAME_PARAM)
            if p is not None and p.AsString():
                vp_type_name = p.AsString()
        except Exception:
            pass
        if vp_type_name == '(unknown)':
            try:
                p = vp_type_elem.get_Parameter(_BIP.ALL_MODEL_TYPE_NAME)
                if p is not None and p.AsString():
                    vp_type_name = p.AsString()
            except Exception:
                pass
        if vp_type_name == '(unknown)':
            try:
                vp_type_name = str(vp_type_elem.Name)
            except Exception:
                pass

    # Read the label offset -- LabelOffset returns XYZ (not UV) in the Revit API.
    # We store X and Y (the sheet plane coordinates in feet). Z is always 0.
    label_offset = chosen_vp.LabelOffset
    label_u = float(label_offset.X)
    label_v = float(label_offset.Y)

    # Get source view name for the confirmation message
    source_view = doc.GetElement(chosen_vp.ViewId)
    source_name = source_view.Name if source_view is not None else '(unknown)'

    # Store data in pyRevit memory using the shared slot name
    script.store_data(
        slot_name=VP_TITLE_SLOT,
        data={
            'source_sheet_name' : active_view.Name,
            'source_view_name'  : source_name,
            'vp_type_id_int'    : vp_type_id_int,
            'vp_type_name'      : vp_type_name,
            'label_u'           : label_u,
            'label_v'           : label_v,
            'copy_type'         : win.copy_type,
            'copy_position'     : win.copy_position,
        }
    )

    # Build confirmation message showing only what was captured
    parts = []
    if win.copy_type:
        parts.append('Title type:      ' + vp_type_name)
    if win.copy_position:
        parts.append('Title position:  U={0:.4f}  V={1:.4f} (ft)'.format(label_u, label_v))

    forms.alert(
        'Viewport Title copied to memory.\n\n'
        'Source sheet:  ' + active_view.Name + '\n'
        'Source view:   ' + source_name + '\n\n'
        + '\n'.join(parts) +
        '\n\nRun Paste State > Viewport Title on another sheet to apply.',
        title='Copy State'
    )


# =============================================================================
# SECTION 6e -- REVIT LINKS COPY HANDLER
# =============================================================================
# Reads per-instance link visibility and overrides DIRECTLY from the view,
# bypassing the view template include state entirely.
#
# Revit API notes:
#   view.GetLinkOverrides(ElementId) -- returns RevitLinkGraphicsSettings for
#       either a RevitLinkType or RevitLinkInstance. This always returns the
#       view's own stored value, even when a template controls the category.
#   RevitLinkGraphicsSettings.LinkVisibility -- enum:
#       ByHostView, ByLinkedView, Custom, Hidden
#       This is the actual "visibility tick" state -- NOT element.IsHidden().


def _copy_revit_links():
    """
    Copy per-instance Revit Link visibility and overrides from the active view
    directly into pyRevit memory.

    Reads GetLinkOverrides() on every RevitLinkInstance so the data reflects
    what is ACTUALLY shown in the view's VG Revit Links tab regardless of
    whether a view template is assigned or whether the template's include
    checkbox for Revit Links is on or off.
    """
    from Autodesk.Revit.DB import (
        FilteredElementCollector,
        RevitLinkType,
        RevitLinkInstance,
        BuiltInParameter,
    )

    doc         = revit.doc
    active_view = revit.active_view

    if active_view is None:
        forms.alert('No active view found.', title='Copy State')
        return

    # -- Collect all link types for display names ----------------------------
    type_names = {}   # type_id_int -> display name string
    try:
        for lt in FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfClass(RevitLinkType).ToElements():
            try:
                try:
                    type_int = int(lt.Id.Value)
                except AttributeError:
                    type_int = lt.Id.IntegerValue
                display = None
                try:
                    p = lt.get_Parameter(BuiltInParameter.ALL_MODEL_TYPE_NAME)
                    if p:
                        display = p.AsString()
                except Exception:
                    pass
                if not display:
                    try:
                        display = lt.Name
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                if not display:
                    display = 'Link Id: ' + str(type_int)
                type_names[type_int] = display
            except Exception:
                pass
    except Exception:
        pass

    # -- Collect per-instance overrides directly from the view ---------------
    # We read GetLinkOverrides() on both the type and instance.
    # Type-level: controls Halftone, Underlay, Display Settings by default.
    # Instance-level: per-placed-instance overrides on top of the type level.

    link_data = {}   # keyed by instance_id_int

    try:
        all_instances = FilteredElementCollector(doc)\
            .OfClass(RevitLinkInstance)\
            .ToElements()

        for inst in all_instances:
            try:
                try:
                    inst_int = int(inst.Id.Value)
                except AttributeError:
                    inst_int = inst.Id.IntegerValue

                type_id = inst.GetTypeId()
                try:
                    type_int = int(type_id.Value)
                except AttributeError:
                    type_int = type_id.IntegerValue

                display_name = type_names.get(type_int, 'Link Id: ' + str(type_int))

                # Read instance-level overrides directly from the view
                inst_gs = None
                try:
                    inst_gs = active_view.GetLinkOverrides(inst.Id)
                except Exception:
                    pass

                # Read type-level overrides directly from the view
                type_gs = None
                try:
                    type_gs = active_view.GetLinkOverrides(type_id)
                except Exception:
                    pass

                # Serialise RevitLinkGraphicsSettings to plain dict.
                # LinkVisibility is the visibility tick: ByHostView/ByLinkedView/Custom/Hidden
                def _gs_to_dict(gs):
                    if gs is None:
                        return None
                    d = {}
                    try:
                        d['link_visibility'] = str(gs.LinkVisibility)
                    except Exception:
                        d['link_visibility'] = 'ByHostView'
                    try:
                        d['is_halftone'] = bool(gs.IsHalftone)
                    except Exception:
                        d['is_halftone'] = False
                    try:
                        d['is_underlay'] = bool(gs.IsUnderlay)
                    except Exception:
                        d['is_underlay'] = False
                    # Display mode is part of LinkVisibility enum, already captured above
                    return d

                link_data[inst_int] = {
                    'display_name'  : display_name,
                    'type_id_int'   : type_int,
                    'instance_gs'   : _gs_to_dict(inst_gs),
                    'type_gs'       : _gs_to_dict(type_gs),
                }

            except Exception:
                pass

    except Exception as ex:
        forms.alert(
            'Could not read Revit Link data from the active view.\n\nDetail: ' + str(ex),
            title='Copy State'
        )
        return

    if not link_data:
        forms.alert(
            'No Revit Links found in this project.',
            title='Copy State'
        )
        return

    # -- Show picker so user selects which links to include ------------------
    # Build sorted list of (display_name, inst_id_int) for the picker.
    picker_items = sorted(
        [(v['display_name'], k) for k, v in link_data.items()],
        key=lambda x: x[0]
    )

    picker = LinkItemPickerWindow(
        items       = picker_items,
        title       = 'Revit Links',
        description = 'Select which Revit Links to copy to memory. All are pre-selected.',
        ok_label    = 'Copy to Memory'
    )
    picker.show()

    if picker.cancelled:
        return

    # Filter link_data to only the chosen instance ids
    chosen_inst_ids = picker.result
    link_data = {k: v for k, v in link_data.items() if k in chosen_inst_ids}

    if not link_data:
        forms.alert('No links selected.', title='Copy State')
        return

    try:
        view_id_int = int(active_view.Id.Value)
    except AttributeError:
        view_id_int = active_view.Id.IntegerValue

    script.store_data(
        slot_name=RVT_LINKS_SLOT,
        data={
            'source_view_name' : active_view.Name,
            'source_view_id'   : view_id_int,
            'link_data'        : link_data,
        }
    )

    forms.alert(
        'Revit Links copied to memory.\n\n'
        'Source view:  ' + active_view.Name + '\n'
        'Links stored: ' + str(len(link_data)) + '\n\n'
        'Run Paste State > Revit Links to apply.',
        title='Copy State'
    )


# =============================================================================
# SECTION 6f -- DWG LINKS COPY HANDLER
# =============================================================================
# Reads per-category imported (DWG/DXF/SAT) visibility and graphic overrides
# DIRECTLY from the view, bypassing any view template include state.
#
# Revit API notes:
#   view.GetCategoryHidden(categoryId) -- view's own hidden flag for that cat.
#   view.GetCategoryOverrides(categoryId) -- view's own OverrideGraphicSettings.
#   These always return the VIEW's own stored value, not the template's.
#   CategoryType.Internal covers ImportInstance categories (DWG rows in VG).


def _copy_dwg_links():
    """
    Copy imported category (DWG/DXF) visibility and overrides from the active
    view directly into pyRevit memory.

    Reads GetCategoryHidden() and GetCategoryOverrides() on every Internal
    category so the data reflects the view's VG Imported Categories tab
    regardless of view template include state.
    """
    from Autodesk.Revit.DB import (
        CategoryType,
        OverrideGraphicSettings,
    )

    doc         = revit.doc
    active_view = revit.active_view

    if active_view is None:
        forms.alert('No active view found.', title='Copy State')
        return

    cat_data = {}   # cat_id_int -> dict of state

    try:
        for cat in doc.Settings.Categories:
            try:
                if cat.CategoryType != CategoryType.Internal:
                    continue

                try:
                    cat_int = int(cat.Id.Value)
                except AttributeError:
                    cat_int = cat.Id.IntegerValue

                hidden = False
                try:
                    hidden = bool(active_view.GetCategoryHidden(cat.Id))
                except Exception:
                    pass

                # Serialise OverrideGraphicSettings to a plain dict.
                # We capture the key line/pattern/colour overrides.
                ogs = None
                try:
                    ogs = active_view.GetCategoryOverrides(cat.Id)
                except Exception:
                    pass

                def _ogs_to_dict(o):
                    if o is None:
                        return {}
                    d = {}
                    try: d['halftone']         = bool(o.Halftone)
                    except Exception: pass
                    try: d['transparency']      = int(o.Transparency)
                    except Exception: pass
                    # Projection line colour
                    try:
                        c = o.ProjectionLineColor
                        d['proj_line_color'] = (c.Red, c.Green, c.Blue, bool(c.IsValid))
                    except Exception: pass
                    try: d['proj_line_weight']  = int(o.ProjectionLineWeight)
                    except Exception: pass
                    try:
                        p = o.ProjectionLinePatternId
                        try:    d['proj_line_pattern_id'] = int(p.Value)
                        except: d['proj_line_pattern_id'] = p.IntegerValue
                    except Exception: pass
                    # Cut line colour
                    try:
                        c = o.CutLineColor
                        d['cut_line_color'] = (c.Red, c.Green, c.Blue, bool(c.IsValid))
                    except Exception: pass
                    try: d['cut_line_weight']   = int(o.CutLineWeight)
                    except Exception: pass
                    try:
                        p = o.CutLinePatternId
                        try:    d['cut_line_pattern_id'] = int(p.Value)
                        except: d['cut_line_pattern_id'] = p.IntegerValue
                    except Exception: pass
                    # Surface patterns
                    try:
                        c = o.SurfaceForegroundPatternColor
                        d['surf_fg_color'] = (c.Red, c.Green, c.Blue, bool(c.IsValid))
                    except Exception: pass
                    try:
                        p = o.SurfaceForegroundPatternId
                        try:    d['surf_fg_pattern_id'] = int(p.Value)
                        except: d['surf_fg_pattern_id'] = p.IntegerValue
                    except Exception: pass
                    return d

                cat_data[cat_int] = {
                    'name'   : cat.Name,
                    'hidden' : hidden,
                    'ogs'    : _ogs_to_dict(ogs),
                }

            except Exception:
                pass

    except Exception as ex:
        forms.alert(
            'Could not read DWG/Imported category data.\n\nDetail: ' + str(ex),
            title='Copy State'
        )
        return

    if not cat_data:
        forms.alert(
            'No imported DWG/DXF categories found in the active view.',
            title='Copy State'
        )
        return

    # -- Show picker so user selects which DWG categories to include ---------
    picker_items = sorted(
        [(v['name'], k) for k, v in cat_data.items()],
        key=lambda x: x[0]
    )

    picker = LinkItemPickerWindow(
        items       = picker_items,
        title       = 'DWG Links',
        description = 'Select which imported DWG / CAD files to copy to memory. All are pre-selected.',
        ok_label    = 'Copy to Memory'
    )
    picker.show()

    if picker.cancelled:
        return

    chosen_cat_ids = picker.result
    cat_data = {k: v for k, v in cat_data.items() if k in chosen_cat_ids}

    if not cat_data:
        forms.alert('No DWG categories selected.', title='Copy State')
        return

    try:
        view_id_int = int(active_view.Id.Value)
    except AttributeError:
        view_id_int = active_view.Id.IntegerValue

    script.store_data(
        slot_name=DWG_LINKS_SLOT,
        data={
            'source_view_name' : active_view.Name,
            'source_view_id'   : view_id_int,
            'cat_data'         : cat_data,
        }
    )

    forms.alert(
        'DWG Links copied to memory.\n\n'
        'Source view:      ' + active_view.Name + '\n'
        'Categories stored: ' + str(len(cat_data)) + '\n\n'
        'Run Paste State > DWG Links to apply.',
        title='Copy State'
    )


# =============================================================================
# SECTION 7 -- MAIN LOGIC
# =============================================================================

available_actions = [
    x for x in copypastestate.get_actions() if x.validate_context()
]

if not available_actions:
    forms.alert(
        'No copy actions are available for this view type.\n\n'
        'Switch to a plan, section, elevation or 3D view and try again.',
        title='Copy State'
    )

else:
    # Build real action options from copypastestate
    action_options = {x.name: x for x in available_actions}

    # Inject Scope Box as a synthetic action alongside the real ones.
    # It has no copypastestate class -- we handle it entirely ourselves.
    class _SyntheticAction(object):
        def __init__(self, name):
            self.name = name

    action_options[SCOPE_BOX_ACTION_NAME]       = _SyntheticAction(SCOPE_BOX_ACTION_NAME)
    action_options[ANNOTATIONS_ACTION_NAME]     = _SyntheticAction(ANNOTATIONS_ACTION_NAME)
    action_options[PROPAGATE_EXTENTS_NAME]      = _SyntheticAction(PROPAGATE_EXTENTS_NAME)
    # Viewport Title: only meaningful on a drawing sheet -- always offer it and
    # let _copy_viewport_title() do the sheet-context check itself so the user
    # gets a clear error message rather than the action just disappearing.
    action_options[VP_TITLE_ACTION_NAME]        = _SyntheticAction(VP_TITLE_ACTION_NAME)
    # Revit Links and DWG Links: read directly from view, bypassing template
    action_options[RVT_LINKS_ACTION_NAME]       = _SyntheticAction(RVT_LINKS_ACTION_NAME)
    action_options[DWG_LINKS_ACTION_NAME]       = _SyntheticAction(DWG_LINKS_ACTION_NAME)

    win = ActionPickerWindow(
        action_options,
        title='Copy State',
        description='Select the view property to copy to memory.',
        ok_label='Copy to Memory'
    )
    win.show()

    if not win.cancelled and win.result:
        # win.result is a list -- loop and run each chosen action in order
        for chosen_name in win.result:

            if chosen_name == SCOPE_BOX_ACTION_NAME:
                _copy_scope_box()

            elif chosen_name == ANNOTATIONS_ACTION_NAME:
                _copy_annotations()

            elif chosen_name == PROPAGATE_EXTENTS_NAME:
                _copy_propagate_extents()

            elif chosen_name == FILTER_ACTION_NAME:
                _copy_filter_overrides()

            elif chosen_name == VP_TITLE_ACTION_NAME:
                _copy_viewport_title()

            elif chosen_name == RVT_LINKS_ACTION_NAME:
                _copy_revit_links()

            elif chosen_name == DWG_LINKS_ACTION_NAME:
                _copy_dwg_links()

            else:
                # All other actions use the original copy() unchanged
                action = action_options[chosen_name]
                try:
                    action().copy()
                except PyRevitException as ex:
                    forms.alert(str(ex.msg), title='Copy State')
                except Exception as ex:
                    forms.alert(
                        'Copy failed for "' + chosen_name + '".\n\n'
                        'Detail: ' + str(ex),
                        title='Copy State'
                    )
```

```python
"""Copy/Paste State Actions"""

# pylint: disable=import-error,invalid-name,broad-except,superfluous-parens
import math

from pyrevit import PyRevitException
from pyrevit import revit, DB
from pyrevit.framework import List
from pyrevit.coreutils import logger
from pyrevit.coreutils import moduleutils
from pyrevit.coreutils import pyutils
from pyrevit import forms
from pyrevit import script

from copypastestate import basetypes


mlogger = logger.get_logger(__name__)


# =============================================================================


class ViewZoomPanStateData(object):
    def __init__(self, view_type, corner_pts, dir_orient):
        self._view_type = revit.serialize(view_type)
        self._corner_pts = [revit.serialize(x) for x in corner_pts]
        self._dir_orient = revit.serialize(dir_orient)

    @property
    def view_type(self):
        return self._view_type.deserialize()

    @property
    def corner_pts(self):
        return [x.deserialize() for x in self._corner_pts]

    @property
    def dir_orient(self):
        return self._dir_orient.deserialize()


@moduleutils.mark(basetypes.COPYPASTE_MARKER_PROPNAME)
class ViewZoomPanStateAction(basetypes.CopyPasteStateAction):
    name = "View Zoom/Pan State"
    invalid_context_msg = "Type of active view is not supported"
    this_project = False

    def copy(self):
        active_view = revit.active_view
        active_ui_view = revit.uidoc.GetOpenUIViews()[0]

        dir_orient = None
        if isinstance(revit.active_view, DB.View3D):
            dir_orient = revit.active_view.GetOrientation()
        elif isinstance(revit.active_view, DB.ViewSection):
            dir_orient = revit.active_view.ViewDirection

        script.store_data(
            slot_name=self.__class__.__name__,
            data=ViewZoomPanStateData(
                view_type=active_view.ViewType,
                corner_pts=active_ui_view.GetZoomCorners(),
                dir_orient=dir_orient,
            ),
            this_project=False,
        )

    def paste(self):
        # load data
        vzps_data = script.load_data(
            slot_name=self.__class__.__name__, this_project=False
        )

        view_type = vzps_data.view_type
        vc1, vc2 = vzps_data.corner_pts
        dir_orient = vzps_data.dir_orient

        active_ui_view = revit.uidoc.GetOpenUIViews()[0]
        if not self.is_compatible_viewtype(revit.active_view, view_type):
            raise PyRevitException(
                "Saved view type (%s) is different from active view (%s)"
                % (vzps_data.view_type, type(revit.active_view).ViewType)
            )
        # load ViewOrientation3D
        if isinstance(revit.active_view, DB.View3D):
            if revit.active_view.IsLocked:
                raise PyRevitException("Current view orientation is locked")
            revit.active_view.SetOrientation(dir_orient)
        elif isinstance(revit.active_view, DB.ViewSection):
            angle = dir_orient.AngleTo(revit.active_view.ViewDirection)
            if not pyutils.almost_equal(angle, math.pi) and not pyutils.almost_equal(
                angle, 0
            ):
                raise PyRevitException("Views are not parallel")
        active_ui_view.ZoomAndCenterRectangle(vc1, vc2)

    @staticmethod
    def validate_context():
        return revit.get_selection().is_empty and isinstance(
            revit.active_view,
            (DB.ViewPlan, DB.ViewSection, DB.View3D, DB.ViewSheet, DB.ViewDrafting),
        )


# =============================================================================


class SectionBox3DStateData(object):
    def __init__(self, section_box, view_orientation):
        self._section_box = revit.serialize(section_box)
        self._view_orientation = revit.serialize(view_orientation)

    @property
    def section_box(self):
        return self._section_box.deserialize()

    @property
    def view_orientation(self):
        return self._view_orientation.deserialize()


@moduleutils.mark(basetypes.COPYPASTE_MARKER_PROPNAME)
class SectionBox3DStateAction(basetypes.CopyPasteStateAction):
    name = "3D Section Box State"
    invalid_context_msg = "You must be on a 3D view to copy and paste 3D section box."
    this_project = False

    def copy(self):
        section_box = revit.active_view.GetSectionBox()
        view_orientation = revit.active_view.GetOrientation()

        script.store_data(
            slot_name=self.__class__.__name__,
            data=SectionBox3DStateData(
                section_box=section_box, view_orientation=view_orientation
            ),
            this_project=False,
        )

    def paste(self):
        sb3d_data = script.load_data(
            slot_name=self.__class__.__name__, this_project=False
        )

        active_ui_view = revit.uidoc.GetOpenUIViews()[0]
        with revit.Transaction("Paste Section Box Settings"):
            revit.active_view.SetSectionBox(sb3d_data.section_box)
            revit.active_view.SetOrientation(sb3d_data.view_orientation)
        active_ui_view.ZoomToFit()

    @staticmethod
    def validate_context():
        return isinstance(revit.active_view, DB.View3D)


# =============================================================================


class VisibilityGraphicsData(object):
    def __init__(self, source_viewid):
        self._source_viewid = revit.serialize(source_viewid)

    @property
    def source_viewid(self):
        return self._source_viewid.deserialize()


@moduleutils.mark(basetypes.COPYPASTE_MARKER_PROPNAME)
class VisibilityGraphicsAction(basetypes.CopyPasteStateAction):
    name = "Visibility Graphics"
    invalid_context_msg = "View does not support Visibility Graphics settings"

    def copy(self):
        script.store_data(
            slot_name=self.__class__.__name__,
            data=VisibilityGraphicsData(
                source_viewid=revit.active_view.Id,
            ),
        )

    def paste(self):
        vg_data = script.load_data(slot_name=self.__class__.__name__)
        with revit.Transaction("Paste Visibility Graphics"):
            revit.active_view.ApplyViewTemplateParameters(
                revit.doc.GetElement(vg_data.source_viewid)
            )

    @staticmethod
    def validate_context():
        return revit.get_selection().is_empty and not isinstance(
            revit.active_view, (DB.ViewSheet, DB.ViewSchedule)
        )

class CropRegionData(object):
    def __init__(self, cropregion_curveloop, crop_bbox, is_active):
        self._cropregion_curveloop = revit.serialize(cropregion_curveloop)
        self._crop_bbox = revit.serialize(crop_bbox)
        self._is_active = is_active

    @property
    def cropregion_curveloop(self):
        return self._cropregion_curveloop.deserialize()

    @property
    def crop_bbox(self):
        return self._crop_bbox.deserialize()

    @property
    def is_active(self):
        return self._is_active


# TODO: correct so split crop regions can be copied as well
@moduleutils.mark(basetypes.COPYPASTE_MARKER_PROPNAME)
class CropRegionAction(basetypes.CopyPasteStateAction):
    name = "Crop Region"
    invalid_context_msg = "Activate a view or select at least one cropable viewport"
    this_project = False

    @staticmethod
    def get_cropable_views():
        # py3 returns a filter object but py3 returns filtered list
        # list() makes it consistent
        # py2 filter does not support keyword arguments
        selected_views = revit.get_selection().only_views()
        if not selected_views:
            selected_views = [revit.uidoc.ActiveGraphicalView]
        return list(filter(revit.query.is_cropable_view, selected_views))

    @staticmethod
    def get_first_cropable_view():
        views = CropRegionAction.get_cropable_views()
        if views:
            return views[0]

    def copy(self):
        view = CropRegionAction.get_first_cropable_view()

        crop_bbox = cropregion_curve_loop = None
        if isinstance(view, DB.View3D):
            crop_bbox = view.CropBox
        else:
            cropregion_curve_loops = revit.query.get_crop_region(view)
            if cropregion_curve_loops:
                cropregion_curve_loop = cropregion_curve_loops[0]

        if crop_bbox or cropregion_curve_loop:
            script.store_data(
                slot_name=self.__class__.__name__,
                data=CropRegionData(
                    cropregion_curveloop=cropregion_curve_loop,
                    crop_bbox=crop_bbox,
                    is_active=view.CropBoxActive,
                ),
                this_project=False,
            )
        else:
            raise PyRevitException("Cannot read crop region of selected view")

    def paste(self):
        cr_data = script.load_data(
            slot_name=self.__class__.__name__, this_project=False
        )
        crv_loop = cr_data.cropregion_curveloop
        with revit.Transaction("Paste Crop Region"):
            for view in CropRegionAction.get_cropable_views():
                if isinstance(view, DB.View3D):
                    if cr_data.crop_bbox:
                        view.CropBox = cr_data.crop_bbox
                else:
                    revit.update.set_crop_region(view, crv_loop)
                view.CropBoxActive = cr_data.is_active
        revit.uidoc.RefreshActiveView()

    @staticmethod
    def validate_context():
        return CropRegionAction.get_first_cropable_view()

ALIGNMENT_CROPBOX = "Align to CROP BOX CORNER on Paste"
ALIGNMENT_BASEPOINT = "Align to BASE POINT on Paste"

ALIGNMENT_OPTIONS_COPY = [
    ALIGNMENT_CROPBOX,
    ALIGNMENT_BASEPOINT,
]

ALIGNMENT_CENTER = "Align to CENTER of Copied Crop Box"
ALIGNMENT_TOP_LEFT = "Align to TOP LEFT Corner of Copied Crop Box"
ALIGNMENT_TOP_RIGHT = "Align to TOP RIGHT Corner of Copied Crop Box"
ALIGNMENT_BOTTOM_LEFT = "Align to BOTTOM LEFT Corner of Copied Crop Box"
ALIGNMENT_BOTTOM_RIGHT = "Align to BOTTOM RIGHT Corner of Copied Crop Box"

ALIGNMENT_OPTIONS = [
    ALIGNMENT_CENTER,
    ALIGNMENT_TOP_LEFT,
    ALIGNMENT_TOP_RIGHT,
    ALIGNMENT_BOTTOM_LEFT,
    ALIGNMENT_BOTTOM_RIGHT,
]


class ViewportPlacementData(object):
    def __init__(self, alignment, center, offset_uv):
        self._alignment = alignment
        self._center = revit.serialize(center)
        self._offset_uv = revit.serialize(offset_uv)

    @property
    def alignment(self):
        return self._alignment

    @property
    def center(self):
        return self._center.deserialize()

    @property
    def offset_uv(self):
        return self._offset_uv.deserialize()


@moduleutils.mark(basetypes.COPYPASTE_MARKER_PROPNAME)
class ViewportPlacementAction(basetypes.CopyPasteStateAction):
    name = "Viewport Placement on Sheet"
    invalid_context_msg = "At least one viewport must be selected"
    this_project = False

    @staticmethod
    def calculate_offset(view, offset_uv, alignment):
        """For usage in 'align by viewport corners' mode.
        Calculates XY-distance between viewport center and specified corner.

        Args:
            view (DB.View): [description]
            offset_uv (DB.UV): [description]
            alignment (str): alignment name (e.g. 'Top Left')

        Returns:
            DB.XYZ: distance between vp-center and specified corner
        """
        if alignment == ALIGNMENT_CENTER:
            return DB.XYZ.Zero
        else:
            outline = view.Outline
            current_offset = (outline.Max - outline.Min) / 2
            offset_uv = offset_uv - current_offset
            if alignment == ALIGNMENT_TOP_LEFT:
                return DB.XYZ(-offset_uv.U, offset_uv.V, 0)
            elif alignment == ALIGNMENT_TOP_RIGHT:
                return DB.XYZ(offset_uv.U, offset_uv.V, 0)
            elif alignment == ALIGNMENT_BOTTOM_RIGHT:
                return DB.XYZ(offset_uv.U, -offset_uv.V, 0)
            elif alignment == ALIGNMENT_BOTTOM_LEFT:
                return DB.XYZ(-offset_uv.U, -offset_uv.V, 0)

    @staticmethod
    def isolate_axis(viewport, new_center, mode=None):
        """Modifies `new_center` so only one of axises will be changed
         in comparison with `viewport` center.

        Args:
            viewport (DB.Viewport): viewport to compare with
            new_center (DB.XYZ): a point to modify
            mode (str, optional): 'X' or 'Y'. Defaults to None.

        Returns:
            DB.XYZ: modified point
        """
        if mode in ("X", "Y"):
            current_center = viewport.GetBoxCenter()
            if mode == "X":
                return DB.XYZ(new_center.X, current_center.Y, 0)
            else:
                return DB.XYZ(current_center.X, new_center.Y, 0)
        else:
            return new_center

    @staticmethod
    def hide_all_elements(view):
        """Hides all elements visible in provided view.

        Args:
            view (DB.View): view to search on

        Returns:
            list[DB.ElementId]: list of hidden element ids
        """
        # hide all elements in the view
        cl_view_elements = DB.FilteredElementCollector(
            view.Document, view.Id
        ).WhereElementIsNotElementType()
        elements_to_hide = [
            el.Id
            for el in cl_view_elements.ToElements()
            if not el.IsHidden(view) and el.CanBeHidden(view)
        ]
        if elements_to_hide:
            try:
                view.HideElements(List[DB.ElementId](elements_to_hide))
            except Exception as exc:
                mlogger.warn(exc)
        return elements_to_hide

    @staticmethod
    def unhide_elements(view, element_ids):
        """Unhide elements in a view

        Args:
            view (DB.View): view to apply visibility changes
            element_ids (list[DB.ElementId]): list of element ids to unhide
        """
        if element_ids:
            try:
                view.UnhideElements(List[DB.ElementId](element_ids))
            except Exception as exc:
                mlogger.warn(exc)

    @staticmethod
    def activate_cropbox(view):
        """Make cropbox active and visible in a view
        Args:
            view (DB.View): view to apply changes

        Returns:
            (bool, bool, int): previous values of CropBoxActive, CropBoxVisible
                               and "Annotation Crop Active"
        """
        cboxannoparam = view.get_Parameter(
            DB.BuiltInParameter.VIEWER_ANNOTATION_CROP_ACTIVE
        )
        current_active = view.CropBoxActive
        current_visible = view.CropBoxVisible
        current_annotations = cboxannoparam.AsInteger()
        # making sure the cropbox is active.
        view.CropBoxActive = True
        view.CropBoxVisible = True
        if not cboxannoparam.IsReadOnly:
            cboxannoparam.Set(0)
        return current_active, current_visible, current_annotations

    @staticmethod
    def recover_cropbox(view, saved_values):
        """Recovers saved cropbox visibility

        Args:
            view (DB.View): view to apply changes
            saved_values ((bool, bool, int)): saved values of CropBoxActive,
                CropBoxVisible and "Annotation Crop Active"
        """
        saved_active, saved_visible, saved_annotations = saved_values
        cboxannoparam = view.get_Parameter(
            DB.BuiltInParameter.VIEWER_ANNOTATION_CROP_ACTIVE
        )
        view.CropBoxActive = saved_active
        view.CropBoxVisible = saved_visible
        if not cboxannoparam.IsReadOnly:
            cboxannoparam.Set(saved_annotations)

    @staticmethod
    def get_title_block_placement(viewport):
        """Search for a TitleBlock on a viewport sheet.
        Returns TitleBlock location on sheet if there is exactly one.

        Args:
            viewport (DB.Viewport): viewport to get sheet from

        Returns:
            DB.XYZ: TitleBlock location or DB.XYZ.Zero
        """
        sheet = viewport.Document.GetElement(viewport.SheetId)
        cl = (
            DB.FilteredElementCollector(sheet.Document, sheet.Id)
            .WhereElementIsNotElementType()
            .OfCategory(DB.BuiltInCategory.OST_TitleBlocks)
        )
        title_blocks = cl.ToElements()
        if len(title_blocks) == 1:
            return title_blocks[0].Location.Point
        else:
            return DB.XYZ.Zero

    @staticmethod
    def zero_cropbox(view):
        """Generates a rectangular curve loop in model coordinates
        (0,0; 0,1; 1,1; 1,0) parallel to a provided view.

        Args:
            view (DB.View): view, to which the curves should be projected

        Returns:
            DB.CurveLoop: result curve loop
        """
        # model points (lower left and upper right corners)
        p1 = DB.XYZ(0, 0, 0)
        p3 = DB.XYZ(1, 1, 1)
        # uv's of model points projected to a view
        uv1 = revit.units.project_to_viewport(p1, view)
        uv3 = revit.units.project_to_viewport(p3, view)
        # uv's of upper left and lower right corners of rectangle
        uv2 = DB.UV(uv1.U, uv3.V)
        uv4 = DB.UV(uv3.U, uv1.V)
        # project all points back to model coordinates
        p2 = revit.units.project_to_world(uv2, view)
        p4 = revit.units.project_to_world(uv4, view)
        p1 = revit.units.project_to_world(
            revit.units.project_to_viewport(p1, view), view
        )
        p3 = revit.units.project_to_world(
            revit.units.project_to_viewport(p3, view), view
        )
        # create lines between points
        l1 = DB.Line.CreateBound(p1, p2)
        l2 = DB.Line.CreateBound(p2, p3)
        l3 = DB.Line.CreateBound(p3, p4)
        l4 = DB.Line.CreateBound(p4, p1)
        # generate curve loop
        crv_loop = DB.CurveLoop()
        for crv in (l1, l2, l3, l4):
            crv_loop.Append(crv)
        return crv_loop

    def copy(self):
        viewports = revit.get_selection().include(DB.Viewport)
        if len(viewports) != 1:
            raise PyRevitException("Exactly one viewport must be selected")
        viewport = viewports[0]
        view = revit.doc.GetElement(viewport.ViewId)

        title_block_pt = ViewportPlacementAction.get_title_block_placement(viewport)

        if view.ViewType in [DB.ViewType.DraftingView, DB.ViewType.Legend]:
            alignment = ALIGNMENT_CROPBOX
        else:
            alignment = forms.CommandSwitchWindow.show(
                ALIGNMENT_OPTIONS_COPY, message="Select Alignment Option"
            )

        if not alignment:
            return

        with revit.DryTransaction("Activate & Read Cropbox, Copy Center"):
            if alignment == ALIGNMENT_BASEPOINT:
                revit.update.set_crop_region(
                    view, ViewportPlacementAction.zero_cropbox(view)
                )
            # use cropbox as alignment if it active
            if alignment == ALIGNMENT_BASEPOINT or view.CropBoxActive:
                ViewportPlacementAction.activate_cropbox(view)
                ViewportPlacementAction.hide_all_elements(view)
                revit.doc.Regenerate()

            if alignment == ALIGNMENT_CROPBOX:
                outline = view.Outline
                offset_uv = (outline.Max - outline.Min) / 2
            center = viewport.GetBoxCenter() - title_block_pt

        script.store_data(
            slot_name=self.__class__.__name__,
            data=ViewportPlacementData(
                alignment=alignment,
                center=center,
                offset_uv=offset_uv if alignment == ALIGNMENT_CROPBOX else None,
            ),
            this_project=False,
        )

    def paste(self):
        vp_data = script.load_data(
            slot_name=self.__class__.__name__, this_project=False
        )

        viewports = revit.get_selection().include(DB.Viewport)
        align_axis = None
        if __shiftclick__:  # pylint: disable=undefined-variable
            align_axis = forms.CommandSwitchWindow.show(
                ["X", "Y", "XY"], message="Align specific axis?"
            )
        # read saved values
        alignment = vp_data.alignment
        center = vp_data.center
        offset_uv = vp_data.offset_uv
        if alignment == ALIGNMENT_CROPBOX:
            corner_alignment = forms.CommandSwitchWindow.show(
                ALIGNMENT_OPTIONS, message="Select Alignment Option"
            )

        with revit.TransactionGroup("Paste Viewport Location"):
            for viewport in viewports:
                view = revit.doc.GetElement(viewport.ViewId)
                title_block_pt = ViewportPlacementAction.get_title_block_placement(
                    viewport
                )
                crop_region_current = None
                cropbox_values_current = None
                hidden_elements = None
                # set temporary settings: hide elements, set cropbox visibility
                #  if cropbox is not active, do nothing (use visible elements)
                if alignment == ALIGNMENT_BASEPOINT or view.CropBoxActive:
                    with revit.Transaction("Temporary settings"):
                        # 'base point' mode - set cropbox to 'zero' temporary
                        if alignment == ALIGNMENT_BASEPOINT:
                            crop_region_current = revit.query.get_crop_region(view)
                            revit.update.set_crop_region(
                                view, ViewportPlacementAction.zero_cropbox(view)
                            )
                        cropbox_values_current = (
                            ViewportPlacementAction.activate_cropbox(view)
                        )
                        hidden_elements = ViewportPlacementAction.hide_all_elements(
                            view
                        )

                with revit.Transaction("Apply Viewport Placement"):
                    new_center = center
                    # 'crop box' mode - align to vp corner if necessary
                    if alignment == ALIGNMENT_CROPBOX and corner_alignment:
                        offset_xyz = ViewportPlacementAction.calculate_offset(
                            view, offset_uv, corner_alignment
                        )
                        new_center += offset_xyz
                    # isolate alignment by x- or y-axis if necessary
                    new_center = ViewportPlacementAction.isolate_axis(
                        viewport, new_center, align_axis
                    )
                    # apply new viewport position
                    viewport.SetBoxCenter(new_center + title_block_pt)
                # unset temporary values
                if crop_region_current:
                    with revit.Transaction("Recover crop region form"):
                        revit.update.set_crop_region(view, crop_region_current)
                if cropbox_values_current:
                    with revit.Transaction("Recover crop region values"):
                        ViewportPlacementAction.recover_cropbox(
                            view, cropbox_values_current
                        )
                if hidden_elements:
                    with revit.Transaction("Recover hidden elements"):
                        ViewportPlacementAction.unhide_elements(view, hidden_elements)

    @staticmethod
    def validate_context():
        return revit.get_selection().include(DB.Viewport)


# =============================================================================


class FilterOverridesData(object):
    def __init__(self, source_viewid, filter_ids):
        self._source_viewid = revit.serialize(source_viewid)
        self._filter_ids = [revit.serialize(x) for x in filter_ids]

    @property
    def source_viewid(self):
        return self._source_viewid.deserialize()

    @property
    def filter_ids(self):
        return [x.deserialize() for x in self._filter_ids]


@moduleutils.mark(basetypes.COPYPASTE_MARKER_PROPNAME)
class FilterOverridesAction(basetypes.CopyPasteStateAction):
    name = "Filter Overrides"
    invalid_context_msg = ""

    @staticmethod
    def get_suitable_views():
        selected_views = revit.get_selection().only_views()
        if not selected_views:
            selected_views = [revit.uidoc.ActiveGraphicalView]
        return [view for view in selected_views if view.AreGraphicsOverridesAllowed()]

    @staticmethod
    def controlled_by_template(view):
        if view.ViewTemplateId != DB.ElementId.InvalidElementId:
            view_template = view.Document.GetElement(view.ViewTemplateId)
            non_controlled_params = view_template.GetNonControlledTemplateParameterIds()
            # check if filters are controlled by template
            if DB.ElementId(DB.BuiltInParameter.VIS_GRAPHICS_FILTERS) \
                    not in non_controlled_params:
                return True
        return False

    def copy(self):
        views = FilterOverridesAction.get_suitable_views()
        if views:
            view = views[0]
            view_filters = revit.query.get_view_filters(view)
            if not view_filters:
                raise PyRevitException("Active/Selected view has no fitlers applied")

            selected_filters = forms.SelectFromList.show(
                view_filters,
                name_attr="Name",
                title="Select filters to copy",
                button_name="Select filters",
                multiselect=True,
            )

            if not selected_filters:
                raise PyRevitException("No filters selected. Cancelled.")

            script.store_data(
                slot_name=self.__class__.__name__,
                data=FilterOverridesData(
                    source_viewid=view.Id, filter_ids=[f.Id for f in view_filters]
                ),
            )

    def paste(self):
        fo_data = script.load_data(slot_name=self.__class__.__name__)

        source_view = revit.doc.GetElement(fo_data.source_viewid)
        source_filter_ids = fo_data.filter_ids

        # to view template or to selected view
        mode_templates = (
            forms.CommandSwitchWindow.show(
                ["Active/Selected View", "Select View Templates"],
                message="Where do you want to paste filters?",
            )
            == "Select View Templates"
        )
        if mode_templates:
            views = forms.select_viewtemplates()
        else:
            views = FilterOverridesAction.get_suitable_views()
            views = [view for view in views if view.Id != source_view.Id]
            views_controlled_by_template = [
                x for x in views if FilterOverridesAction.controlled_by_template(x)
            ]
            if views_controlled_by_template:
                forms.alert(
                    "You have selected views with template applied."
                    " They will be skipped"
                )
        if not views:
            raise PyRevitException("No suitable views selected or active")

        # check if there are views controlled by template
        with revit.TransactionGroup("Paste Filter Overrides"):
            for view in views:
                with revit.Transaction("Paste filter"):
                    # check if filters are controlled by template
                    if FilterOverridesAction.controlled_by_template(view):
                        mlogger.warn(
                            "Skip view '{}'".format(revit.query.get_name(view))
                        )
                        continue

                    view_filters_ids = view.GetFilters()
                    for filter_id in source_filter_ids:
                        # remove filter override if exists
                        if filter_id in view_filters_ids:
                            view.RemoveFilter(filter_id)
                        # add new fitler override
                        filter_overrides = source_view.GetFilterOverrides(filter_id)
                        view.SetFilterOverrides(filter_id, filter_overrides)

    @staticmethod
    def validate_context():
        return bool(FilterOverridesAction.get_suitable_views())

```

```python
"""Copy/Paste State Base Types"""
#pylint: disable=import-error,invalid-name,broad-except,superfluous-parens
from pyrevit.coreutils import logger
from pyrevit import DB


mlogger = logger.get_logger(__name__)


COPYPASTE_MARKER_PROPNAME = 'is_copypaste_action'

COMPATIBLE_VIEWTYPES = [
    [
        DB.ViewType.FloorPlan,
        DB.ViewType.CeilingPlan,
        DB.ViewType.EngineeringPlan,
        DB.ViewType.AreaPlan
    ]
]


class CopyPasteStateAction(object):
    """Base class for creating Copy/Paste State Actions.

    Example:
        >>>@moduleutils.mark(COPYPASTE_MARKER_PROPNAME)
        >>>class ViewScale(CopyPasteStateAction):
        >>>    name = 'View Scale'
        >>>
        >>>    def copy(self, datafile):
        >>>        view_scale = revit.active_view.Scale
        >>>        datafile.dump(view_scale)
        >>>
        >>>    def paste(self, datafile):
        >>>        view_scale_saved = datafile.load()
        >>>        revit.active_view.Scale = view_scale_saved
        >>>
        >>>    @staticmethod
        >>>    def validate_context():
        >>>        if not isinstance(revit.active_view, DB.TableView):
        >>>            return "Geometrical view must be active. Not a schedule."

    Usage:
        >>>if not ViewScale.validate_context():
        >>>   view_scale_action = ViewScale()
        >>>   view_scale_action.copy()
        ...
        >>>    view_scale_action.paste()
    """
    name = None
    invalid_context_msg = None
    this_project = True

    def copy(self):
        """Performs copy action.

        Args:
            datafile (DataFile): instance of DataFile in `write` mode

        Example:
            >>>def copy(self, datafile):
            >>>    view_scale = revit.active_view.Scale
            >>>    datafile.dump(view_scale)
        """
        pass

    def paste(self):
        """Performs paste action.

        Args:
            datafile (DataFile): instance of DataFile in `read` mode

        Example:
            >>>def paste(self, datafile):
            >>>    view_scale_saved = datafile.load()
            >>>    with revit.Transaction('Paste view scale'):
            >>>        try:
            >>>            revit.active_view.Scale = view_scale_saved
            >>>        except:
            >>>            raise Exception('Cannot paste view scale')
        """
        pass

    @staticmethod
    def validate_context():
        """Validating context before running the action. e.g. if certain view
        type must be active, certail element type selected.
        To be run 'silently', therefore should contain no ui or forms.

        Returns:
            str: message describing the failure; None if validation successful

        Example:
            >>>@staticmethod
            >>>def validate_context():
            >>>    if not isinstance(revit.active_view, DB.TableView):
            >>>        return "Geometrical view must be active. Not a schedule."
        """
        return

    @staticmethod
    def is_compatible_viewtype(target_view, source_viewtype):
        """Check if view types are compatible for this action"""
        if target_view.ViewType == source_viewtype:
            return True

        for compat_viewtypes in COMPATIBLE_VIEWTYPES:
            if target_view.ViewType in compat_viewtypes \
                    and source_viewtype in compat_viewtypes:
                return True

        return False

```

## FILE_START: JasonHacksRevit.tab/Selection.panel/memo.stack/Memory.pulldown/lib/iter_selection.py
## META: sha1=45093cb5878a31f1309d68a745f33971371ccaab size=1472
## TYPE: text
## IMPORTS: ["os.path","pickle","pyrevit","pyrevit.compat"]
## FUNCTIONS: ["iterate"]
## CLASSES: []
```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import os.path as op
import pickle

from pyrevit import revit
from pyrevit import script
from pyrevit.compat import get_elementid_from_value_func


logger = script.get_logger()

get_elementid_from_value = get_elementid_from_value_func()


def iterate(mode, step_size=1):
    """Iterate over elements in memorized selection"""
    index_datafile = script.get_document_data_file("SelListPrevNextIndex", "pym")
    datafile = script.get_document_data_file("SelList", "pym")

    selection = revit.get_selection()

    if op.exists(index_datafile):
        with open(index_datafile, "rb") as f:
            idx = pickle.load(f)

        if mode == "-":
            idx = idx - step_size
        else:
            idx = idx + step_size
    else:
        idx = 0

    if op.exists(datafile):
        try:
            with open(datafile, "rb") as df:
                cursel = pickle.load(df)

            if cursel:
                if idx < 0:
                    idx = abs(idx / len(cursel)) * len(cursel) + idx
                elif idx >= len(cursel):
                    idx = idx - abs(idx / len(cursel)) * len(cursel)
                selection.set_to(get_elementid_from_value(list(cursel)[idx]))

                with open(index_datafile, "wb") as f:
                    pickle.dump(idx, f)
        except Exception as io_err:
            logger.error("Error read/write to: %s | %s", datafile, io_err)

```
## FILE_END: JasonHacksRevit.tab/Selection.panel/memo.stack/Memory.pulldown/lib/iter_selection.py

```python
import os
import os.path as op
import pickle as pl

from pyrevit import revit
from pyrevit import script
from pyrevit.compat import get_elementid_value_func


datafile = script.get_document_data_file("SelList", "pym")

selection = revit.get_selection()
get_elementid_value = get_elementid_value_func()
selected_ids = {str(get_elementid_value(elid)) for elid in selection.element_ids}

try:
    f = open(datafile, 'rb')
    prevsel = pl.load(f)
    newsel = prevsel.difference(selected_ids)
    f.close()
    f = open(datafile, 'wb')
    pl.dump(newsel, f)
    f.close()
except Exception:
    f = open(datafile, 'wb')
    pl.dump([], f)
    f.close()

```

```python
"""Saves current selection memory as a Selection Filter."""

# pylint: disable=import-error,invalid-name,broad-except
import os.path as op
import pickle as pl

from pyrevit import coreutils
from pyrevit import revit, DB
from pyrevit import script
from pyrevit.compat import get_elementid_from_value_func

logger = script.get_logger()

get_elementid_from_value = get_elementid_from_value_func()

proj_info = revit.query.get_project_info()
data_file = script.get_document_data_file("SelList", "pym")
logger.debug(data_file)

if op.exists(data_file):
    if proj_info.name:
        filter_name = "SavedSelection_" + proj_info.name + "_" + coreutils.timestamp()
    else:
        filter_name = "SavedSelection_" + coreutils.timestamp()

    with open(data_file, "rb") as f:
        cursel = pl.load(f)

    with revit.Transaction("pySaveSelection"):
        selection_filter = DB.SelectionFilterElement.Create(
            revit.doc, coreutils.cleanup_filename(filter_name)
        )
        for elid in cursel:
            selection_filter.AddSingle(get_elementid_from_value(elid))

```
## FILE_END: JasonHacksRevit.tab/Selection.panel/memo.stack/Memory.pulldown/Save Memory as Selection.pushbutton/script.py

```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# Script:        PasteState_script.py
# Description:   Applies a copied view state to the active view.
#                All picker windows follow the CLAUDE.md WPF style guide.
#                Filter Overrides paste is intercepted to replace pyRevit's
#                CommandSwitchWindow with our styled window.
#                Revit Links correctly copies the visibility checkbox as well
#                as the display settings.
# Author:        Jason Braga
# Last Updated:  2026-03-20
# Revit Version: 2022 / 2023 / 2024

# pylint: disable=import-error,invalid-name,broad-except

# =============================================================================
# SECTION 5 -- ACTION PICKER WINDOW CLASS (checkbox multi-select)
# =============================================================================

class ActionPickerWindow(object):
    """
    Checkbox multi-select list for choosing which state actions to paste.
    Follows CLAUDE.md: CheckListBoxItem, SelectionMode=Extended,
    Select All / Clear All, OK disabled until at least one item ticked.
    result: list of chosen action name strings.
    """

    def __init__(self, action_options):
        self._options     = action_options
        self._checked_ids = set()
        self.result       = []
        self.cancelled    = True

        self._win        = System.Windows.Markup.XamlReader.Parse(_PICKER_XAML)
        self._lst        = self._win.FindName('lst_Actions')
        self._btn_ok     = self._win.FindName('btn_OK')
        self._btn_cancel = self._win.FindName('btn_Cancel')
        self._btn_all    = self._win.FindName('btn_SelectAll')
        self._btn_clear  = self._win.FindName('btn_ClearAll')

        self._names = sorted(action_options.keys())
        for name in self._names:
            cb               = Controls.CheckBox()
            cb.Content       = name
            cb.FontFamily    = System.Windows.Media.FontFamily('Segoe UI')
            cb.FontSize      = 11
            cb.Foreground    = System.Windows.Media.SolidColorBrush(
                                   System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(
                                       0x1A, 0x1A, 0x1A))
            cb.VerticalAlignment = System.Windows.VerticalAlignment.Center
            cb.IsHitTestVisible  = False
            cb.Focusable         = False
            cb.IsChecked         = False

            item         = Controls.ListBoxItem()
            item.Content = cb
            item.Tag     = name
            self._lst.Items.Add(item)

        self._lst.PreviewMouseDown += self._on_mouse_down
        self._btn_ok.Click         += self._on_ok
        self._btn_cancel.Click     += self._on_cancel
        self._btn_all.Click        += self._on_select_all
        self._btn_clear.Click      += self._on_clear_all

    def _sync_checkboxes(self):
        for i in range(self._lst.Items.Count):
            item = self._lst.Items.GetItemAt(i)
            if isinstance(item.Content, Controls.CheckBox):
                item.Content.IsChecked = (item.Tag in self._checked_ids)

    def _update_ok(self):
        self._btn_ok.IsEnabled = len(self._checked_ids) > 0

    def _on_mouse_down(self, sender, args):
        element      = args.OriginalSource
        clicked_item = None
        while element is not None:
            if isinstance(element, Controls.ListBoxItem):
                clicked_item = element
                break
            try:
                element = System.Windows.Media.VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(element)
            except Exception:
                break
        if clicked_item is None:
            return
        name = clicked_item.Tag
        if name in self._checked_ids:
            self._checked_ids.discard(name)
        else:
            self._checked_ids.add(name)
        self._sync_checkboxes()
        self._update_ok()
        args.Handled = True

    def _on_select_all(self, sender, args):
        for name in self._names:
            self._checked_ids.add(name)
        self._sync_checkboxes()
        self._update_ok()

    def _on_clear_all(self, sender, args):
        self._checked_ids.clear()
        self._sync_checkboxes()
        self._update_ok()

    def _on_ok(self, sender, args):
        self.result    = [n for n in self._names if n in self._checked_ids]
        self.cancelled = False
        self._win.Close()

    def _on_cancel(self, sender, args):
        self.cancelled = True
        self._win.Close()

    def show(self):
        self._win.ShowDialog()
        return self

# SECTION 6 -- VG SECTION PICKER WINDOW CLASS
# =============================================================================

class VGSectionPickerWindow(object):
    """
    Checkbox list for selecting which VG sections to paste.
    All sections pre-ticked. User unticks what they don't want.
    """

    def __init__(self, sections, source_name):
        self._sections    = sections
        self._checked_ids = set()
        self.result       = []
        self.cancelled    = True

        self._win        = System.Windows.Markup.XamlReader.Parse(_VG_PICKER_XAML)
        self._lst        = self._win.FindName('lst_Sections')
        self._btn_paste  = self._win.FindName('btn_Paste')
        self._btn_cancel = self._win.FindName('btn_Cancel')
        self._btn_all    = self._win.FindName('btn_SelectAll')
        self._btn_clear  = self._win.FindName('btn_ClearAll')
        self._txt_source = self._win.FindName('txt_SourceView')

        self._txt_source.Text = source_name

        for label, key in sections:
            cb               = Controls.CheckBox()
            cb.Content       = label
            cb.FontFamily    = System.Windows.Media.FontFamily('Segoe UI')
            cb.FontSize      = 11
            cb.Foreground    = System.Windows.Media.SolidColorBrush(
                                   System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(
                                       0x1A, 0x1A, 0x1A))
            cb.VerticalAlignment = System.Windows.VerticalAlignment.Center
            cb.IsHitTestVisible  = False
            cb.Focusable         = False
            cb.IsChecked         = True

            item         = Controls.ListBoxItem()
            item.Content = cb
            item.Tag     = key
            self._lst.Items.Add(item)
            self._checked_ids.add(key)

        self._lst.PreviewMouseDown += self._on_mouse_down
        self._btn_paste.Click      += self._on_paste
        self._btn_cancel.Click     += self._on_cancel
        self._btn_all.Click        += self._on_select_all
        self._btn_clear.Click      += self._on_clear_all
        self._update_paste_button()

    def _toggle_key(self, key):
        if key in self._checked_ids:
            self._checked_ids.discard(key)
        else:
            self._checked_ids.add(key)

    def _sync_checkboxes(self):
        for i in range(self._lst.Items.Count):
            item = self._lst.Items.GetItemAt(i)
            if isinstance(item.Content, Controls.CheckBox):
                item.Content.IsChecked = (item.Tag in self._checked_ids)

    def _update_paste_button(self):
        self._btn_paste.IsEnabled = len(self._checked_ids) > 0

    def _on_mouse_down(self, sender, args):
        element      = args.OriginalSource
        clicked_item = None
        while element is not None:
            if isinstance(element, Controls.ListBoxItem):
                clicked_item = element
                break
            try:
                element = System.Windows.Media.VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(element)
            except Exception:
                break
        if clicked_item is None:
            return
        self._toggle_key(clicked_item.Tag)
        self._sync_checkboxes()
        self._update_paste_button()
        args.Handled = True

    def _on_select_all(self, sender, args):
        for label, key in self._sections:
            self._checked_ids.add(key)
        self._sync_checkboxes()
        self._update_paste_button()

    def _on_clear_all(self, sender, args):
        self._checked_ids.clear()
        self._sync_checkboxes()
        self._update_paste_button()

    def _on_paste(self, sender, args):
        self.result    = [key for label, key in self._sections
                          if key in self._checked_ids]
        self.cancelled = False
        self._win.Close()

    def _on_cancel(self, sender, args):
        self.cancelled = True
        self._win.Close()

    def show(self):
        self._win.ShowDialog()
        return self
```
