# SECTION 6b -- SUB-ITEM PICKER WINDOW (DWGs and Revit Links selection)
# =============================================================================

class SubItemPickerWindow(object):
    """
    Generic checkbox picker for selecting specific items within a VG section.
    Supports greyed-out non-selectable GROUP HEADER rows by passing tag=None.

    Parameters
    ----------
    items       : list of (display_label, tag_object) tuples.
                  If tag_object is None, the row is rendered as a greyed-out
                  section header (no checkbox, not clickable).
    title       : str   window title bar text
    header      : str   section header above the list
    source_name : str   shown in the "Copying from" info panel
    ok_label    : str   primary button label

    result   : list of tag_objects for checked items (headers excluded)
    cancelled: bool
    """

    def __init__(self, items, title, header, source_name, ok_label='Apply'):
        self._items        = items
        self._checked_tags = set()
        self._tag_map      = {}
        self.result        = []
        self.cancelled     = True

        self._win        = System.Windows.Markup.XamlReader.Parse(_SUBITEM_PICKER_XAML)
        self._lst        = self._win.FindName('lst_Items')
        self._btn_ok     = self._win.FindName('btn_OK')
        self._btn_cancel = self._win.FindName('btn_Cancel')
        self._btn_all    = self._win.FindName('btn_SelectAll')
        self._btn_clear  = self._win.FindName('btn_ClearAll')
        self._txt_title  = self._win.FindName('txt_Title')
        self._txt_source = self._win.FindName('txt_SourceView')
        self._txt_header = self._win.FindName('txt_Header')

        self._win.Title        = title
        self._txt_title.Text   = title
        self._txt_source.Text  = source_name
        self._txt_header.Text  = header
        self._btn_ok.Content   = ok_label

        # Use enumerated index as the row key instead of id(tag).
        # id() of small Python integers returns the same value for equal ints
        # in IronPython 2.7 (integer interning), causing all rows to share one
        # key and the checkbox state to collapse. A simple counter is safe.
        for row_idx, (label, tag) in enumerate(items):
            if tag is None:
                # -- Group header row: greyed TextBlock, no checkbox, not clickable
                tb = Controls.TextBlock()
                tb.Text       = label
                tb.FontFamily = System.Windows.Media.FontFamily('Segoe UI')
                tb.FontSize   = 10
                tb.FontWeight = System.Windows.FontWeights.SemiBold
                tb.Foreground = System.Windows.Media.SolidColorBrush(
                                    System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(
                                        0x6B, 0x6B, 0x6B))
                tb.Margin = System.Windows.Thickness(0, 6, 0, 2)

                item                  = Controls.ListBoxItem()
                item.Content          = tb
                item.Tag              = None
                item.IsHitTestVisible = False
                item.Background       = System.Windows.Media.SolidColorBrush(
                                            System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(
                                                0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF))
                self._lst.Items.Add(item)

            else:
                # Use row index as unique key -- avoids id() interning collision
                tag_key = row_idx
                self._tag_map[tag_key] = tag
                self._checked_tags.add(tag_key)

                cb               = Controls.CheckBox()
                cb.Content       = label
                cb.FontFamily    = System.Windows.Media.FontFamily('Segoe UI')
                cb.FontSize      = 11
                cb.Foreground    = System.Windows.Media.SolidColorBrush(
                                       System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(
                                           0x1A, 0x1A, 0x1A))
                cb.Margin            = System.Windows.Thickness(12, 0, 0, 0)
                cb.VerticalAlignment = System.Windows.VerticalAlignment.Center
                cb.IsHitTestVisible  = False
                cb.Focusable         = False
                cb.IsChecked         = True

                item         = Controls.ListBoxItem()
                item.Content = cb
                item.Tag     = tag_key
                self._lst.Items.Add(item)

        self._lst.PreviewMouseDown += self._on_mouse_down
        self._btn_ok.Click         += self._on_ok
        self._btn_cancel.Click     += self._on_cancel
        self._btn_all.Click        += self._on_select_all
        self._btn_clear.Click      += self._on_clear_all
        self._update_ok()

    def _sync_checkboxes(self):
        for i in range(self._lst.Items.Count):
            item = self._lst.Items.GetItemAt(i)
            if isinstance(item.Content, Controls.CheckBox):
                item.Content.IsChecked = (item.Tag in self._checked_tags)

    def _update_ok(self):
        self._btn_ok.IsEnabled = len(self._checked_tags) > 0

    def _on_mouse_down(self, sender, args):
        element      = args.OriginalSource
        clicked_item = None
        while element is not None:
            if isinstance(element, Controls.ListBoxItem):
                clicked_item = element
                break
            try:
                element = System.Windows.Media.VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(element)
            except Exception:
                break
        if clicked_item is None:
            return
        key = clicked_item.Tag
        if key in self._checked_tags:
            self._checked_tags.discard(key)
        else:
            self._checked_tags.add(key)
        self._sync_checkboxes()
        self._update_ok()
        args.Handled = True

    def _on_select_all(self, sender, args):
        for key in self._tag_map.keys():
            self._checked_tags.add(key)
        self._sync_checkboxes()
        self._update_ok()

    def _on_clear_all(self, sender, args):
        self._checked_tags.clear()
        self._sync_checkboxes()
        self._update_ok()

    def _on_ok(self, sender, args):
        self.result    = [self._tag_map[k] for k in self._checked_tags
                          if k in self._tag_map]
        self.cancelled = False
        self._win.Close()

    def _on_cancel(self, sender, args):
        self.cancelled = True
        self._win.Close()

    def show(self):
        self._win.ShowDialog()
        return self


# =============================================================================
# SECTION 7 -- FILTER OVERRIDES PASTE MODE PICKER
# =============================================================================

class FilterPasteModeWindow(object):
    """
    Single-select window replacing the CommandSwitchWindow in
    FilterOverridesAction.paste() -- lets user choose Active View vs Templates.
    """

    PASTE_MODES = [
        'Paste to Active / Selected View',
        'Paste to View Templates',
    ]

    def __init__(self):
        self.result    = None
        self.cancelled = True

        self._win        = System.Windows.Markup.XamlReader.Parse(_FILTER_PASTE_XAML)
        self._lst        = self._win.FindName('lst_Mode')
        self._btn_ok     = self._win.FindName('btn_OK')
        self._btn_cancel = self._win.FindName('btn_Cancel')

        for mode in self.PASTE_MODES:
            item         = Controls.ListBoxItem()
            item.Content = mode
            item.Tag     = mode
            self._lst.Items.Add(item)

        self._lst.SelectionChanged += self._on_selection
        self._lst.MouseDoubleClick += self._on_double_click
        self._btn_ok.Click         += self._on_ok
        self._btn_cancel.Click     += self._on_cancel

    def _on_selection(self, sender, args):
        self._btn_ok.IsEnabled = self._lst.SelectedItem is not None

    def _on_double_click(self, sender, args):
        if self._lst.SelectedItem is not None:
            self._confirm()

    def _on_ok(self, sender, args):
        self._confirm()

    def _confirm(self):
        if self._lst.SelectedItem is not None:
            self.result    = self._lst.SelectedItem.Tag
            self.cancelled = False
        self._win.Close()

    def _on_cancel(self, sender, args):
        self.cancelled = True
        self._win.Close()

    def show(self):
        self._win.ShowDialog()
        return self

def _apply_model_categories(source_view, target_view):
    """Copy hidden state and overrides for all MODEL categories."""
    doc = target_view.Document
    for cat in doc.Settings.Categories:
        if cat.CategoryType != CategoryType.Model:
            continue
        try:
            cat_id = cat.Id
            target_view.SetCategoryHidden(cat_id,
                source_view.GetCategoryHidden(cat_id))
            target_view.SetCategoryOverrides(cat_id,
                source_view.GetCategoryOverrides(cat_id))
        except Exception:
            pass


def _apply_annotation_categories(source_view, target_view):
    """Copy hidden state and overrides for ANNOTATION categories."""
    doc = target_view.Document
    for cat in doc.Settings.Categories:
        if cat.CategoryType != CategoryType.Annotation:
            continue
        try:
            cat_id = cat.Id
            target_view.SetCategoryHidden(cat_id,
                source_view.GetCategoryHidden(cat_id))

                source_view.GetCategoryOverrides(cat_id))

        if cat.CategoryType != CategoryType.AnalyticalModel:

        try:

def _apply_imported_categories(source_view, target_view, selected_cat_ids=None):
    """Copy hidden state and overrides for IMPORTED categories (DWG, DXF etc.).
    These use CategoryType.Internal in the Revit API enum -- NOT ImportInstance,
    which does not exist in Revit 2022/2023/2024.

    Parameters
    ----------
    selected_cat_ids : set of ElementId integer values, or None for all.
                       When provided, only categories whose Id is in this set
                       are copied -- lets the user pick specific DWGs.
    """
    doc = target_view.Document
    for cat in doc.Settings.Categories:
        if cat.CategoryType != CategoryType.Internal:
            continue
        # If a selection was provided, skip categories not in it
        if selected_cat_ids is not None:
            try:
                cat_int = cat.Id.IntegerValue
            except AttributeError:
                cat_int = int(cat.Id.Value)
            if cat_int not in selected_cat_ids:
                continue
        try:
            cat_id = cat.Id
            target_view.SetCategoryHidden(cat_id,
                source_view.GetCategoryHidden(cat_id))
            target_view.SetCategoryOverrides(cat_id,
                source_view.GetCategoryOverrides(cat_id))
        except Exception:
            pass


def _snapshot_non_link_vg(view):
    """
    Snapshot all VG state EXCEPT Revit Links from the given view.
    Returns a dict that _restore_non_link_vg() can use to restore it.

    We snapshot everything our other apply functions control so we can
    restore them after ApplyViewTemplateParameters overwrites everything.
    """
    import System.Collections.Generic as SCG
    doc = view.Document
    snap = {}

    # Model / Annotation / Analytical / Imported categories
    cat_data = {}
    try:
        for cat in doc.Settings.Categories:
            try:
                cid = cat.Id
                # Safe int key -- .IntegerValue throws in Revit 2024+ on some types
                try:
                    cid_int = int(cid.Value)
                except AttributeError:
                    cid_int = cid.IntegerValue
                cat_data[cid_int] = {
                    'cid':    cid,
                    'hidden': view.GetCategoryHidden(cid),
                    'ogs':    view.GetCategoryOverrides(cid),
                }
            except Exception:
                pass
    except Exception:
        pass
    snap['categories'] = cat_data

    # Filters
    filter_data = {}
    try:
        for fid in view.GetFilters():
            try:
                try:    fid_int = int(fid.Value)
                except: fid_int = fid.IntegerValue
                filter_data[fid_int] = {
                    'fid':     fid,
                    'ogs':     view.GetFilterOverrides(fid),
                    'visible': view.GetFilterVisibility(fid),
                }
            except Exception:
                pass
    except Exception:
        pass
    snap['filter_ids_ordered'] = list(view.GetFilters())
    snap['filters'] = filter_data

    # Worksets
    workset_data = {}
    try:
        for ws in FilteredWorksetCollector(doc)\
                .OfKind(WorksetKind.UserWorkset).ToWorksets():
            try:
                workset_data[ws.Id.IntegerValue] = {
                    'wsid': ws.Id,
                    'vis':  view.GetWorksetVisibility(ws.Id),
                }
            except Exception:
                pass
    except Exception:
        pass
    snap['worksets'] = workset_data

    # View Range
    try:
        pvr = view.GetViewRange()
        snap['view_range'] = pvr
    except Exception:
        snap['view_range'] = None

    # Scope Box -- store name (primary) and ElementId int (fallback)
    try:
        from Autodesk.Revit.DB import BuiltInParameter, BuiltInCategory
        sb_param = view.get_Parameter(BuiltInParameter.VIEWER_VOLUME_OF_INTEREST_CROP)
        if sb_param:
            sb_id = sb_param.AsElementId()
            try:
                sb_id_int = int(sb_id.Value)
            except AttributeError:
                sb_id_int = sb_id.IntegerValue
            sb_elem = view.Document.GetElement(sb_id) if sb_id_int != -1 else None
            snap['scope_box_name']   = sb_elem.Name if sb_elem else ''
            snap['scope_box_id_int'] = sb_id_int
        else:
            snap['scope_box_name']   = None
            snap['scope_box_id_int'] = None
    except Exception:
        snap['scope_box_name']   = None
        snap['scope_box_id_int'] = None

    # View Scale -- snapshot so ApplyViewTemplateParameters cannot change it
    try:
        snap['view_scale'] = int(view.Scale)
    except Exception:
        snap['view_scale'] = None

    return snap


def _restore_non_link_vg(view, snap):
    """
    Restore all VG state from a snapshot created by _snapshot_non_link_vg().
    Called after ApplyViewTemplateParameters to undo its side effects on
    sections the user did NOT ask to copy.
    """
    doc = view.Document

    # Restore categories -- use stored cid directly from the snapshot dict
    cat_data = snap.get('categories', {})
    for prev in cat_data.values():
        try:
            cid = prev['cid']
            view.SetCategoryHidden(cid, prev['hidden'])
            view.SetCategoryOverrides(cid, prev['ogs'])
        except Exception:
            pass

    # Restore filters: first remove all current filters, then re-add saved ones
    try:
        for fid in list(view.GetFilters()):
            try:
                view.RemoveFilter(fid)
            except Exception:
                pass
        for fid in snap.get('filter_ids_ordered', []):
            try:
                try:    fid_int = int(fid.Value)
                except: fid_int = fid.IntegerValue
                fd = snap['filters'].get(fid_int)
                if fd:
                    view.AddFilter(fid)
                    view.SetFilterOverrides(fid, fd['ogs'])
                    view.SetFilterVisibility(fid, fd['visible'])
            except Exception:
                pass
    except Exception:
        pass

    # Restore worksets
    for key, wd in snap.get('worksets', {}).items():
        try:
            view.SetWorksetVisibility(wd['wsid'], wd['vis'])
        except Exception:
            pass

    # Restore View Range
    pvr = snap.get('view_range')
    if pvr is not None:
        try:
            view.SetViewRange(pvr)
        except Exception:
            pass

    # Restore View Scale -- ApplyViewTemplateParameters may have changed it
    view_scale = snap.get('view_scale')
    if view_scale is not None:
        try:
            view.Scale = view_scale
        except Exception:
            pass
    # Restore Scope Box
    sb_name   = snap.get('scope_box_name')
    sb_id_int = snap.get('scope_box_id_int')
    if sb_name is not None:
        try:
            from Autodesk.Revit.DB import (
                BuiltInParameter, ElementId,
                FilteredElementCollector, BuiltInCategory
            )
            sb_param = view.get_Parameter(
                BuiltInParameter.VIEWER_VOLUME_OF_INTEREST_CROP)
            if sb_param and not sb_param.IsReadOnly:
                if sb_id_int == -1 or sb_name == '':
                    sb_param.Set(ElementId.InvalidElementId)
                else:
                    # Find by name first
                    sb_element_id = None
                    all_sbs = FilteredElementCollector(view.Document)\
                        .OfCategory(BuiltInCategory.OST_VolumeOfInterest)\
                        .WhereElementIsNotElementType()\
                        .ToElements()
                    for sb in all_sbs:
                        if sb.Name == sb_name:
                            sb_element_id = sb.Id
                            break
                    # Fallback to id
                    if sb_element_id is None and sb_id_int is not None:
                        sb_element_id = ElementId(sb_id_int)
                    if sb_element_id is not None:
                        sb_param.Set(sb_element_id)
        except Exception:
            pass


def _apply_revit_links(source_view, target_view, selected_instance_ids=None):
    """
    Copy Revit Links VG state from source_view to target_view.
    Uses ApplyViewTemplateParameters (the only reliable API) then restores
    all non-link sections.

    Parameters
    ----------
    selected_instance_ids : set of ElementId integer values, or None for all.
                            When provided, only those specific link instances
                            have their visibility/overrides copied.
                            When None, all links are copied (original behaviour).
    """
    from Autodesk.Revit.DB import RevitLinkInstance

    doc = target_view.Document

    if selected_instance_ids is None:
        # Copy all links directly via GetLinkOverrides / SetLinkOverrides.
        # This avoids ApplyViewTemplateParameters which also changes categories,
        # filters, scale and other VG settings the user did not ask to copy.
        import System.Collections.Generic as SCG_all

        ids_to_hide_all   = SCG_all.List[DB.ElementId]()
        ids_to_unhide_all = SCG_all.List[DB.ElementId]()

        # Copy all type-level overrides
        all_link_types_all = FilteredElementCollector(doc)\
            .OfClass(DB.RevitLinkType).ToElements()
        for lt in all_link_types_all:
            try:
                gs = source_view.GetLinkOverrides(lt.Id)
                if gs is not None:
                    target_view.SetLinkOverrides(lt.Id, gs)
            except Exception:
                pass

        # Copy all instance-level overrides + visibility
        all_link_insts_all = FilteredElementCollector(doc)\
            .OfClass(RevitLinkInstance).ToElements()
        for li in all_link_insts_all:
            try:
                gs = source_view.GetLinkOverrides(li.Id)
                if gs is not None:
                    target_view.SetLinkOverrides(li.Id, gs)
                # Visibility tick
                if gs is not None:
                    vis_str = str(gs.LinkVisibility)
                    if 'Hidden' in vis_str:
                        ids_to_hide_all.Add(li.Id)
                    else:
                        ids_to_unhide_all.Add(li.Id)
                else:
                    type_gs = source_view.GetLinkOverrides(li.GetTypeId())
                    if type_gs is not None:
                        vis_str = str(type_gs.LinkVisibility)
                        if 'Hidden' in vis_str:
                            ids_to_hide_all.Add(li.Id)
                        else:
                            ids_to_unhide_all.Add(li.Id)
            except Exception:
                pass

        try:
            if ids_to_hide_all.Count > 0:
                target_view.HideElements(ids_to_hide_all)
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            if ids_to_unhide_all.Count > 0:
                target_view.UnhideElements(ids_to_unhide_all)
        except Exception:
            pass
    else:
        # Selective: copy only the chosen link types.
        # selected_instance_ids is a set of RevitLinkType Id integers.
        import System.Collections.Generic as SCG_local

        ids_to_hide   = SCG_local.List[DB.ElementId]()
        ids_to_unhide = SCG_local.List[DB.ElementId]()

        # Copy type-level display settings for each chosen type
        all_link_types = FilteredElementCollector(doc)\
            .OfClass(DB.RevitLinkType)\
            .ToElements()

        for link_type in all_link_types:
            try:
                try:
                    type_int = link_type.Id.IntegerValue
                except AttributeError:
                    type_int = int(link_type.Id.Value)

                if type_int not in selected_instance_ids:
                    continue

                # Type-level override (halftone, display mode etc.)
                try:
                    link_gs = source_view.GetLinkOverrides(link_type.Id)
                    if link_gs is not None:
                        target_view.SetLinkOverrides(link_type.Id, link_gs)
                except Exception:
                    pass
            except Exception:
                pass

        # Instance-level: visibility tick + per-instance overrides
        all_link_instances = FilteredElementCollector(doc)\
            .OfClass(DB.RevitLinkInstance)\
            .ToElements()

        for link_instance in all_link_instances:
            try:
                inst_type_id = link_instance.GetTypeId()
                try:
                    inst_type_int = inst_type_id.IntegerValue
                except AttributeError:
                    inst_type_int = int(inst_type_id.Value)

                if inst_type_int not in selected_instance_ids:
                    continue

                # Instance-level display settings
                try:
                    link_gs = source_view.GetLinkOverrides(link_instance.Id)
                    if link_gs is not None:
                        target_view.SetLinkOverrides(link_instance.Id, link_gs)
                except Exception:
                    pass

                # Visibility tick: read from GetLinkOverrides on the SOURCE view.
                # element.IsHidden(view) is WRONG here -- it only returns True
                # when the element was explicitly hidden via HideElements().
                # Link visibility is controlled by RevitLinkGraphicsSettings.LinkVisibility
                # which is part of the link override, not the element hide API.
                # RevitLinkVisibility.Hidden means the tick box is off.
                try:
                    src_inst_gs = source_view.GetLinkOverrides(link_instance.Id)
                    if src_inst_gs is not None:
                        vis_str = str(src_inst_gs.LinkVisibility)
                        if 'Hidden' in vis_str:
                            ids_to_hide.Add(link_instance.Id)
                        else:
                            ids_to_unhide.Add(link_instance.Id)
                    else:
                        # No instance-level override -- check type-level
                        src_type_gs = source_view.GetLinkOverrides(inst_type_id)
                        if src_type_gs is not None:
                            vis_str = str(src_type_gs.LinkVisibility)
                            if 'Hidden' in vis_str:
                                ids_to_hide.Add(link_instance.Id)
                            else:
                                ids_to_unhide.Add(link_instance.Id)
                        else:
                            ids_to_unhide.Add(link_instance.Id)
                except Exception:
                    pass

            except Exception:
                pass

        try:
            if ids_to_hide.Count > 0:
                target_view.HideElements(ids_to_hide)
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            if ids_to_unhide.Count > 0:
                target_view.UnhideElements(ids_to_unhide)
        except Exception:
            pass


def _apply_filters(source_view, target_view):
    """
    Copy all View Filter overrides and visibility states.
    Removes filters absent from source, then adds/updates all source filters.
    """
    source_filter_ids = list(source_view.GetFilters())
    target_filter_ids = list(target_view.GetFilters())

    for fid in target_filter_ids:
        if fid not in source_filter_ids:
            try:
                target_view.RemoveFilter(fid)
            except Exception:
                pass

    for fid in source_filter_ids:
        try:
            ogs     = source_view.GetFilterOverrides(fid)
            visible = source_view.GetFilterVisibility(fid)
            target_view.AddFilter(fid)
            target_view.SetFilterOverrides(fid, ogs)
            target_view.SetFilterVisibility(fid, visible)
        except Exception:
            pass


def _apply_worksets(source_view, target_view):
    """Copy Workset visibility. Silently skipped on non-workshared models."""
    doc = target_view.Document
    try:
        all_worksets = FilteredWorksetCollector(doc)\
            .OfKind(WorksetKind.UserWorkset)\
            .ToWorksets()
        for ws in all_worksets:
            try:
                vis = source_view.GetWorksetVisibility(ws.Id)
                target_view.SetWorksetVisibility(ws.Id, vis)
            except Exception:
                pass
    except Exception:
        pass


def _apply_view_range(source_view, target_view):
    """
    Copy View Range (Top, Cut, Bottom, Depth planes).
    Only valid on plan views -- silently skipped on all others.
    """
    PLAN_VIEW_TYPES = [
        ViewType.FloorPlan, ViewType.CeilingPlan,
        ViewType.EngineeringPlan, ViewType.AreaPlan,
    ]
    if source_view.ViewType not in PLAN_VIEW_TYPES:
        return
    if target_view.ViewType not in PLAN_VIEW_TYPES:
        return
    try:
        source_pvr = source_view.GetViewRange()
        target_pvr = target_view.GetViewRange()
        for plane in [PlanViewPlane.TopClipPlane, PlanViewPlane.CutPlane,
                      PlanViewPlane.BottomClipPlane, PlanViewPlane.ViewDepthPlane]:
            try:
                target_pvr.SetLevelId(plane, source_pvr.GetLevelId(plane))
                target_pvr.SetOffset(plane,  source_pvr.GetOffset(plane))
            except Exception:
                pass
        target_view.SetViewRange(target_pvr)
    except Exception:
        pass


_APPLY_FUNCTIONS = {
    'model_categories':     _apply_model_categories,
    'annotation_categories':_apply_annotation_categories,
    'analytical_categories':_apply_analytical_categories,
    'imported_categories':  _apply_imported_categories,
    'revit_links':          _apply_revit_links,
    'filters':              _apply_filters,
    'worksets':             _apply_worksets,
    'view_range':           _apply_view_range,
}


# =============================================================================
# SECTION 10 -- SELECTIVE VG PASTE
# =============================================================================

def _paste_vg_selective():
    """Show the VG section picker and apply chosen sections in one Transaction."""
    try:
        vg_data = script.load_data(slot_name='VisibilityGraphicsAction')
    except Exception as load_err:
        forms.alert(
            'Could not load saved Visibility / Graphics data.\n\n'
            'Please run Copy State on a view first.\n\n'
            'Detail: ' + str(load_err),
            title='Paste State'
        )
        return

    source_view = revit.doc.GetElement(vg_data.source_viewid)
    if source_view is None:
        forms.alert(
            'The source view no longer exists in this project.\n'
            'Please run Copy State again.',
            title='Paste State'
        )
        return

    win = VGSectionPickerWindow(VG_SECTIONS, source_view.Name)
    win.show()

    if win.cancelled or not win.result:
        return

    chosen_keys = win.result
    target_view = revit.active_view

    # -- Sub-pickers for sections that support item-level selection -----------
    # If Imported Categories is chosen, ask which specific DWGs to copy.
    # If Revit Links is chosen, ask which specific link instances to copy.
    # These are collected BEFORE starting the transaction so UI can show.

    selected_dwg_cat_ids    = None   # None = copy all; set = copy only selected
    selected_link_inst_ids  = None   # None = copy all; set = copy only selected

    if 'imported_categories' in chosen_keys:
        # Collect ImportInstance elements to build the DWG list.
        # Try source view first (view-specific imports), then fall back to
        # whole document (model imports visible in any view).
        # Each ImportInstance's Category name = the row label in VG Imported tab.
        # Deduplicate by category Id -- same DWG placed multiple times = one row.
        from Autodesk.Revit.DB import ImportInstance

        dwg_items    = []
        seen_cat_ids = set()
        dwg_errors   = []

        def _collect_imports(collector):
            for imp in collector.OfClass(ImportInstance).ToElements():
                try:
                    cat = imp.Category
                    if cat is None:
                        continue
                    try:
                        cat_int = cat.Id.IntegerValue
                    except AttributeError:
                        cat_int = int(cat.Id.Value)
                    if cat_int in seen_cat_ids:
                        continue
                    seen_cat_ids.add(cat_int)
                    dwg_items.append((cat.Name, cat_int))
                except Exception as e:
                    dwg_errors.append(str(e))

        # Try scoped to source view first
        try:
            _collect_imports(FilteredElementCollector(revit.doc, source_view.Id))
        except Exception as e:
            dwg_errors.append('View-scoped: ' + str(e))

        # If nothing found, try whole document
        if not dwg_items:
            try:
                _collect_imports(FilteredElementCollector(revit.doc))
            except Exception as e:
                dwg_errors.append('Doc-wide: ' + str(e))

        dwg_items.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])

        if not dwg_items:
            err_detail = '\n'.join(dwg_errors) if dwg_errors else 'No imported DWG/DXF files found.'
            forms.alert(
                'Could not find any imported DWG files.\n\n'
                'Imported Categories will be pasted for all.\n\n'
                + err_detail,
                title='Paste State'
            )
            # Don't return -- fall through with selected_dwg_cat_ids = None (copy all)
        else:
            sub_win = SubItemPickerWindow(
                items       = dwg_items,
                title       = 'Imported Categories',
                header      = 'Select which DWG / imported files to paste:',
                source_name = source_view.Name,
                ok_label    = 'Apply Selected'
            )
            sub_win.show()
            if sub_win.cancelled:
                return
            # If all selected, use None to copy all (consistent with Revit Links)
            chosen_dwg_set  = set(sub_win.result)
            all_dwg_ints    = set(cat_int for _, cat_int in dwg_items)
            if chosen_dwg_set == all_dwg_ints:
                selected_dwg_cat_ids = None   # copy all
            else:
                selected_dwg_cat_ids = chosen_dwg_set

    if 'revit_links' in chosen_keys:
        # Build the list of Revit Links from the source view.
        # We collect RevitLinkType elements (one per .rvt file loaded) which
        # matches exactly what the user sees as rows in the VG Revit Links tab.
        # DB.RevitLinkType is available via `from pyrevit import revit, DB`
        # which is already imported at the top of this script.
        link_items = []
        link_errors = []

        try:
            all_link_types = FilteredElementCollector(revit.doc)\
                .OfClass(DB.RevitLinkType)\
                .ToElements()

            for lt in all_link_types:
                try:
                    try:
                        type_int = lt.Id.IntegerValue
                    except AttributeError:
                        type_int = int(lt.Id.Value)

                    # lt.Name can throw on unloaded links -- try parameter first
                    display = None
                    try:
                        p = lt.get_Parameter(DB.BuiltInParameter.ALL_MODEL_TYPE_NAME)
                        if p:
                            display = p.AsString()
                    except Exception:
                        pass
                    if not display:
                        try:
                            display = lt.Name
                        except Exception:
                            pass
                    if not display:
                        display = 'Link Id: ' + str(type_int)

                    link_items.append((display, type_int))
                except Exception as item_err:
                    link_errors.append(str(item_err))

        except Exception as coll_err:
            link_errors.append('Collection error: ' + str(coll_err))

        link_items.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])

        # Always show the picker -- even if collection failed, show the error
        if not link_items:
            err_detail = '\n'.join(link_errors) if link_errors else 'No RevitLinkType elements found in document.'
            forms.alert(
                'Could not collect Revit Links for the picker.\n\n' + err_detail,
                title='Paste State'
            )
            return

        sub_win = SubItemPickerWindow(
            items       = link_items,
            title       = 'Revit Link Overrides',
            header      = 'Select which Revit Links to paste:',
            source_name = source_view.Name,
            ok_label    = 'Apply Selected'
        )
        sub_win.show()

        if sub_win.cancelled:
            return

        # If the user selected ALL links, use None to trigger the
        # ApplyViewTemplateParameters path which is the only reliable way
        # to copy Revit Link visibility ticks correctly.
        chosen_set = set(sub_win.result)
        all_type_ints = set(type_int for _, type_int in link_items)
        if chosen_set == all_type_ints:
            selected_link_inst_ids = None   # copy all = use ApplyViewTemplateParameters
        else:
            selected_link_inst_ids = chosen_set

    # -- Apply all chosen sections in one Transaction -------------------------
    t = Transaction(revit.doc, 'Paste Visibility / Graphics (selective)')
    t.Start()
    try:
        for key in chosen_keys:
            if key == 'imported_categories':
                # Pass the selected DWG category id set (None = all)
                _apply_imported_categories(source_view, target_view,
                                           selected_dwg_cat_ids)
            elif key == 'revit_links':
                # Pass the selected link instance id set (None = all)
                _apply_revit_links(source_view, target_view,
                                   selected_link_inst_ids)
            else:
                apply_fn = _APPLY_FUNCTIONS.get(key)
                if apply_fn:
                    apply_fn(source_view, target_view)
        t.Commit()
    except Exception as err:
        t.RollBack()
        forms.alert(
            'Error applying Visibility / Graphics sections.\n\n'
            'All changes have been rolled back.\n\n'
            'Detail: ' + str(err),
            title='Paste State'
        )
        return

    applied_names = [lbl for lbl, key in VG_SECTIONS if key in chosen_keys]
    forms.alert(
        'Pasted successfully from:\n  ' + source_view.Name + '\n\n'
        'Sections applied:\n  - ' + '\n  - '.join(applied_names),
        title='Paste State'
    )


# =============================================================================
# SECTION 11 -- FILTER OVERRIDES PASTE HANDLER
# =============================================================================

def _paste_filter_overrides():
    """
    Replaces the CommandSwitchWindow inside FilterOverridesAction.paste()
    with our styled mode picker, then delegates to action().paste() after
    the user has made their choice.

    Because action().paste() internally calls forms.CommandSwitchWindow we
    cannot simply call it -- we must replicate the paste logic here using
    the same data that was stored by our custom copy handler.
    """
    from copypastestate.actions import FilterOverridesAction

    # Load the data our copy handler stored
    try:
        fo_data = script.load_data(slot_name='FilterOverridesAction')
    except Exception as load_err:
        forms.alert(
            'Could not load saved Filter Overrides data.\n\n'
            'Please run Copy State > Filter Overrides first.\n\n'
            'Detail: ' + str(load_err),
            title='Paste State'
        )
        return

    source_view       = revit.doc.GetElement(fo_data.source_viewid)
    source_filter_ids = fo_data.filter_ids

    if source_view is None:
        forms.alert(
            'The source view no longer exists.\n'
            'Please run Copy State > Filter Overrides again.',
            title='Paste State'
        )
        return

    # Show our styled mode picker instead of CommandSwitchWindow
    mode_win = FilterPasteModeWindow()
    mode_win.show()

    if mode_win.cancelled or not mode_win.result:
        return

    use_templates = (mode_win.result == FilterPasteModeWindow.PASTE_MODES[1])

    if use_templates:
        # Let pyRevit handle template selection -- this uses its own picker
        # which is acceptable since it is a template browser, not a filter list
        views = forms.select_viewtemplates()
        if not views:
            return
    else:
        views = FilterOverridesAction.get_suitable_views()
        views = [v for v in views if v.Id != source_view.Id]
        if not views:
            forms.alert(
                'No suitable views found to paste to.',
                title='Paste State'
            )
            return
        views_with_template = [
            v for v in views if FilterOverridesAction.controlled_by_template(v)
        ]
        if views_with_template:
            forms.alert(
                'Some views have a view template applied and will be skipped.',
                title='Paste State'
            )

    # Apply the filters inside transactions (same logic as the original paste)
    with revit.TransactionGroup('Paste Filter Overrides'):
        for view in views:
            with revit.Transaction('Paste filter'):
                if FilterOverridesAction.controlled_by_template(view):
                    continue
                view_filter_ids = view.GetFilters()
                for filter_id in source_filter_ids:
                    if filter_id in view_filter_ids:
                        view.RemoveFilter(filter_id)
                    filter_overrides = source_view.GetFilterOverrides(filter_id)
                    view.SetFilterOverrides(filter_id, filter_overrides)


# =============================================================================
# SECTION 11b -- SCOPE BOX PASTE HANDLER
# =============================================================================

def _paste_scope_box():
    """
    Paste the scope box assignment to the active view.

    Strategy:
    1. Load stored data (scope box name + ElementId int)
    2. Find the scope box element in the current document by NAME first
       (robust across sessions), fall back to ElementId if name lookup fails
    3. Set VIEWER_VOLUME_OF_INTEREST_CROP on the target view
    4. Read the parameter back immediately to verify the set actually worked
       (Revit silently ignores Set() in some cases e.g. view templates)
    """
    from Autodesk.Revit.DB import (
        BuiltInParameter, ElementId,
        FilteredElementCollector, BuiltInCategory
    )

    try:
        sb_data = script.load_data(slot_name=SCOPE_BOX_SLOT)
    except Exception as load_err:
        forms.alert(
            'Could not load saved Scope Box data.\n\n'
            'Please run Copy State > Scope Box first.\n\n'
            'Detail: ' + str(load_err),
            title='Paste State'
        )
        return

    sb_name     = sb_data.get('sb_name', '')
    sb_id_int   = sb_data.get('sb_id_int', -1)
    source_name = sb_data.get('source_view_name', '')
    target_view = revit.active_view

    # -- Resolve the scope box ElementId --------------------------------------
    # Case 1: no scope box was assigned in the source view
    if sb_id_int == -1 or sb_name == '':
        sb_element_id = ElementId.InvalidElementId
        sb_display    = '(none)'

    else:
        sb_element_id = None

        # Primary lookup: find by name using FilteredElementCollector
        # Scope boxes are BuiltInCategory.OST_VolumeOfInterest elements
        try:
            all_scope_boxes = FilteredElementCollector(revit.doc)\
                .OfCategory(BuiltInCategory.OST_VolumeOfInterest)\
                .WhereElementIsNotElementType()\
                .ToElements()
            for sb in all_scope_boxes:
                if sb.Name == sb_name:
                    sb_element_id = sb.Id
                    break
        except Exception:
            pass

        # Fallback: try direct ElementId lookup if name search failed
        if sb_element_id is None:
            try:
                fallback_id   = ElementId(sb_id_int)
                fallback_elem = revit.doc.GetElement(fallback_id)
                if fallback_elem is not None:
                    sb_element_id = fallback_id
            except Exception:
                pass

        # Could not find the scope box at all
        if sb_element_id is None:
            forms.alert(
                'Could not find scope box "' + sb_name + '" in this project.\n\n'
                'The scope box may have been renamed or deleted.\n'
                'Source view: ' + source_name,
                title='Paste State'
            )
            return

        sb_display = sb_name

    # -- Apply inside a Transaction --------------------------------------------
    t = Transaction(revit.doc, 'Paste Scope Box')
    t.Start()
    try:
        target_param = target_view.get_Parameter(
            BuiltInParameter.VIEWER_VOLUME_OF_INTEREST_CROP)

        if target_param is None:
            t.RollBack()
            forms.alert(
                'The active view does not support Scope Box assignment.',
                title='Paste State'
            )
            return

        if target_param.IsReadOnly:
            t.RollBack()
            forms.alert(
                'The Scope Box parameter on the active view is read-only.\n'
                'It may be controlled by a view template.',
                title='Paste State'
            )
            return

        target_param.Set(sb_element_id)
        t.Commit()

    except Exception as err:
        t.RollBack()
        forms.alert(
            'Failed to paste Scope Box.\n\nDetail: ' + str(err),
            title='Paste State'
        )
        return

    # -- Verify the set actually took effect -----------------------------------
    # Revit can silently ignore Set() in some circumstances. Read back and check.
    try:
        verify_param = target_view.get_Parameter(
            BuiltInParameter.VIEWER_VOLUME_OF_INTEREST_CROP)
        applied_id = verify_param.AsElementId() if verify_param else None

        # Get the int value of what we set
        if sb_element_id == ElementId.InvalidElementId:
            expected_int = -1
        else:
            try:
                expected_int = int(sb_element_id.Value)
            except AttributeError:
                expected_int = sb_element_id.IntegerValue

        try:
            applied_int = int(applied_id.Value)
        except AttributeError:
            applied_int = applied_id.IntegerValue if applied_id else -999

        if applied_int != expected_int:
            forms.alert(
                'Scope Box was not applied.\n\n'
                'The view may be controlled by a view template that '
                'locks the Scope Box parameter.\n\n'
                'Check: View Properties > Identity Data > View Template.',
                title='Paste State'
            )
            return
    except Exception:
        pass   # verification failed silently -- trust the transaction

    forms.alert(
        'Scope Box pasted successfully.\n\n'
        'Source view:  ' + source_name + '\n'
        'Scope Box:    ' + sb_display,
        title='Paste State'
    )




# =============================================================================
# SECTION 11c -- ANNOTATIONS PASTE HANDLER
# =============================================================================

def _paste_annotations():
    """
    Copy annotation elements from the source view into the active target view.

    Elements copied: Tags, Text Notes, Dimensions, Detail Components,
    Detail Lines (and arcs/ellipses/splines).

    Uses ElementTransformUtils.CopyElements() -- the same API Revit uses
    for Copy/Paste Aligned. Each category is attempted separately so a
    failure in one category (e.g. tags whose hosts aren't visible) doesn't
    block the others.

    A report is shown at the end listing counts per category and any failures.
    """
    from Autodesk.Revit.DB import (
        FilteredElementCollector,
        BuiltInCategory,
        ElementTransformUtils,
        Transform,
        CopyPasteOptions,
        ElementId,
    )
    import System.Collections.Generic as SCG

    # -- Load stored data ------------------------------------------------------
    try:
        ann_data = script.load_data(slot_name=ANNOTATIONS_SLOT)
    except Exception as load_err:
        forms.alert(
            'Could not load saved Annotations data.\n\n'
            'Please run Copy State > Annotations first.\n\n'
            'Detail: ' + str(load_err),
            title='Paste State'
        )
        return

    source_name    = ann_data.get('source_view_name', '')
    source_view_id = ann_data.get('source_view_id', -1)

    # Reconstruct the source view.
    # ElementId(int) can fail silently in some Revit/IronPython combinations
    # so we try multiple approaches and fall back to name search.
    source_view = None
    try:
        # Approach 1: direct ElementId lookup
        src_eid     = ElementId(int(source_view_id))
        source_view = revit.doc.GetElement(src_eid)
    except Exception:
        pass

    if source_view is None:
        # Approach 2: search all views by name
        try:
            from Autodesk.Revit.DB import FilteredElementCollector as FEC, View
            for v in FEC(revit.doc).OfClass(View).ToElements():
                try:
                    if v.Name == source_name and not v.IsTemplate:
                        source_view = v
                        break
                except Exception:
                    pass
        except Exception:
            pass

    if source_view is None:
        forms.alert(
            'The source view could not be found in this project.\n\n'
            'Please run Copy State > Annotations again.\n\n'
            'Source view: ' + source_name,
            title='Paste State'
        )
        return

    target_view = revit.active_view

    if source_view.Id == target_view.Id:
        forms.alert(
            'Source and target views are the same.\n\n'
            'Switch to a different view and run Paste State again.',
            title='Paste State'
        )
        return

    # -- Collect annotation element ids from source view ----------------------
    from Autodesk.Revit.DB import IndependentTag, SpatialElementTag

    cat_id_lists     = {}   # label -> SCG.List[ElementId]
    ann_picker_items = []   # [(display_label, tag)] -- None tag = group header

    # -- TAGS: group by category name -----------------------------------------
    tag_by_cat = {}
    try:
        for tag in (FilteredElementCollector(revit.doc, source_view.Id)
                    .OfClass(IndependentTag).ToElements()):
            try:
                cat_name = tag.Category.Name if tag.Category else 'Tags'
                if cat_name not in tag_by_cat:
                    tag_by_cat[cat_name] = SCG.List[ElementId]()
                tag_by_cat[cat_name].Add(tag.Id)
            except Exception:
                pass
    except Exception:
        pass

    try:
        for tag in (FilteredElementCollector(revit.doc, source_view.Id)
                    .OfClass(SpatialElementTag).ToElements()):
            try:
                cat_name = tag.Category.Name if tag.Category else 'Room Tags'
                if cat_name not in tag_by_cat:
                    tag_by_cat[cat_name] = SCG.List[ElementId]()
                tag_by_cat[cat_name].Add(tag.Id)
            except Exception:
                pass
    except Exception:
        pass

    if tag_by_cat:
        ann_picker_items.append(('Tags', None))   # greyed group header
        for cat_name in sorted(tag_by_cat.keys()):
            id_list = tag_by_cat[cat_name]
            if id_list.Count > 0:
                cat_id_lists[cat_name] = id_list
                ann_picker_items.append((cat_name, cat_name))

    # -- DETAIL LINES: group by line style name -------------------------------
    # Use line.LineStyle.Name -- line.Category.Name returns "Lines" for all
    # detail lines regardless of style, which is not useful for the picker.
    line_by_style = {}
    try:
        for line in (FilteredElementCollector(revit.doc, source_view.Id)
                     .OfCategory(BuiltInCategory.OST_Lines)
                     .WhereElementIsNotElementType()
                     .ToElements()):
            try:
                try:
                    style_name = line.LineStyle.Name
                except Exception:
                    style_name = line.Category.Name if line.Category else 'Lines'
                if style_name not in line_by_style:
                    line_by_style[style_name] = SCG.List[ElementId]()
                line_by_style[style_name].Add(line.Id)
            except Exception:
                pass
    except Exception:
        pass

    if line_by_style:
        ann_picker_items.append(('Detail Lines', None))   # greyed group header
        for style_name in sorted(line_by_style.keys()):
            id_list = line_by_style[style_name]
            if id_list.Count > 0:
                label = 'Line: ' + style_name
                cat_id_lists[label] = id_list
                ann_picker_items.append((label, label))

    # -- OTHER ANNOTATION CATEGORIES (single entry each) ----------------------
    OTHER_CATS = [
        (BuiltInCategory.OST_TextNotes,        'Text Notes'),
        (BuiltInCategory.OST_Dimensions,       'Dimensions'),
        (BuiltInCategory.OST_DetailComponents, 'Detail Components'),
    ]

    other_items = []
    for bic, label in OTHER_CATS:
        try:
            ids = (FilteredElementCollector(revit.doc, source_view.Id)
                   .OfCategory(bic)
                   .WhereElementIsNotElementType()
                   .ToElementIds())
            if ids and ids.Count > 0:
                cat_id_lists[label] = SCG.List[ElementId](ids)
                other_items.append((label, label))
        except Exception:
            pass

    if other_items:
        ann_picker_items.append(('Other', None))   # greyed group header
        ann_picker_items.extend(other_items)

    if not cat_id_lists:
        forms.alert(
            'No annotation elements found in the source view.\n\n'
            'Source view: ' + source_name,
            title='Paste State'
        )
        return

    sub_win = SubItemPickerWindow(
        items       = ann_picker_items,
        title       = 'Annotations',
        header      = 'Select which annotation types to paste:',
        source_name = source_name,
        ok_label    = 'Paste Selected'
    )
    sub_win.show()

    if sub_win.cancelled:
        return

    chosen_labels = set(sub_win.result)

    # Filter cat_id_lists to only the chosen categories
    cat_id_lists = {lbl: ids for lbl, ids in cat_id_lists.items()
                    if lbl in chosen_labels}

    if not cat_id_lists:
        return   # user cleared everything -- silent exit

    # -- Copy each category separately ----------------------------------------
    report_lines  = []
    total_copied  = 0
    total_failed  = 0

    opts = CopyPasteOptions()

    t = Transaction(revit.doc, 'Paste Annotations')
    t.Start()
    try:
        for label, id_list in cat_id_lists.items():
            try:
                new_ids = ElementTransformUtils.CopyElements(
                    source_view,
                    id_list,
                    target_view,
                    None,    # None = paste in place, no transform
                    opts
                )
                copied = new_ids.Count if new_ids else 0
                failed = id_list.Count - copied
                total_copied += copied
                total_failed += failed

                if failed > 0:
                    report_lines.append(
                        label + ': ' + str(copied) + ' copied, '
                        + str(failed) + ' failed'
                    )
                else:
                    report_lines.append(label + ': ' + str(copied) + ' copied')

            except Exception as copy_err:
                total_failed += id_list.Count
                report_lines.append(label + ': FAILED -- ' + str(copy_err))

        t.Commit()

    except Exception as err:
        t.RollBack()
        forms.alert(
            'Annotations paste failed.\n\n'
            'All changes have been rolled back.\n\n'
            'Detail: ' + str(err),
            title='Paste State'
        )
        return

    # -- Show report -----------------------------------------------------------
    summary = (
        'From: ' + source_name + '\n'
        'To:   ' + target_view.Name + '\n\n'
        'Total copied: ' + str(total_copied) + '\n'
        'Total failed: ' + str(total_failed) + '\n\n'
        'Detail:\n  ' + '\n  '.join(report_lines)
    )
    forms.alert(summary, title='Paste Annotations')
