```python
            <Button x:Name="btn_ActiveView" Grid.Column="0" Content="Active View"
                    Style="{StaticResource SecondaryButton}"/>
            <Button x:Name="btn_CheckAll"   Grid.Column="2" Content="Check All"
                    Style="{StaticResource SecondaryButton}"/>
            <Button x:Name="btn_UncheckAll" Grid.Column="4" Content="Uncheck All"
                    Style="{StaticResource SecondaryButton}"/>
            <Button x:Name="btn_Toggle"     Grid.Column="6" Content="Toggle All"
                    Style="{StaticResource SecondaryButton}"/>
        </Grid>
        <StackPanel Grid.Row="6" Orientation="Horizontal"
                    HorizontalAlignment="Right" Margin="0 12 0 0">
            <Button x:Name="btn_Cancel" Content="Cancel"
                    Style="{StaticResource SecondaryButton}"
                    Margin="0 0 8 0" IsCancel="True"/>
            <Button x:Name="btn_OK" Content="Propagate"
                    Style="{StaticResource PrimaryButton}"
                    IsEnabled="False"/>
        </StackPanel>
    </Grid>
</Window>
""".replace('STYLES_PLACEHOLDER', _STYLES)


_PE_SHOW_ALL = '-- Show all --'


def _pe_get_elementid_int(eid):
    """Stable ElementId int across Revit 2022/2023/2024."""
    try:
        return int(eid.Value)
    except AttributeError:
        return eid.IntegerValue


def _pe_get_combined_type_cached(views):
    """
    Pre-compute 'ViewType > FamilyType' strings for all views in one pass.
    Returns a dict: {view_element_id_int -> combined_type_string}.
    Called ONCE at window construction -- never per-keypress.
    """
    # Batch: collect all unique type ElementIds first, then fetch in one loop
    type_id_to_str = {}
    result = {}
    for v in views:
        try:
            vid = _pe_get_elementid_int(v.Id)
            type_id = v.GetTypeId()
            tid_int = _pe_get_elementid_int(type_id)
            if tid_int not in type_id_to_str:
                try:
                    vft = revit.doc.GetElement(type_id)
                    if vft is not None:
                        p = vft.get_Parameter(
                            DB.BuiltInParameter.ALL_MODEL_TYPE_NAME)
                        if p:
                            name = p.AsString()
                            if name:
                                type_id_to_str[tid_int] = (
                                    str(v.ViewType) + ' > ' + name)
                                continue
                    type_id_to_str[tid_int] = str(v.ViewType)
                except Exception:
                    type_id_to_str[tid_int] = str(v.ViewType)
            result[vid] = type_id_to_str[tid_int]
        except Exception:
            try:
                result[_pe_get_elementid_int(v.Id)] = str(v.ViewType)
            except Exception:
                pass
    return result


def _pe_get_target_views(host_view):
    """Return all non-template views with the same ViewType as host."""
    result = []
    try:
        for v in DB.FilteredElementCollector(revit.doc)\
                .OfClass(DB.View).ToElements():
            try:
                if v.IsTemplate:
                    continue
                if v.Id == host_view.Id:
                    continue
                if v.ViewType != host_view.ViewType:
                    continue
                result.append(v)
            except Exception:
                pass
    except Exception:
        pass
    result.sort(key=lambda v: v.Name)
    return result


class PropagateTargetPickerWindow(object):
    """
    Target view picker for Propagate Extents.
    Performance optimisations:
    - Type strings pre-computed once at construction (not per keypress)
    - WPF resources (FontFamily, Brush) created once and shared
    - ListBoxItems pre-built once; _fill just shows/hides rather than rebuilding
    Interaction model matches the original PropagateExtentsOverride tool exactly.
    """

    def __init__(self, target_views, host_name, active_view_id=None):
        self._all_views   = target_views
        self._checked_ids = set()
        self._active_vid  = active_view_id
        self.result       = []
        self.cancelled    = True

        # Pre-compute type strings ONCE -- no per-keypress Revit API calls
        self._type_map = _pe_get_combined_type_cached(target_views)
        # Pre-compute label strings ONCE
        self._label_map = {}
        for v in target_views:
            try:
                vid = _pe_get_elementid_int(v.Id)
                self._label_map[vid] = '{} [{}]'.format(v.Name, v.ViewType)
            except Exception:
                pass
        # Pre-compute lowercased names for fast search filtering
        self._name_lower = {}
        for v in target_views:
            try:
                self._name_lower[_pe_get_elementid_int(v.Id)] = v.Name.lower()
            except Exception:
                pass

        # Shared WPF resources -- created ONCE, reused for every ListBoxItem
        self._font      = System.Windows.Media.FontFamily('Segoe UI')
        self._fg_brush  = System.Windows.Media.SolidColorBrush(
                              System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(
                                  0x1A, 0x1A, 0x1A))

        self._win        = System.Windows.Markup.XamlReader.Parse(
                               _PROPAGATE_TARGET_XAML)
        self._lst        = self._win.FindName('lst_Views')
        self._txt        = self._win.FindName('txt_Search')
        self._cmb        = self._win.FindName('cmb_ViewType')
        self._btn_ok     = self._win.FindName('btn_OK')
        self._btn_cancel = self._win.FindName('btn_Cancel')
        self._btn_active = self._win.FindName('btn_ActiveView')
        self._btn_all    = self._win.FindName('btn_CheckAll')
        self._btn_none   = self._win.FindName('btn_UncheckAll')
        self._btn_toggle = self._win.FindName('btn_Toggle')
        self._txt_host   = self._win.FindName('txt_HostView')

        self._txt_host.Text = host_name

        if active_view_id is not None:
            for v in target_views:
                if _pe_get_elementid_int(v.Id) == active_view_id:
                    self._checked_ids.add(active_view_id)
                    break

        # Pre-build ALL ListBoxItems AFTER checked_ids is populated
        # so the active view's checkbox renders as ticked from the start
        self._all_items = []
        for v in target_views:
            self._all_items.append(self._make_item(v))

        self._populate_type_filter()
        self._apply_filter()

        self._txt.TextChanged      += self._on_filter
        self._cmb.SelectionChanged += self._on_filter
        self._lst.PreviewMouseDown += self._on_list_mouse_down
        self._btn_ok.Click         += self._on_ok
        self._btn_cancel.Click     += self._on_cancel
        self._btn_active.Click     += self._on_select_active
        self._btn_all.Click        += self._on_check_all
        self._btn_none.Click       += self._on_uncheck_all
        self._btn_toggle.Click     += self._on_toggle

    def _populate_type_filter(self):
        # Use pre-computed type_map -- no Revit API calls here
        types = sorted(set(self._type_map.values()))
        self._cmb.Items.Clear()
        self._cmb.Items.Add(_PE_SHOW_ALL)
        for t in types:
            self._cmb.Items.Add(t)
        self._cmb.SelectedIndex = 0

    def _get_filtered_views(self):
        q        = self._txt.Text.strip().lower()
        sel_type = self._cmb.SelectedItem
        use_type = sel_type and sel_type != _PE_SHOW_ALL
        result   = []
        for v in self._all_views:
            try:
                vid = _pe_get_elementid_int(v.Id)
                if q and q not in self._name_lower.get(vid, ''):
                    continue
                if use_type and self._type_map.get(vid) != sel_type:
                    continue
                result.append(v)
            except Exception:
                pass
        return result

    def _apply_filter(self):
        """Rebuild list from filtered views -- uses pre-built items where possible."""
        filtered = self._get_filtered_views()
        filtered_ids = set(_pe_get_elementid_int(v.Id) for v in filtered)

        self._lst.Items.Clear()
        active_item = None
        for item in self._all_items:
            try:
                vid = _pe_get_elementid_int(item.Tag.Id)
                if vid in filtered_ids:
                    self._lst.Items.Add(item)
                    if vid == self._active_vid:
                        active_item = item
            except Exception:
                pass

        # Scroll to and highlight the active view item on initial load
        if active_item is not None:
            self._lst.ScrollIntoView(active_item)

        self._update_ok()

    def _make_item(self, view):
        """Build ListBoxItem using shared WPF resources."""
        vid   = _pe_get_elementid_int(view.Id)
        label = self._label_map.get(vid, view.Name)

        cb = Controls.CheckBox()
        cb.Content           = label
        cb.FontFamily        = self._font
        cb.FontSize          = 11
        cb.Foreground        = self._fg_brush
        cb.VerticalAlignment = System.Windows.VerticalAlignment.Center
        cb.IsHitTestVisible  = False
        cb.Focusable         = False
        cb.IsChecked         = (vid in self._checked_ids)

        item         = Controls.ListBoxItem()
        item.Content = cb
        item.Tag     = view
        return item

    def _sync_checkboxes(self):
        for i in range(self._lst.Items.Count):
            item = self._lst.Items.GetItemAt(i)
            vid  = _pe_get_elementid_int(item.Tag.Id)
            if isinstance(item.Content, Controls.CheckBox):
                item.Content.IsChecked = (vid in self._checked_ids)

    def _update_ok(self):
        self._btn_ok.IsEnabled = len(self._checked_ids) > 0

    def _on_filter(self, sender, args):
        self._apply_filter()

    def _on_select_active(self, sender, args):
        self._checked_ids.clear()
        if self._active_vid is not None:
            self._checked_ids.add(self._active_vid)
        self._sync_checkboxes()
        self._update_ok()

    def _on_list_mouse_down(self, sender, args):
        pos = args.GetPosition(self._lst)
        hit = self._lst.InputHitTest(pos)

        clicked_item = None
        element = hit
        while element is not None:
            if isinstance(element, Controls.ListBoxItem):
                clicked_item = element
                break
            try:
                element = System.Windows.Media.VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(element)
            except Exception:
                break

        if clicked_item is None:
            return

        item_pos = args.GetPosition(clicked_item)

        if item_pos.X <= 20:
            if not clicked_item.IsSelected:
                clicked_item.IsSelected = True

            selected = list(self._lst.SelectedItems)
            if not selected:
                selected = [clicked_item]

            selected_ids = [_pe_get_elementid_int(i.Tag.Id)
                            for i in selected
                            if hasattr(i, 'Tag') and i.Tag is not None]

            all_checked = all(vid in self._checked_ids for vid in selected_ids)
            if all_checked:
                for vid in selected_ids:
                    self._checked_ids.discard(vid)
            else:
                for vid in selected_ids:
                    self._checked_ids.add(vid)

            self._sync_checkboxes()
            self._update_ok()
            args.Handled = True

    def _on_check_all(self, sender, args):
        for i in range(self._lst.Items.Count):
            self._checked_ids.add(
                _pe_get_elementid_int(self._lst.Items.GetItemAt(i).Tag.Id))
        self._sync_checkboxes()
        self._update_ok()

    def _on_uncheck_all(self, sender, args):
        self._checked_ids.clear()
        self._sync_checkboxes()
        self._update_ok()

    def _on_toggle(self, sender, args):
        for i in range(self._lst.Items.Count):
            vid = _pe_get_elementid_int(self._lst.Items.GetItemAt(i).Tag.Id)
            if vid in self._checked_ids:
                self._checked_ids.discard(vid)
            else:
                self._checked_ids.add(vid)
        self._sync_checkboxes()
        self._update_ok()

    def _on_ok(self, sender, args):
        self.result = [
            self._lst.Items.GetItemAt(i).Tag
            for i in range(self._lst.Items.Count)
            if _pe_get_elementid_int(self._lst.Items.GetItemAt(i).Tag.Id)
               in self._checked_ids
        ]
        self.cancelled = False
        self._win.Close()

    def _on_cancel(self, sender, args):
        self.cancelled = True
        self._win.Close()

    def show(self):
        self._win.ShowDialog()
        return self



def _paste_propagate_extents():
    """
    Propagate grid extents from the stored host view to user-chosen targets.
    Replicates the full logic of the standalone PropagateExtentsOverride tool:
      1. Load stored host view
      2. Show target view picker (same ViewType as host only)
      3. Store crop states, disable crops, propagate grids, restore crops
    All inside one Transaction.
    """
    import System.Collections.Generic as SCG_pe

    # -- Load stored host view data -------------------------------------------
    try:
        pe_data = script.load_data(slot_name=PROPAGATE_EXTENTS_SLOT)
    except Exception as load_err:
        forms.alert(
            'Could not load saved Propagate Extents data.\n\n'
            'Please run Copy State > Propagate Extents first.\n\n'
            'Detail: ' + str(load_err),
            title='Paste State'
        )
        return

    host_name    = pe_data.get('host_view_name', '')
    host_view_id = pe_data.get('host_view_id', -1)

    # Resolve host view element
    host_view = None
    try:
        host_view = revit.doc.GetElement(DB.ElementId(int(host_view_id)))
    except Exception:
        pass

    if host_view is None:
        # Fallback: search by name
        try:
            for v in DB.FilteredElementCollector(revit.doc)\
                    .OfClass(DB.View).ToElements():
                try:
                    if v.Name == host_name and not v.IsTemplate:
                        host_view = v
                        break
                except Exception:
                    pass
        except Exception:
            pass

    if host_view is None:
        forms.alert(
            'Could not find host view "' + host_name + '".\n\n'
            'Please run Copy State > Propagate Extents again.',
            title='Paste State'
        )
        return

    # -- Collect grids and levels in host view --------------------------------
    grids_in_host  = []
    levels_in_host = []

    try:
        grids_in_host = list(
            DB.FilteredElementCollector(revit.doc, host_view.Id)
            .OfClass(DB.Grid)
            .ToElements()
        )
    except Exception as e:
        forms.alert(
            'Could not collect grids from host view.\n\nDetail: ' + str(e),
            title='Paste State'
        )
        return

    try:
        levels_in_host = list(
            DB.FilteredElementCollector(revit.doc, host_view.Id)
            .OfClass(DB.Level)
            .ToElements()
        )
    except Exception:
        pass

    if not grids_in_host and not levels_in_host:
        forms.alert(
            'No grids or levels found in host view:\n' + host_name,
            title='Paste State'
        )
        return

    # -- Show target view picker ----------------------------------------------
    target_candidates = _pe_get_target_views(host_view)
    if not target_candidates:
        forms.alert(
            'No valid target views found.\n\n'
            'Target views must have the same view type as the host ('
            + str(host_view.ViewType) + ').',
            title='Paste State'
        )
        return

    win = PropagateTargetPickerWindow(
        target_candidates,
        host_name,
        active_view_id=_pe_get_elementid_int(revit.active_view.Id)
    )
    win.show()

    if win.cancelled or not win.result:
        return

    target_views = win.result

    # -- Build target ElementId set for PropagateToViews ----------------------
    target_ids = SCG_pe.HashSet[DB.ElementId]()
    for v in target_views:
        target_ids.Add(v.Id)

    # -- Run propagation in one Transaction -----------------------------------
    ok_count   = 0
    fail_count = 0
    fail_msgs  = []

    with revit.Transaction('Propagate Grid and Level Extents'):
        # Store and disable crop boxes on targets
        crop_states = {}
        for v in target_views:
            try:
                vid = _pe_get_elementid_int(v.Id)
                crop_states[vid] = {
                    'active':  v.CropBoxActive,
                    'visible': v.CropBoxVisible,
                }
                v.CropBoxActive = False
            except Exception:
                pass

        # Propagate grids
        for grid in grids_in_host:
            grid_name = getattr(grid, 'Name', str(grid.Id))
            try:
                grid.PropagateToViews(host_view, target_ids)
                ok_count += 1
            except Exception as e:
                fail_count += 1
                fail_msgs.append('Grid ' + grid_name + ': ' + str(e))

        # Propagate levels
        for level in levels_in_host:
            level_name = getattr(level, 'Name', str(level.Id))
            try:
                level.PropagateToViews(host_view, target_ids)
                ok_count += 1
            except Exception as e:
                fail_count += 1
                fail_msgs.append('Level ' + level_name + ': ' + str(e))

        # Restore crop states
        for v in target_views:
            try:
                vid   = _pe_get_elementid_int(v.Id)
                state = crop_states.get(vid)
                if state:
                    v.CropBoxActive  = state['active']
                    v.CropBoxVisible = state['visible']
            except Exception:
                pass

    # -- Report ---------------------------------------------------------------
    summary = (
        'Propagation complete.\n\n'
        'Host:    ' + host_name + '\n'
        'Targets: ' + str(len(target_views)) + '\n'
        'Grids:   ' + str(len(grids_in_host)) + '\n'
        'Levels:  ' + str(len(levels_in_host)) + '\n'
        'Success: ' + str(ok_count) + '\n'
        'Failed:  ' + str(fail_count)
    )
    if fail_msgs:
        summary += '\n\nFailed:\n  ' + '\n  '.join(fail_msgs)
    forms.alert(summary, title='Propagate Extents')


# =============================================================================
# SECTION 11c -- REVIT LINKS PASTE HANDLER
# =============================================================================
# Applies stored RVT link state (visibility + overrides) to:
#   a) the active / selected view   (same as Filter Overrides mode 1)
#   b) selected view templates      (same as Filter Overrides mode 2)
#
# Uses GetLinkOverrides / SetLinkOverrides directly -- never calls
# ApplyViewTemplateParameters so no other view properties are touched.
#
# RevitLinkGraphicsSettings cannot be deserialised from our plain-dict store,
# so at paste time we READ from the STORED SOURCE VIEW (still in the project)
# using its ElementId, then write to the target. If the source view no longer
# exists we fall back to best-effort from the serialised dict.

_LINKS_PASTE_MODE_XAML = ("""
<Window xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        Title="Paste State"
        Width="480" Height="260"
        MinWidth="360" MinHeight="220"
        ShowInTaskbar="False"
        Topmost="True"
        ResizeMode="CanResizeWithGrip"
        WindowStartupLocation="CenterScreen"
        Background="#FFFFFF"
        FontFamily="Segoe UI"
        FontSize="11">
    <Window.Resources>STYLES_PLACEHOLDER</Window.Resources>
    <Grid Margin="16">
        <Grid.RowDefinitions>
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
            <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
            <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
        </Grid.RowDefinitions>
        <TextBlock x:Name="txt_Title" Grid.Row="0"
                   Text="Paste Links"
                   FontSize="14" FontWeight="Bold"
                   Foreground="#1A1A1A" Margin="0 0 0 6"/>
        <TextBlock x:Name="txt_Desc" Grid.Row="1"
                   Text="Where do you want to paste the link overrides?"
                   FontSize="11" Foreground="#6B6B6B"
                   TextWrapping="Wrap" Margin="0 0 0 12"/>
        <ListBox x:Name="lst_Mode" Grid.Row="2"
                 Style="{StaticResource StandardListBox}"
                 ItemContainerStyle="{StaticResource StandardListBoxItem}"
                 SelectionMode="Single"/>
        <StackPanel Grid.Row="3" Orientation="Horizontal"
                    HorizontalAlignment="Right" Margin="0 12 0 0">
            <Button x:Name="btn_Cancel" Content="Cancel"
                    Style="{StaticResource SecondaryButton}"
                    Margin="0 0 8 0" IsCancel="True"/>
            <Button x:Name="btn_OK" Content="Paste"
                    Style="{StaticResource PrimaryButton}"
                    IsEnabled="False"/>
        </StackPanel>
    </Grid>
</Window>
""").replace('STYLES_PLACEHOLDER', _STYLES)


class LinksPasteModeWindow(object):
    """
    Single-select mode picker matching FilterPasteModeWindow.
    Reusable for both Revit Links and DWG Links.

    PASTE_MODES mirrors FilterPasteModeWindow so the UX is identical.
    """

    PASTE_MODES = [
        'Paste to Active / Selected View',
        'Paste to View Templates',
    ]

    def __init__(self, title, description):
        self.result    = None
        self.cancelled = True

        self._win        = System.Windows.Markup.XamlReader.Parse(_LINKS_PASTE_MODE_XAML)
        self._lst        = self._win.FindName('lst_Mode')
        self._btn_ok     = self._win.FindName('btn_OK')
        self._btn_cancel = self._win.FindName('btn_Cancel')
        self._txt_title  = self._win.FindName('txt_Title')
        self._txt_desc   = self._win.FindName('txt_Desc')

        self._txt_title.Text = title
        self._txt_desc.Text  = description

        for mode in self.PASTE_MODES:
            item         = Controls.ListBoxItem()
            item.Content = mode
            item.Tag     = mode
            self._lst.Items.Add(item)

        self._lst.SelectionChanged += self._on_selection
        self._lst.MouseDoubleClick += self._on_double_click
        self._btn_ok.Click         += self._on_ok
        self._btn_cancel.Click     += self._on_cancel

    def _on_selection(self, sender, args):
        self._btn_ok.IsEnabled = self._lst.SelectedItem is not None

    def _on_double_click(self, sender, args):
        if self._lst.SelectedItem is not None:
            self._confirm()

    def _on_ok(self, sender, args):
        self._confirm()

    def _confirm(self):
        if self._lst.SelectedItem is not None:
            self.result    = self._lst.SelectedItem.Tag
            self.cancelled = False
        self._win.Close()

    def _on_cancel(self, sender, args):
        self.cancelled = True
        self._win.Close()

    def show(self):
        self._win.ShowDialog()
        return self


def _apply_rvt_links_to_view(source_view, target_view, memory, selected_inst_ids=None):
    """
    Apply stored RVT link overrides from source_view to target_view.
    Only touches the selected instances -- all other links are left unchanged.

    Does NOT use ApplyViewTemplateParameters -- touches only selected links
    directly via GetLinkOverrides / SetLinkOverrides.
    """
    from Autodesk.Revit.DB import (
        FilteredElementCollector,
        RevitLinkInstance,
        RevitLinkType,
    )

    doc = target_view.Document

    # Build the set of instance id ints to process
    link_data = memory.get('link_data', {})
    if selected_inst_ids is not None:
        active_inst_ids = selected_inst_ids
    else:
        active_inst_ids = set()
        for k in link_data.keys():
            try:
                active_inst_ids.add(int(k))
            except Exception:
                pass

    if not active_inst_ids or source_view is None:
        return

    all_instances = []
    try:
        all_instances = list(
            FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfClass(RevitLinkInstance).ToElements()
        )
    except Exception:
        pass

    import System.Collections.Generic as SCG_rvt
    ids_to_hide   = SCG_rvt.List[DB.ElementId]()
    ids_to_unhide = SCG_rvt.List[DB.ElementId]()

    # Track which types we have already written to avoid redundant writes
    written_type_ints = set()

    for link_inst in all_instances:
        try:
            try:    inst_int = int(link_inst.Id.Value)
            except: inst_int = link_inst.Id.IntegerValue

            # Only process selected instances
            if inst_int not in active_inst_ids:
                continue

            type_id = link_inst.GetTypeId()
            try:    type_int = int(type_id.Value)
            except: type_int = type_id.IntegerValue

            # Copy type-level override from source (once per type)
            if type_int not in written_type_ints:
                try:
                    src_type_gs = source_view.GetLinkOverrides(type_id)
                    if src_type_gs is not None:
                        target_view.SetLinkOverrides(type_id, src_type_gs)
                    written_type_ints.add(type_int)
                except Exception:
                    pass

            # Copy instance-level override from source
            try:
                src_inst_gs = source_view.GetLinkOverrides(link_inst.Id)
                if src_inst_gs is not None:
                    target_view.SetLinkOverrides(link_inst.Id, src_inst_gs)
            except Exception:
                pass

            # Visibility tick -- read from instance gs, fall back to type gs
            vis_str = 'ByHostView'
            try:
                src_inst_gs = source_view.GetLinkOverrides(link_inst.Id)
                if src_inst_gs is not None:
                    vis_str = str(src_inst_gs.LinkVisibility)
                else:
                    src_type_gs = source_view.GetLinkOverrides(type_id)
                    if src_type_gs is not None:
                        vis_str = str(src_type_gs.LinkVisibility)
            except Exception:
                pass

            if 'Hidden' in vis_str:
                ids_to_hide.Add(link_inst.Id)
            else:
                ids_to_unhide.Add(link_inst.Id)

        except Exception:
            pass

    try:
        if ids_to_hide.Count > 0:
            target_view.HideElements(ids_to_hide)
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        if ids_to_unhide.Count > 0:
            target_view.UnhideElements(ids_to_unhide)
    except Exception:
        pass


def _paste_revit_links():
    """
    Paste stored Revit Links state.

    Flow:
      1. Load memory -- show which links were stored
      2. Link picker -- user selects which stored links to apply (all pre-checked)
      3. Mode picker -- Active View or View Templates (mirrors Filter Overrides)
      4. Transaction -- apply only the chosen links to chosen targets
    """
    memory = script.load_data(slot_name=RVT_LINKS_SLOT)
    if memory is None:
        forms.alert(
            'No Revit Links data in memory.\n\n'
            'Run Copy State > Revit Links on a view first.',
            title='Paste State'
        )
        return

    source_view_id_int = memory.get('source_view_id')
    source_view_name   = memory.get('source_view_name', '?')
    link_data          = memory.get('link_data', {})

    # -- Step 1: Link picker -------------------------------------------------
    # Build sorted list of (display_name, inst_id_int) from stored data.
    # All items pre-checked -- user unticks what they don't want.
    picker_items = []
    for inst_int, info in link_data.items():
        try:
            picker_items.append((info.get('display_name', 'Link ' + str(inst_int)), int(inst_int)))
        except Exception:
            pass
    picker_items.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])

    if not picker_items:
        forms.alert(
            'No link data found in memory.\n\n'
            'Run Copy State > Revit Links again.',
            title='Paste State'
        )
        return

    link_win = SubItemPickerWindow(
        items       = picker_items,
        title       = 'Paste Revit Links',
        header      = 'Select which Revit Links to paste:',
        source_name = source_view_name,
        ok_label    = 'Next'
    )
    link_win.show()

    if link_win.cancelled:
        return

    # result is a list of int_key values for checked items
    selected_inst_ids = set(link_win.result)

    if not selected_inst_ids:
        forms.alert('No links selected.', title='Paste State')
        return

    # -- Step 2: Resolve source view -----------------------------------------
    source_view = None
    if source_view_id_int is not None:
        import System as _Sys
        try:
            from Autodesk.Revit.DB import ElementId as _EId
            src_eid = _EId(_Sys.Int64(source_view_id_int))
            source_view = revit.doc.GetElement(src_eid)
        except Exception:
            pass

    # -- Step 3: Mode picker (Active View / View Templates) ------------------
    mode_win = LinksPasteModeWindow(
        title       = 'Paste Revit Links',
        description = (
            'Copied from: ' + source_view_name + '\n\n'
            'Where do you want to paste the Revit Link overrides?'
        )
    )
    mode_win.show()

    if mode_win.cancelled or not mode_win.result:
        return

    use_templates = (mode_win.result == LinksPasteModeWindow.PASTE_MODES[1])

    if use_templates:
        target_views = forms.select_viewtemplates()
        if not target_views:
            return
    else:
        target_views = [revit.uidoc.ActiveGraphicalView]
        if not target_views[0]:
            forms.alert('No active graphical view found.', title='Paste State')
            return

    # -- Step 4: Transaction -------------------------------------------------
    ok_count  = 0
    fail_msgs = []

    t = Transaction(revit.doc, 'Py: Paste Revit Links')
    t.Start()
    try:
        for tv in target_views:
            try:
                _apply_rvt_links_to_view(source_view, tv, memory, selected_inst_ids)
                ok_count += 1
            except Exception as ex:
                fail_msgs.append((tv.Name if tv else '?') + ': ' + str(ex))
        t.Commit()
    except Exception as tx_ex:
        t.RollBack()
        forms.alert(
            'Transaction failed -- no changes made.\n\nDetail: ' + str(tx_ex),
            title='Paste State'
        )
        return

    summary = (
        'Paste Revit Links complete.\n\n'
        'Source view:    ' + source_view_name + '\n'
        'Links applied:  ' + str(len(selected_inst_ids)) + '\n'
        'Views updated:  ' + str(ok_count)
    )
    if fail_msgs:
        summary += '\nFailed: ' + str(len(fail_msgs))
        summary += '\n\n' + '\n'.join(fail_msgs)
    forms.alert(summary, title='Paste State')

# SECTION 11d -- DWG LINKS PASTE HANDLER
# =============================================================================

def _apply_dwg_links_to_view(source_view, target_view, memory):
    """
    Apply stored DWG/imported category overrides to target_view.
    Only touches categories that were selected at copy time.
    Reads directly from source_view if available; falls back to dict otherwise.
    """
    from Autodesk.Revit.DB import CategoryType

    doc = target_view.Document

    # Build set of category id ints selected at copy time
    cat_data        = memory.get('cat_data', {})
    stored_cat_ids  = set()
    for k in cat_data.keys():
        try:
            stored_cat_ids.add(int(k))
        except Exception:
            pass

    if source_view is not None:
        # Primary path: read live from the source view -- only selected cats
        for cat in doc.Settings.Categories:
            try:
                if cat.CategoryType != CategoryType.Internal:
                    continue
                try:    cat_int = int(cat.Id.Value)
                except: cat_int = cat.Id.IntegerValue
                if cat_int not in stored_cat_ids:
                    continue   # not selected at copy time
                hidden = source_view.GetCategoryHidden(cat.Id)
                ogs    = source_view.GetCategoryOverrides(cat.Id)
                target_view.SetCategoryHidden(cat.Id, hidden)
                target_view.SetCategoryOverrides(cat.Id, ogs)
            except Exception:
                pass
    else:
        # Fallback: source view deleted -- apply visibility from stored dict
        for cat in doc.Settings.Categories:
            try:
                if cat.CategoryType != CategoryType.Internal:
                    continue
                try:    cat_int = int(cat.Id.Value)
                except: cat_int = cat.Id.IntegerValue
                if cat_int not in stored_cat_ids:
                    continue
                stored = cat_data.get(cat_int)
                if stored is None:
                    continue
                target_view.SetCategoryHidden(cat.Id, bool(stored.get('hidden', False)))
            except Exception:
                pass


def _paste_dwg_links():
    """
    Paste stored DWG Links state to active view or view templates.
    Mirrors Revit Links paste flow exactly.
    """
    memory = script.load_data(slot_name=DWG_LINKS_SLOT)
    if memory is None:
        forms.alert(
            'No DWG Links data in memory.\n\n'
            'Run Copy State > DWG Links on a view first.',
            title='Paste State'
        )
        return

    source_view_id_int = memory.get('source_view_id')
    source_view_name   = memory.get('source_view_name', '?')

    source_view = None
    if source_view_id_int is not None:
        import System as _Sys
        try:
            from Autodesk.Revit.DB import ElementId as _EId
            src_eid = _EId(_Sys.Int64(source_view_id_int))
            source_view = revit.doc.GetElement(src_eid)
        except Exception:
            pass

    mode_win = LinksPasteModeWindow(
        title       = 'Paste DWG Links',
        description = (
            'Copied from: ' + source_view_name + '\n\n'
            'Where do you want to paste the DWG / imported category overrides?'
        )
    )
    mode_win.show()

    if mode_win.cancelled or not mode_win.result:
        return

    use_templates = (mode_win.result == LinksPasteModeWindow.PASTE_MODES[1])

    if use_templates:
        target_views = forms.select_viewtemplates()
        if not target_views:
            return
    else:
        target_views = [revit.uidoc.ActiveGraphicalView]
        if not target_views[0]:
            forms.alert('No active graphical view found.', title='Paste State')
            return

    ok_count  = 0
    fail_msgs = []

    t = Transaction(revit.doc, 'Py: Paste DWG Links')
    t.Start()
    try:
        for tv in target_views:
            try:
                _apply_dwg_links_to_view(source_view, tv, memory)
                ok_count += 1
            except Exception as ex:
                fail_msgs.append((tv.Name if tv else '?') + ': ' + str(ex))
        t.Commit()
    except Exception as tx_ex:
        t.RollBack()
        forms.alert(
            'Transaction failed -- no changes made.\n\nDetail: ' + str(tx_ex),
            title='Paste State'
        )
        return

    summary = (
        'Paste DWG Links complete.\n\n'
        'Source view:   ' + source_view_name + '\n'
        'Views updated: ' + str(ok_count)
    )
    if fail_msgs:
        summary += '\nFailed: ' + str(len(fail_msgs))
        summary += '\n\n' + '\n'.join(fail_msgs)
    forms.alert(summary, title='Paste State')

class VpTitleModePickerWindow(object):
    """
    Small prompt window with two clickable cards:
      'Paste to Current Sheet'   -> self.result = 'current'
      'Paste to Multiple Sheets' -> self.result = 'multiple'

    Clicking either card immediately closes the window and sets result.
    Cancel sets self.cancelled = True.
    """

    def __init__(self, memory_summary, active_sheet_name=None):
        self._win     = System.Windows.Markup.XamlReader.Parse(_VP_TITLE_MODE_XAML)
        self._summary = self._win.FindName('txt_MemorySummary')
        self._card_c  = self._win.FindName('card_Current')
        self._card_m  = self._win.FindName('card_Multiple')
        self._btn_cancel = self._win.FindName('btn_Cancel')

        self.cancelled = True
        self.result    = None   # 'current' or 'multiple'

        self._summary.Text = memory_summary

        # Dim the Current Sheet card if not on a sheet
        if active_sheet_name is None:
            self._card_c.Opacity  = 0.4
            self._card_c.IsEnabled = False
            self._card_c.ToolTip  = 'Open a sheet first to use this option.'
        else:
            # Update label to show the sheet name
            try:
                sp = self._card_c.Child
                sp.Children[0].Text = u'Paste to Current Sheet  ({0})'.format(
                    active_sheet_name)
            except Exception:
                pass

        self._card_c.MouseLeftButtonUp  += self._on_current
        self._card_m.MouseLeftButtonUp  += self._on_multiple
        self._btn_cancel.Click          += self._on_cancel

    def _on_current(self, sender, args):
        self.result    = 'current'
        self.cancelled = False
        self._win.Close()

    def _on_multiple(self, sender, args):
        self.result    = 'multiple'
        self.cancelled = False
        self._win.Close()

    def _on_cancel(self, sender, args):
        self.cancelled = True
        self._win.Close()

    def show(self):
        self._win.ShowDialog()

class VpTitleSheetPickerWindow(object):
    """
    Step 1 -- Sheet shuttle window (AlignViewportTitles style).
    Left: all sheets. Middle: arrow buttons. Right: target sheets.

    After show():
      self.cancelled      -- True if user cancelled
      self.result_sheets  -- list of chosen ViewSheet elements
    """

    def __init__(self, all_sheets, memory_summary, default_sheet=None):
        self._all_sheets    = all_sheets
        self._left_sheets   = list(all_sheets)
        # Pre-populate target with the active sheet if one was passed in
        self._right_sheets  = [default_sheet] if default_sheet is not None else []

        self._win = System.Windows.Markup.XamlReader.Parse(_VP_TITLE_SHEET_XAML)
        self._lst_all    = self._win.FindName('lst_AllSheets')
        self._lst_target = self._win.FindName('lst_TargetSheets')
        self._txt_search = self._win.FindName('txt_SheetSearch')
        self._lbl_count  = self._win.FindName('lbl_SheetCount')
        self._btn_add        = self._win.FindName('btn_Add')
        self._btn_add_all    = self._win.FindName('btn_AddAll')
        self._btn_remove     = self._win.FindName('btn_Remove')
        self._btn_remove_all = self._win.FindName('btn_RemoveAll')
        self._btn_next   = self._win.FindName('btn_Next')
        self._btn_cancel = self._win.FindName('btn_Cancel')
        self._txt_summary = self._win.FindName('txt_MemorySummary')

        self.cancelled     = True
        self.result_sheets = []

        self._txt_summary.Text = memory_summary
        self._refresh_left()

        self._txt_search.TextChanged += self._on_search
        self._btn_add.Click          += self._on_add
        self._btn_add_all.Click      += self._on_add_all
        self._btn_remove.Click       += self._on_remove
        self._btn_remove_all.Click   += self._on_remove_all
        self._btn_next.Click         += self._on_next
        self._btn_cancel.Click       += self._on_cancel

    def _sheet_label(self, sheet):
        """'A100 - Sheet Name' label."""
        try:
            return u'{0} - {1}'.format(sheet.SheetNumber, sheet.Name)
        except Exception:
            return u'(unknown sheet)'

    def _make_item(self, sheet):
        item         = Controls.ListBoxItem()
        item.Content = self._sheet_label(sheet)
        item.Tag     = sheet
        return item

    def _refresh_left(self):
        """Rebuild left list with current search filter applied."""
        self._lst_all.Items.Clear()
        search = ''
        try:
            search = self._txt_search.Text.strip().lower()
        except Exception:
            pass
        # Only show sheets not already in target list
        target_ids = set(id(s) for s in self._right_sheets)
        for sheet in self._all_sheets:
            if id(sheet) in target_ids:
                continue
            label = self._sheet_label(sheet)
            if search and search not in label.lower():
                continue
            self._lst_all.Items.Add(self._make_item(sheet))

    def _refresh_right(self):
        self._lst_target.Items.Clear()
        for sheet in self._right_sheets:
            self._lst_target.Items.Add(self._make_item(sheet))
        n = len(self._right_sheets)
        self._lbl_count.Text = '{0} sheet{1} selected'.format(n, 's' if n != 1 else '')
        self._btn_next.IsEnabled = (n > 0)

    def _on_search(self, sender, args):
        self._refresh_left()

    def _on_add(self, sender, args):
        for item in list(self._lst_all.SelectedItems):
            if item.Tag not in self._right_sheets:
                self._right_sheets.append(item.Tag)
        self._refresh_left()
        self._refresh_right()

    def _on_add_all(self, sender, args):
        # Add everything currently visible on the left
        for i in range(self._lst_all.Items.Count):
            sheet = self._lst_all.Items.GetItemAt(i).Tag
            if sheet not in self._right_sheets:
                self._right_sheets.append(sheet)
        self._refresh_left()
        self._refresh_right()

    def _on_remove(self, sender, args):
        for item in list(self._lst_target.SelectedItems):
            if item.Tag in self._right_sheets:
                self._right_sheets.remove(item.Tag)
        self._refresh_left()
        self._refresh_right()

    def _on_remove_all(self, sender, args):
        self._right_sheets = []
        self._refresh_left()
        self._refresh_right()

    def _on_next(self, sender, args):
        if not self._right_sheets:
            return
        self.result_sheets = list(self._right_sheets)
        self.cancelled     = False
        self._win.Close()

    def _on_cancel(self, sender, args):
        self.cancelled = True
        self._win.Close()

    def show(self):
        self._refresh_right()
        self._win.ShowDialog()


class ViewportTargetPickerWindow(object):
    """
    Step 2 -- Viewport multi-select across all chosen sheets.
    Each list entry is prefixed with the sheet number so the user knows
    which sheet each viewport belongs to.
    A 'Back' button signals the caller to re-show the sheet picker.

    After show():
      self.cancelled        -- True if user cancelled
      self.went_back        -- True if user pressed Back
      self.result_viewports -- list of chosen Viewport elements
      self.apply_type       -- True if 'Apply title type' ticked
      self.apply_position   -- True if 'Apply title position' ticked
    """

    def __init__(self, viewports_with_sheet, memory_summary):
        # viewports_with_sheet: list of (sheet, viewport) tuples
        self._all_pairs = viewports_with_sheet

        self._win            = System.Windows.Markup.XamlReader.Parse(_VP_TITLE_TARGET_XAML)
        self._lst            = self._win.FindName('lst_Viewports')
        self._search         = self._win.FindName('txt_Search')
        self._summary        = self._win.FindName('txt_MemorySummary')
        self._btn_ok         = self._win.FindName('btn_OK')
        self._btn_cancel     = self._win.FindName('btn_Cancel')
        self._btn_back       = self._win.FindName('btn_Back')
        self._btn_select_all = self._win.FindName('btn_SelectAll')
        self._btn_clear_all  = self._win.FindName('btn_ClearAll')
        self._chk_type       = self._win.FindName('chk_ApplyType')
        self._chk_pos        = self._win.FindName('chk_ApplyPosition')

        self.cancelled        = True
        self.went_back        = False
        self.result_viewports = []
        self.apply_type       = True
        self.apply_position   = True

        self._summary.Text = memory_summary
        self._populate(viewports_with_sheet)

        self._lst.SelectionChanged   += self._on_selection_changed
        self._search.TextChanged     += self._on_search_changed
        self._btn_ok.Click           += self._on_ok
        self._btn_cancel.Click       += self._on_cancel
        self._btn_back.Click         += self._on_back
        self._btn_select_all.Click   += self._on_select_all
        self._btn_clear_all.Click    += self._on_clear_all

    def _vp_label(self, sheet, vp):
        """'A100 - View Name  [Type Name]'"""
        from Autodesk.Revit.DB import BuiltInParameter
        doc = revit.doc
        try:
            sheet_num = sheet.SheetNumber
        except Exception:
            sheet_num = '?'
        view = doc.GetElement(vp.ViewId)
        try:
            vname = view.Name if view is not None else '(unknown view)'
        except Exception:
            vname = '(unknown view)'
        vtype = doc.GetElement(vp.GetTypeId())
        tname = '(unknown type)'
        if vtype is not None:
            try:
                p = vtype.get_Parameter(BuiltInParameter.SYMBOL_NAME_PARAM)
                if p is not None and p.AsString():
                    tname = p.AsString()
            except Exception:
                pass
            if tname == '(unknown type)':
                try:
                    p = vtype.get_Parameter(BuiltInParameter.ALL_MODEL_TYPE_NAME)
                    if p is not None and p.AsString():
                        tname = p.AsString()
                except Exception:
                    pass
            if tname == '(unknown type)':
                try:
                    tname = str(vtype.Name)
                except Exception:
                    pass
        return u'{0} - {1}  [{2}]'.format(sheet_num, vname, tname)

    def _populate(self, pairs):
        self._lst.Items.Clear()
        search = ''
        try:
            search = self._search.Text.strip().lower()
        except Exception:
            pass
        for sheet, vp in pairs:
            label = self._vp_label(sheet, vp)
            if search and search not in label.lower():
                continue
            item         = Controls.ListBoxItem()
            item.Content = label
            item.Tag     = vp
            self._lst.Items.Add(item)

    def _on_search_changed(self, sender, args):
        self._populate(self._all_pairs)
        self._update_ok()

    def _on_selection_changed(self, sender, args):
        self._update_ok()

    def _update_ok(self):
        self._btn_ok.IsEnabled = (self._lst.SelectedItems.Count > 0)

    def _on_select_all(self, sender, args):
        self._lst.SelectAll()
        self._update_ok()

    def _on_clear_all(self, sender, args):
        self._lst.UnselectAll()
        self._update_ok()

    def _on_ok(self, sender, args):
        selected = list(self._lst.SelectedItems)
        if not selected:
            return
        self.result_viewports = [item.Tag for item in selected]
        self.apply_type       = bool(self._chk_type.IsChecked)
        self.apply_position   = bool(self._chk_pos.IsChecked)
        self.cancelled        = False
        self._win.Close()

    def _on_cancel(self, sender, args):
        self.cancelled  = True
        self.went_back  = False
        self._win.Close()

    def _on_back(self, sender, args):
        self.cancelled = True
        self.went_back = True
        self._win.Close()

    def show(self):
        self._win.ShowDialog()


def _paste_viewport_title():
    """
    Viewport Title paste flow:

    0. Mode picker  -- 'Paste to Current Sheet' or 'Paste to Multiple Sheets'
    1. (Multiple only) Sheet shuttle -- pick target sheets
    2. Viewport picker -- multi-select viewports from target sheet(s)
    3. Transaction -- apply type and/or position to all chosen viewports
    """
    from Autodesk.Revit.DB import (
        ElementId, Transaction, XYZ,
        FilteredElementCollector, ViewSheet,
    )
    import System

    doc         = revit.doc
    active_view = revit.active_view

    # Load stored memory
    memory = script.load_data(slot_name=VP_TITLE_SLOT)
    if memory is None:
        forms.alert(
            'No Viewport Title data in memory.\n\n'
            'Run Copy State > Viewport Title on a sheet first.',
            title='Paste State'
        )
        return

    # Detect active sheet (used by mode picker + current-sheet flow)
    active_sheet      = None
    active_sheet_name = None
    if str(active_view.ViewType) == 'DrawingSheet':
        active_sheet      = active_view
        active_sheet_name = u'{0} - {1}'.format(
            active_view.SheetNumber, active_view.Name)

    # Build memory banner text
    banner_parts = [
        'Copied from:  ' + memory.get('source_sheet_name', '?') +
        '  /  ' + memory.get('source_view_name', '?'),
    ]
    if memory.get('copy_type', False):
        banner_parts.append('Title type:    ' + memory.get('vp_type_name', '?'))
    if memory.get('copy_position', False):
        banner_parts.append(
            'Title position:  X={0:.4f}  Y={1:.4f} (ft)'.format(
                memory.get('label_u', 0.0),
                memory.get('label_v', 0.0),
            )
        )
    memory_summary = '\n'.join(banner_parts)

    # Resolve type ElementId (System.Int64 avoids IronPython overload error)
    stored_type_id_int = memory.get('vp_type_id_int', -1)
    target_type_id     = ElementId(System.Int64(stored_type_id_int))
    target_type_elem   = doc.GetElement(target_type_id)

    # Reconstruct XYZ for label offset
    target_xyz = XYZ(
        float(memory.get('label_u', 0.0)),
        float(memory.get('label_v', 0.0)),
        0.0
    )

    # ---- Step 0: Mode picker -----------------------------------------------
    mode_win = VpTitleModePickerWindow(memory_summary, active_sheet_name)
    mode_win.show()

    if mode_win.cancelled:
        return

    mode = mode_win.result   # 'current' or 'multiple'

    # ---- Route based on mode -----------------------------------------------
    chosen_sheets    = None
    chosen_viewports = None
    apply_type       = True
    apply_position   = True

    if mode == 'current':
        # -- Current sheet: skip sheet picker, go straight to viewport picker --
        if active_sheet is None:
            forms.alert(
                'No active sheet found.\n\nPlease open a sheet and try again.',
                title='Paste State'
            )
            return

        vp_ids = active_sheet.GetAllViewports()
        pairs  = []
        for vid in vp_ids:
            vp = doc.GetElement(vid)
            if vp is not None:
                pairs.append((active_sheet, vp))

        if not pairs:
            forms.alert(
                'The active sheet has no viewports to paste onto.',
                title='Paste State'
            )
            return

        vp_win = ViewportTargetPickerWindow(pairs, memory_summary)
        vp_win.show()

        if vp_win.cancelled:
            return

        chosen_sheets    = [active_sheet]
        chosen_viewports = vp_win.result_viewports
        apply_type       = vp_win.apply_type
        apply_position   = vp_win.apply_position

    else:
        # -- Multiple sheets: full shuttle then viewport picker ---------------
        all_sheets = list(
            FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfClass(ViewSheet).ToElements()
        )
        all_sheets = [s for s in all_sheets if not s.IsPlaceholder]
        all_sheets.sort(key=lambda s: s.SheetNumber)

        if not all_sheets:
            forms.alert('No sheets found in this project.', title='Paste State')
            return

        # Pre-select active sheet as default if on one
        default_sheet = active_sheet

        while True:
            # Step 1: sheet shuttle
            sheet_win = VpTitleSheetPickerWindow(
                all_sheets, memory_summary, default_sheet=default_sheet
            )
            sheet_win.show()

            if sheet_win.cancelled:
                return

            chosen_sheets = sheet_win.result_sheets

            # Collect viewports across all chosen sheets
            pairs = []
            for sheet in chosen_sheets:
                vp_ids = sheet.GetAllViewports()
                for vid in vp_ids:
                    vp = doc.GetElement(vid)
                    if vp is not None:
                        pairs.append((sheet, vp))

            if not pairs:
                forms.alert(
                    'The selected sheet(s) have no viewports.\n\n'
                    'Please choose different sheets.',
                    title='Paste State'
                )
                continue

            # Step 2: viewport picker
            vp_win = ViewportTargetPickerWindow(pairs, memory_summary)
            vp_win.show()

            if vp_win.went_back:
                continue   # Back -- return to sheet shuttle

            if vp_win.cancelled:
                return

            chosen_viewports = vp_win.result_viewports
            apply_type       = vp_win.apply_type
            apply_position   = vp_win.apply_position
            break

    # ---- Validate ----------------------------------------------------------
    if not chosen_viewports:
        return

    if not apply_type and not apply_position:
        forms.alert(
            'Please tick at least one option:\n'
            '  "Apply title type"  or  "Apply title position".',
            title='Paste State'
        )
        return

    if apply_type and memory.get('copy_type', False) and target_type_elem is None:
        forms.alert(
            'The stored viewport type no longer exists in this model.\n\n'
            'Untick "Apply title type" to paste position only.',
            title='Paste State'
        )
        return

    # ---- Transaction -------------------------------------------------------
    ok_count  = 0
    fail_msgs = []

    t = Transaction(doc, 'Py: Paste Viewport Title')
    t.Start()
    try:
        for vp in chosen_viewports:
            try:
                if apply_type and memory.get('copy_type', False):
                    vp.ChangeTypeId(target_type_id)
                if apply_position and memory.get('copy_position', False):
                    vp.LabelOffset = target_xyz
                ok_count += 1
            except Exception as vp_ex:
                view     = doc.GetElement(vp.ViewId)
                vp_label = view.Name if view else '(unknown)'
                fail_msgs.append(vp_label + ': ' + str(vp_ex))
        t.Commit()
    except Exception as tx_ex:
        t.RollBack()
        forms.alert(
            'Transaction failed -- no changes were made.\n\nDetail: ' + str(tx_ex),
            title='Paste State'
        )
        return

    # ---- Report ------------------------------------------------------------
    n_sheets = len(chosen_sheets) if chosen_sheets else 0
    summary  = (
        'Paste Viewport Title complete.\n\n'
        'Sheets processed:  ' + str(n_sheets) + '\n'
        'Viewports updated: ' + str(ok_count)
    )
    if fail_msgs:
        summary += '\nFailed:            ' + str(len(fail_msgs))
        summary += '\n\nFailed:\n  ' + '\n  '.join(fail_msgs)
    forms.alert(summary, title='Paste State')


# =============================================================================
# SECTION 12 -- MAIN LOGIC
# =============================================================================

# Collect the real copypastestate actions that have data saved
available_actions = [
    x for x in copypastestate.get_actions()
    if x.validate_context() and script.data_exists(
        x.__name__, this_project=x.this_project
    )
]

# Synthetic action wrapper -- gives Scope Box the same .name interface
# as real copypastestate actions so it fits into the picker dict
class _SyntheticAction(object):
    def __init__(self, name):
        self.name = name

# Check if Scope Box data was previously copied
scope_box_has_data = False
try:
    scope_box_has_data = script.data_exists(SCOPE_BOX_SLOT)
except Exception:
    pass

# Check if Annotations data was previously copied
annotations_has_data = False
try:
    annotations_has_data = script.data_exists(ANNOTATIONS_SLOT)
except Exception:
    pass

# Check if Propagate Extents data was previously copied
propagate_extents_has_data = False
try:
    propagate_extents_has_data = script.data_exists(PROPAGATE_EXTENTS_SLOT)
except Exception:
    pass

# Check if Viewport Title data was previously copied
vp_title_has_data = False
try:
    vp_title_has_data = script.data_exists(VP_TITLE_SLOT)
except Exception:
    pass

# Check if Revit Links data was previously copied
rvt_links_has_data = False
try:
    rvt_links_has_data = script.data_exists(RVT_LINKS_SLOT)
except Exception:
    pass

# Check if DWG Links data was previously copied
dwg_links_has_data = False
try:
    dwg_links_has_data = script.data_exists(DWG_LINKS_SLOT)
except Exception:
    pass

# Build the final options dict -- real actions + synthetic ones if data exists
action_options = {x.name: x for x in available_actions}
if scope_box_has_data:
    action_options[SCOPE_BOX_ACTION_NAME]       = _SyntheticAction(SCOPE_BOX_ACTION_NAME)
if annotations_has_data:
    action_options[ANNOTATIONS_ACTION_NAME]     = _SyntheticAction(ANNOTATIONS_ACTION_NAME)
if propagate_extents_has_data:
    action_options[PROPAGATE_EXTENTS_NAME]      = _SyntheticAction(PROPAGATE_EXTENTS_NAME)
if vp_title_has_data:
    action_options[VP_TITLE_ACTION_NAME]        = _SyntheticAction(VP_TITLE_ACTION_NAME)
if rvt_links_has_data:
    action_options[RVT_LINKS_ACTION_NAME]       = _SyntheticAction(RVT_LINKS_ACTION_NAME)
if dwg_links_has_data:
    action_options[DWG_LINKS_ACTION_NAME]       = _SyntheticAction(DWG_LINKS_ACTION_NAME)

if not action_options:
    forms.alert(
        'No paste actions are available for this view, or no data has been '
        'copied yet.\n\nUse Copy State on a view first, then switch to your '
        'target view and run Paste State.',
        title='Paste State'
    )

else:
    # Always show the action picker so the user can see what's available
    # and confirm what they want to paste -- even if only one action exists.
    win = ActionPickerWindow(action_options)
    win.show()
    if win.cancelled or not win.result:
        script.exit()
    chosen_names = win.result   # list of action name strings

    # Sort order: Scope Box first, Annotations last (after VG/filters),
    # everything else in between.
    def _action_sort_key(name):
        if name == SCOPE_BOX_ACTION_NAME:
            return 0
        if name == ANNOTATIONS_ACTION_NAME:
            return 2
        if name == PROPAGATE_EXTENTS_NAME:
            return 3   # always last -- runs its own transaction
        if name == VP_TITLE_ACTION_NAME:
            return 4   # after propagate extents -- runs its own transaction
        if name == RVT_LINKS_ACTION_NAME:
            return 5
        if name == DWG_LINKS_ACTION_NAME:
            return 6
        return 1

    chosen_names = sorted(chosen_names, key=_action_sort_key)

    # Route each chosen action to its correct handler, in order
    for chosen_name in chosen_names:

        if chosen_name == VG_ACTION_NAME:
            _paste_vg_selective()

        elif chosen_name == FILTER_ACTION_NAME:
            _paste_filter_overrides()

        elif chosen_name == SCOPE_BOX_ACTION_NAME:
            _paste_scope_box()

        elif chosen_name == ANNOTATIONS_ACTION_NAME:
            _paste_annotations()

        elif chosen_name == PROPAGATE_EXTENTS_NAME:
            _paste_propagate_extents()

        elif chosen_name == VP_TITLE_ACTION_NAME:
            _paste_viewport_title()

        elif chosen_name == RVT_LINKS_ACTION_NAME:
            _paste_revit_links()

        elif chosen_name == DWG_LINKS_ACTION_NAME:
            _paste_dwg_links()

        else:
            # All other actions (Zoom/Pan, Crop Region, etc.) paste normally
            action = action_options[chosen_name]
            try:
                action().paste()
            except PyRevitException as ex:
                forms.alert(str(ex.msg), title='Paste State')
            except Exception as ex:
                forms.alert(
                    'Paste failed for "' + chosen_name + '".\n\n'
                    'Detail: ' + str(ex),
                    title='Paste State'
                )

```

```python
# Script:        PropagateExtentsOverride.py
# Description:   Propagate grid extents from selected host view to selected
#                target views, overriding crop view temporarily.
# Author:        Jason Braga
# Revit Version: 2022/2023/2024

#pylint: disable=import-error,invalid-name,broad-except

import clr
clr.AddReference('PresentationFramework')
clr.AddReference('PresentationCore')

import System
import System.Windows
import System.Windows.Controls as Controls
import System.Windows.Markup

from pyrevit import revit, DB, forms, script

__author__ = 'Jason Braga'

logger = script.get_logger()
output = script.get_output()


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Inline XAML strings - no external .xaml files needed
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------

_HOST_XAML = """
<Window xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        Title="Select Host View"
        Width="700" Height="640"
        MinWidth="500" MinHeight="400"
        ShowInTaskbar="False"
        ResizeMode="CanResizeWithGrip"
        WindowStartupLocation="CenterScreen"
        Background="#FFFFFF"
        FontFamily="Segoe UI"
        FontSize="11">
    <Window.Resources>
```
