```python
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# All logic functions below are identical to the original script
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------

class ViewOption(forms.TemplateListItem):
    @property
    def name(self):
        try:
            return '{} [{}]'.format(self.item.Name, self.item.ViewType)
        except Exception:
            return str(self.item.Name)


def get_elementid_value(eid):
    """Return stable int value from ElementId across Revit versions."""
    if eid is None:
        return None
    try:
        return int(eid.Value)          # Revit 2024+
    except AttributeError:
        return eid.IntegerValue        # Older Revit


def get_candidate_host_views():
    """Return valid host views: plans, sections, elevations."""
    valid_types = [
        DB.ViewType.FloorPlan,
        DB.ViewType.CeilingPlan,
        DB.ViewType.EngineeringPlan,
        DB.ViewType.AreaPlan,
        DB.ViewType.Section,
        DB.ViewType.Elevation,
        DB.ViewType.Detail
    ]

    all_views = DB.FilteredElementCollector(revit.doc)\
        .OfClass(DB.View)\
        .ToElements()

    result = []
    for view in all_views:
        try:
            if not view:
                continue
            if view.IsTemplate:
                continue
            if view.ViewType not in valid_types:
                continue
            result.append(view)
        except Exception:
            pass

    result.sort(key=lambda x: x.Name)
    return result


def get_target_views(host_view):
    """Return valid target views with same view type as host."""
    all_views = DB.FilteredElementCollector(revit.doc)\
        .OfClass(DB.View)\
        .ToElements()

    result = []
    for view in all_views:
        try:
            if not view:
                continue
            if view.IsTemplate:
                continue
            if view.Id == host_view.Id:
                continue
            if view.ViewType != host_view.ViewType:
                continue
            result.append(view)
        except Exception:
            pass

    result.sort(key=lambda x: x.Name)
    return result


def get_grids_in_view(view):
    """Collect all grids visible in the host view."""
    return list(
        DB.FilteredElementCollector(revit.doc, view.Id)
        .OfClass(DB.Grid)
        .ToElements()
    )


def get_levels_in_view(view):
    """Collect all levels visible in the host view."""
    return list(
        DB.FilteredElementCollector(revit.doc, view.Id)
        .OfClass(DB.Level)
        .ToElements()
    )


def propagate_levels(host_view, levels_in_view, target_views):
    """Propagate level extents from host to target views.
    Level inherits from DatumPlane so PropagateToViews works identically to Grid.
    """
    target_ids = build_target_id_set(target_views)

    msgs   = []
    status = []

    for level in levels_in_view:
        level_name = getattr(level, 'Name', str(level.Id))
        try:
            level.PropagateToViews(host_view, target_ids)
            msgs.append('OK Propagated level: {}'.format(level_name))
            status.append(True)
        except Exception as err:
            msgs.append('FAILED {} -> {}'.format(level_name, str(err)))
            status.append(False)

    return msgs, status


def build_target_id_set(target_views):
    """Create .NET HashSet[ElementId] for PropagateToViews."""
    target_ids = System.Collections.Generic.HashSet[DB.ElementId]()
    for view in target_views:
        target_ids.Add(view.Id)
    return target_ids


def store_crop_state(views):
    """Store crop settings for each target view."""
    states = {}
    for view in views:
        key = get_elementid_value(view.Id)
        try:
            states[key] = {
                'crop_active': view.CropBoxActive,
                'crop_visible': view.CropBoxVisible
            }
        except Exception:
            states[key] = {
                'crop_active': None,
                'crop_visible': None
            }
    return states


def set_override_crop_state(views):
    """Temporarily disable crop view so propagation works."""
    msgs = []
    for view in views:
        try:
            view.CropBoxActive = False
            msgs.append('Override crop off: {}'.format(view.Name))
        except Exception as err:
            msgs.append('Could not override crop for {} -> {}'.format(view.Name, err))
    return msgs


def restore_crop_state(views, states):
    """Restore original crop settings."""
    msgs = []
    for view in views:
        try:
            state = states.get(get_elementid_value(view.Id))
            if not state:
                continue
            if state['crop_active'] is not None:
                view.CropBoxActive = state['crop_active']
            if state['crop_visible'] is not None:
                view.CropBoxVisible = state['crop_visible']
            msgs.append('Restored crop state: {}'.format(view.Name))
        except Exception as err:
            msgs.append('Could not restore crop state for {} -> {}'.format(view.Name, err))
    return msgs


def propagate_grids(host_view, grids_in_view, target_views):
    """Propagate grids from host to target views."""
    target_ids = build_target_id_set(target_views)

    msgs = []
    status = []

    for grid in grids_in_view:
        grid_name = getattr(grid, 'Name', str(grid.Id))
        try:
            grid.PropagateToViews(host_view, target_ids)
            msgs.append('OK Propagated grid: {}'.format(grid_name))
            status.append(True)
        except Exception as err:
            msgs.append('FAILED {} -> {}'.format(grid_name, str(err)))
            status.append(False)

    return msgs, status


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Shared helper - combined 'Family > Type' string, matching Viewport tool
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------

def get_combined_type(view):
    """Return 'Family > Type' e.g. 'EngineeringPlan > PLN-GA'.
    Uses ALL_MODEL_TYPE_NAME parameter exactly as the Viewport tool does."""
    try:
        family = str(view.ViewType)
        vft    = revit.doc.GetElement(view.GetTypeId())
        if vft is not None:
            p = vft.get_Parameter(DB.BuiltInParameter.ALL_MODEL_TYPE_NAME)
            if p:
                type_name = p.AsString()
                if type_name:
                    return '{} > {}'.format(family, type_name)
        return family
    except Exception:
        return str(view.ViewType)


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# WPF window classes
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------

_SHOW_ALL = '-- Show all --'


def _parse_xaml(xaml_str):
    """Parse an inline XAML string into a WPF Window object."""
    return System.Windows.Markup.XamlReader.Parse(xaml_str)


class HostViewWindow(object):
    """Window 1 - single-select list with text search and combined type filter.
    The currently active view is pre-selected if it appears in the list.
    Double-clicking a row confirms the selection immediately.
    """

    def __init__(self, host_views):
        self._win        = _parse_xaml(_HOST_XAML)
        self._lst        = self._win.FindName('lst_Views')
        self._txt        = self._win.FindName('txt_Search')
        self._cmb        = self._win.FindName('cmb_ViewType')
        self._btn_ok     = self._win.FindName('btn_OK')
        self._btn_cancel = self._win.FindName('btn_Cancel')

        self._all_views  = host_views
        self.result      = None
        self.cancelled   = True

        # Store active view id for pre-selection
        try:
            self._active_vid = get_elementid_value(revit.active_view.Id)
        except Exception:
            self._active_vid = None

        # Populate combobox BEFORE wiring events so SelectionChanged
        # doesn't fire during setup and clear the pre-selection
        self._populate_type_filter()
        self._apply_filter()

        # Wire events AFTER initial population
        self._txt.TextChanged      += self._on_filter
        self._cmb.SelectionChanged += self._on_filter
        self._lst.SelectionChanged += self._on_selection
        self._lst.MouseDoubleClick += self._on_double_click
        self._btn_ok.Click         += self._on_ok
        self._btn_cancel.Click     += self._on_cancel

    def _populate_type_filter(self):
        types = sorted(set(get_combined_type(v) for v in self._all_views))
        self._cmb.Items.Clear()
        self._cmb.Items.Add(_SHOW_ALL)
        for t in types:
            self._cmb.Items.Add(t)
        self._cmb.SelectedIndex = 0

    def _get_filtered_views(self):
        q        = self._txt.Text.strip().lower()
        sel_type = self._cmb.SelectedItem
        use_type = sel_type and sel_type != _SHOW_ALL
        result   = []
        for v in self._all_views:
            if q and q not in v.Name.lower():
                continue
            if use_type and get_combined_type(v) != sel_type:
                continue
            result.append(v)
        return result

    def _apply_filter(self):
        self._lst.Items.Clear()
        active_item = None
        for view in self._get_filtered_views():
            item         = Controls.ListBoxItem()
            item.Content = '{} [{}]'.format(view.Name, view.ViewType)
            item.Tag     = view
            self._lst.Items.Add(item)
            # Track the item that matches the active view
            if (self._active_vid is not None and
                    get_elementid_value(view.Id) == self._active_vid):
                active_item = item

        # Pre-select the active view and enable the button
        if active_item is not None:
            active_item.IsSelected   = True
            self._btn_ok.IsEnabled   = True
            self._lst.ScrollIntoView(active_item)
        else:
            self._btn_ok.IsEnabled = self._lst.SelectedItem is not None

    def _on_filter(self, sender, args):
        self._apply_filter()

    def _on_selection(self, sender, args):
        self._btn_ok.IsEnabled = self._lst.SelectedItem is not None

    def _on_double_click(self, sender, args):
        """Double-clicking a row immediately confirms selection."""
        if self._lst.SelectedItem is not None:
            self.result    = self._lst.SelectedItem.Tag
            self.cancelled = False
            self._win.Close()

    def _on_ok(self, sender, args):
        if self._lst.SelectedItem is not None:
            self.result    = self._lst.SelectedItem.Tag
            self.cancelled = False
            self._win.Close()

    def _on_cancel(self, sender, args):
        self.cancelled = True
        self._win.Close()

    def show(self):
        self._win.ShowDialog()
        return self


class TargetViewsWindow(object):
    """Window 2 - checkbox list with combined type filter.

    Behaviour matches the original pyRevit SelectFromList exactly:
    - Click row text      -> highlights the row (no check change)
    - Shift+Click         -> highlights a range (no check change)
    - Ctrl+Click          -> adds/removes row from highlight (no check change)
    - Click checkbox area -> toggles checked state on ALL highlighted rows
    - Check All / Uncheck All / Toggle -> bulk operations on every row
    """

    def __init__(self, target_views):
        self._win         = _parse_xaml(_TARGET_XAML)
        self._lst         = self._win.FindName('lst_Views')
        self._txt         = self._win.FindName('txt_Search')
        self._cmb         = self._win.FindName('cmb_ViewType')
        self._btn_ok      = self._win.FindName('btn_OK')
        self._btn_cancel  = self._win.FindName('btn_Cancel')
        self._btn_check   = self._win.FindName('btn_CheckAll')
        self._btn_uncheck = self._win.FindName('btn_UncheckAll')
        self._btn_toggle  = self._win.FindName('btn_Toggle')

        self._all_views   = target_views
        self._checked_ids = set()
        self.result       = []
        self.cancelled    = True

        self._populate_type_filter()
        self._apply_filter()

        self._txt.TextChanged      += self._on_filter
        self._cmb.SelectionChanged += self._on_filter
        self._lst.PreviewMouseDown += self._on_list_mouse_down
        self._btn_ok.Click         += self._on_ok
        self._btn_cancel.Click     += self._on_cancel
        self._btn_check.Click      += self._on_check_all
        self._btn_uncheck.Click    += self._on_uncheck_all
        self._btn_toggle.Click     += self._on_toggle

    def _populate_type_filter(self):
        """Single combined 'Family > Type' dropdown, Show all at top."""
        types = sorted(set(get_combined_type(v) for v in self._all_views))
        self._cmb.Items.Clear()
        self._cmb.Items.Add(_SHOW_ALL)
        for t in types:
            self._cmb.Items.Add(t)
        self._cmb.SelectedIndex = 0

    def _get_filtered_views(self):
        q        = self._txt.Text.strip().lower()
        sel_type = self._cmb.SelectedItem
        use_type = sel_type and sel_type != _SHOW_ALL

        result = []
        for v in self._all_views:
            if q and q not in v.Name.lower():
                continue
            if use_type and get_combined_type(v) != sel_type:
                continue
            result.append(v)
        return result

    def _apply_filter(self):
        """Repopulate list from current filter, preserving checked state."""
        self._fill(self._get_filtered_views())

    def _make_item(self, view):
        """Build a ListBoxItem. CheckBox is visual only - IsHitTestVisible=False."""
        cb = Controls.CheckBox()
        cb.Content           = '{} [{}]'.format(view.Name, view.ViewType)
        cb.FontFamily        = System.Windows.Media.FontFamily('Segoe UI')
        cb.FontSize          = 11
        cb.Foreground        = System.Windows.Media.SolidColorBrush(
                                   System.Windows.Media.Color.FromRgb(0x1A, 0x1A, 0x1A))
        cb.VerticalAlignment = System.Windows.VerticalAlignment.Center
        cb.IsHitTestVisible  = False
        cb.Focusable         = False

        item = Controls.ListBoxItem()
        item.Content = cb
        item.Tag     = view
        return item

    def _fill(self, views):
        """Repopulate list, restoring checked state from _checked_ids."""
        self._lst.Items.Clear()
        for view in views:
            item = self._make_item(view)
            if get_elementid_value(view.Id) in self._checked_ids:
                item.Content.IsChecked = True
            self._lst.Items.Add(item)
        self._update_ok()

    def _sync_checkboxes(self):
        """Push _checked_ids state onto every visible checkbox."""
        for i in range(self._lst.Items.Count):
            li  = self._lst.Items.GetItemAt(i)
            vid = get_elementid_value(li.Tag.Id)
            li.Content.IsChecked = (vid in self._checked_ids)

    def _on_list_mouse_down(self, sender, args):
        """Intercept mouse clicks on the list.
        Checkbox area (X <= 20px): toggle checked state on all highlighted rows.
        Text area: let WPF handle normally for Shift/Ctrl highlighting."""
        pos = args.GetPosition(self._lst)
        hit = self._lst.InputHitTest(pos)

        clicked_item = None
        element = hit
        while element is not None:
            if isinstance(element, Controls.ListBoxItem):
                clicked_item = element
                break
            try:
                element = System.Windows.Media.VisualTreeHelper.GetParent(element)
            except Exception:
                break

        if clicked_item is None:
            return

        item_pos = args.GetPosition(clicked_item)

        if item_pos.X <= 20:
            if not clicked_item.IsSelected:
                clicked_item.IsSelected = True

            selected = list(self._lst.SelectedItems)
            if not selected:
                selected = [clicked_item]

            selected_ids = [get_elementid_value(i.Tag.Id) for i in selected
                            if hasattr(i, 'Tag') and i.Tag is not None]

            all_checked = all(vid in self._checked_ids for vid in selected_ids)

            if all_checked:
                for vid in selected_ids:
                    self._checked_ids.discard(vid)
            else:
                for vid in selected_ids:
                    self._checked_ids.add(vid)

            self._sync_checkboxes()
            self._update_ok()
            args.Handled = True

    def _on_filter(self, sender, args):
        self._apply_filter()

    def _on_check_all(self, sender, args):
        for i in range(self._lst.Items.Count):
            vid = get_elementid_value(self._lst.Items.GetItemAt(i).Tag.Id)
            self._checked_ids.add(vid)
        self._sync_checkboxes()
        self._update_ok()

    def _on_uncheck_all(self, sender, args):
        self._checked_ids.clear()
        self._sync_checkboxes()
        self._update_ok()

    def _on_toggle(self, sender, args):
        for i in range(self._lst.Items.Count):
            vid = get_elementid_value(self._lst.Items.GetItemAt(i).Tag.Id)
            if vid in self._checked_ids:
                self._checked_ids.discard(vid)
            else:
                self._checked_ids.add(vid)
        self._sync_checkboxes()
        self._update_ok()

    def _update_ok(self):
        self._btn_ok.IsEnabled = len(self._checked_ids) > 0

    def _on_ok(self, sender, args):
        self.result = [
            self._lst.Items.GetItemAt(i).Tag
            for i in range(self._lst.Items.Count)
            if get_elementid_value(self._lst.Items.GetItemAt(i).Tag.Id)
               in self._checked_ids
        ]
        self.cancelled = False
        self._win.Close()

    def _on_cancel(self, sender, args):
        self.cancelled = True
        self._win.Close()

    def show(self):
        self._win.ShowDialog()
        return self


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Replacement select functions - identical signatures to the originals
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------

def select_host_view():
    """Prompt user to choose host view."""
    host_views = get_candidate_host_views()

    if not host_views:
        forms.alert('No valid host views found.', exitscript=True)

    win = HostViewWindow(host_views)
    win.show()

    if win.cancelled or win.result is None:
        forms.alert('No host view selected.', exitscript=True)

    return win.result


def select_target_views(host_view):
    """Prompt user to choose target views."""
    target_views = get_target_views(host_view)

    if not target_views:
        forms.alert('No valid target views found.', exitscript=True)

    win = TargetViewsWindow(target_views)
    win.show()

    if win.cancelled or not win.result:
        forms.alert('No target views selected.', exitscript=True)

    return win.result


# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Execution block
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------

host_view    = select_host_view()
target_views = select_target_views(host_view)

grids_in_host  = get_grids_in_view(host_view)
levels_in_host = get_levels_in_view(host_view)

if not grids_in_host and not levels_in_host:
    forms.alert(
        'No grids or levels found in selected host view:\n{}'.format(
            host_view.Name),
        exitscript=True
    )

crop_states = store_crop_state(target_views)

all_messages       = []
propagation_results = []

with revit.Transaction('Propagate Grid and Level Extents Override'):
    all_messages.append('Host View: {}'.format(host_view.Name))
    all_messages.append('Grid Count:  {}'.format(len(grids_in_host)))
    all_messages.append('Level Count: {}'.format(len(levels_in_host)))
    all_messages.append('Target View Count: {}'.format(len(target_views)))
    all_messages.append('')

    all_messages.append('--- Applying target crop override ---')
    all_messages.extend(set_override_crop_state(target_views))
    all_messages.append('')

    if grids_in_host:
        all_messages.append('--- Propagating grids ---')
        prop_msgs, prop_results = propagate_grids(
            host_view, grids_in_host, target_views)
        all_messages.extend(prop_msgs)
        propagation_results.extend(prop_results)
        all_messages.append('')

    if levels_in_host:
        all_messages.append('--- Propagating levels ---')
        lvl_msgs, lvl_results = propagate_levels(
            host_view, levels_in_host, target_views)
        all_messages.extend(lvl_msgs)
        propagation_results.extend(lvl_results)
        all_messages.append('')

    all_messages.append('--- Restoring crop states ---')
    all_messages.extend(restore_crop_state(target_views, crop_states))
    all_messages.append('')

    all_messages.append('Propagation finished.')

print '\n'.join(all_messages)

grid_ok   = len([x for x in propagation_results if x])
grid_fail = len([x for x in propagation_results if not x])

forms.alert(
    'Propagation finished.\n\n'
    'Host:    {}\n'
    'Targets: {}\n'
    'Grids:   {}\n'
    'Levels:  {}\n'
    'Success: {}\n'
    'Failed:  {}'.format(
        host_view.Name,
        len(target_views),
        len(grids_in_host),
        len(levels_in_host),
        grid_ok,
        grid_fail,
    ),
    title='Propagate Grid and Level Extents Override'
)

```

## FILE_START: JasonHacksRevit.tab/Selection.panel/README.md
## META: sha1=13effcdc6a2d7e265662fa56bd8ffa4be207d81f size=3900
## TYPE: text
```markdown
# Advanced Select — pyRevit Tab

## What this tab does

Two buttons that help you find, inspect, and select elements by category:

| Button | What it does |
|---|---|
| **Show Hidden Categories** | Lists every category hidden in the active view. Tick the ones you want restored and click "Make Visible". Changes wrapped in one Transaction. |
| **Category Picker** | Opens a searchable checklist of ALL model categories. Tick any combination, click "Select Elements", and Revit highlights every placed instance of those categories. No model changes — no Transaction needed. |

---

## Folder Structure

```
AdvancedSelect.extension/
└── AdvancedSelect.tab/
    └── Selection.panel/
        ├── ShowHiddenCategories.pushbutton/
        │   ├── script.py                  ← entry point only
        │   ├── ShowHiddenCategories.py    ← all logic
        │   ├── icon.png
        │   └── icon.dark.png
        └── CategoryPicker.pushbutton/
            ├── script.py                  ← entry point only
            ├── CategoryPicker.py          ← all logic + WPF code-behind
            ├── CategoryPicker.xaml        ← WPF layout
            ├── icon.png
            └── icon.dark.png

lib/
├── selection_helpers.py   ← shared functions used by BOTH buttons
└── ...
```

---

## Key API Concepts Used

### `doc.Settings.Categories`
The master table of every category in a Revit document.
Loop through it to get model, annotation, and internal categories.

### `view.GetCategoryHidden(categoryId)`
Returns `True` if that category is currently hidden in a specific view.
Only works on views (not sheets) that support V/G overrides.

### `view.SetCategoryHidden(categoryId, hidden)`
Toggles a category on/off in a view.
**Must be inside a Transaction** — it modifies the model.

### `ElementMulticategoryFilter`
A fast Revit API filter that accepts a list of category IDs.
Much faster than filtering in Python because Revit does it natively.

### `uidoc.Selection.SetElementIds(ids)`
Replaces the active Revit selection with a list of element IDs.
This is a UI operation — **no Transaction required**.

### `forms.WPFWindow` (pyRevit)
pyRevit's helper base class for WPF dialogs backed by a `.xaml` file.
Inherit from it, pass the `.xaml` filename, and pyRevit handles loading.

---

## How to Test

### Show Hidden Categories
1. Open any floor plan view
2. Turn off a few categories via Visibility/Graphics (VG) → uncheck some rows → OK
3. Run the tool — the dialog should list exactly those categories
4. Tick them all, click "Make Visible"
5. Check Revit's Visibility/Graphics — they should be ticked again
6. Check Undo (Ctrl+Z) — one undo step should restore the hidden state

### Category Picker
1. Run the tool from any view
2. Type "wall" in the search box — the list should filter to wall-related categories
3. Tick "Walls" and "Structural Framing"
4. The status label should show a non-zero element count
5. Click "Select Elements" — the dialog closes
6. In Revit, the Properties panel and status bar should show elements selected
7. Press Escape or Ctrl+Z — this does NOT undo the selection (it's not a model change)

---

## ⚠️ Things to Watch Out For

- **Sheet views** — `SetCategoryHidden` will throw if called on a ViewSheet.
  The ShowHiddenCategories tool guards against this with an early exit.
- **Categories with `AllowsVisibilityControl = False`** — some analytical
  and internal categories cannot be toggled. The helpers silently skip these.
- **Large models** — `get_all_model_categories` includes sub-categories.
  In very large models this list can be 500+ items. The search box helps.
- **Empty categories** — the Category Picker may show categories that have
  zero placed instances. The tool alerts you if no elements are found.

```
## FILE_END: JasonHacksRevit.tab/Selection.panel/README.md

```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
__title__ = "Unhide All Elements in Active View"
__version__ = 'Version = 1.0'
__doc__ = """Version = 1.0
Date    = 15.09.2022
_____________________________________________________________________
Description:
Unhide all Elements in the active view
_____________________________________________________________________
Last update:
_____________________________________________________________________
To-Do:
_____________________________________________________________________
Author: Erik Frits"""

# ╦╔╦╗╔═╗╔═╗╦═╗╔╦╗╔═╗
# ║║║║╠═╝║ ║╠╦╝ ║ ╚═╗
# ╩╩ ╩╩  ╚═╝╩╚═ ╩ ╚═╝ IMPORTS
# ==================================================
from Autodesk.Revit.DB import *

# .NET Imports
import os, clr
clr.AddReference("System")
from System.Collections.Generic import List

# ╦  ╦╔═╗╦═╗╦╔═╗╔╗ ╦  ╔═╗╔═╗
# ╚╗╔╝╠═╣╠╦╝║╠═╣╠╩╗║  ║╣ ╚═╗
#  ╚╝ ╩ ╩╩╚═╩╩ ╩╚═╝╩═╝╚═╝╚═╝ VARIABLES
# ==================================================
doc   = __revit__.ActiveUIDocument.Document

# ╔╦╗╔═╗╦╔╗╔
# ║║║╠═╣║║║║
# ╩ ╩╩ ╩╩╝╚╝ MAIN
# ==================================================
if __name__ == '__main__':
    all_elements = FilteredElementCollector(doc).WhereElementIsNotElementType().ToElementIds()
    unhide_elements = List[ElementId](all_elements)

    with Transaction(doc,__title__) as t:
        t.Start()
        doc.ActiveView.UnhideElements(unhide_elements)
        t.Commit()
```

## FILE_START: JasonHacksRevit.tab/Sheets.panel/Sheet Tools.pulldown/CloudRevisions.pushbutton/CloudRevisions_script.py
## META: sha1=2d526343614e30c18308934a53546749ad435025 size=9211
## TYPE: text
## IMPORTS: ["Autodesk.Revit.DB","Autodesk.Revit.DB.Architecture","Autodesk.Revit.UI","clr","pyrevit","traceback"]
## FUNCTIONS: ["get_rev_label","get_rev_desc","get_rev_date","sort_key","print_row","print_list"]
## CLASSES: []
```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# Script:        CloudRevisions_script.py
# Description:   Produces three lists for every sheet/revision pair:
#                LIST 1 -- revision driven by cloud only (no manual tick)
#                LIST 2 -- revision has BOTH a cloud AND a manual tick
#                LIST 3 -- revision manually ticked only (no cloud)
# Author:        Your Name
# Last Updated:  2026-03-27
# Revit Version: 2022 / 2023 / 2024

import clr
clr.AddReference('RevitAPI')
clr.AddReference('RevitAPIUI')
from Autodesk.Revit.DB import *
from Autodesk.Revit.UI import *
from Autodesk.Revit.DB.Architecture import *

from pyrevit import revit, script, HOST_APP
doc   = revit.doc
uidoc = revit.uidoc
app   = HOST_APP.uiapp.Application

output = script.get_output()

try:

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # STEP 1 -- Collect every revision cloud in the project.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    all_clouds = FilteredElementCollector(doc)\
        .OfClass(RevisionCloud)\
        .WhereElementIsNotElementType()\
        .ToElements()

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # STEP 2 -- Build sheet lookup keyed by ElementId.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    all_sheets = FilteredElementCollector(doc)\
        .OfClass(ViewSheet)\
        .WhereElementIsNotElementType()\
        .ToElements()

    sheet_lookup = {}
    for sheet in all_sheets:
        if not sheet.IsPlaceholder:
            sheet_lookup[sheet.Id] = sheet

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # STEP 3 -- Build cloud-driven set and label dict.
    #
    # cloud_driven_set : set of (sheet_id, rev_id) pairs that have a cloud
    # cloud_label      : dict of (sheet_id, rev_id) -> "DIRECT  " or "VIA VIEW"
    #
    # cloud.OwnerViewId is a ViewSheet -> DIRECT (cloud on the sheet itself)
    # cloud.OwnerViewId is a View      -> VIA VIEW (cloud in a viewport)
    # If both exist for same pair, DIRECT wins.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    cloud_driven_set = set()
    cloud_label      = {}

    for cloud in all_clouds:
        is_direct = cloud.OwnerViewId in sheet_lookup
        label     = "DIRECT  " if is_direct else "VIA VIEW"

        for sheet_id in cloud.GetSheetIds():
            if sheet_id not in sheet_lookup:
                continue
            key = (sheet_id, cloud.RevisionId)
            cloud_driven_set.add(key)
            # Only upgrade VIA VIEW to DIRECT, never downgrade
            if key not in cloud_label or cloud_label[key] == "VIA VIEW":
                cloud_label[key] = label

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # STEP 4 -- Build the full set of all sheet/revision pairs from Revit.
    #
    # sheet.GetAllRevisionIds() returns every revision on a sheet regardless
    # of how it was added -- cloud-driven or manual tick.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    all_sheet_rev_pairs = set()

    for sheet_id, sheet in sheet_lookup.items():
        for rev_id in sheet.GetAllRevisionIds():
            all_sheet_rev_pairs.add((sheet_id, rev_id))

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # STEP 5 -- Classify every pair into one of three categories.
    #
    # has_cloud  = pair exists in cloud_driven_set
    # has_manual = pair exists in all_sheet_rev_pairs
    #              (all pairs from GetAllRevisionIds are on the sheet)
    #
    # The manual tick check works like this:
    #   - GetAllRevisionIds() returns ALL revisions on a sheet
    #   - A cloud ALWAYS adds its revision to GetAllRevisionIds()
    #   - So we cannot use GetAllRevisionIds() alone to detect manual ticks
    #
    # The correct approach is to check AdditionalRevisionIds:
    #   sheet.GetAdditionalRevisionIds() returns ONLY the manually ticked ones
    #   This is the Revit API method that separates manual from cloud-driven.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    manually_ticked_set = set()

    for sheet_id, sheet in sheet_lookup.items():
        # GetAdditionalRevisionIds() returns only manually ticked revision ids
        # This is available in Revit 2022+
        try:
            for rev_id in sheet.GetAdditionalRevisionIds():
                manually_ticked_set.add((sheet_id, rev_id))
        except Exception:
            # Fallback: if API not available, treat non-cloud pairs as manual
            for rev_id in sheet.GetAllRevisionIds():
                key = (sheet_id, rev_id)
                if key not in cloud_driven_set:
                    manually_ticked_set.add(key)

    # Now classify into three buckets
    cloud_only  = {}   # has cloud, no manual tick
    both        = {}   # has cloud AND manual tick
    manual_only = {}   # manual tick only, no cloud

    # Process cloud-driven pairs
    for key in cloud_driven_set:
        if key in manually_ticked_set:
            both[key] = cloud_label.get(key, "DIRECT  ")
        else:
            cloud_only[key] = cloud_label.get(key, "DIRECT  ")

    # Process manually ticked pairs
    for key in manually_ticked_set:
        if key not in cloud_driven_set:
            manual_only[key] = "MANUAL  "

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # STEP 6 -- Build revision lookup and helper functions.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    all_revisions = FilteredElementCollector(doc)\
        .OfClass(Revision)\
        .WhereElementIsNotElementType()\
        .ToElements()

    revision_lookup = {}
    for rev in all_revisions:
        revision_lookup[rev.Id] = rev

    def get_rev_label(rev):
        p_num = rev.get_Parameter(BuiltInParameter.PROJECT_REVISION_REVISION_NUM)
        if p_num and p_num.AsString():
            return p_num.AsString()
        p_seq = rev.get_Parameter(BuiltInParameter.PROJECT_REVISION_SEQUENCE_NUM)
        if p_seq:
            return "Seq. %d" % p_seq.AsInteger()
        return "?"

    def get_rev_desc(rev):
        p = rev.get_Parameter(BuiltInParameter.PROJECT_REVISION_REVISION_DESCRIPTION)
        return p.AsString() if p and p.AsString() else ""

    def get_rev_date(rev):
        p = rev.get_Parameter(BuiltInParameter.PROJECT_REVISION_REVISION_DATE)
        return p.AsString() if p and p.AsString() else ""

    def sort_key(item):
        (sheet_id, rev_id), label = item
        sheet = sheet_lookup[sheet_id]
        rev   = revision_lookup.get(rev_id)
        p_seq = rev.get_Parameter(
            BuiltInParameter.PROJECT_REVISION_SEQUENCE_NUM
        ) if rev else None
        seq = p_seq.AsInteger() if p_seq else 0
        return (sheet.SheetNumber, seq)

    def print_row(sheet_id, rev_id, label):
        sheet = sheet_lookup.get(sheet_id)
        rev   = revision_lookup.get(rev_id)
        if not sheet or not rev:
            return
        sheet_link = output.linkify(sheet.Id, title=sheet.SheetNumber)
        print "[%s]  %s  |  %-40s  |  %-8s  |  %-28s  |  %s" % (
            label,
            sheet_link,
            sheet.Name,
            get_rev_label(rev),
            get_rev_desc(rev),
            get_rev_date(rev),
        )

    def print_list(title, description, data_dict, empty_msg):
        output.print_html("<h2>%s</h2>" % title)
        output.print_html("<p style='color:grey'>%s</p>" % description)
        if not data_dict:
            print empty_msg
        else:
            print "-" * 90
            for item in sorted(data_dict.items(), key=sort_key):
                (sheet_id, rev_id), label = item
                print_row(sheet_id, rev_id, label)
            print "-" * 90
            print "Total: %d" % len(data_dict)

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # STEP 7 -- Print all three lists.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    print_list(
        "List 1 -- Cloud-driven revisions only",
        "Revision is on the sheet purely because of a revision cloud.<br>"
        "DIRECT = cloud drawn on the sheet. "
        "VIA VIEW = cloud in a viewport on the sheet.<br>"
        "No manual tick exists for these.",
        cloud_only,
        "No cloud-only revisions found."
    )

    print_list(
        "List 2 -- Cloud AND manually ticked",
        "Revision has a revision cloud on the sheet AND was also manually ticked.<br>"
        "DIRECT = cloud drawn on the sheet. "
        "VIA VIEW = cloud in a viewport on the sheet.",
        both,
        "No revisions found with both a cloud and a manual tick."
    )

    print_list(
        "List 3 -- Manually ticked only",
        "Revision was ticked manually in the sheet revision box.<br>"
        "No revision cloud exists for these on this sheet.",
        manual_only,
        "No manually ticked revisions found."
    )

except Exception as e:
    import traceback
    print "ERROR: " + str(e)
    print traceback.format_exc()

```

```python
"""Reorders the selected viewport on current sheet."""

from collections import namedtuple

from pyrevit import revit, DB
from pyrevit import forms


ViewportConfig = namedtuple('ViewportConfig', ['box_center',
                                               'type_id',
                                               'view_id'])


def get_selected_viewports():
    selection = revit.get_selection()
    return [x for x in selection if isinstance(x, DB.Viewport)]


def get_nonselected_viewports(sheet):
    svps = get_selected_viewports()
    svp_ids = [x.Id for x in svps]
    if isinstance(sheet, DB.ViewSheet):
        vps = sheet.GetAllViewports()
        if svp_ids:
            return [revit.doc.GetElement(x) for x in vps if x not in svp_ids]

    return []


def capture_vp_config(viewport):
    return ViewportConfig(viewport.GetBoxCenter(),
                          viewport.GetTypeId(),
                          viewport.ViewId)


def bring_to_front(sheet, vp_list):
    with revit.Transaction('Reorder Viewports'):
        for vp in vp_list:
            config = capture_vp_config(vp)
            sheet.DeleteViewport(vp)
            new_vp = DB.Viewport.Create(revit.doc,
                                        sheet.Id,
                                        config.view_id,
                                        config.box_center)
            new_vp.ChangeTypeId(config.type_id)


selected_vps = get_selected_viewports()

if selected_vps:
    selected_option = \
        forms.CommandSwitchWindow.show(
            ['Bring to Front', 'Send to Back'],
            message='Select reordering method:'
        )


    if selected_option:
        if selected_option == 'Bring to Front':
            viewports = get_selected_viewports()
        elif selected_option == 'Send to Back':
            viewports = get_nonselected_viewports(revit.active_view)

        bring_to_front(revit.active_view, viewports)
else:
    forms.alert('Select a Viewport first.')

```

## FUNCTIONS: ["load_xaml","find_controls","check_controls","get_all_sheets","build_sheet_label","build_sheet_item","build_viewport_item","__init__","_on_current","_on_multiple","_on_cancel","__init__","_get_selected_sheet_ids","_apply_filter","_on_filter_changed","_on_reset_number","_on_reset_name","_refresh_status","_get_selected_items","_on_add","_on_add_all","_on_remove","_on_remove_all","_on_dbl_click_add","_on_dbl_click_remove","_on_back","_on_cancel","_on_next","__init__","_on_window_closed","_load_viewports","_rebuild_list","_get_selected_indices","_restore_selection","_on_move_up","_on_move_down","_on_move_top","_on_move_bottom","_on_list_keydown","_on_update_sheet","_on_apply","_on_skip","_on_cancel","_wait_for_window","on_closed"]

```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# Script:        ReorderViewports_script.py
# Description:   Reorder viewport draw order on one or many sheets.
#                Step 1: pick Current Sheet or Multiple Sheets.
#                Step 2 (multi only): pick which sheets to process.
#                Step 3: reorder viewports per sheet and apply.
# Author:        Your Name
# Last Updated:  2026-04-01
# Revit Version: 2022/2023/2024

import clr
clr.AddReference('RevitAPI')
clr.AddReference('RevitAPIUI')
clr.AddReference('PresentationFramework')
clr.AddReference('PresentationCore')
clr.AddReference('WindowsBase')

from Autodesk.Revit.DB import *
from Autodesk.Revit.UI import *
from Autodesk.Revit.DB.Architecture import *

# pyRevit host -- always use this exact pattern to get doc, uidoc, app
from pyrevit import revit, script, HOST_APP, forms
doc   = revit.doc
uidoc = revit.uidoc
app   = HOST_APP.uiapp.Application

# pyRevit output -- required for linkify (clickable element links)
output = script.get_output()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# WPF IMPORTS
# Every WPF type must be explicitly imported. Never use System.Windows.* inline.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
from System.Windows.Controls import (
    ListBoxItem, StackPanel, TextBlock, Border, Orientation
)
from System.Windows.Media import SolidColorBrush, Color
from System.Windows import (
    Thickness, CornerRadius, VerticalAlignment, FontWeights, Visibility
)
from System.Windows.Input import Key, ModifierKeys

import os
import traceback

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# XAML FILE PATHS
# All XAML files sit next to this script. Named per the pushbutton folder.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
SCRIPT_DIR       = os.path.dirname(__file__)
XAML_MODE        = os.path.join(SCRIPT_DIR, 'ReorderViewports_mode_ui.xaml')
XAML_SHEETS      = os.path.join(SCRIPT_DIR, 'ReorderViewports_sheets_ui.xaml')
XAML_REORDER     = os.path.join(SCRIPT_DIR, 'ReorderViewports_ui.xaml')

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SHARED COLOURS  (CLAUDE.md palette -- built once, reused everywhere)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
COL_BADGE_BG   = SolidColorBrush(Color.FromRgb(0x1A, 0x6E, 0xBF))
COL_BADGE_TEXT = SolidColorBrush(Color.FromRgb(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF))
COL_LABEL_TEXT = SolidColorBrush(Color.FromRgb(0x1A, 0x1A, 0x1A))


# ===========================================================================
# UTILITY FUNCTIONS
# ===========================================================================

def load_xaml(xaml_path):
    """Load a XAML file from disk and return the WPF Window object."""
    try:
        from System.IO import FileStream, FileMode
        from System.Windows.Markup import XamlReader
        stream = FileStream(xaml_path, FileMode.Open)
        win    = XamlReader.Load(stream)
        stream.Close()
        return win
    except Exception as e:
        forms.alert(
            "Could not load XAML:\n" + xaml_path + "\n\n" + str(e),
            title="XAML Error"
        )
        return None


def find_controls(win, name_list):
    """
    Given a WPF Window and a list of control names, return a dict of
    name -> control.  Any missing controls are mapped to None.
    Uses FindName() which is the only safe method in IronPython 2.7.
    """
    return {name: win.FindName(name) for name in name_list}


def check_controls(ctrl_dict):
    """
    Return a list of control names that came back as None from FindName().
    An empty list means all controls were found.
    """
    return [name for name, ctrl in ctrl_dict.items() if ctrl is None]


def get_all_sheets():
    """
    Collect all ViewSheet elements in the document, sorted by sheet number.
    Returns a list of ViewSheet objects.
    """
    all_sheets = (
        FilteredElementCollector(doc)
        .OfClass(ViewSheet)
        .WhereElementIsNotElementType()
        .ToElements()
    )
    # Sort by sheet number so the list matches what users expect
    return sorted(all_sheets, key=lambda s: s.SheetNumber)


def build_sheet_label(sheet):
    """Return 'SheetNumber - SheetName' display string for a sheet."""
    return "%s  -  %s" % (sheet.SheetNumber, sheet.Name)


# ===========================================================================
# SHARED LIST-ITEM BUILDER
# Builds a WPF ListBoxItem for one sheet in the picker lists.
# We build in Python to avoid IronPython data-binding reflection issues.
# The sheet object is stored in item.Tag for retrieval later.
# ===========================================================================

def build_sheet_item(sheet):
    """Build a ListBoxItem displaying the sheet number and name."""
    label          = TextBlock()
    label.Text     = build_sheet_label(sheet)
    label.FontSize = 11
    label.Foreground = COL_LABEL_TEXT
    label.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center

    item         = ListBoxItem()
    item.Content = label
    item.Tag     = sheet  # store the ViewSheet object for later retrieval
    return item


# ViewType enum name to readable display label.
# We call str(view.ViewType) in IronPython which returns the enum member name
# e.g. "FloorPlan", "EngineeringPlan", "Legend", "ThreeD" etc.
# This dict converts those raw names to the friendly labels shown in the list.
VIEW_TYPE_LABELS = {
    "FloorPlan"          : "Floor Plan",
    "CeilingPlan"        : "Ceiling Plan",
    "Elevation"          : "Elevation",
    "ThreeD"             : "3D View",
    "Detail"             : "Detail",
    "Section"            : "Section",
    "Rendering"          : "Rendering",
    "DraftingView"       : "Drafting View",
    "Legend"             : "Legend",
    "EngineeringPlan"    : "Engineering Plan",
    "AreaPlan"           : "Area Plan",
    "StructuralPlan"     : "Structural Plan",
    "Walkthrough"        : "Walkthrough",
    "Schedule"           : "Schedule",
    "ColumnSchedule"     : "Column Schedule",
    "PanelSchedule"      : "Panel Schedule",
    "CostReport"         : "Cost Report",
    "LoadsReport"        : "Loads Report",
    "PressureLossReport" : "Pressure Loss Report",
    "DrawingSheet"       : "Sheet",
    "Report"             : "Report",
    "SystemBrowser"      : "System Browser",
    "ProjectBrowser"     : "Project Browser",
    "Undefined"          : "",
}

# Grey pill background for the view type label
COL_TYPE_BG   = SolidColorBrush(Color.FromRgb(0xDE, 0xDE, 0xDE))  # #DEDEDE light grey
COL_TYPE_TEXT = SolidColorBrush(Color.FromRgb(0x6B, 0x6B, 0x6B))  # #6B6B6B medium grey


def build_viewport_item(position, viewport):
    """
    Build a ListBoxItem for the reorder list showing:
        [pos badge]  [ViewType pill]  View Name  [Det. XX]

    position -- 1-based integer badge (1 = front of draw order)
    viewport -- Revit Viewport element; stored in item.Tag
    """
    # Resolve the view inside this viewport
    view         = doc.GetElement(viewport.ViewId)
    view_name    = view.Name if view else "(unknown view)"

    # Get the ViewType label.
    # str(view.ViewType) in IronPython returns the enum member name
    # e.g. "FloorPlan", "EngineeringPlan", "Legend", "ThreeD".
    # We look that up in VIEW_TYPE_LABELS for a friendly display string.
    # If the name is not in our dict we show the raw enum name as a fallback.
    if view is not None:
        try:
            vtype_raw   = str(view.ViewType)
            vtype_label = VIEW_TYPE_LABELS.get(vtype_raw, vtype_raw)
        except Exception:
            vtype_label = ""
    else:
        vtype_label = ""

    detail_param = viewport.LookupParameter("Detail Number")
    detail_num   = detail_param.AsString() if detail_param else ""
    label_text   = (
        "%s  [Det. %s]" % (view_name, detail_num) if detail_num else view_name
    )

    # Blue position badge
    badge_tb            = TextBlock()
    badge_tb.Text       = str(position)
    badge_tb.FontSize   = 10
    badge_tb.FontWeight = FontWeights.SemiBold
    badge_tb.Foreground = COL_BADGE_TEXT
    badge_tb.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center

    badge            = Border()
    badge.Background = COL_BADGE_BG
    badge.CornerRadius = CornerRadius(2)
    badge.Padding    = Thickness(5, 1, 5, 1)
    badge.Margin     = Thickness(0, 0, 6, 0)
    badge.Child      = badge_tb

    # Grey view type pill -- only shown when we have a label
    type_tb            = TextBlock()
    type_tb.Text       = vtype_label
    type_tb.FontSize   = 10
    type_tb.Foreground = COL_TYPE_TEXT
    type_tb.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center

    type_pill            = Border()
    type_pill.Background = COL_TYPE_BG
    type_pill.CornerRadius = CornerRadius(2)
    type_pill.Padding    = Thickness(5, 1, 5, 1)
    type_pill.Margin     = Thickness(0, 0, 8, 0)
    type_pill.Child      = type_tb

    # View name label
    name_tb                   = TextBlock()
    name_tb.Text              = label_text
    name_tb.FontSize          = 11
    name_tb.Foreground        = COL_LABEL_TEXT
    name_tb.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center

    # Horizontal stack: [blue badge] [grey type pill] [view name]
    stack             = StackPanel()
    stack.Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal
    stack.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center
    stack.Children.Add(badge)
    if vtype_label:
        stack.Children.Add(type_pill)
    stack.Children.Add(name_tb)

    item         = ListBoxItem()
    item.Content = stack
    item.Tag     = viewport  # store the Viewport element for _on_apply
    return item


# ===========================================================================
# WINDOW 1: MODE PICKER
# Shows two buttons: "Current Sheet" or "Multiple Sheets".
# Sets self.mode to "current" or "multiple" and closes.
# ===========================================================================

class ModePicker(object):
    """
    First window the user sees. Two big buttons choose the mode.
    self.mode is read by the caller after ShowDialog() returns.
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.mode = None  # "current" | "multiple" | None (cancelled)

        win = load_xaml(XAML_MODE)
        if win is None:
            return
        self._win = win

        ctrls = find_controls(win, ["CurrentSheetBtn", "MultipleSheetsBtn", "CancelBtn"])
        missing = check_controls(ctrls)
        if missing:
            forms.alert("XAML controls missing: " + ", ".join(missing), title="Error")
            return

        ctrls["CurrentSheetBtn"].Click  += self._on_current
        ctrls["MultipleSheetsBtn"].Click += self._on_multiple
        ctrls["CancelBtn"].Click         += self._on_cancel

        win.ShowDialog()

    def _on_current(self, sender, args):
        self.mode = "current"
        self._win.Close()

    def _on_multiple(self, sender, args):
        self.mode = "multiple"
        self._win.Close()

    def _on_cancel(self, sender, args):
        self.mode = None
        self._win.Close()


# ===========================================================================
# WINDOW 2: SHEET PICKER
# Left list = filtered view of all sheets. Right list = sheets to process.
# Filter rows (Sheet No. / Sheet Name) match JasonExporter exactly:
#   DockPanel Height=24, label Width=90, Reset button Width=50 on the right,
#   TextBox fills the remaining middle space.
# Typing in either TextBox instantly re-filters the left list.
# Transfer buttons move items between lists.
# self.selected_sheets is read by the caller after ShowDialog() returns.
# ===========================================================================

class SheetPicker(object):
    """
    Sheet picker: filter panel + left/right list with transfer buttons.
    self.selected_sheets holds the chosen ViewSheet objects after closing.
    None means the user cancelled or went back.
    """

    def __init__(self):
        self.selected_sheets = None  # list of ViewSheet | None
        self._go_back        = False  # True when user clicks Back

        win = load_xaml(XAML_SHEETS)
        if win is None:
            return
        self._win = win

        ctrls = find_controls(win, [
            "AllSheetsList", "SelectedSheetsList",
            "AddBtn", "AddAllBtn", "RemoveBtn", "RemoveAllBtn",
            "FilterNumber", "FilterName",
            "ResetNumberBtn", "ResetNameBtn",
            "StatusText", "BackBtn", "CancelBtn", "NextBtn"
        ])
        missing = check_controls(ctrls)
        if missing:
            forms.alert("XAML controls missing: " + ", ".join(missing), title="Error")
            return

        # Store refs used across methods
        self._all_list      = ctrls["AllSheetsList"]
        self._sel_list      = ctrls["SelectedSheetsList"]
        self._status        = ctrls["StatusText"]
        self._next_btn      = ctrls["NextBtn"]
        self._filter_num    = ctrls["FilterNumber"]
        self._filter_name   = ctrls["FilterName"]

        # Master list of ALL sheets -- filter operates on this, never modifies it
        self._all_sheets    = get_all_sheets()

        # Wire up filter TextBox events -- TextChanged fires on every keystroke
        self._filter_num.TextChanged  += self._on_filter_changed
        self._filter_name.TextChanged += self._on_filter_changed

        # Reset buttons clear their TextBox and re-apply the filter
        ctrls["ResetNumberBtn"].Click += self._on_reset_number
        ctrls["ResetNameBtn"].Click   += self._on_reset_name

        # Wire up transfer buttons
        ctrls["AddBtn"].Click       += self._on_add
        ctrls["AddAllBtn"].Click    += self._on_add_all
        ctrls["RemoveBtn"].Click    += self._on_remove
        ctrls["RemoveAllBtn"].Click += self._on_remove_all

        # Footer buttons
        ctrls["BackBtn"].Click   += self._on_back
        ctrls["CancelBtn"].Click += self._on_cancel
        ctrls["NextBtn"].Click   += self._on_next

        # Double-click on left adds that item; double-click on right removes it.
        # MouseDoubleClick fires before SelectedItems updates, so we use a
        # dedicated handler that reads the clicked item from the event source.
        self._all_list.MouseDoubleClick += self._on_dbl_click_add
        self._sel_list.MouseDoubleClick += self._on_dbl_click_remove

        # Initial population of the left list (no filter text yet)
        self._apply_filter()

        win.ShowDialog()

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # FILTER LOGIC
    # self._all_sheets is the master list of every sheet in the project.
    # self._apply_filter() rebuilds the left list from this master list,
    # excluding:
    #   (a) sheets that don't match the current filter text, AND
    #   (b) sheets that are already in the right (selected) list.
    # Both filters are case-insensitive substring matches, same as
    # the JasonExporter SheetFilter text box behaviour.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _get_selected_sheet_ids(self):
        """Return a set of ElementIds for sheets already in the right list."""
        return set(item.Tag.Id for item in self._sel_list.Items)

    def _apply_filter(self):
        """
        Rebuild the left list applying both filter fields.
        Called on every TextChanged event and after any transfer operation.
        """
        # Read filter strings -- strip whitespace, lower for case-insensitive match
        num_filter  = self._filter_num.Text.strip().lower()
        name_filter = self._filter_name.Text.strip().lower()

        # Sheets already on the right must not appear on the left
        selected_ids = self._get_selected_sheet_ids()

        self._all_list.Items.Clear()
        for sheet in self._all_sheets:
            # Skip if already selected
            if sheet.Id in selected_ids:
                continue
            # Sheet No. filter: sheet number must contain the typed text
            if num_filter and num_filter not in sheet.SheetNumber.lower():
                continue
            # Sheet Name filter: sheet name must contain the typed text
            if name_filter and name_filter not in sheet.Name.lower():
                continue
            # Passed both filters -- add to the left list
            self._all_list.Items.Add(build_sheet_item(sheet))

        self._refresh_status()

    def _on_filter_changed(self, sender, args):
        """Called every time either filter TextBox changes."""
        self._apply_filter()

    def _on_reset_number(self, sender, args):
        """Clear the Sheet No. filter TextBox."""
        self._filter_num.Text = ""
        # _apply_filter is called automatically by the TextChanged event

    def _on_reset_name(self, sender, args):
        """Clear the Sheet Name filter TextBox."""
        self._filter_name.Text = ""

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # STATUS UPDATE
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _refresh_status(self):
        count = self._sel_list.Items.Count
        self._status.Text = "%d sheet(s) selected to process" % count
        self._next_btn.IsEnabled = (count > 0)

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # TRANSFER HELPERS
    # Items are moved between the WPF ListBoxes.
    # After every transfer we call _apply_filter() to rebuild the left list
    # so it always reflects the current filter AND excludes already-selected sheets.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _get_selected_items(self, listbox):
        """Return a plain Python list of the selected ListBoxItem objects."""
        return list(listbox.SelectedItems)

    def _on_add(self, sender, args):
        # WPF rule: a UIElement can only live in one parent at a time.
        # We read the sheet from item.Tag, build a FRESH ListBoxItem for
        # the right list, then _apply_filter rebuilds the left list from
        # the master sheet list (auto-excluding sheets now on the right).
        selected_items = list(self._all_list.SelectedItems)
        if not selected_items:
            return
        for item in selected_items:
            self._sel_list.Items.Add(build_sheet_item(item.Tag))
        self._apply_filter()

    def _on_add_all(self, sender, args):
        # Add all currently visible filtered sheets to the right list
        sheets_to_add = [item.Tag for item in list(self._all_list.Items)]
        for sheet in sheets_to_add:
            self._sel_list.Items.Add(build_sheet_item(sheet))
        self._apply_filter()

    def _on_remove(self, sender, args):
        # Safe to remove directly -- these items belong to _sel_list
        selected_items = list(self._sel_list.SelectedItems)
        if not selected_items:
            return
        for item in selected_items:
            self._sel_list.Items.Remove(item)
        self._apply_filter()

    def _on_remove_all(self, sender, args):
        self._sel_list.Items.Clear()
        self._apply_filter()

    def _on_dbl_click_add(self, sender, args):
        # MouseDoubleClick fires before SelectedItems is updated in WPF.
        # We walk up the visual tree from the clicked element to find the
        # ListBoxItem that was double-clicked, then add that specific sheet.
        from System.Windows import FrameworkElement
        src = args.OriginalSource
        # Walk up the visual tree until we find a ListBoxItem or run out
        while src is not None and not isinstance(src, ListBoxItem):
            try:
                src = src.Parent
            except Exception:
                src = None
        if src is not None and src.Tag is not None:
            self._sel_list.Items.Add(build_sheet_item(src.Tag))
            self._apply_filter()

    def _on_dbl_click_remove(self, sender, args):
        # Same visual-tree walk to find the clicked ListBoxItem on the right list
        from System.Windows import FrameworkElement
        src = args.OriginalSource
        while src is not None and not isinstance(src, ListBoxItem):
            try:
                src = src.Parent
            except Exception:
                src = None
        if src is not None:
            self._sel_list.Items.Remove(src)
            self._apply_filter()

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # FOOTER BUTTONS
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _on_back(self, sender, args):
        self._go_back        = True
        self.selected_sheets = None
        self._win.Close()

    def _on_cancel(self, sender, args):
        self.selected_sheets = None
        self._win.Close()

    def _on_next(self, sender, args):
        # Read the sheet objects from the right list's item Tags
        self.selected_sheets = [
            item.Tag for item in self._sel_list.Items
        ]
        self._win.Close()


# ===========================================================================
# WINDOW 3: REORDER WINDOW
# Shows viewports for ONE sheet at a time. The caller loops over all sheets.
# self.result is "applied", "skipped", or "cancelled" after closing.
# ===========================================================================

class ReorderWindow(object):
    """
    Modeless viewport reorder window for a single sheet.
    self.result is set before the window closes and read by the caller.
    """

    def __init__(self, sheet, current_index, total_count):
        self.result   = "cancelled"
        self._closed  = False  # used by caller to poll when window closes

        win = load_xaml(XAML_REORDER)
        if win is None:
            return
        self._win   = win
        self._sheet = sheet

        ctrls = find_controls(win, [
            "ViewportList", "SheetLabel", "StatusText",
            "MoveTopBtn", "MoveUpBtn", "MoveDownBtn", "MoveBottomBtn",
            "SkipBtn", "CancelBtn", "ApplyBtn",
            "UpdateSheetBtn"
        ])
        missing = check_controls(ctrls)
        if missing:
            forms.alert("XAML controls missing: " + ", ".join(missing), title="Error")
            return

        self._listbox     = ctrls["ViewportList"]
        self._sheet_lbl   = ctrls["SheetLabel"]
        self._status      = ctrls["StatusText"]
        self._skip_btn    = ctrls["SkipBtn"]
        self._update_btn  = ctrls["UpdateSheetBtn"]
        self._apply_btn   = ctrls["ApplyBtn"]

        # Show the Skip Sheet button only when processing multiple sheets
        if total_count > 1:
            self._skip_btn.Visibility   = Visibility.Visible
            self._update_btn.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed
        else:
            self._skip_btn.Visibility   = Visibility.Collapsed
            # Show Update button in single-sheet (Current Sheet) mode only
            self._update_btn.Visibility = Visibility.Visible

        self._sheet_lbl.Text = build_sheet_label(sheet)

        if total_count > 1:
            self._status.Text = "Sheet %d of %d" % (current_index, total_count)
        else:
            self._status.Text = ""

        # Wire up buttons
        ctrls["MoveTopBtn"].Click    += self._on_move_top
        ctrls["MoveUpBtn"].Click     += self._on_move_up
        ctrls["MoveDownBtn"].Click   += self._on_move_down
        ctrls["MoveBottomBtn"].Click += self._on_move_bottom
        ctrls["ApplyBtn"].Click      += self._on_apply
        ctrls["SkipBtn"].Click       += self._on_skip
        ctrls["CancelBtn"].Click     += self._on_cancel
        ctrls["UpdateSheetBtn"].Click += self._on_update_sheet

        self._listbox.KeyDown += self._on_list_keydown
        self._win.Closed      += self._on_window_closed

        # Show/hide the window with Revit focus using Win32 activation hooks.
        # We watch the Revit main window's HWND via a WndProc hook:
        #   WM_ACTIVATEAPP (0x001C) fires whenever the application gains or
        #   loses focus to another app (not just window-to-window within Revit).
        #   wParam=1 means Revit is being activated, wParam=0 means deactivated.
        # This makes our window behave like the Revit Properties palette --
        # visible when Revit is active, hidden when another app is in front.
        # Always on top -- simplest reliable approach
        self._win.Topmost = True

        self._items = []
        self._load_viewports()

        self._win.Show()

    def _on_window_closed(self, sender, args):
        """Called when the window is closed by any means."""
        self._closed = True



    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # LOAD VIEWPORTS
    # GetAllViewports() returns ElementIds in creation order (oldest = back).
    # We reverse so index 0 = front = top of the list.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _load_viewports(self):
        all_vp_ids = list(self._sheet.GetAllViewports())
        all_vp_ids.reverse()  # index 0 = most recently created = front

        self._items = []
        for i, vp_id in enumerate(all_vp_ids):
            vp   = doc.GetElement(vp_id)
            item = build_viewport_item(i + 1, vp)
            self._items.append(item)

        self._rebuild_list()

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # REBUILD LIST
    # Clears the ListBox and re-adds all items from self._items.
    # Also refreshes the numbered badge on each item.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _rebuild_list(self):
        self._listbox.Items.Clear()
        for i, item in enumerate(self._items):
            # Refresh badge: item.Content = StackPanel
            #                  Children[0] = Border
            #                    Child    = TextBlock (badge)
            try:
                item.Content.Children[0].Child.Text = str(i + 1)
            except Exception:
                pass
            self._listbox.Items.Add(item)

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # SELECTION HELPERS
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _get_selected_indices(self):
        return sorted(
            i for i, item in enumerate(self._items) if item.IsSelected
        )

    def _restore_selection(self, indices):
        self._listbox.UnselectAll()
        for idx in sorted(indices):
            if 0 <= idx < len(self._items):
                self._items[idx].IsSelected = True
        if indices:
            top = min(indices)
            if 0 <= top < len(self._items):
                self._listbox.ScrollIntoView(self._items[top])

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # MOVE OPERATIONS
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _on_move_up(self, sender, args):
        indices = self._get_selected_indices()
        if not indices or indices[0] == 0:
            return
        new_indices = []
        for idx in indices:
            self._items[idx - 1], self._items[idx] = \
                self._items[idx], self._items[idx - 1]
            new_indices.append(idx - 1)
        self._rebuild_list()
        self._restore_selection(new_indices)

    def _on_move_down(self, sender, args):
        indices = self._get_selected_indices()
        last    = len(self._items) - 1
        if not indices or indices[-1] == last:
            return
        new_indices = []
        for idx in reversed(indices):
            self._items[idx], self._items[idx + 1] = \
                self._items[idx + 1], self._items[idx]
            new_indices.append(idx + 1)
        self._rebuild_list()
        self._restore_selection(new_indices)

    def _on_move_top(self, sender, args):
        indices = self._get_selected_indices()
        if not indices or indices[0] == 0:
            return
        selected = [self._items[i] for i in indices]
        for idx in reversed(indices):
            self._items.pop(idx)
        new_indices = []
        for offset, item in enumerate(selected):
            self._items.insert(offset, item)
            new_indices.append(offset)
        self._rebuild_list()
        self._restore_selection(new_indices)

    def _on_move_bottom(self, sender, args):
        indices = self._get_selected_indices()
        last    = len(self._items) - 1
        if not indices or indices[-1] == last:
            return
        selected = [self._items[i] for i in indices]
        for idx in reversed(indices):
            self._items.pop(idx)
        new_indices = []
        base = len(self._items)
        for offset, item in enumerate(selected):
            self._items.append(item)
            new_indices.append(base + offset)
        self._rebuild_list()
        self._restore_selection(new_indices)

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # KEYBOARD -- Alt+Up / Alt+Down
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _on_list_keydown(self, sender, args):
        alt_held = (args.KeyboardDevice.Modifiers == ModifierKeys.Alt)
        if alt_held and args.Key == Key.Up:
            self._on_move_up(sender, args)
            args.Handled = True
        elif alt_held and args.Key == Key.Down:
            self._on_move_down(sender, args)
            args.Handled = True

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # UPDATE TO CURRENT SHEET
    # Reloads the viewport list from whatever sheet is currently active in
    # Revit. Lets the user switch sheets in Revit while the window is open
    # and refresh without reopening the tool.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _on_update_sheet(self, sender, args):
        active = revit.active_view
        if not isinstance(active, ViewSheet):
            forms.alert(
                "The active view is not a Sheet. Please open a Sheet first.",
                title="No Sheet Active"
            )
            return
        # Update the stored sheet and label
        self._sheet = active
        self._sheet_lbl.Text = build_sheet_label(active)
        # Reload the viewport list from the new sheet
        self._items = []
        self._load_viewports()

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # APPLY
    # Single transaction: save offsets, delete, recreate, restore offsets.
    # No Regenerate() needed -- LabelOffset is a direct property set,
    # not geometry-dependent, so it works within the same transaction.
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _on_apply(self, sender, args):

        # STEP 1: Save LabelOffset for every viewport before anything changes.
        # Keyed by ViewId -- survives delete since the view is not deleted.
        saved_offsets = {}
        for item in self._items:
            vp = item.Tag
            try:
                off = vp.LabelOffset
                saved_offsets[vp.ViewId] = XYZ(off.X, off.Y, off.Z)
            except Exception:
                saved_offsets[vp.ViewId] = XYZ(0, 0, 0)

        # Build desired back-to-front order
        desired_back_to_front = list(reversed(
            [item.Tag for item in self._items]
        ))

        # Get original creation order (back to front)
        orig_back_to_front = [
            doc.GetElement(vp_id)
            for vp_id in self._sheet.GetAllViewports()
            if doc.GetElement(vp_id) is not None
        ]

        # Find first position where orders differ
        orig_ids    = [vp.Id for vp in orig_back_to_front]
        desired_ids = [vp.Id for vp in desired_back_to_front]
        first_diff  = len(orig_ids)
        for i in range(min(len(orig_ids), len(desired_ids))):
            if orig_ids[i] != desired_ids[i]:
                first_diff = i
                break

        vps_to_recreate = desired_back_to_front[first_diff:]

        if not vps_to_recreate:
            self._status.Text = "Already in correct order."
            print "No draw order change needed."
            return

        # Snapshot configs before starting transaction
        recreate_configs = [
            {
                'view_id': vp.ViewId,
                'center' : vp.GetBoxCenter(),
                'type_id': vp.GetTypeId(),
            }
            for vp in vps_to_recreate
        ]

        sheet = self._sheet

        # Window stays OPEN after apply -- user can keep reordering
        # or switch sheets with Update to Current Sheet.
        # Disable Apply button during transaction to prevent double-click.
        self._apply_btn.IsEnabled = False
        self._status.Text = "Applying..."

        # STEP 2 + 3: Single transaction -- delete, recreate, restore offsets.
        t = Transaction(doc, "Reorder Viewports - " + sheet.SheetNumber)
        t.Start()
        try:
            # Delete only the viewports that need to move
            for vp in vps_to_recreate:
                sheet.DeleteViewport(vp)

            # Recreate in back-to-front order and immediately restore offset
            for cfg in recreate_configs:
                new_vp = Viewport.Create(
                    doc, sheet.Id, cfg['view_id'], cfg['center']
                )
                new_vp.ChangeTypeId(cfg['type_id'])

                # Restore the saved LabelOffset directly on the new viewport
                saved = saved_offsets.get(cfg['view_id'])
                if saved is not None:
                    new_vp.LabelOffset = saved

            t.Commit()
            self.result = "applied"

            sheet_link = output.linkify(sheet.Id, title=sheet.SheetNumber)
            print "Reordered: " + sheet_link + "  " + sheet.Name
            print "  Recreated: %d  |  Untouched: %d" % (
                len(vps_to_recreate), first_diff
            )

            # Reload the list to reflect the new draw order from Revit
            # and re-enable Apply
            self._items = []
            self._load_viewports()
            self._apply_btn.IsEnabled = True
            self._status.Text = "Order applied. Continue reordering or close."

        except Exception as e:
            t.RollBack()
            self._apply_btn.IsEnabled = True
            self._status.Text = "Error -- see output window."
            print "ERROR: " + str(e)
            print traceback.format_exc()
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # SKIP / CANCEL
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _on_skip(self, sender, args):
        self.result = "skipped"
        self._win.Close()

    def _on_cancel(self, sender, args):
        self.result = "cancelled"
        self._win.Close()


# ===========================================================================
# MODELESS WINDOW HELPER
# Show() returns immediately on the main thread. We must keep processing
# WPF dispatcher messages on that same thread or the window freezes and
# Revit freezes with it. time.sleep() blocks the main thread entirely --
# never use it here. The correct approach is PushFrame() which enters a
# nested WPF message loop that keeps both WPF and Revit responsive while
# waiting for the window to close.
# ===========================================================================
def _wait_for_window(rw):
    """
    Block the script using a nested WPF message loop until the modeless
    window closes. PushFrame() keeps the dispatcher running so WPF events,
    button clicks, and Revit stay fully responsive.
    """
    from System.Windows.Threading import Dispatcher, DispatcherFrame
    frame = DispatcherFrame()

    def on_closed(s, e):
        # When the window closes, tell the frame to exit
        frame.Continue = False

    rw._win.Closed += on_closed
    # Enter the nested message loop -- blocks here until frame.Continue = False
    Dispatcher.PushFrame(frame)


# ===========================================================================
# ENTRY POINT
# Orchestrates the three windows in sequence.
# ===========================================================================
try:
    # ---- Step 1: Mode picker ----
    mode_win = ModePicker()
    if mode_win.mode is None:
        # User cancelled at the mode picker -- stop here
        pass

    elif mode_win.mode == "current":
        # ---- Current Sheet mode ----
        active = revit.active_view
        if not isinstance(active, ViewSheet):
            forms.alert(
                "Please open a Sheet view before running this tool.",
                title="No Sheet Active"
            )
        else:
            rw = ReorderWindow(active, 1, 1)
            # Modeless window -- pump the WPF dispatcher until window closes
            _wait_for_window(rw)
            if rw.result == "applied":
                print "Done."

    else:
        # ---- Multiple Sheets mode ----
        sheet_win = SheetPicker()

        # If user went Back, re-show the mode picker (simple loop)
        while sheet_win._go_back:
            mode_win2 = ModePicker()
            if mode_win2.mode != "multiple":
                sheet_win.selected_sheets = None
                break
            sheet_win = SheetPicker()

        sheets = sheet_win.selected_sheets
        if sheets:
            total   = len(sheets)
            applied = 0
            skipped = 0

            for i, sheet in enumerate(sheets):
                rw = ReorderWindow(sheet, i + 1, total)
                _wait_for_window(rw)

                if rw.result == "applied":
                    applied += 1
                elif rw.result == "skipped":
                    skipped += 1
                elif rw.result == "cancelled":
                    print "Cancelled by user after %d applied, %d skipped." % (
                        applied, skipped
                    )
                    break

            print "Reorder Viewports complete: %d applied, %d skipped." % (
                applied, skipped
            )

except Exception as e:
    print "ERROR: " + str(e)
    print traceback.format_exc()
```

```
    <Grid Margin="16">

        </Grid.RowDefinitions>

        <!-- TITLE -->
        <TextBlock Grid.Row="0"
                   Text="Reorder Viewports - Select Sheets"
                   FontSize="14" FontWeight="Bold"

        <!-- DESCRIPTION -->
        <TextBlock Grid.Row="1"
                   FontSize="11" Foreground="#6B6B6B"

        <!-- FILTER PANEL
             Matches JasonExporter layout exactly:
             DockPanel rows, Height=24, label left (Width=90),
             Reset button right (Width=50), TextBox fills the middle.
        -->
        <Border Grid.Row="2"
                Background="#F5F5F5"
                BorderBrush="#DEDEDE"
                BorderThickness="1"
                CornerRadius="4"

            <StackPanel>

                <TextBlock Text="Filter All Sheets"
                           FontWeight="SemiBold"

                           Margin="0 0 0 6"/>

                <!-- Sheet No. filter row: Height=24 matching JasonExporter -->
                <DockPanel Height="24" Margin="0 0 0 5">
                    <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Left"
                               Text="Sheet No."
```
