```python
    def write_run_output(self, text, append=True):
        if not self.txt_run_output:
            return

        existing = ''
        try:
            existing = self.txt_run_output.Text or ''
        except Exception:
            existing = ''

        if append and existing and existing != 'No run output yet.':
            self.txt_run_output.Text = existing + '\n\n' + text
        else:
            self.txt_run_output.Text = text

    def _issue_view_ids(self, failures):
        ids = set()
        for item in failures:
            try:
                view_id = int(item[1])
                if view_id > 0:
                    ids.add(view_id)
            except Exception:
                pass
        return ids

    def _count_success_without_issues(self, results, failures):
        issue_ids = self._issue_view_ids(failures)
        count = 0
        for item in results:
            if item.get('view_id') not in issue_ids:
                count += 1
        return count

    def _format_run_output(self, title, options, results, failures):
        lines = []
        lines.append(title)
        lines.append('Selected: {}'.format(options.get('selected_count', len(results))))
        lines.append('Move/rotate: {}'.format('Yes' if options.get('move_in_plan') else 'No'))
        lines.append('Flip: {}'.format('Yes' if options.get('flip_after') else 'No'))
        lines.append('Match extents: {}'.format('Yes' if options.get('match_horizontal') else 'No'))
        lines.append('Assign scope box: {}'.format('Yes' if options.get('assign_scope_box') else 'No'))
        lines.append('Vertical mode: {}'.format(options.get('vertical_mode', 'None')))

        success_count = self._count_success_without_issues(results, failures)
        lines.append('Success: {}'.format(success_count))
        lines.append('Issues: {}'.format(len(failures)))

        if failures:
            lines.append('')
            lines.append('Issues by view:')
            for name, view_id, reason in failures:
                lines.append('- {} [{}] | {}'.format(name, view_id, reason))

        if results:
            lines.append('')
            lines.append('Processed views:')
            for item in results:
                detail = []
                if options.get('move_in_plan'):
                    detail.append('move {:.1f} mm'.format(ft_to_mm(item.get('snap_dist_ft', 0.0))))
                if options.get('flip_after'):
                    detail.append('flip {}'.format('Yes' if abs(item.get('flip_deg', 0.0)) > 0.0 else 'No'))
                if options.get('match_horizontal'):
                    detail.append('extents {}'.format('Yes' if item.get('extent_updated') else 'No'))
                if options.get('assign_scope_box'):
                    detail.append('scope {}'.format('Yes' if item.get('scope_assigned') else 'No'))
                if options.get('vertical_mode') == 'Update vertical crop extents from Levels':
                    detail.append('vertical {}'.format('Yes' if item.get('vertical_crop_updated') else 'No'))

                summary = ', '.join(detail) if detail else 'no stage actions'
                lines.append('- {} [{}] | {}'.format(item.get('view_name', '<missing>'), item.get('view_id', 0), summary))

        return '\n'.join(lines)

    def clear_affected_click(self, sender, args):
        self.staged_targets = []
        self.rebuild_mapping_rows()
        self.apply_target_filters()
        self.refresh_affected_status()
        self.update_stage_enable_state()
        self.update_vertical_enable_state()

    def refresh_affected_status(self):
        count = len(self.staged_targets)

        if count == 0:
            text = 'Affected sections: 0'
        elif count == 1:
            text = 'Affected sections: 1'
        else:
            text = 'Affected sections: {}'.format(count)

        if self.txt_affected_status:
            self.txt_affected_status.Text = text

        if self.txt_plan_stage_status:
            if count:
                self.txt_plan_stage_status.Text = 'Plan/extents stage ready: {} affected section(s).'.format(count)
            else:
                self.txt_plan_stage_status.Text = 'Plan/extents stage ready: No affected sections added.'

        if self.txt_vertical_stage_status:
            if count:
                self.txt_vertical_stage_status.Text = 'Vertical crop stage ready: {} affected section(s).'.format(count)
            else:
                self.txt_vertical_stage_status.Text = 'Vertical crop stage ready: No affected sections added.'

    def add_to_selection_click(self, sender, args):
        selected = self.get_selected_targets()

        if not selected:
            forms.alert('Select at least one section/detail view to add.')
            return

        if not hasattr(self, 'staged_targets'):
            self.staged_targets = []

        existing_ids = set()

        for target in self.staged_targets:
            try:
                existing_ids.add(target['view'].Id.IntegerValue)
            except Exception:
                pass

        added = 0

        for target in selected:
            try:
                view_id = target['view'].Id.IntegerValue

                if view_id not in existing_ids:
                    self.staged_targets.append(target)
                    existing_ids.add(view_id)
                    added += 1

            except Exception:
                pass

        if added == 0:
            forms.alert('Selected views are already in the affected section set.')

        self.rebuild_mapping_rows()
        self.apply_target_filters()
        self.refresh_affected_status()
        self.update_vertical_enable_state()
        self.update_stage_enable_state()

    def populate_plan_views(self):
        self.plan_views = collect_plan_views()

        self.cmb_plan_view.Items.Clear()

        active_view_id = None
        try:
            active_view_id = doc.ActiveView.Id.IntegerValue
        except Exception:
            pass

        selected_index = 0

        for index, view in enumerate(self.plan_views):
            label = '{} [{}]'.format(view.Name, view.Id.IntegerValue)
            item = make_combo_item(label, view)
            self.cmb_plan_view.Items.Add(item)

            if active_view_id and view.Id.IntegerValue == active_view_id:
                selected_index = index

        if self.cmb_plan_view.Items.Count:
            self.cmb_plan_view.SelectedIndex = selected_index


    def get_selected_plan_view(self):
        item = self.cmb_plan_view.SelectedItem
        if not item:
            return None

        try:
            return item.Tag
        except Exception:
            return None


    def refresh_scope_boxes(self):
        self.scope_box = None
        self.cmb_scope_box.Items.Clear()

        plan_view = self.get_selected_plan_view()

        if not plan_view:
            self.refresh_summary()
            return

        scope_boxes = collect_scope_boxes_visible_in_view(plan_view)

        for scope_box in scope_boxes:
            label = '{} [{}]'.format(scope_box.Name, scope_box.Id.IntegerValue)
            self.cmb_scope_box.Items.Add(make_combo_item(label, scope_box))

        if self.cmb_scope_box.Items.Count:
            self.cmb_scope_box.SelectedIndex = 0
            self.scope_box = self.cmb_scope_box.SelectedItem.Tag

        self.refresh_summary()

    def populate_batch_level_controls(self):
        controls = [self.cmb_batch_lower, self.cmb_batch_upper]

        for control in controls:
            if not control:
                continue

            control.Items.Clear()
            for level in self.levels:
                control.Items.Add(level.Name)

        if self.cmb_batch_lower and self.cmb_batch_lower.Items.Count:
            self.cmb_batch_lower.SelectedIndex = 0

        if self.cmb_batch_upper and self.cmb_batch_upper.Items.Count:
            self.cmb_batch_upper.SelectedIndex = self.cmb_batch_upper.Items.Count - 1

    def apply_batch_vertical_click(self, sender, args):
        if not self.staged_targets:
            forms.alert('Add section/detail views to the affected selection first.')
            return

        if not bool(self.rb_map_vertical.IsChecked):
            forms.alert('Enable "Update vertical crop extents from Levels" before applying a batch update.')
            return

        if not self.rows:
            self.rebuild_mapping_rows()

        selected_ids = self._selected_view_ids()
        staged_ids = self._staged_view_ids()
        target_ids = selected_ids.intersection(staged_ids)

        if not target_ids:
            forms.alert(
                'Select one or more views in Sections list that are already in affected sections, then run batch update.'
            )
            return

        lower_name = str(self.cmb_batch_lower.SelectedItem) if self.cmb_batch_lower and self.cmb_batch_lower.SelectedItem else None
        upper_name = str(self.cmb_batch_upper.SelectedItem) if self.cmb_batch_upper and self.cmb_batch_upper.SelectedItem else None

        if not lower_name or not upper_name:
            forms.alert('Choose both Lower and Upper levels for batch update.')
            return

        lower_offset = safe_float(self.txt_batch_lower_offset.Text if self.txt_batch_lower_offset else '0.0', 0.0)
        upper_offset = safe_float(self.txt_batch_upper_offset.Text if self.txt_batch_upper_offset else '0.0', 0.0)

        updated = 0
        for row in self.rows:
            view_id = row.view.Id.IntegerValue
            if view_id not in target_ids:
                continue

            row.cmb_lower.SelectedItem = lower_name
            row.cmb_upper.SelectedItem = upper_name
            row.txt_lower_offset.Text = '{:.1f}'.format(lower_offset)
            row.txt_upper_offset.Text = '{:.1f}'.format(upper_offset)

            self.last_applied_vertical_specs[view_id] = row.get_spec()
            updated += 1

        if self.txt_vertical_stage_status:
            self.txt_vertical_stage_status.Text = 'Batch mapping applied: {} affected section(s) updated.'.format(updated)

        self.write_run_output(
            'Batch Vertical Mapping\nUpdated views: {}\nLower: {} @ {:.1f} mm\nUpper: {} @ {:.1f} mm'.format(
                updated,
                lower_name,
                lower_offset,
                upper_name,
                upper_offset
            ),
            append=False
        )

    def plan_view_changed(self, sender, args):
        self.refresh_scope_boxes()
        self.refresh_targets()

    def scope_box_changed(self, sender, args):
        item = self.cmb_scope_box.SelectedItem

        if item:
            try:
                self.scope_box = item.Tag
            except Exception:
                self.scope_box = None
        else:
            self.scope_box = None

        self.refresh_summary()

    def show(self):
        ok = self.ShowDialog()
        if ok:
            return self.result
        return None

    def refresh_summary(self):
        self.txt_active_view.Text = 'Active view: {} [{}]'.format(doc.ActiveView.Name, doc.ActiveView.Id.IntegerValue)

        plan_view = self.get_selected_plan_view()
        if plan_view and self.txt_plan_note:
            self.txt_plan_note.Text = 'Plan used for plan/scope stages: {} [{}]. Make sure required scope boxes are visible in this plan.'.format(
                plan_view.Name,
                plan_view.Id.IntegerValue
            )
        elif self.txt_plan_note:
            self.txt_plan_note.Text = 'No plan selected. Plan-driven stages require a selected plan view.'

        if self.scope_box:
            self.txt_scope_box.Text = 'Scope box: {} [{}]'.format(self.scope_box.Name, self.scope_box.Id.IntegerValue)
        else:
            self.txt_scope_box.Text = 'Scope box: none selected'

    def refresh_targets(self):
        if not self.all_targets:
            self.all_targets = collect_all_detail_targets()

        self.visible_target_viewids = set()

        plan_view = self.get_selected_plan_view()
        if plan_view:
            try:
                visible_targets = collect_visible_detail_targets_in_plan_view(plan_view)
                for item in visible_targets:
                    self.visible_target_viewids.add(item['view'].Id.IntegerValue)
            except Exception:
                pass

        self.apply_target_filters()

    def target_filter_changed(self, sender, args):
        self.apply_target_filters()

    def apply_target_filters(self):
        items = list(self.all_targets)

        name_filter = ''
        if self.txt_name_filter:
            try:
                name_filter = (self.txt_name_filter.Text or '').strip().lower()
            except Exception:
                name_filter = ''

        if name_filter:
            items = [
                x for x in items
                if name_filter in x['view'].Name.lower()
            ]

        visible_only = bool(self.chk_visible_in_plan_only.IsChecked) if self.chk_visible_in_plan_only else False
        if visible_only:
            items = [
                x for x in items
                if x['view'].Id.IntegerValue in self.visible_target_viewids
            ]

        sort_mode = 'Name A-Z'
        if self.cmb_sort_targets and self.cmb_sort_targets.SelectedItem:
            try:
                sort_mode = str(self.cmb_sort_targets.SelectedItem.Content)
            except Exception:
                pass

        if sort_mode == 'Name Z-A':
            items.sort(key=lambda x: x['view'].Name.lower(), reverse=True)
        elif sort_mode == 'View Id':
            items.sort(key=lambda x: x['view'].Id.IntegerValue)
        else:
            items.sort(key=lambda x: x['view'].Name.lower())

        selected_ids = set()
        for item in self.lst_targets.SelectedItems:
            try:
                selected_ids.add(item.Tag['view'].Id.IntegerValue)
            except Exception:
                pass

        self.targets = items
        self.lst_targets.Items.Clear()

        for target in self.targets:
            view = target['view']
            view_id = view.Id.IntegerValue
            visible_tag = ''
            if self.visible_target_viewids:
                visible_tag = ' | visible in plan' if view_id in self.visible_target_viewids else ' | not visible in plan'

            item = ListBoxItem()
            item.Content = '{} [{}]{}'.format(view.Name, view_id, visible_tag)
            item.Tag = target
            self.lst_targets.Items.Add(item)

            if view_id in selected_ids:
                self.lst_targets.SelectedItems.Add(item)

        if self.txt_target_count:
            self.txt_target_count.Text = 'Filtered detail views: {}'.format(len(self.targets))

        if self.txt_catalog_count:
            self.txt_catalog_count.Text = 'All detail views: {} | Filtered: {} | Affected: {}'.format(
                len(self.all_targets),
                len(self.targets),
                len(self.staged_targets)
            )

    def rebuild_mapping_rows(self):
        if not self.map_rows:
            return

        self.map_rows.Children.Clear()
        self.rows = []

        for target in self.staged_targets:
            try:
                view_id = target['view'].Id.IntegerValue
                initial_spec = self.last_applied_vertical_specs.get(view_id)

                row = MappingRow(target, self.levels, initial_spec)
                self.rows.append(row)
                self.map_rows.Children.Add(row.build())

            except Exception as ex:
                txt = TextBlock()
                txt.Text = '{} | {}'.format(target['view'].Name, str(ex))
                txt.Margin = Thickness(0, 0, 0, 4)
                self.map_rows.Children.Add(txt)

    def collect_vertical_specs(self):
        if not self.rows:
            self.rebuild_mapping_rows()

        vertical_specs = []

        for row in self.rows:
            spec = row.get_spec()

            if not spec['lower_level'] or not spec['upper_level']:
                forms.alert('Vertical crop mapping is incomplete for "{}".'.format(row.view.Name))
                return None

            vertical_specs.append(spec)

        return vertical_specs

    def get_selected_targets(self):
        selected = []
        for item in self.lst_targets.SelectedItems:
            try:
                selected.append(item.Tag)
            except Exception:
                pass
        return selected

    def update_vertical_enable_state(self):
        has_affected = len(self.staged_targets) > 0
        assign_scope = bool(self.chk_assign_scope_box.IsChecked)
        selection_only = bool(self.chk_selection_only.IsChecked)
        map_vertical = bool(self.rb_map_vertical.IsChecked)

        vertical_enabled = has_affected and not assign_scope and not selection_only

        self.rb_keep_vertical.IsEnabled = vertical_enabled
        self.rb_map_vertical.IsEnabled = vertical_enabled

        rows_enabled = vertical_enabled and map_vertical
        if self.map_rows:
            self.map_rows.IsEnabled = rows_enabled

        if self.btn_run_vertical_crop:
            self.btn_run_vertical_crop.IsEnabled = rows_enabled

        if self.btn_apply_batch_vertical:
            self.btn_apply_batch_vertical.IsEnabled = rows_enabled

        if self.cmb_batch_lower:
            self.cmb_batch_lower.IsEnabled = rows_enabled

        if self.cmb_batch_upper:
            self.cmb_batch_upper.IsEnabled = rows_enabled

        if self.txt_batch_lower_offset:
            self.txt_batch_lower_offset.IsEnabled = rows_enabled

        if self.txt_batch_upper_offset:
            self.txt_batch_upper_offset.IsEnabled = rows_enabled

        if self.txt_vertical_stage_status:
            if not has_affected:
                self.txt_vertical_stage_status.Text = 'Vertical crop stage ready: No affected sections added.'
            elif assign_scope:
                self.txt_vertical_stage_status.Text = 'Vertical crop stage disabled because Assign scope box last is enabled.'
            elif selection_only:
                self.txt_vertical_stage_status.Text = 'Vertical crop stage disabled because Selection only / no updates is enabled.'
            elif map_vertical:
                self.txt_vertical_stage_status.Text = 'Vertical crop stage ready: {} affected section(s).'.format(len(self.staged_targets))
            else:
                self.txt_vertical_stage_status.Text = 'Vertical crop stage not enabled.'

    def update_stage_enable_state(self):
        affected_count = len(self.staged_targets)
        has_affected = affected_count > 0

        selection_only = bool(self.chk_selection_only.IsChecked)

        # Stage controls.
        self.chk_move_plan.IsEnabled = not selection_only
        self.chk_flip_after.IsEnabled = not selection_only
        self.chk_match_horizontal.IsEnabled = not selection_only
        self.chk_assign_scope_box.IsEnabled = not selection_only
        self.cmb_side.IsEnabled = not selection_only

        if self.cmb_scope_box:
            self.cmb_scope_box.IsEnabled = not selection_only

        if self.cmb_plan_view:
            self.cmb_plan_view.IsEnabled = True

        # Plan/extents run button.
        plan_actions_enabled = any([
            bool(self.chk_move_plan.IsChecked),
            bool(self.chk_flip_after.IsChecked),
            bool(self.chk_match_horizontal.IsChecked),
            bool(self.chk_assign_scope_box.IsChecked)
        ])

        self.btn_run_plan_extent.IsEnabled = has_affected and not selection_only and plan_actions_enabled

        # Vertical run button.
        vertical_enabled = (
            has_affected
            and not selection_only
            and not bool(self.chk_assign_scope_box.IsChecked)
            and bool(self.rb_map_vertical.IsChecked)
        )

        self.btn_run_vertical_crop.IsEnabled = vertical_enabled

    def _selected_view_ids(self):
        ids = set()
        for target in self.get_selected_targets():
            try:
                ids.add(target['view'].Id.IntegerValue)
            except Exception:
                pass
        return ids

    def _staged_view_ids(self):
        ids = set()
        for target in self.staged_targets:
            try:
                ids.add(target['view'].Id.IntegerValue)
            except Exception:
                pass
        return ids

    def validate_vertical_selection_alignment(self):
        if not bool(self.rb_map_vertical.IsChecked):
            return True

        selected_ids = self._selected_view_ids()
        staged_ids = self._staged_view_ids()

        if selected_ids != staged_ids:
            forms.alert(
                'Vertical mapping uses the affected section set.\n\n'
                'Make the current selection match the affected section set, '
                'or run the vertical stage separately from the staged targets.'
            )
            return False

        return True

    def get_selected_side_name(self):
        side_item = self.cmb_side.SelectedItem
        side_name = 'Top'

        if side_item:
            try:
                side_name = side_item.Content
            except Exception:
                side_name = str(side_item)

        return str(side_name)

    def run_vertical_crop_click(self, sender, args):
        if not self.staged_targets:
            forms.alert('Add section/detail views to the affected selection first.')
            return

        if not bool(self.rb_map_vertical.IsChecked):
            forms.alert('Enable "Update vertical crop extents from Levels" before running this stage.')
            return

        vertical_specs = self.collect_vertical_specs()
        if vertical_specs is None:
            return

        self.last_applied_vertical_specs = dict(
            (spec['view_id'], spec) for spec in vertical_specs
        )

        options = {
            'selection_only': False,
            'move_in_plan': False,
            'flip_after': False,
            'match_horizontal': False,
            'assign_scope_box': False,
            'side_name': self.get_selected_side_name(),
            'vertical_mode': 'Update vertical crop extents from Levels',
            'suppress_output': True
        }

        payload = {
            'selected_targets': list(self.staged_targets),
            'scope_box': self.scope_box,
            'plan_view': self.get_selected_plan_view(),
            'vertical_specs': vertical_specs,
            'options': options
        }

        response = run_detailmove(payload) or {}
        results = response.get('results', [])
        failures = response.get('failures', [])

        updated_count = 0
        for item in results:
            if item.get('vertical_crop_updated'):
                updated_count += 1

        self.rebuild_mapping_rows()
        self.refresh_affected_status()
        self.apply_target_filters()
        self.update_vertical_enable_state()
        self.update_stage_enable_state()

        self.write_run_output(
            self._format_run_output('Vertical Crop Run', options, results, failures),
            append=False
        )

        if self.txt_vertical_stage_status:
            if updated_count and not failures:
                self.txt_vertical_stage_status.Text = 'Vertical crop update complete: {} of {} views updated.'.format(
                    updated_count,
                    len(self.staged_targets)
                )
            elif updated_count:
                self.txt_vertical_stage_status.Text = 'Vertical crop update complete: {} updated, {} issue(s). See output.'.format(
                    updated_count,
                    len(failures)
                )
            else:
                self.txt_vertical_stage_status.Text = 'Vertical crop update finished with no successful updates. See output.'

    def run_plan_extent_click(self, sender, args):
        if not self.staged_targets:
            forms.alert('Add section/detail views to the affected selection first.')
            return

        plan_view = self.get_selected_plan_view()

        options = {
            'selection_only': False,
            'move_in_plan': bool(self.chk_move_plan.IsChecked),
            'flip_after': bool(self.chk_flip_after.IsChecked),
            'match_horizontal': bool(self.chk_match_horizontal.IsChecked),
            'assign_scope_box': bool(self.chk_assign_scope_box.IsChecked),
            'side_name': self.get_selected_side_name(),
            'vertical_mode': 'Keep current vertical extents',
            'suppress_output': True
        }

        if not any([
            options['move_in_plan'],
            options['flip_after'],
            options['match_horizontal'],
            options['assign_scope_box']
        ]):
            forms.alert('Tick at least one Plan + extent stage before running.')
            return

        plan_required = any([
            options['move_in_plan'],
            options['flip_after'],
            options['match_horizontal']
        ])

        scope_required = any([
            options['move_in_plan'],
            options['match_horizontal'],
            options['assign_scope_box']
        ])

        if plan_required and not plan_view:
            forms.alert(
                'Select a plan view for the selected plan-based stages.\n\n'
                'The selected plan should have the required section markers and scope boxes visible.'
            )
            return

        if scope_required and not self.scope_box:
            forms.alert(
                'Select a scope box for the selected scope-driven stages.\n\n'
                'If no scope boxes are listed, choose a plan view where the required scope boxes are visible.'
            )
            return

        payload = {
            'selected_targets': list(self.staged_targets),
            'scope_box': self.scope_box,
            'plan_view': plan_view,
            'vertical_specs': [],
            'options': options
        }

        response = run_detailmove(payload) or {}
        results = response.get('results', [])
        failures = response.get('failures', [])

        updated_count = self._count_success_without_issues(results, failures)

        issue_count = len(failures)

        self.refresh_targets()
        self.refresh_affected_status()

        if self.txt_plan_stage_status:
            if updated_count and not issue_count:
                self.txt_plan_stage_status.Text = 'Plan/extents stage complete: {} of {} views updated.'.format(
                    updated_count,
                    len(self.staged_targets)
                )
            elif updated_count:
                self.txt_plan_stage_status.Text = 'Plan/extents stage complete: {} updated, {} issue(s). See output.'.format(
                    updated_count,
                    issue_count
                )
            else:
                self.txt_plan_stage_status.Text = 'Plan/extents stage finished with no successful updates. See output.'

        self.write_run_output(
            self._format_run_output('Plan + Extents Run', options, results, failures),
            append=False
        )

    def normalize_options(self):
        side_item = self.cmb_side.SelectedItem
        side_name = 'Top'

        if side_item:
            try:
                side_name = side_item.Content
            except Exception:
                side_name = str(side_item)

        selection_only = bool(self.chk_selection_only.IsChecked)

        vertical_mode = 'Keep current vertical extents'
        if bool(self.rb_map_vertical.IsChecked):
            vertical_mode = 'Update vertical crop extents from Levels'

        options = {
            'selection_only': selection_only,
            'move_in_plan': bool(self.chk_move_plan.IsChecked),
            'flip_after': bool(self.chk_flip_after.IsChecked),
            'match_horizontal': bool(self.chk_match_horizontal.IsChecked),
            'assign_scope_box': bool(self.chk_assign_scope_box.IsChecked),
            'side_name': str(side_name),
            'vertical_mode': vertical_mode
        }

        if selection_only:
            options['move_in_plan'] = False
            options['flip_after'] = False
            options['match_horizontal'] = False
            options['assign_scope_box'] = False
            options['vertical_mode'] = 'None'

        if options['assign_scope_box']:
            options['vertical_mode'] = 'None'

        if not any([
            options['move_in_plan'],
            options['flip_after'],
            options['match_horizontal'],
            options['assign_scope_box'],
            options['vertical_mode'] == 'Update vertical crop extents from Levels',
            options['selection_only']
        ]):
            forms.alert('Choose at least one action, or tick "Selection only / no updates".')
            return None

        return options

    def refresh_targets_click(self, sender, args):
        self.all_targets = []
        self.refresh_targets()

    def select_all_click(self, sender, args):
        self.lst_targets.SelectAll()

    def select_none_click(self, sender, args):
        self.lst_targets.UnselectAll()

    def pick_scope_click(self, sender, args):
        scope_box = pick_scope_box()
        if scope_box:
            self.scope_box = scope_box
        self.refresh_summary()

    def targets_changed(self, sender, args):
        return

    def stage_toggle_changed(self, sender, args):
        self.update_vertical_enable_state()
        self.update_stage_enable_state()

    def cancel_click(self, sender, args):
        self.result = None
        self.Close()

    def run_click(self, sender, args):
            selected_targets = list(self.staged_targets)

            if not selected_targets:
                forms.alert('Add at least one detail view to affected sections.')
                return

            options = self.normalize_options()
            if not options:
                return

            plan_view = self.get_selected_plan_view()

            plan_required = any([
                options['move_in_plan'],
                options['flip_after'],
                options['match_horizontal']
            ])

            scope_required = any([
                options['move_in_plan'],
                options['match_horizontal'],
                options['assign_scope_box']
            ])

            if plan_required and not plan_view:
                forms.alert(
                    'Select a plan view for the selected plan-based stages.\n\n'
                    'The selected plan should have the required section markers and scope boxes visible.'
                )
                return

            if scope_required and not self.scope_box:
                forms.alert(
                    'Select a scope box for the selected scope-driven stages.\n\n'
                    'If no scope boxes are listed, choose a plan view where the required scope boxes are visible.'
                )
                return

            vertical_specs = []

            if options['vertical_mode'] == 'Update vertical crop extents from Levels':
                if not self.rows:
                    self.rebuild_mapping_rows()

                for row in self.rows:
                    try:
                        spec = row.get_spec()

                        if not spec['lower_level'] or not spec['upper_level']:
                            forms.alert('Vertical crop mapping is incomplete for "{}".'.format(row.view.Name))
                            return

                        vertical_specs.append(spec)

                    except Exception as ex:
                        forms.alert('Vertical crop mapping is invalid for "{}"\n\n{}'.format(row.view.Name, str(ex)))
                        return

            self.result = {
                'selected_targets': selected_targets,
                'scope_box': self.scope_box,
                'plan_view': plan_view,
                'vertical_specs': vertical_specs,
                'options': options
            }

            self.result['options']['suppress_output'] = True
            response = run_detailmove(self.result) or {}
            results = response.get('results', [])
            failures = response.get('failures', [])

            success_count = self._count_success_without_issues(results, failures)
            issue_count = len(failures)

            self.refresh_targets()
            self.refresh_affected_status()
            self.update_vertical_enable_state()
            self.update_stage_enable_state()

            if self.txt_plan_stage_status:
                if success_count and not issue_count:
                    self.txt_plan_stage_status.Text = 'Full run complete: {} of {} views updated.'.format(
                        success_count,
                        len(selected_targets)
                    )
                elif success_count:
                    self.txt_plan_stage_status.Text = 'Full run complete: {} updated, {} issue(s). See output.'.format(
                        success_count,
                        issue_count
                    )
                else:
                    self.txt_plan_stage_status.Text = 'Full run finished with no successful updates. See output.'

            if options.get('vertical_mode') == 'Update vertical crop extents from Levels':
                if self.txt_vertical_stage_status:
                    if success_count and not issue_count:
                        self.txt_vertical_stage_status.Text = 'Vertical crop update complete: {} of {} views updated.'.format(
                            success_count,
                            len(selected_targets)
                        )
                    elif success_count:
                        self.txt_vertical_stage_status.Text = 'Vertical crop update complete: {} updated, {} issue(s). See output.'.format(
                            success_count,
                            issue_count
                        )
                    else:
                        self.txt_vertical_stage_status.Text = 'Vertical crop update finished with no successful updates. See output.'

            self.write_run_output(
                self._format_run_output('Full Run', options, results, failures),
                append=False
            )
```

## FILE_START: lib/Diagnostics/diagnostics.py
## META: sha1=647e0af4e8ebfd4e36d8f53cbc701ebe5047d2bd size=3813
## TYPE: text
## IMPORTS: ["datetime","json","os"]
## FUNCTIONS: ["_now","clear","add_entry","_param_value_snapshot","run_basic_checks","write_report","summary_text"]
## CLASSES: []
```python
# diagnostics utilities for AddCoordinates
import os
import datetime
import json

REPORTS_DIR = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), 'reports')
if not os.path.exists(REPORTS_DIR):
    try:
        os.makedirs(REPORTS_DIR)
    except Exception:
        pass

_entries = []

def _now():
    return datetime.datetime.now().isoformat()

def clear():
    global _entries
    _entries = []

def add_entry(entry):
    _entries.append(entry)

def _param_value_snapshot(p):
    try:
        if p.StorageType == p.StorageType.Double:
            return float(p.AsDouble())
        if p.StorageType == p.StorageType.Integer:
            return int(p.AsInteger())
        if p.StorageType == p.StorageType.String:
            return p.AsString()
    except Exception:
        try:
            return p.AsValueString()
        except Exception:
            return None
    return None

def run_basic_checks(elements, doc, prefix=''):
    """Collect basic diagnostics for provided element list.
    `elements` should be iterable of Element objects.
    """
    try:
        for el in elements:
            try:
                el_id = el.Id.IntegerValue
            except Exception:
                try:
                    # if passed ElementId
                    el_id = int(el)
                except Exception:
                    el_id = None
            entry = {
                'timestamp': _now(),
                'prefix': prefix,
                'element_id': el_id,
                'category': None,
                'has_location_point': False,
                'params': {}
            }
            try:
                if hasattr(el, 'Category') and el.Category:
                    entry['category'] = str(el.Category.Name)
            except Exception:
                pass
            try:
                loc = getattr(el, 'Location', None)
                entry['has_location_point'] = bool(loc and hasattr(loc, 'Point'))
            except Exception:
                entry['has_location_point'] = False

            # capture RBG params
            for pname in ("RBG_Survey_SP_X", "RBG_Survey_SP_Y", "RBG_Survey_SP_Z"):
                try:
                    p = el.LookupParameter(pname)
                    if p is None:
                        entry['params'][pname] = {'exists': False}
                    else:
                        entry['params'][pname] = {
                            'exists': True,
                            'storage': int(p.StorageType),
                            'value': _param_value_snapshot(p)
                        }
                except Exception as e:
                    entry['params'][pname] = {'exists': False, 'error': str(e)}

            add_entry(entry)
    except Exception as e:
        add_entry({'timestamp': _now(), 'prefix': prefix, 'error': 'run_basic_checks failed: ' + str(e)})

def write_report(filename=None):
    if filename is None:
        filename = 'diagnostics_{0}.json'.format(datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S'))
    path = os.path.join(REPORTS_DIR, filename)
    try:
        with open(path, 'w') as f:
            json.dump({'generated': _now(), 'entries': _entries}, f, indent=2)
        return path
    except Exception:
        # try fallback to temp file in package dir
        try:
            path2 = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), 'diagnostics_fallback.json')
            with open(path2, 'w') as f:
                json.dump({'generated': _now(), 'entries': _entries}, f, indent=2)
            return path2
        except Exception:
            return None

def summary_text():
    lines = []
    for e in _entries[-200:]:
        lines.append(str(e))
    return '\n'.join(lines)

```
## FILE_END: lib/Diagnostics/diagnostics.py

## FILE_START: lib/Examples/Shift Click/config.py
## META: sha1=6f88c7a71a2546c06eb9448deaf41127ba8978bb size=980
## TYPE: text
## IMPORTS: ["Autodesk.Revit.DB","pyrevit"]
## FUNCTIONS: []
## CLASSES: []
```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
__title__ = "Grids: Set 3D (Fast)"

from Autodesk.Revit.DB import *
from pyrevit import script

doc = __revit__.ActiveUIDocument.Document
view = doc.ActiveView

# ---- Safety guard ----
if not view or not view.CanBePrinted:
    script.exit()

# ---- Collect visible grids ----
grids = list(
    FilteredElementCollector(doc, view.Id)
    .OfClass(Grid)
    .WhereElementIsNotElementType()
)

if not grids:
    script.exit()

# ---- Run in a batch transaction group to minimize regeneration ----
tg = TransactionGroup(doc, __title__)
tg.Start()

t = Transaction(doc, "Apply 3D Extents")
t.Start()

target = DatumExtentType.Model

for g in grids:
    try:
        # Apply directly (fastest: no checking)
        g.SetDatumExtentType(DatumEnds.End0, view, target)
        g.SetDatumExtentType(DatumEnds.End1, view, target)
    except:
        # Skip problematic grids silently
        pass

t.Commit()
tg.Assimilate()
```

```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
__title__ = "Grids: Set 2D Extents"

from Autodesk.Revit.DB import *
from pyrevit import script

doc = __revit__.ActiveUIDocument.Document
view = doc.ActiveView

# ---- Safety guard: require a printable view ----
if not view or not view.CanBePrinted:
    script.exit()

# ---- Collect only grids visible in the active view ----
grids = list(
    FilteredElementCollector(doc, view.Id)
    .OfClass(Grid)
    .WhereElementIsNotElementType()
)

if not grids:
    script.exit()

# ---- Batch transaction group to minimize regeneration ----
tg = TransactionGroup(doc, __title__)
tg.Start()

t = Transaction(doc, "Apply 2D Extents")
t.Start()

target = DatumExtentType.ViewSpecific

# Fast path: apply directly without pre-checks (supported & safe)
for g in grids:
    try:
        g.SetDatumExtentType(DatumEnds.End0, view, target)
        g.SetDatumExtentType(DatumEnds.End1, view, target)
    except:
        # Skip any problematic/hidden grids silently
        pass

t.Commit()
tg.Assimilate()
```

```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
__title__ = "In‑Place Hunter"
__doc__ = """Version = 1.2
Date = 31.01.2026
--------------------------------------------
Find all model-in-place FamilyInstances.
Group by Category (ignore Family name differences).
Render a styled accordion (CSS/JS injected into output head).
"""

from Autodesk.Revit.DB import FilteredElementCollector, FamilyInstance
from pyrevit import script

doc     = __revit__.ActiveUIDocument.Document
output  = script.get_output()

NO_CATEGORY        = "<No Category>"
GROUP_LINK_CHUNK   = 180
START_EXPANDED     = True

# Inject CSS + JS into output head (supported by pyRevit output API)
output.add_style("""
.acc      { border:1px solid #444; border-radius:6px; margin:8px 0; background:#161616; }
.acc .hdr { cursor:pointer; padding:8px 12px; font-weight:600; color:#fff; display:flex; align-items:center; }
.acc .hdr .arrow { width:0; height:0; border-left:6px solid #bbb; border-top:6px solid transparent; border-bottom:6px solid transparent; margin-right:8px; transform:rotate(90deg); transition:transform .12s ease-out; }
.acc .hdr .meta  { margin-left:auto; color:#bbb; font-weight:400; }
.acc .body { display:none; padding:8px 12px 10px; color:#ddd; }
.acc.open .body { display:block; }
.acc.open .hdr .arrow { transform:rotate(0deg); }
.acc hr.sep { border:none; border-top:1px solid #333; margin:8px 0 12px; }
.acc ul { margin:6px 0 10px 18px; }
.acc li { margin:2px 0; }
""")

output.inject_script("""
document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
  var t = e.target;
  while (t && !t.classList.contains('hdr')) { t = t.parentNode; }
  if (t && t.classList.contains('hdr')) {
    t.parentNode.classList.toggle('open');
  }
});
""")

# 1) Collect
collector = FilteredElementCollector(doc).OfClass(FamilyInstance)
inplace = []
for fi in collector:
    sym = fi.Symbol
    if sym and sym.Family and sym.Family.IsInPlace:
        inplace.append(fi)

if not inplace:
    output.print_html("<h3>No model-in-place family instances found.</h3>")
else:
    output.print_html("<h3>Model-In-Place Family Instances Found:</h3><hr/>")

# 2) Group by Category
by_cat = {}
for fi in inplace:
    cat_name = fi.Category.Name if fi.Category else NO_CATEGORY
    by_cat.setdefault(cat_name, []).append(fi)

def _chunk_group_ids(ids, base_label):
    if len(ids) <= GROUP_LINK_CHUNK:
        return [(base_label, ids)]
    parts = []
    total = (len(ids) + GROUP_LINK_CHUNK - 1) // GROUP_LINK_CHUNK
    for i in range(0, len(ids), GROUP_LINK_CHUNK):
        sub = ids[i:i + GROUP_LINK_CHUNK]
        label = "{} (part {} of {})".format(base_label, (i // GROUP_LINK_CHUNK) + 1, total)
        parts.append((label, sub))
    return parts

# 3) Print accordion blocks
for cat in sorted(by_cat.keys()):
    instances = by_cat[cat]
    all_ids = [fi.Id for fi in instances]
    parts = _chunk_group_ids(all_ids, "All {}".format(cat))

    if len(parts) == 1:
        all_link_html = output.linkify(parts[0][1], parts[0][0])
    else:
        all_link_html = ")  (".join(output.linkify(sub_ids, label) for (label, sub_ids) in parts)

    open_cls = " open" if START_EXPANDED else ""
    html = []
    html.append(u"<div class='acc{}'>".format(open_cls))
    html.append(u"  <div class='hdr'><div class='arrow'></div>"
                u"Category: <b>{}</b>&nbsp;&nbsp;|&nbsp;&nbsp;{}"
                u"<span class='meta'>&nbsp;&nbsp;Count: {}</span></div>"
                .format(cat, all_link_html, len(instances)))
    html.append(u"  <div class='body'>")
    html.append(u"    <ul>")
    for idx, fi in enumerate(instances, 1): 
        html.append(u"      <li>Element {}: {}</li>"
                    .format(idx, output.linkify(fi.Id, "ID {}".format(fi.Id.IntegerValue))))
    html.append(u"    </ul>")
    html.append(u"    <hr class='sep'/>")
    html.append(u"  </div>")
    html.append(u"</div>")

    output.print_html(u"".join(html))

```

## FILE_START: lib/Examples/WPF Formatting/script.py
## META: sha1=b5e39da3e1f8fd9979fbaba1db5fc94ea985d2ce size=24599
## TYPE: text
## IMPORTS: ["Autodesk.Revit.DB","System.Windows","System.Windows.Controls","System.Windows.Documents","System.Windows.Media","clr","os","pyrevit","pyrevit.forms"]
## FUNCTIONS: ["_coerce_selected_views","is_template","build_base_segments","contains_forbidden","collect_existing_viewnames","format_number","clamp","split_segments_at","drop_chars_from_segments","__init__","prefix","find","replace","suffix","numbering_enabled","insert_mode","num_start","num_incr","num_pad","num_sep","sep_before","sep_after","insert_index","replace_len","is_multi","_cancel","_compose_segments_with_number","_emit_runs","_build_preview_row","_refresh","_on_mode_change","_confirm","apply_all"]
## CLASSES: ["LivePreviewWindow"]
```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
__title__ = "View Renamer"
__doc__ = """Version = 1.8
Date = 09.02.2026
____________________________________________________________
Description:
Select views, live preview naming (green-highlighted changes),
validate forbidden symbols, confirm in WPF, then rename.
Adds incremental numbering with Insert Modes (Insert / Replace length),
separator placement (Before / After / Both), and a robust preview
pipeline that avoids duplicated text.

NEW (v1.8):
- High-contrast "Enable" pill for numbering (white text).
- Edit Mode toggle: All (auto rules) / Multi (per-row manual edits).
- Select column with checkboxes.
- In All mode: non-editable preview (as before), applies to all.
- In Multi mode: New Name becomes editable TextBoxes; only checked rows commit.
____________________________________________________________
Author: Harley / M365 Copilot
"""

from Autodesk.Revit.DB import Transaction, View, FilteredElementCollector
import clr, os

# .NET / WPF
clr.AddReference('System')
clr.AddReference('PresentationFramework')
clr.AddReference('PresentationCore')
clr.AddReference('WindowsBase')

from System.Windows import Thickness, Visibility, GridLength, VerticalAlignment
from System.Windows.Media import Brushes
from System.Windows.Documents import Run

# pyRevit
from pyrevit.forms import select_views, WPFWindow
from pyrevit import UI

# -----------------------------------------------------------
# Context
# -----------------------------------------------------------
uidoc = __revit__.ActiveUIDocument
doc = uidoc.Document

# -----------------------------------------------------------
# Selection
# -----------------------------------------------------------
def _coerce_selected_views():
    try:
        chosen = select_views()
        if chosen and len(chosen) > 0:
            return list(chosen)
    except:
        pass
    sel_ids = uidoc.Selection.GetElementIds()
    if sel_ids and sel_ids.Count:
        selected = [doc.GetElement(eid) for eid in sel_ids]
        only_views = [v for v in selected if isinstance(v, View)]
        if only_views:
            return only_views
    UI.TaskDialog.Show("View Renamer", "No views selected. Please select views and try again.")
    return []

views = _coerce_selected_views()
if not views:
    raise SystemExit

# -----------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# -----------------------------------------------------------
FORBIDDEN_SYMBOLS = r""":\{}[]/;<>?`~"""  # use raw < and >
def is_template(view):
    try: return bool(view.IsTemplate)
    except: return False

def build_base_segments(old_name, prefix, find, replace, suffix):
    """
    Return (segs, base_str) where segs is a list of (text, is_green) covering
    prefix + find/replace + suffix. No numbering here.
    """
    segs = []
    if prefix:
        segs.append((prefix, True))  # prefix in green
    if find:
        parts = old_name.split(find)
        for i, part in enumerate(parts):
            if part:
                segs.append((part, False))  # unchanged body
            if i < len(parts) - 1:
                if replace:
                    segs.append((replace, True))  # replacement highlighted
    else:
        if old_name:
            segs.append((old_name, False))
    if suffix:
        segs.append((suffix, True))
    base_str = u"".join(t for (t, _) in segs)
    return segs, base_str

def contains_forbidden(name):
    fset = set(FORBIDDEN_SYMBOLS)
    return any((ch in fset) for ch in name)

def collect_existing_viewnames():
    all_views = (FilteredElementCollector(doc)
                 .OfClass(View)
                 .WhereElementIsNotElementType()
                 .ToElements())
    return set(v.Name for v in all_views)

# [Numbering] ------------------------------------------------
def format_number(seq, pad):
    try:
        p = max(int(pad), 0)
    except:
        p = 0
    return u"{:0{w}d}".format(int(seq), w=p)

def clamp(n, lo, hi):
    return max(lo, min(hi, n))

def split_segments_at(segs, idx_chars):
    """
    Split a list of (text,is_green) into left and right at character index.
    Returns (left, right) without duplicating characters.
    """
    left, right = [], []
    remaining = idx_chars
    for text, green in segs:
        if remaining <= 0:
            right.append((text, green))
            continue
        if len(text) <= remaining:
            left.append((text, green))
            remaining -= len(text)
        else:
            # split this segment
            left.append((text[:remaining], green))
            right.append((text[remaining:], green))
            remaining = 0
    return left, right

def drop_chars_from_segments(segs, count):
    """
    Consume 'count' characters from the *start* of 'segs' and return remainder.
    """
    remaining = count
    out = []
    for text, green in segs:
        if remaining <= 0:
            out.append((text, green))
            continue
        if len(text) <= remaining:
            remaining -= len(text)
            continue  # drop whole segment
        else:
            out.append((text[remaining:], green))
            remaining = 0
    return out

# -----------------------------------------------------------
# WPF — Live preview window (extended with All/Multi)
# -----------------------------------------------------------
class LivePreviewWindow(WPFWindow):
    def __init__(self, xaml_path, views):
        WPFWindow.__init__(self, xaml_path)
        self.Views = [v for v in views]

        # NEW: rows storage & mode
        self._rows = []          # list of dicts per row: {'view','grid','chk','oldtb','newtb','editbox'}
        self._built_rows = False

        # Text inputs
        self.PrefixBox.TextChanged   += self._refresh
        self.FindBox.TextChanged     += self._refresh
        self.ReplaceBox.TextChanged  += self._refresh
        self.SuffixBox.TextChanged   += self._refresh

        # Numbering controls
        self.EnableNumbering.Checked     += self._refresh
        self.EnableNumbering.Unchecked   += self._refresh
        self.InsertModeBox.SelectionChanged += self._refresh
        self.NumStartBox.TextChanged     += self._refresh
        self.NumIncrBox.TextChanged      += self._refresh
        self.NumPadBox.TextChanged       += self._refresh
        self.NumSepBox.TextChanged       += self._refresh
        self.SepBefore.Checked           += self._refresh
        self.SepBefore.Unchecked         += self._refresh
        self.SepAfter.Checked            += self._refresh
        self.SepAfter.Unchecked          += self._refresh
        self.NumberInsertSlider.ValueChanged += self._refresh
        self.ReplaceLenBox.TextChanged   += self._refresh

        # NEW: Edit mode toggle
        self.ModeAll.Checked   += self._on_mode_change
        self.ModeMulti.Checked += self._on_mode_change

        # Buttons
        self.ConfirmBtn.Click += self._confirm
        self.CancelBtn.Click  += self._cancel

        self.Result = None
        self._refresh()

    # Accessors
    @property
    def prefix(self): return self.PrefixBox.Text or u""
    @property
    def find(self): return self.FindBox.Text or u""
    @property
    def replace(self): return self.ReplaceBox.Text or u""
    @property
    def suffix(self): return self.SuffixBox.Text or u""
    @property
    def numbering_enabled(self): return bool(self.EnableNumbering.IsChecked)

    # [Mode]
    @property
    def insert_mode(self):
        # 0 = Insert, 1 = Replace length
        try:
            return int(self.InsertModeBox.SelectedIndex)
        except:
            return 0
    @property
    def num_start(self):
        try: return int(self.NumStartBox.Text or "1")
        except: return 1
    @property
    def num_incr(self):
        try: return int(self.NumIncrBox.Text or "1")
        except: return 1
    @property
    def num_pad(self):
        try: return int(self.NumPadBox.Text or "0")
        except: return 0
    @property
    def num_sep(self): return self.NumSepBox.Text or u""
    @property
    def sep_before(self): return bool(self.SepBefore.IsChecked)
    @property
    def sep_after(self): return bool(self.SepAfter.IsChecked)
    @property
    def insert_index(self):
        try: return int(self.NumberInsertSlider.Value)
        except: return 0
    @property
    def replace_len(self):
        try:
            n = int(self.ReplaceLenBox.Text or "0")
            return max(0, n)
        except:
            return 0

    # NEW: helper
    def is_multi(self):
        try:
            return bool(self.ModeMulti.IsChecked)
        except:
            return False

    def _cancel(self, sender=None, e=None):
        self.Result = None
        self.Close()

    # --- Composition & Preview (no duplication) ---
    def _compose_segments_with_number(self, base_segs, base_str, seq_value):
        """
        Return (final_segs, final_text)
        Insert or replace at 'insert_index', using sep placement and formatted number.
        """
        # Slider can be up to length of base_str
        at = clamp(self.insert_index, 0, len(base_str))
        # Build number token with sep placement
        numtxt = format_number(seq_value, self.num_pad)
        insert_token = u""
        if self.sep_before: insert_token += (self.num_sep or u"")
        insert_token += numtxt
        if self.sep_after: insert_token += (self.num_sep or u"")
        # Split at index
        left, right = split_segments_at(base_segs, at)
        # Replace mode: drop N chars from right before inserting
        if self.insert_mode == 1 and self.replace_len > 0:
            right = drop_chars_from_segments(right, self.replace_len)
        # Stitch: left + [insert] + right
        final_segs = []
        if left: final_segs.extend(left)
        if insert_token:
            final_segs.append((insert_token, True))  # number+seps highlighted
        if right: final_segs.extend(right)
        final_text = u"".join(t for (t, _) in final_segs)
        return final_segs, final_text

    def _emit_runs(self, textblock, segs, old_name, final_text):
        """Write WPF runs with coloring; dim if absolutely no change."""
        textblock.Inlines.Clear()
        # Any change?
        changed = (final_text != old_name)
        for text, is_green in segs:
            run = Run(text)
            if is_green:
                run.Foreground = Brushes.LightGreen
            else:
                # If nothing changed overall, dim unchanged preview a touch
                if not changed:
                    run.Foreground = Brushes.Gainsboro
            textblock.Inlines.Add(run)
        # Forbidden -> paint entire line red
        if contains_forbidden(final_text):
            for inline in list(textblock.Inlines):
                inline.Foreground = Brushes.IndianRed

    def _build_preview_row(self, view, newname_segs, newname_text, oldname_text):
        from System.Windows.Controls import Grid, ColumnDefinition, TextBlock, CheckBox, TextBox
        g = Grid(); g.Margin = Thickness(0, 1, 0, 1)

        # Columns: Select(80), ID(120), Old(360), New(360)
        for w in (80, 120, 360, 360):
            cd = ColumnDefinition(); cd.Width = GridLength(w)
            g.ColumnDefinitions.Add(cd)

        # Select checkbox
        chk = CheckBox()
        chk.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment.Center
        # In All mode, we'll force-checked & disabled in the first refresh
        Grid.SetColumn(chk, 0); g.Children.Add(chk)

        # Element ID
        idtb = TextBlock(); idtb.Text = "ID {}".format(view.Id.Value); idtb.Margin = Thickness(0,0,6,0)
        Grid.SetColumn(idtb, 1); g.Children.Add(idtb)

        # Old name
        oldtb = TextBlock(); oldtb.Text = oldname_text; oldtb.Margin = Thickness(0,0,6,0)
        Grid.SetColumn(oldtb, 2); g.Children.Add(oldtb)

        # New name - two controls:
        # 1) TextBlock (green-highlight preview) for ALL mode
        newtb = TextBlock(); newtb.Margin = Thickness(0,0,0,0)
        self._emit_runs(newtb, newname_segs, oldname_text, newname_text)
        Grid.SetColumn(newtb, 3); g.Children.Add(newtb)

        # 2) TextBox for MULTI mode (editable)
        editbox = TextBox()
        editbox.Text = newname_text
        editbox.Margin = Thickness(0,0,0,0)
        editbox.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed  # shown only in Multi
        # Re-validate as the user edits
        editbox.TextChanged += self._refresh
        Grid.SetColumn(editbox, 3); g.Children.Add(editbox)

        # Keep references so _refresh/_confirm can read & toggle them
        self._rows.append(dict(view=view, grid=g, chk=chk, oldtb=oldtb, newtb=newtb, editbox=editbox))
        return g

    def _refresh(self, sender=None, e=None):
        from System.Windows.Controls import TextBlock
        # Enable/disable numbering controls coherently
        num_enabled = self.numbering_enabled
        for ctrl in (self.InsertModeBox, self.NumStartBox, self.NumIncrBox,
                     self.NumPadBox, self.NumSepBox, self.SepBefore, self.SepAfter,
                     self.NumberInsertSlider, self.ReplaceLenBox):
            ctrl.IsEnabled = num_enabled

        # Prepare base names to compute slider max (length BEFORE numbering)
        base_lengths, base_pack = [], []  # (view, segs, base_str)
        for v in self.Views:
            if is_template(v):
                base_pack.append((v, None, None))
                base_lengths.append(0)
            else:
                segs, base_str = build_base_segments(v.Name, self.prefix, self.find, self.replace, self.suffix)
                base_pack.append((v, segs, base_str))
                base_lengths.append(len(base_str))
        max_len = max(base_lengths) if base_lengths else 0
        self.NumberInsertSlider.Maximum = max_len
        if int(self.NumberInsertSlider.Value) > max_len:
            self.NumberInsertSlider.Value = max_len

        # Label
        if self.insert_mode == 0:
            self.InsertIndexLabel.Text = u"at {}".format(int(self.NumberInsertSlider.Value))
        else:
            self.InsertIndexLabel.Text = u"at {} (replace {})".format(int(self.NumberInsertSlider.Value), self.replace_len)

        # Build rows once to preserve user edits in Multi
        if not self._built_rows:
            self.PreviewList.Children.Clear()
            self._rows[:] = []
            seq_val = self.num_start
            incr = self.num_incr
            for v, segs, base_str in base_pack:
                if is_template(v):
                    t = TextBlock()
                    t.Text = "ID {}  {}  (template)".format(v.Id.Value, v.Name)
                    t.Foreground = Brushes.DarkGray
                    self.PreviewList.Children.Add(t)
                    continue
                final_segs, final_text = (segs, base_str)
                if num_enabled:
                    final_segs, final_text = self._compose_segments_with_number(segs, base_str, seq_val)
                    seq_val += incr
                row = self._build_preview_row(v, final_segs, final_text, v.Name)
                self.PreviewList.Children.Add(row)
            self._built_rows = True

        # Update rows (don’t rebuild; respect any user edits)
        any_forbidden = False
        composition_mismatch = False
        seq_val = self.num_start
        incr = self.num_incr
        multi = self.is_multi()

        for row in self._rows:
            v = row['view']
            # Mode toggles: Select + Editors
            row['chk'].IsEnabled = multi and (not is_template(v))
            if not multi:
                row['chk'].IsChecked = True  # All mode implicitly selects all
            row['editbox'].Visibility = Visibility.Visible if multi else Visibility.Collapsed
            row['newtb'].Visibility   = Visibility.Collapsed if multi else Visibility.Visible

            if is_template(v):
                # Nothing else to do for template rows
                continue

            # Recompute proposed name from current inputs
            segs, base_str = build_base_segments(v.Name, self.prefix, self.find, self.replace, self.suffix)
            final_segs, final_text = (segs, base_str)
            if num_enabled:
                final_segs, final_text = self._compose_segments_with_number(segs, base_str, seq_val)
            # In All mode we step the sequence; in Multi we still show a default suggestion,
            # but we do not override user edits in the TextBox.
            if num_enabled:
                seq_val += incr

            # Update preview TextBlock (All mode)
            if not multi:
                self._emit_runs(row['newtb'], final_segs, v.Name, final_text)

            # Set default text for the edit box only if it's empty and we are in Multi
            if multi and (not row['editbox'].Text):
                row['editbox'].Text = final_text

            # Validation (forbidden chars) — All validates computed; Multi validates edited text
            candidate = final_text if not multi else (row['editbox'].Text or "")
            if contains_forbidden(candidate):
                any_forbidden = True

            # Composition sanity (as before) in All mode
            if not multi:
                if u"".join(t for (t, _) in final_segs) != final_text:
                    composition_mismatch = True

        # Validation banner & confirm enablement
        if any_forbidden:
            self.ValidationBanner.Text = u"Forbidden symbol(s) detected in proposed names. Forbidden set: " + FORBIDDEN_SYMBOLS
            self.ValidationBanner.Visibility = Visibility.Visible
            self.ConfirmBtn.IsEnabled = False
        elif composition_mismatch:
            self.ValidationBanner.Text = u"Internal preview validation failed (composition mismatch). Please adjust inputs."
            self.ValidationBanner.Visibility = Visibility.Visible
            self.ConfirmBtn.IsEnabled = False
        else:
            self.ValidationBanner.Text = ""
            self.ValidationBanner.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed
            self.ConfirmBtn.IsEnabled = True

    def _on_mode_change(self, sender=None, e=None):
        # Just re-run refresh to toggle visibility/enabled states
        self._refresh()

    def _confirm(self, sender=None, e=None):
        if self.ValidationBanner.Visibility == Visibility.Visible:
            UI.TaskDialog.Show("View Renamer", "Resolve validation issues before confirming.")
            return

        if self.is_multi():
            # Gather overrides only for ticked rows
            overrides = {}
            for row in self._rows:
                v = row['view']
                if is_template(v):
                    continue
                if bool(row['chk'].IsChecked):
                    newname = (row['editbox'].Text or u"").strip()
                    if not newname:
                        continue
                    overrides[int(v.Id.Value)] = newname
            if not overrides:
                UI.TaskDialog.Show("View Renamer", "No rows selected in Multi mode.")
                return
            # Minimal client-side validation
            if any(contains_forbidden(nm) for nm in overrides.values()):
                UI.TaskDialog.Show("View Renamer", "One or more edited names contain forbidden characters.")
                return
            # Return only what we need for multi-rename
            self.Result = dict(
                edit_mode="multi",
                overrides=overrides
            )
            self.Close()
            return

        # All mode — original auto-rename payload
        self.Result = dict(
            edit_mode="all",
            prefix=self.prefix, find=self.find, replace=self.replace, suffix=self.suffix,
            numbering=self.numbering_enabled, mode=self.insert_mode,
            start=self.num_start, incr=self.num_incr, pad=self.num_pad,
            sep=self.num_sep, sep_before=self.sep_before, sep_after=self.sep_after,
            at=self.insert_index, repl_len=self.replace_len
        )
        self.Close()

# --- Resolve XAML path and show dialog ---
SCRIPT_DIR = os.path.dirname(__file__)
XAML_PATH  = os.path.join(SCRIPT_DIR, 'LivePreview.xaml')
if not os.path.exists(XAML_PATH):
    UI.TaskDialog.Show("View Renamer", "Missing LivePreview.xaml next to the script.\nCreate the file and try again.")
    raise SystemExit

win = LivePreviewWindow(XAML_PATH, views)
win.ShowDialog()
if not win.Result:
    raise SystemExit

# Results from dialog
EDIT_MODE = win.Result.get('edit_mode', 'all')

if EDIT_MODE == 'all':
    PREFIX      = win.Result['prefix']
    FIND        = win.Result['find']
    REPLACE     = win.Result['replace']
    SUFFIX      = win.Result['suffix']
    NUM_ENABLED = bool(win.Result['numbering'])
    MODE        = int(win.Result['mode'])  # 0 insert, 1 replace length
    NUM_START   = int(win.Result['start'])
    NUM_INCR    = int(win.Result['incr'])
    NUM_PAD     = int(win.Result['pad'])
    NUM_SEP     = win.Result['sep'] or u""
    SEP_BEFORE  = bool(win.Result['sep_before'])
    SEP_AFTER   = bool(win.Result['sep_after'])
    NUM_AT      = int(win.Result['at'])
    REPL_LEN    = int(win.Result['repl_len'])

existing_names = collect_existing_viewnames()
renamed = skipped_nochange = skipped_template = skipped_forbidden = skipped_conflict = failed = 0

def apply_all(old_name, seq):
    # Build base segments/text
    segs, base_str = build_base_segments(old_name, PREFIX, FIND, REPLACE, SUFFIX)
    if not NUM_ENABLED:
        return base_str
    # Build number token with sep placement
    numtxt = format_number(seq, NUM_PAD)
    token = u""
    if SEP_BEFORE: token += (NUM_SEP or u"")
    token += numtxt
    if SEP_AFTER: token += (NUM_SEP or u"")
    # Position (clamped)
    at = clamp(NUM_AT, 0, len(base_str))
    left, right = split_segments_at(segs, at)
    if MODE == 1 and REPL_LEN > 0:
        right = drop_chars_from_segments(right, REPL_LEN)
    final_text = u"".join(t for t,_ in left) + token + u"".join(t for t,_ in right)
    return final_text

t = Transaction(doc, "Rename Views")
t.Start()
try:
    if EDIT_MODE == 'multi':
        overrides = win.Result['overrides']
        # Apply only to selected rows
        for v in views:
            try:
                if is_template(v):
                    skipped_template += 1
                    continue
                vid = int(v.Id.Value)
                if vid not in overrides:
                    continue
                new_name = overrides[vid]
                old_name = v.Name
                if new_name == old_name:
                    skipped_nochange += 1
                    continue
                if contains_forbidden(new_name):
                    skipped_forbidden += 1
                    continue
                if new_name in existing_names:
                    skipped_conflict += 1
                    continue
                v.Name = new_name
                existing_names.add(new_name)
                renamed += 1
            except:
                failed += 1
    else:
        # All mode — original auto-rename flow
        seq = NUM_START
        for v in views:
            try:
                if is_template(v):
                    skipped_template += 1
                    continue
                old_name = v.Name
                new_name = apply_all(old_name, seq)
                if NUM_ENABLED:
                    seq += NUM_INCR
                if new_name == old_name:
                    skipped_nochange += 1
                    continue
                if contains_forbidden(new_name):
                    skipped_forbidden += 1
                    continue
                if new_name in existing_names:
                    skipped_conflict += 1
                    continue
                v.Name = new_name
                existing_names.add(new_name)
                renamed += 1
            except:
                failed += 1
finally:
    t.Commit()
```

```python
# ╦╔╦╗╔═╗╔═╗╦═╗╔╦╗╔═╗

import os, sys
from pyrevit import forms
from Autodesk.Revit.DB import ( Transaction,
                                View,
                                ViewPlan,
                                ViewSection,
                                View3D,
                                ViewSchedule,
                                ViewDrafting)
from Autodesk.Revit.Exceptions import ArgumentException

#CUSTOM
from GUI.forms import my_WPF

# .NET IMPORTS
from clr import AddReference
AddReference("System")
from System.Diagnostics.Process import Start
from System.Windows.Window import DragMove
from System.Windows.Input import MouseButtonState
import wpf



# ╦  ╦╔═╗╦═╗╦╔═╗╔╗ ╦  ╔═╗╔═╗
# ╚╗╔╝╠═╣╠╦╝║╠═╣╠╩╗║  ║╣ ╚═╗
#  ╚╝ ╩ ╩╩╚═╩╩ ╩╚═╝╩═╝╚═╝╚═╝ VARIABLES

PATH_SCRIPT = os.path.dirname(__file__)

# ╔╦╗╔═╗╦╔╗╔
# ║║║╠═╣║║║║
# ╩ ╩╩ ╩╩╝╚╝MAIN
#====================================================================================================
class FindReplace(my_WPF):
    """GUI for [Views: Find and Replace]"""
    run = False

    def __init__(self, title, label = "Find and Replace", button_name = "Rename"):
        self.add_wpf_resource()

        path_xaml_file = os.path.join(PATH_SCRIPT, 'FindReplace.xaml')
        wpf.LoadComponent(self, path_xaml_file)
        self.apply_style_contract()
        # self.form = forms.WPFWindow.__init__(self, path_xaml_file)

        self.UI_label.Content       = label
        self.UI_main_button.Content = button_name
        self.main_title.Text        = title
        self.ShowDialog()


    def find_replace(self, name):
        #type:(str) -> str
        """Function to create new name with FindReplace logic.
        :param name: String of ucrrent name
        :return: Updated name
        """
        return self.prefix + str(name).replace(self.find, self.replace) + self.suffix


    @property
    def find(self):
        return self.input_find.Text

    @property
    def replace(self):
        return self.input_replace.Text

    @property
    def prefix(self):
        return self.input_prefix.Text

    @property
    def suffix(self):
        return self.input_suffix.Text



    # GUI EVENT HANDLERS:
    def button_close(self,sender,e):
        """Stop application by clicking on a <Close> button in the top right corner."""
        self.Close()
        sys.exit()

    def Hyperlink_RequestNavigate(self, sender, e):
        """Forwarding for a Hyperlink"""
        Start(e.Uri.AbsoluteUri)

    def header_drag(self,sender,e):
        """Drag window by holding LeftButton on the header."""
        if e.LeftButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed:
            DragMove(self)

    def button_run(self, sender, e):
        """Button action: Rename view with given """
        # view_rename(selected_views,self.find,self.replace, self.prefix, self.suffix)
        self.Close()
```
