```python
#====================================================================================================
PATH_SCRIPT = os.path.dirname(__file__)

uidoc   = __revit__.ActiveUIDocument
app     = __revit__.Application
doc     = __revit__.ActiveUIDocument.Document

active_view_id      = doc.ActiveView.Id
active_view         = doc.GetElement(active_view_id)
active_view_level   = active_view.GenLevel

class ListItem:
    """Helper Class for displaying selected sheets in my custom GUI."""
    def __init__(self,  Name='Unnamed', element = None, checked = False):
        self.Name       = Name
        self.IsChecked  = checked
        self.element    = element

# ╔═╗╦  ╔═╗╔═╗╔═╗╔═╗╔═╗
# ║  ║  ╠═╣╚═╗╚═╗║╣ ╚═╗
# ╚═╝╩═╝╩ ╩╚═╝╚═╝╚═╝╚═╝ CLASSES
#====================================================================================================
class CreateFromRooms(my_WPF):
    selected_type = []
    offset         = 0

    def __init__(self, items, title       = '__title',
                              label       = "Select Type:" ,
                              button_name = 'Create',
                              version     = 'version= 1.0'):
        """Function to show GUI to a user to Select Type and offset for creating elements from Rooms
            :param items:           Dictionary of items {e.Name:e}
            :param title:           Title of the window.
            :param label:           Label that is displayed above ListBox
            :param button_name:     Text in Button
            :param version:         Version of the script for footer."""
        self.items       = items        #type: dict
        self.title       = title        #type: str
        self.label       = label        #type: str
        self.button_name = button_name  #type: str
        self.version     = version      #type: str

        #>>>>>>>>>> SET RESOURCES AND LOAD WPF
        super(CreateFromRooms, self).add_wpf_resource()
        path_xaml_file = os.path.join(PATH_SCRIPT, 'CreateFromRooms.xaml')
        wpf.LoadComponent(self, path_xaml_file )

        self.update_UI()
        self.ShowDialog()

    def update_UI(self):
        """Function to make updates to UI based on provided arguments."""
        # UPDATE GUI ELEMENTS
        self.main_title.Text          = self.title
        self.text_label.Content       = self.label
        self.button_main.Content      = self.button_name
        self.footer_version.Text      = self.version

        self.items                    = self.generate_list_items()
        self.main_ListBox.ItemsSource = self.items


    def generate_list_items(self):
        """Function to create a ICollection to pass to ListBox in GUI"""

        list_of_items = List[type(ListItem())]()
        first = True
        for type_name, typ in sorted(self.items.items()):
            checked = True if first else False
            first   = False
            list_of_items.Add(ListItem(type_name, typ, checked))
        return list_of_items


    # ╔═╗╦ ╦╦  ╔═╗╦  ╦╔═╗╔╗╔╔╦╗╔═╗
    # ║ ╦║ ║║  ║╣ ╚╗╔╝║╣ ║║║ ║ ╚═╗
    # ╚═╝╚═╝╩  ╚═╝ ╚╝ ╚═╝╝╚╝ ╩ ╚═╝ GUI EVENTS
    #==================================================
    def text_filter_updated(self, sender, e):
        """Function to filter items in the main_ListBox."""
        filtered_list_of_items = List[type(ListItem())]()
        filter_keyword = self.textbox_filter.Text

        #RESTORE ORIGINAL LIST
        if not filter_keyword:
            self.main_ListBox.ItemsSource = self.items
            return

        # FILTER ITEMS
        for item in self.items:
            if filter_keyword.lower() in item.Name.lower():
                filtered_list_of_items.Add(item)

        # UPDATE LIST OF ITEMS
        self.main_ListBox.ItemsSource = filtered_list_of_items


    def UIe_ItemChecked(self, sender, e):
        """Single Selection in ListBox"""
        filtered_list_of_items = List[type(ListItem())]()
        for item in self.main_ListBox.Items:
            item.IsChecked = True if item.Name == sender.Content.Text else False
            filtered_list_of_items.Add(item)
        self.main_ListBox.ItemsSource = filtered_list_of_items

    def NumberValidationTextBox(self, sender, e):
        """Ensure that only Numbers and decimals can be inserted"""
        import re
        regex = re.compile('[^0-9.]+')
        e.Handled = regex.match(e.Text)


    # ╔╗ ╦ ╦╔╦╗╔╦╗╔═╗╔╗╔╔═╗
    # ╠╩╗║ ║ ║  ║ ║ ║║║║╚═╗
    # ╚═╝╚═╝ ╩  ╩ ╚═╝╝╚╝╚═╝ BUTTONS
    #==================================================
    def button_close(self, sender, e):
        """Stop application by clicking on a <Close> button in the top right corner."""
        self.Close()
        sys.exit()

    def button_run(self, sender, e):
        """Button to finilize selection"""
        self.textbox_filter.Text = ''
        self.Close()

        try:
            selected_items = [item.element for item in self.main_ListBox.ItemsSource if item.IsChecked]
            self.offset    = convert_internal_units(float(self.UI_offset.Text),
                                                        get_internal=True,
                                                        units = 'cm')

            # if not selected_items:
            #     forms.alert('Type was not selected. Please Try Again', title='Create from Rooms',exitscript=True)

            self.selected_type = selected_items[0]

        except:
            # print(traceback.format_exc())

            self.offset = 0

```

## FILE_START: lib/GUI/Tools/CreateFromRooms.xaml
## META: sha1=a1363cdcd3b1863f40f800e3220c18dca2ef77f1 size=37806
## TYPE: text
```
<Window
    xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
    xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
    xmlns:d="http://schemas.microsoft.com/expression/blend/2008"
    xmlns:mc="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006"
    mc:Ignorable="d"
    Title="Create From Rooms"
    Height="460" Width="400"
    MinWidth="400"
    MinHeight="460" MaxHeight="550"
    WindowStartupLocation="CenterScreen"
    HorizontalAlignment="Center"
    ShowInTaskbar="True"
    WindowStyle="None"
    AllowsTransparency="True"
    Background="#080326">

    <Window.Resources>
        <ResourceDictionary xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
                    xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
                    xmlns:local="clr-namespace:Common.WPF_styles">

            <!-->>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>[COLOURS]-->
            <SolidColorBrush x:Key="header_background"  Color="#0f0f2d" />

            <SolidColorBrush x:Key="text_white"         Color="#E5E4E2" />
            <SolidColorBrush x:Key="text_gray"          Color="Gray" />
            <SolidColorBrush x:Key="text_magenta"       Color="#EE82EE" />

            <SolidColorBrush x:Key="button_fg_normal"   Color="White" />
            <SolidColorBrush x:Key="button_bg_normal"   Color="#39385D" />
            <SolidColorBrush x:Key="button_bg_hover"    Color="#FF4C70" />

            <SolidColorBrush x:Key="border_magenta"     Color="#EE82EE" />
            <SolidColorBrush x:Key="border_blue"     Color="DodgerBlue" />

            <SolidColorBrush x:Key="uncheckbox_checked_colour"     Color="Gray" />
            <SolidColorBrush x:Key="checkbox_checked_colour"     Color="#EE82EE" />

            <SolidColorBrush x:Key="footer_donate"     Color="#FF4C70" />






            <!-->>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>[STYLE] - REPEAT BUTTON? -->

            <Style x:Key="RepeatButtonTransparent" TargetType="{x:Type RepeatButton}">
                <Setter Property="OverridesDefaultStyle" Value="true"/>
                <Setter Property="Background" Value="#505050"/>
                <Setter Property="Focusable" Value="false"/>
                <Setter Property="IsTabStop" Value="false"/>
                <Setter Property="Template">
                    <Setter.Value>
                        <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type RepeatButton}">
                            <Border Background="{TemplateBinding Background}" Height="{TemplateBinding Height}" Width="{TemplateBinding Width}" CornerRadius="10"/>
                        </ControlTemplate>
                    </Setter.Value>
                </Setter>
            </Style>


            <!-->>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>[STYLE] - THUMB -->

            <Style x:Key="ScrollBarThumbVertical" TargetType="{x:Type Thumb}">
                <Setter Property="OverridesDefaultStyle" Value="true"/>
                <!--<Setter Property="Margin" Value="3"/>-->

                <Setter Property="IsTabStop" Value="false"/>
                <Setter Property="Template">
                    <Setter.Value>
                        <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type Thumb}">
                            <Border x:Name="rectangle" Background="Black" Height="{TemplateBinding Height}" SnapsToDevicePixels="True" Width="{TemplateBinding Width}" CornerRadius="8"/>
                            <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                                <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="true">
                                    <Setter Property="Background" TargetName="rectangle" Value="Black"/>
                                </Trigger>
                                <Trigger Property="IsDragging" Value="true">
                                    <Setter Property="Background" TargetName="rectangle" Value="Black"/>
                                </Trigger>
                            </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                        </ControlTemplate>
                    </Setter.Value>
                </Setter>
            </Style>

            <!-->>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>[STYLE] - BUTTON -->
            <Style TargetType="Button">
                <!--[BUTTON] STYLES-->
                <Setter Property="TextElement.FontFamily"   Value="Arial"/>
                <Setter Property="Background"               Value="{StaticResource button_bg_normal}"/>
                <Setter Property="Foreground"               Value="{StaticResource button_fg_normal}"/>
                <Setter Property="Cursor"                   Value="Hand"/>

                <!--[BUTTON] TEMPLATE-->
                <Setter Property="Template">
                    <Setter.Value>
                        <ControlTemplate TargetType="Button">
                            <Border CornerRadius="8"
                            Background="{TemplateBinding Background}">

                                <ContentPresenter  VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                           HorizontalAlignment="Center"/>
                            </Border>
                        </ControlTemplate>
                    </Setter.Value>
                </Setter>

                <!--[BUTTON] TRIGGERS-->
                <Style.Triggers>
                    <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                        <Setter Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource button_bg_hover}"/>
                    </Trigger>
                </Style.Triggers>
            </Style>



            <!-->>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>[STYLE] - TextBlock -->
            <Style TargetType="TextBlock">
                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource text_white}"/>
            </Style>
            <!-->>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>[STYLE] - TextBox -->

            <Style TargetType="TextBox">
                <Setter Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource header_background}"/>
                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource text_magenta}"/>
                <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{StaticResource border_blue}"/>
                <Setter Property="VerticalContentAlignment" Value="Center"/>

                <Style.Resources>
                    <Style TargetType="Border">
                        <Setter Property="CornerRadius" Value="5"/>
                    </Style>
                </Style.Resources>
            </Style>

            <!--
                            <Border  BorderBrush="{DynamicResource border_magenta}"
                         BorderThickness="1"
                         CornerRadius="10" >
            -->

            <!-->>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>[STYLE] - Border -->

            <Style TargetType="Border">
                <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
                <Setter Property="CornerRadius" Value="10"/>
            </Style>

            <!-->>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>[STYLE] - LABEL -->
            <!-->>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>[STYLE] - LABEL -->
            <Style TargetType="Label">
                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource text_magenta}"/>
            </Style>

            <!-->>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>[STYLE] - CheckBox -->

            <Style TargetType="CheckBox">
                <Setter Property="SnapsToDevicePixels" Value="true"/>
                <Setter Property="OverridesDefaultStyle" Value="true"/>
                <Setter Property="FocusVisualStyle" Value="{x:Null}"/>
                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="White"/>
                <Setter Property="Template">
                    <Setter.Value>
                        <ControlTemplate TargetType="CheckBox">
                            <BulletDecorator Background="Transparent">
                                <BulletDecorator.Bullet>
                                    <Border x:Name="Border" Width="15" Height="15" CornerRadius="2" BorderThickness="0">
                                        <Border.Background>
                                            <LinearGradientBrush StartPoint="0,1" EndPoint="1,0">
                                                <GradientStop Color= "#88FC467B" Offset="1" />
                                                <GradientStop Color= "#993F5EFB" Offset="0" />
                                            </LinearGradientBrush>
                                        </Border.Background>
                                        <Path Width="9" Height="9" x:Name="CheckMark" SnapsToDevicePixels="False"
                                              Stroke="Pink" StrokeThickness="2" Data="M 0 4 L 3 8 8 0" />
                                    </Border>
                                </BulletDecorator.Bullet>
                                <ContentPresenter Margin="4,0,0,0" VerticalAlignment="Center" HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                                                  RecognizesAccessKey="True"/>
                            </BulletDecorator>
                            <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                                <Trigger Property="IsChecked" Value="false">
                                    <Setter TargetName="CheckMark" Property="Visibility" Value="Collapsed"/>
                                </Trigger>
                                <Trigger Property="IsChecked" Value="{x:Null}">
                                    <Setter TargetName="CheckMark" Property="Data" Value="M 0 8 L 8 0" />
                                </Trigger>
                                <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="true">
                                    <Setter TargetName="Border" Property="Background" Value="#FF131313" />
                                </Trigger>
                                <Trigger Property="IsEnabled" Value="false">
                                    <Setter TargetName="CheckMark" Property="Stroke" Value="#FF6C6C6C"/>
                                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="Gray"/>
                                </Trigger>
                            </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                        </ControlTemplate>
                    </Setter.Value>
                </Setter>
            </Style>

            <!-->>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>[STYLE] - DockPanel -->
            <Style TargetType="DockPanel">
                <Setter Property="Margin" Value="2"/>
            </Style>



            <!-->>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>HEADER -->
            <Style x:Key="Header" TargetType="ContentControl">
                <Setter Property="ContentTemplate">
                    <Setter.Value>
                        <DataTemplate>
                            <!--HEADER START-->
                            <Grid
                Background="{StaticResource header_background}"
                Grid.ColumnSpan="2">
                                <!--HEADER GRID-->
                                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="100"/>
                                    <ColumnDefinition/>
                                    <ColumnDefinition Width="60"/>
                                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                                <!--LOGO-->
                                <DockPanel  Grid.Column="0"
                        Grid.ColumnSpan="2"
                        VerticalAlignment="Center"
                        HorizontalAlignment="Left">
                                    <Image Width="20" Height="20"
                      />
                                    <!--Source="https://www.erikfrits.com/media/images/LOGO.png"-->

                                    <TextBlock>
                    <Hyperlink  RequestNavigate="Hyperlink_RequestNavigate"
                                NavigateUri="https://erikfrits.com/blog/"
                                FontSize="14px"
                                FontWeight="Heavy"
                                Foreground="{StaticResource text_white}">
                                EF-Tools
                    </Hyperlink>
                                    </TextBlock>
                                </DockPanel>

                                <!--__TITLE__-->
                                <TextBlock x:Name="main_title"
                                            Text="__title__"
                                            Grid.Column="1"
                                            VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                            HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                                            Foreground="{StaticResource text_white}"/>

                                <!--CLOSE-->
                                <Button Content="Close"
                                        Grid.Column="2"
                                        Width="60" Height="20"
                                        FontSize="10"
                                        Click="button_close"
                                        VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                        HorizontalAlignment="Right"/>
                            </Grid>
                            <!--HEADER END-->
                        </DataTemplate>
                    </Setter.Value>
                </Setter>
            </Style>

            <!-->>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>[ComboBox] -->
            <ControlTemplate x:Key="ComboBoxToggleButton" TargetType="{x:Type ToggleButton}">
                <Grid>
                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <ColumnDefinition />
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="20" />
                    </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                    <!-- ARROW BOX-->
                    <Border x:Name="Border"
                            Grid.ColumnSpan="2"
                            CornerRadius="2"
                            Background="{StaticResource header_background}"
                            BorderBrush="{StaticResource border_blue}"
                            BorderThickness="1" />

                    <!-- MAIN BOX-->
                    <Border
                            Grid.Column="0"
                            CornerRadius="0"
                            Margin="1"
                            Background="{StaticResource header_background}"
                            BorderBrush="{StaticResource border_blue}"
                            BorderThickness="0,0,1,0" />

                    <!-- MAIN BOX-->
                    <Path   x:Name="Arrow"
                            Grid.Column="1"
                            Fill="White"
                            HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                            VerticalAlignment="Center"
                            Data="M0,0 L0,2 L4,6 L8,2 L8,0 L4,4 z"/>

                </Grid>
            </ControlTemplate>

            <ControlTemplate x:Key="ComboBoxTextBox" TargetType="{x:Type TextBox}">
                <Border x:Name="PART_ContentHost" Focusable="False" Background="{TemplateBinding Background}" />
            </ControlTemplate>

            <Style x:Key="{x:Type ComboBox}" TargetType="{x:Type ComboBox}">
                <Setter Property="SnapsToDevicePixels" Value="true"/>
                <Setter Property="OverridesDefaultStyle" Value="true"/>
                <Setter Property="ScrollViewer.HorizontalScrollBarVisibility" Value="Auto"/>
                <Setter Property="ScrollViewer.VerticalScrollBarVisibility" Value="Auto"/>
                <Setter Property="ScrollViewer.CanContentScroll" Value="true"/>
                <Setter Property="MinWidth" Value="120"/>
                <Setter Property="MinHeight" Value="20"/>
                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="White"/>
                <Setter Property="Template">
                    <Setter.Value>
                        <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type ComboBox}">
                            <Grid>
                                <ToggleButton Name="ToggleButton"
                                                Template="{StaticResource ComboBoxToggleButton}"
                                                Grid.Column="2"
                                                Focusable="false"
                                                IsChecked="{Binding Path=IsDropDownOpen,Mode=TwoWay,RelativeSource={RelativeSource TemplatedParent}}"
                                                ClickMode="Press">
                                </ToggleButton>

                                <ContentPresenter Name="ContentSite" IsHitTestVisible="False"  Content="{TemplateBinding SelectionBoxItem}"
                                                ContentTemplate="{TemplateBinding SelectionBoxItemTemplate}"
                                                ContentTemplateSelector="{TemplateBinding ItemTemplateSelector}"
                                                Margin="3,3,23,3"
                                                VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                                HorizontalAlignment="Left" />
                                <TextBox x:Name="PART_EditableTextBox"
                                            Style="{x:Null}"
                                            Template="{StaticResource ComboBoxTextBox}"
                                            HorizontalAlignment="Left"
                                            VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                            Margin="3,3,23,3"
                                            Focusable="True"
                                            Background="#FF3F3F3F"
                                            Foreground="Green"
                                            Visibility="Hidden"
                                            IsReadOnly="{TemplateBinding IsReadOnly}"/>

                                <Popup Name="Popup"
                                        Placement="Bottom"
                                        IsOpen="{TemplateBinding IsDropDownOpen}"
                                        AllowsTransparency="True"
                                        Focusable="False"
                                        PopupAnimation="Slide">

                                    <Grid Name="DropDown"
                                          SnapsToDevicePixels="True"
                                          MinWidth="{TemplateBinding ActualWidth}"
                                          MaxHeight="{TemplateBinding MaxDropDownHeight}">

                                        <Border x:Name="DropDownBorder"
                                                Background="{StaticResource header_background}"
                                                BorderThickness="1"
                                                BorderBrush="{StaticResource border_blue}"/>

                                        <ScrollViewer Margin="4,6,4,6" SnapsToDevicePixels="True">
                                            <StackPanel IsItemsHost="True" KeyboardNavigation.DirectionalNavigation="Contained" />
                                        </ScrollViewer>
                                    </Grid>
                                </Popup>
                            </Grid>


                            <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                                <Trigger Property="HasItems" Value="false">
                                    <Setter TargetName="DropDownBorder" Property="MinHeight" Value="95"/>
                                </Trigger>

                                <Trigger Property="IsEnabled" Value="false">
                                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#888888"/>
                                </Trigger>

                                <Trigger Property="IsGrouping" Value="true">
                                    <Setter Property="ScrollViewer.CanContentScroll" Value="false"/>
                                </Trigger>

                                <Trigger SourceName="Popup" Property="Popup.AllowsTransparency" Value="true">
                                    <Setter TargetName="DropDownBorder" Property="CornerRadius" Value="0"/>
                                    <Setter TargetName="DropDownBorder" Property="Margin" Value="0,2,0,0"/>
                                </Trigger>

                                <Trigger Property="IsEditable"  Value="true">
                                    <Setter Property="IsTabStop" Value="false"/>
                                    <Setter TargetName="PART_EditableTextBox" Property="Visibility" Value="Visible"/>
                                    <Setter TargetName="ContentSite" Property="Visibility" Value="Hidden"/>
                                </Trigger>

                            </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                        </ControlTemplate>
                    </Setter.Value>
                </Setter>
                <Style.Triggers>
                </Style.Triggers>
            </Style>

            <!-- SimpleStyles: ComboBoxItem -->
            <Style x:Key="{x:Type ComboBoxItem}" TargetType="{x:Type ComboBoxItem}">
                <Setter Property="SnapsToDevicePixels" Value="true"/>
                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="White"/>
                <Setter Property="OverridesDefaultStyle" Value="true"/>
                <Setter Property="Template">
                    <Setter.Value>
                        <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type ComboBoxItem}">
                            <Border Name="Border"
                              Padding="2"
                              SnapsToDevicePixels="true">
                                <ContentPresenter />
                            </Border>
                            <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                                <Trigger Property="IsHighlighted" Value="true">
                                    <Setter TargetName="Border" Property="Background" Value="#FF4F4F4F"/>
                                </Trigger>
                                <Trigger Property="IsEnabled" Value="false">
                                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#888888"/>
                                </Trigger>
                            </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                        </ControlTemplate>
                    </Setter.Value>
                </Setter>
            </Style>
            <!-->>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>[LISTBOX] -->

            <Style TargetType="ListBox">
                <Setter Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource header_background}"/>
                <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{StaticResource border_magenta}"/>
                <Setter Property="ScrollViewer.VerticalScrollBarVisibility" Value="Visible"/>
                <Setter Property="ScrollViewer.HorizontalScrollBarVisibility" Value="Hidden"/>


                <Style.Resources>
                    <Style TargetType="Border">
                        <Setter Property="CornerRadius" Value="10"/>
                    </Style>
                </Style.Resources>
            </Style>

            <!-->>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>[SCROLLBAR] -->

            <Style TargetType="ScrollBar">
                <Setter Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource border_magenta}"/>
                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource border_magenta}"/>
                <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{StaticResource header_background}"/>
                <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.9"/>
                <Setter Property="Margin" Value="3"/>

                <Setter Property="Template">
                    <Setter.Value>
                        <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type ScrollBar}">
                            <Grid x:Name="Bg"
                                              SnapsToDevicePixels="true">
                                <Border BorderBrush     = "{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}"
                                                    BorderThickness = "{TemplateBinding BorderThickness}"
                                                    Background      = "{TemplateBinding Background}"

                                                    Grid.Row        = "1"
                                                    CornerRadius="10"/>

                                <Track x:Name="PART_Track"
                                                   IsDirectionReversed="true"
                                                   IsEnabled="{TemplateBinding IsMouseOver}"
                                                   Grid.Row="1">
                                    <Track.Thumb>
                                        <Thumb Style="{StaticResource ScrollBarThumbVertical}"
                                                           Margin="2"/>
                                    </Track.Thumb>
                                </Track>

                            </Grid>

                        </ControlTemplate>
                    </Setter.Value>
                </Setter>
            </Style>



            <!-->>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>[EXTRA] -->

            <!-->>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>[EXTRA] -->
        </ResourceDictionary>

    </Window.Resources>



    <!--MAIN-->
    <Grid>
        <Grid.Background>
            <LinearGradientBrush StartPoint="0,1" EndPoint="1,0">
                <GradientStop Color= "#33FC467B" Offset="0" />
                <GradientStop Color="#333F5EFB" Offset="1" />
            </LinearGradientBrush>
        </Grid.Background>


        <Grid.RowDefinitions>

            <RowDefinition Height="25"/>
            <RowDefinition Height="45"/>
            <RowDefinition/>
            <RowDefinition Height="25"/>
        </Grid.RowDefinitions>
        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
            <ColumnDefinition></ColumnDefinition>
        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

        <!--HEADER START-->
        <Grid   MouseDown="header_drag"
                Background="{StaticResource header_background}"
                Grid.ColumnSpan="2">
            <!--HEADER GRID-->
            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="75"/>
                <ColumnDefinition/>
                <ColumnDefinition Width="60"/>
            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

            <!--LOGO-->
            <DockPanel  Grid.Column="0"
                        Grid.ColumnSpan="2"
                        VerticalAlignment="Center"
                        HorizontalAlignment="Left">


                <TextBlock Margin="5,0,0,0">
                    <Hyperlink
                        RequestNavigate="Hyperlink_RequestNavigate"
                        NavigateUri="https://www.linkedin.com/company/80151029"
                        FontSize="14px"
                        FontWeight="Heavy"
                        Foreground="{StaticResource text_white}">
                        EF-Tools
                    </Hyperlink>
                </TextBlock>
            </DockPanel>

            <!--__TITLE__-->
            <TextBlock x:Name="main_title"
                Text="__title__"
                Grid.Column="1"
                VerticalAlignment="Center"
                HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                Foreground="{StaticResource text_white}"
                />

            <!--CLOSE-->
            <Button
                Content="Close"
                Grid.Column="2"
                Width="60" Height="20"
                FontSize="10"
                Click="button_close"
                VerticalAlignment="Center"
                HorizontalAlignment="Right"
                    />
        </Grid>
        <!--HEADER END-->



        <!--FILTER START-->
        <DockPanel Grid.Row="1">
            <Label  Content="🔍"
                    VerticalAlignment="Top" Height="26"
                    Foreground="{StaticResource text_magenta}"
                    Margin="5,5,5,5"/>

            <TextBox x:Name="textbox_filter"
                    Text=""
                     Height="22" VerticalAlignment="Top"
                     Foreground="{StaticResource text_magenta}" Background="{StaticResource header_background}"
                     Margin="0,8,10,5" FontSize="14"
                     BorderBrush="{StaticResource border_magenta}"
                     TextChanged="text_filter_updated">

                <TextBox.Style>
                    <Style TargetType="TextBox">
                        <Style.Resources>
                            <Style TargetType="Border">
                                <Setter Property="CornerRadius" Value="5"/>
                            </Style>
                        </Style.Resources>
                    </Style>
                </TextBox.Style>
            </TextBox>
        </DockPanel>
        <!--FILTER END-->

        <!--LISTBOX START-->
        <StackPanel Grid.Row="2"
                    VerticalAlignment="Top"
                    Margin="10,0,10,0">


            <Label x:Name="text_label"  Content="Select Type:"
                           Foreground="{StaticResource text_magenta}"/>

            <ListBox x:Name="main_ListBox"
                         Height="150" Grid.Row="0"
                         Background="{StaticResource header_background}"
                         SelectionMode="Single"
                         ScrollViewer.VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Visible"
                         ScrollViewer.HorizontalScrollBarVisibility="Disabled"
                         BorderBrush="{StaticResource border_magenta}"
                         >

                <ListBox.Resources>
                    <Style TargetType="ScrollBar">
                        <Setter Property="Background" Value="{StaticResource border_magenta}"/>
                        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="{StaticResource border_magenta}"/>
                        <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="{StaticResource header_background}"/>
                        <Setter Property="Opacity" Value="0.9"/>
                        <Setter Property="Margin" Value="3"/>

                        <Setter Property="Template">
                            <Setter.Value>
                                <ControlTemplate TargetType="{x:Type ScrollBar}">
                                    <Grid x:Name="Bg"
                                              SnapsToDevicePixels="true">
                                        <Border BorderBrush     = "{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}"
                                                    BorderThickness = "{TemplateBinding BorderThickness}"
                                                    Background      = "{TemplateBinding Background}"

                                                    Grid.Row        = "1"
                                                    CornerRadius="10"/>

                                        <Track x:Name="PART_Track"
                                                   IsDirectionReversed="true"
                                                   IsEnabled="{TemplateBinding IsMouseOver}"
                                                   Grid.Row="1">
                                            <Track.Thumb>
                                                <Thumb Style="{StaticResource ScrollBarThumbVertical}"
                                                           Margin="2"/>
                                            </Track.Thumb>
                                        </Track>

                                    </Grid>

                                </ControlTemplate>
                            </Setter.Value>
                        </Setter>
                    </Style>
                    <Style TargetType="ListBox">
                        <Style.Resources>
                            <Style TargetType="Border">
                                <Setter Property="CornerRadius" Value="10"/>
                            </Style>
                        </Style.Resources>
                    </Style>
                </ListBox.Resources>

                <ListBox.ItemTemplate>
                    <DataTemplate>
                        <CheckBox  Background="#EE82EE" Foreground="{StaticResource text_white}" IsChecked="{Binding IsChecked}"  Checked="UIe_ItemChecked" >
                            <TextBlock Text="{Binding Name}"/>
                        </CheckBox>
                    </DataTemplate>
                </ListBox.ItemTemplate>


            </ListBox>





            <Separator Margin="5,20,5,5" Background="{StaticResource border_magenta}"/>

            <!--REGION SETTINGS-->
            <StackPanel Margin="5,20,5,5" x:Name="UI_stack_region_settings" >
                <Label Content="Additional Settings:" Margin="0, -25,0,0 "/>
                <Border  BorderBrush="{DynamicResource border_magenta}" Padding="0,5,0,10">
                    <StackPanel Margin="5,10,5,5" >

                        <!--REGION WIDTH-->
                        <DockPanel>
                            <TextBlock  Text="Offset from level (cm):"    Width="130"/>
                            <TextBox    Text="0" Width="200" x:Name="UI_offset" PreviewTextInput="NumberValidationTextBox"/>
                        </DockPanel>


                    </StackPanel>
                </Border>
            </StackPanel>

            <!--BUTTON_2-->
            <Button x:Name="button_main"
                Content="Create"
                        Click="button_run"
                        Height="30"
                        Width="210"
                        Margin="5"
                        />


        </StackPanel>
        <!--LISTBOX END-->

        <!--FOOTER START-->
        <Grid Grid.Row="3" Background="{StaticResource header_background}">
            <!--FOOTER GRID-->
            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <ColumnDefinition/>
                <ColumnDefinition/>
                <ColumnDefinition/>
            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

            <!--IMAGE-->
            <TextBlock>
                <Hyperlink  NavigateUri="https://www.learnrevitapi.com" RequestNavigate="Hyperlink_RequestNavigate">
                               <Image  Height="20"   Margin="1"  HorizontalAlignment="Left"   VerticalAlignment="Top"
```

```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# ui_acc.py — Reusable HTML/CSS accordion helpers for pyRevit output
# IronPython 2.7 compatible

# --- Robust HTML encoding setup ----------------------------------------------
def _to_unicode(s):
    try:
        return u"" if s is None else unicode(s)
    except NameError:
        return u"" if s is None else str(s)

_html_encode_impl = None
try:
    import clr
    try:
        clr.AddReference('System.Web')
    except:
        pass
    from System.Web import HttpUtility
    def _html_encode_impl(text):
        return HttpUtility.HtmlEncode(_to_unicode(text))
except:
    try:
        from System.Net import WebUtility
        def _html_encode_impl(text):
            return WebUtility.HtmlEncode(_to_unicode(text))
    except:
        def _html_encode_impl(text):
            t = _to_unicode(text)
            t = t.replace(u"&", u"&amp;")
            t = t.replace(u"<", u"&lt;")
            t = t.replace(u">", u"&gt;")
            t = t.replace(u"\"", u"&quot;")
            t = t.replace(u"'", u"&#39;")
            return t

def html_encode(s):
    """Encode text for HTML. Prefers .NET implementations; falls back to manual."""
    return _html_encode_impl(s)

# --- Hardcoded one-off labels -------------------------------------------------
NO_CATEGORY_LABEL = u"<No Category>"

# --- CSS only (no JS needed) --------------------------------------------------
DEFAULT_CSS = u"""
.acc      { border:1px solid #d8dde3; border-radius:8px; margin:8px 0; background:#ffffff; }
.acc .hdr { cursor:pointer; padding:8px 12px; font-weight:600; color:#1a1a1a; display:flex; align-items:center; user-select:none; background:#f9fafb; }
.acc .hdr .arrow { width:0; height:0; border-left:6px solid #5e6a75; border-top:6px solid transparent; border-bottom:6px solid transparent; margin-right:8px; transform:rotate(90deg); transition:transform .12s ease-out; }
.acc .hdr .meta  { margin-left:auto; color:#5e6a75; font-weight:400; }
.acc .body { display:none; padding:8px 12px 10px; color:#1a1a1a; }
.acc.open .body { display:block; }
.acc.open .hdr .arrow { transform:rotate(0deg); }
.acc hr.sep { border:none; border-top:1px solid #d8dde3; margin:8px 0 12px; }
.acc ul { margin:6px 0 10px 18px; }
.acc li { margin:2px 0; }
"""

def add_assets(output, css=None, js=None):
    """
    Inject CSS into pyRevit output. (JS intentionally omitted for maximum compatibility.)
    Passing 'js' is ignored by design in this JS-less version.
    """
    output.add_style(css or DEFAULT_CSS)
    # Intentionally do not inject JS. We’ll use inline onclick handlers per header.

# --- Minimal tag builder ------------------------------------------------------
def tag(name, content=None, **attrs):
    """
    Minimal HTML tag builder.
    - Use 'cls' or 'class_' for class attribute.
    - Underscores in attribute names become hyphens (e.g., data_id -> data-id).
    - 'content' is inserted as-is (assume you pass already-HTML-safe).
    """
    norm_attrs = {}
    for k, v in attrs.items():
        key = 'class' if k in ('cls', 'class_') else k
        key = key.replace('_', '-')
        norm_attrs[key] = v
    attr_str = u" ".join(u'{0}="{1}"'.format(k, html_encode(v)) for k, v in norm_attrs.items())
    if content is None:
        return u"<{0}{1}/>".format(name, (u" " + attr_str) if attr_str else u"")
    return u"<{0}{2}>{1}</{0}>".format(name, content, (u" " + attr_str) if attr_str else u"")

# --- ID chunking + link builder ----------------------------------------------
def chunk_ids(ids, base_label, size):
    """
    Split large ID lists into (label, ids) parts for multiple linkify groups.
    Returns a list even for <= size (single (label, ids) pair).
    """
    n = len(ids)
    if n <= size:
        return [(base_label, ids)]
    parts, total = [], (n + size - 1) // size
    for i in range(0, n, size):
        parts.append((
            u"{} (part {} of {})".format(base_label, (i // size) + 1, total),
            ids[i:i+size]
        ))
    return parts

def build_all_links(output, ids, base_label, chunk_size):
    """
    Build a single HTML string containing one or more 'All ...' links,
    split by chunk_size if needed.
    """
    parts = chunk_ids(ids, base_label, chunk_size)
    return u" | ".join(output.linkify(id_list, label) for (label, id_list) in parts)

# --- Inline onclick toggle (no classList / no delegation) ---------------------
# This is injected directly into the header element. It toggles 'open' by
# editing className string only—compatible with old IE engines.
_ONCLICK_TOGGLE = (
    u"var p=this.parentNode||this.parentElement;"
    u"if(!p)return;"
    u"var c=p.className||'';"
    u"var s=' '+c+' ';"
    u"var t=' open ';"
    u"if(s.indexOf(t)>-1){p.className=(s.replace(t,' ')).replace(/^\\s+|\\s+$/g,'');}"
    u"else{p.className=(c?c+' open':'open');}"
)

# --- Accordion renderer -------------------------------------------------------
def render_category_block(output, category_text, instances,
                          chunk_size=180, start_open=True, show_index=True):
    """
    Render an accordion block for a category.
    - category_text is plain text (will be encoded).
    - instances is a list of FamilyInstance.
    - Uses output.linkify for element id and group links.
    - If only one instance, still renders <ul>, but numbering can be hidden via show_index.
    """
    all_ids   = [inst.Id for inst in instances]
    all_links = build_all_links(output, all_ids, u"All {}".format(category_text), chunk_size)

    # Per-instance list items
    items = []
    for idx, inst in enumerate(instances, 1):
        link = output.linkify(inst.Id, u"ID {}".format(inst.Id.IntegerValue))
        label = u"Element {}: {}".format(idx, link) if show_index else u"{}".format(link)
        items.append(tag(u"li", label))

    # Header with inline onclick handler (no external JS)
    header = tag(
        u"div",
        tag(u"div", u"", cls=u"arrow") +
        u"Category: <b>{}</b>&nbsp;&nbsp;|&nbsp;&nbsp;{}".format(
            html_encode(category_text), all_links
        ) +
        tag(u"span", u"&nbsp;&nbsp;Count: {}".format(len(instances)), cls=u"meta"),
        cls=u"hdr",
        onclick=_ONCLICK_TOGGLE
    )

    body = tag(u"div",
               tag(u"ul", u"\n      ".join(items)) + tag(u"hr", cls=u"sep"),
               cls=u"body")

    outer_cls = u"acc open" if start_open else u"acc"
    return tag(u"div", header + body, cls=outer_cls)
```

```python
__author__ = "Erik Frits"

# ╦╔╦╗╔═╗╔═╗╦═╗╔╦╗╔═╗

import os, sys
from pyrevit import revit, forms

import os, clr
clr.AddReference("System")

from System.Diagnostics.Process import Start
from System.Windows.Window import DragMove
from System.Windows.Input import MouseButtonState
import wpf
from System.Windows import Application, Window, ResourceDictionary
from System import Uri

try:
    from GUI.style_guide_2026 import (
        apply_window_contract,
        apply_topmost_and_parent,
        apply_style_guide_resources,
    )
except Exception:
    apply_window_contract = None
    apply_topmost_and_parent = None
    apply_style_guide_resources = None

# ╦ ╦╔═╗╔═╗  ╔╦╗╔═╗╔╦╗╔═╗╦  ╔═╗╔╦╗╔═╗
# ║║║╠═╝╠╣    ║ ║╣ ║║║╠═╝║  ╠═╣ ║ ║╣
# ╚╩╝╩  ╚     ╩ ╚═╝╩ ╩╩  ╩═╝╩ ╩ ╩ ╚═╝ WPF TEMPLATE
# ==================================================
class my_WPF(Window):

    # ╔╦╗╔═╗╔╦╗╦ ╦╔═╗╔╦╗╔═╗
    # ║║║║╣  ║ ╠═╣║ ║ ║║╚═╗
    # ╩ ╩╚═╝ ╩ ╩ ╩╚═╝═╩╝╚═╝ METHODS
    #==================================================
    def add_wpf_resource(self):
        """Function to add WPF resources."""
        dir_path = os.path.dirname(__file__)
        style_paths = [
            os.path.join(dir_path, 'Resources', 'RBG_StyleGuide_2026.xaml'),
            os.path.join(dir_path, 'Resources', 'WPF_styles.xaml')
        ]

        merged_resources = ResourceDictionary()
        for style_path in style_paths:
            if not os.path.isfile(style_path):
                continue
            style_dictionary = ResourceDictionary()
            style_dictionary.Source = Uri(style_path)
            merged_resources.MergedDictionaries.Add(style_dictionary)

        self.Resources = merged_resources

        if apply_style_guide_resources:
            apply_style_guide_resources(self)

        if apply_window_contract:
            apply_window_contract(self)

    def apply_style_contract(self):
        """Apply shell defaults and Revit-parenting behavior."""
        if apply_window_contract:
            apply_window_contract(self)
        if apply_topmost_and_parent:
            apply_topmost_and_parent(self)

    # ╔═╗╦ ╦╦  ╔═╗╦  ╦╔═╗╔╗╔╔╦╗╔═╗
    # ║ ╦║ ║║  ║╣ ╚╗╔╝║╣ ║║║ ║ ╚═╗
    # ╚═╝╚═╝╩  ╚═╝ ╚╝ ╚═╝╝╚╝ ╩ ╚═╝ GUI EVENTS
    #==================================================
    def button_close(self, sender, e):
        """Stop application by clicking on a <Close> button in the top right corner."""
        self.Close()

    def header_drag(self, sender, e):
        """Drag window by holding LeftButton on the header."""
        if e.LeftButton == MouseButtonState.Pressed:
            DragMove(self)

    def Hyperlink_RequestNavigate(self, sender, e):
        """Forwarding for a Hyperlinks."""
        Start(e.Uri.AbsoluteUri)
```

```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
__title__ = "ToolSearchCommon"
__doc__ = """Shared utilities for Ribbon enumeration, config, and suggestion store.
Version = 1.0
Date = 16.02.2026
"""

import os
import sys
import json
import time
from datetime import datetime

import clr
# Revit Ribbon (Autodesk.Windows)
clr.AddReference('AdWindows')
from Autodesk.Windows import ComponentManager

from pyrevit import script, forms

# ---------------------------
# Config Helpers (pyRevit)
# ---------------------------
def get_cfg():
    cfg = script.get_config()
    if not hasattr(cfg, 'include_non_pyrevit'):
        cfg.include_non_pyrevit = False
    if not hasattr(cfg, 'tab_filter'):   # comma-separated allowlist
        cfg.tab_filter = 'pyRevit'       # default focus on pyRevit tab(s)
    if not hasattr(cfg, 'cache_enabled'):
        cfg.cache_enabled = True
    if not hasattr(cfg, 'cache_path'):
        cfg.cache_path = _default_cache_path()
    if not hasattr(cfg, 'suggestions_store'):
        cfg.suggestions_store = ''  # if empty, falls back to user appdata
    if not hasattr(cfg, 'allow_vote_close'):
        cfg.allow_vote_close = False  # allow resolving/closing suggestion from UI
    return cfg

def save_cfg(cfg):
    script.save_config()

def _ensure_dir(p):
    d = os.path.dirname(p)
    if d and not os.path.isdir(d):
        os.makedirs(d)

def _appdata_dir():
    # e.g. %APPDATA%\pyRevit\RBG_ToolSearch
    from System import Environment
    from System.Environment import SpecialFolder
    appdata = Environment.GetFolderPath(SpecialFolder.ApplicationData)
    return os.path.join(appdata, 'pyRevit', 'RBG_ToolSearch')

def _default_cache_path():
    return os.path.join(_appdata_dir(), 'tool_index_cache.json')

def _default_suggestions_path():
    return os.path.join(_appdata_dir(), 'tool_suggestions.json')

# ---------------------------
# Suggestion Store
# ---------------------------
class SuggestionStore(object):
    def __init__(self, cfg):
        self.cfg = cfg
        self.path = cfg.suggestions_store.strip() or _default_suggestions_path()
        _ensure_dir(self.path)
        self._lock_path = self.path + '.lock'
        self.data = self._load()

    def _now_iso(self):
        return datetime.utcnow().strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')

    def _load(self):
        if not os.path.isfile(self.path):
            return {'version': 1, 'updated': self._now_iso(), 'items': []}
        try:
            with open(self.path, 'r') as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            # Corrupt? Backup
            backup = self.path + '.bak_' + str(int(time.time()))
            try:
                os.rename(self.path, backup)
            except Exception:
                pass
            return {'version': 1, 'updated': self._now_iso(), 'items': []}

    def _acquire_lock(self, tries=30, delay=0.1):
        for _ in range(tries):
            try:
                fd = os.open(self._lock_path, os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_RDWR)
                os.close(fd)
                return True
            except Exception:
                time.sleep(delay)
        return False

    def _release_lock(self):
        try:
            if os.path.exists(self._lock_path):
                os.remove(self._lock_path)
        except Exception:
            pass

    def save(self):
        if not self._acquire_lock():
            pass
        try:
            self.data['updated'] = self._now_iso()
            tmp = self.path + '.tmp'
            with open(tmp, 'w') as f:
                json.dump(self.data, f, indent=2)
            if os.path.exists(self.path):
                os.remove(self.path)
            os.rename(tmp, self.path)
        finally:
            self._release_lock()

    def _user_id(self):
        try:
            from System import Environment
            user = Environment.UserName
            domain = Environment.UserDomainName
            return u'{}\\{}'.format(domain, user)
        except Exception:
            return u'unknown\\user'

    def _new_id(self):
        from System import Guid
        return Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N")

    def list_items(self):
        return list(self.data.get('items', []))

    def add_item(self, title, desc, tags):
        item = {
            'id': self._new_id(),
            'title': title.strip(),
            'desc': desc.strip() if desc else '',
            'tags': [t.strip() for t in (tags or []) if t and t.strip()],
            'author': self._user_id(),
            'status': 'open',
            'votes': 1,
            'voters': [self._user_id()],
            'created': self._now_iso(),
            'last_vote': self._now_iso()
        }
        self.data['items'].append(item)
        self.save()
        return item

    def vote(self, item_id, withdraw=False):
        uid = self._user_id()
        for it in self.data.get('items', []):
            if it.get('id') == item_id:
                voters = it.get('voters', [])
                if withdraw:
                    if uid in voters:
                        voters.remove(uid)
                        it['votes'] = max(0, int(it.get('votes', 0)) - 1)
                        it['voters'] = voters
                        it['last_vote'] = self._now_iso()
                        self.save()
                        return True, it
                    return False, it
                else:
                    if uid not in voters:
                        voters.append(uid)
                        it['votes'] = int(it.get('votes', 0)) + 1
                        it['voters'] = voters
                        it['last_vote'] = self._now_iso()
                        self.save()
                        return True, it
                    return False, it
        return False, None

    def set_status(self, item_id, status):
        for it in self.data.get('items', []):
            if it.get('id') == item_id:
                it['status'] = status
                self.save()
                return True, it
        return False, None

# ---------------------------
# Ribbon Enumeration
# ---------------------------
def _safe_str(val):
    if val is None:
        return u''
    try:
        return unicode(val)
    except:
        try:
            return val.ToString()
        except:
            return u''

def _get_tooltip_text(btn):
    try:
        tt = getattr(btn, 'ToolTip', None)
        if tt:
            title = _safe_str(getattr(tt, 'Title', u''))
            expanded = _safe_str(getattr(tt, 'ExpandedContent', u''))
            if expanded and title:
                return title + u' — ' + expanded
            return expanded or title
    except Exception:
        pass
    return u''

def _item_text(item):
    for attr in ('Text', 'Header', 'Title', 'AutomationName'):
        try:
            t = getattr(item, attr, None)
            s = _safe_str(t)
            if s:
                return s
        except Exception:
            pass
    try:
        return _safe_str(getattr(item, 'Id', ''))
    except Exception:
        return u''

def _iter_button_like(item):
    try:
        typname = item.GetType().Name
    except Exception:
        typname = ''
    if typname in ('RibbonButton', 'RibbonToggleButton'):
        yield item
        return
    for attr in ('Items', 'DropDownItems'):
        try:
            subitems = getattr(item, attr, None)
            if subitems:
                for sub in list(subitems):
                    for leaf in _iter_button_like(sub):
                        yield leaf
        except Exception:
            pass

def _panel_items(panel):
    src = getattr(panel, 'Source', None)
    if src is not None:
        items = getattr(src, 'Items', None)
        if items is not None:
            return list(items)
    items = getattr(panel, 'Items', None)
    if items is not None:
        return list(items)
    return []

def _tab_title(tab):
    for attr in ('Title', 'Header'):
        try:
            t = getattr(tab, attr, None)
            s = _safe_str(t)
            if s:
                return s
        except Exception:
            pass
    return u''

def _panel_title(panel):
    for attr in ('Source',):
        try:
            src = getattr(panel, attr, None)
            if src:
                for a in ('Title', 'Header', 'Text'):
                    s = _safe_str(getattr(src, a, u''))
                    if s:
                        return s
        except Exception:
            pass
    for a in ('Title', 'Header', 'Text'):
        try:
            s = _safe_str(getattr(panel, a, u''))
            if s:
                return s
        except Exception:
            pass
    return u''

def _tab_allowed(tabname, cfg):
    tabname_l = (tabname or u'').strip()
    if not tabname_l:
        return False
    allow = [t.strip() for t in _safe_str(cfg.tab_filter).split(',') if t.strip()]
    if not allow:
        if cfg.include_non_pyrevit:
            return True
        return tabname_l.lower().startswith('pyrevit')
    if cfg.include_non_pyrevit:
        return True if tabname_l else False

# ---------------------------
# Cache + Enumeration + UI helpers
# ---------------------------
def read_cache(cfg):
    try:
        if not getattr(cfg, 'cache_enabled', True):
            return None
        path = getattr(cfg, 'cache_path', _default_cache_path())
        if not path or not os.path.isfile(path):
            return None
        with open(path, 'r') as f:
            return json.load(f)
    except Exception:
        return None

def write_cache(cfg, tools):
    try:
        path = getattr(cfg, 'cache_path', _default_cache_path())
        _ensure_dir(path)
        data = {'version': 1, 'updated': datetime.utcnow().strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'), 'tools': tools}
        tmp = path + '.tmp'
        with open(tmp, 'w') as f:
            json.dump(data, f, indent=2)
        if os.path.exists(path):
            os.remove(path)
        os.rename(tmp, path)
    except Exception:
        pass

def enumerate_ribbon_tools(cfg):
    out = []
    try:
        ribbon = getattr(ComponentManager, 'Ribbon', None)
        if not ribbon:
            return out
        tabs = getattr(ribbon, 'Tabs', None) or []
        for tab in list(tabs):
            tab_title = _tab_title(tab)
            if not _tab_allowed(tab_title, cfg):
                continue
            panels = getattr(tab, 'Panels', None) or []
            for pnl in list(panels):
                pnl_title = _panel_title(pnl) or u''
                items = _panel_items(pnl)
                for item in items:
                    for btn in _iter_button_like(item):
                        name = _item_text(btn) or u''
                        desc = _get_tooltip_text(btn) or u''
                        out.append({'tab': tab_title, 'panel': pnl_title, 'name': name, 'desc': desc})
    except Exception:
        pass
    return out

def inject_base_styles(output):
    try:
        css = u"""

def inject_search_script(output):
```
