# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
__title__ = "MagpieGroup Data Removal"
__doc__ = "Remove [valueUnit,] tokens from 'RBG_MagpieGroup' while keeping any other text."

import re

from Autodesk.Revit.DB import (
    FilteredElementCollector, StorageType, Transaction
)
from pyrevit import forms, script

doc = __revit__.ActiveUIDocument.Document
PARAM_NAME = "RBG_MagpieGroup"

TOKEN_PATTERN = re.compile(r"\[\s*[^,\[\]]+?\s*(MPa|kPa|N)?\s*,\s*\]")

elements = (
    FilteredElementCollector(doc)
    .WhereElementIsNotElementType()
    .ToElements()
)

if not elements:
    forms.alert("No elements found.")
    script.exit()

res = forms.alert(
    "This will remove all '[valueUnit,]' tokens (e.g. [40MPa,])\n"
    "from the '{}' parameter on all elements,\n"
    "while keeping any other text.\n\n"
    "Continue?".format(PARAM_NAME),
    yes=True, no=True
)
if not res:
    script.exit()

t = Transaction(doc, "Clean Magpie Group Data")
t.Start()
try:
    for el in elements:
        p = el.LookupParameter(PARAM_NAME)
        if not p or p.IsReadOnly or p.StorageType != StorageType.String:
            continue

        existing = p.AsString()
        if not existing:
            continue

        cleaned = TOKEN_PATTERN.sub("", existing).strip()
        if cleaned != existing:
            p.Set(cleaned)

    t.Commit()
except:
    t.RollBack()
    raise

## TYPE: text
## IMPORTS: ["Autodesk.Revit.DB","pyrevit","re","telemetry"]
## FUNCTIONS: ["get_unit_label","convert_from_internal","format_number","build_token_from_param","merge_existing_and_new","choose_source_param_name","get_source_param"]
## CLASSES: []
```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
try:
    import telemetry
    telemetry.track_tool_click(__file__)
except Exception:
    pass

__title__ = "MagpieGroup Data"
__doc__ = "Copy a chosen parameter into 'RBG_MagpieGroup' as [valueUnit,] and keep existing text."

import re

from Autodesk.Revit.DB import (
    BuiltInCategory, ElementCategoryFilter, LogicalOrFilter,
    FilteredElementCollector, StorageType, Transaction, UnitUtils,
    LabelUtils, ElementId
)
from pyrevit import forms, script

try:
    from Autodesk.Revit.DB import UnitTypeId
    USE_NEW_UNITS = True
except:
    from Autodesk.Revit.DB import DisplayUnitType
    USE_NEW_UNITS = False

doc = __revit__.ActiveUIDocument.Document

TARGET_PARAM_NAME = "RBG_MagpieGroup"
DEFAULT_SOURCE_PARAM = "RBG_ConcStrength"
DEFAULT_TEXT_UNIT = "MPa"

CATEGORIES = [
    BuiltInCategory.OST_Floors,
    BuiltInCategory.OST_StructuralFraming,
    BuiltInCategory.OST_StructuralFoundation,
    BuiltInCategory.OST_Walls,
    BuiltInCategory.OST_StructuralColumns,
]

TOKEN_PATTERN = re.compile(r"\[\s*[^,\[\]]+?\s*(MPa|kPa|N)?\s*,\s*\]")

if USE_NEW_UNITS:
    UNIT_ABBREV = {
        UnitTypeId.Megapascals: "MPa",
        UnitTypeId.Kilopascals: "kPa",
        UnitTypeId.Newtons: "N",
    }
else:
    UNIT_ABBREV = {
        DisplayUnitType.DUT_MEGAPASCALS: "MPa",
        DisplayUnitType.DUT_KILOPASCALS: "kPa",
        DisplayUnitType.DUT_NEWTONS: "N",
    }

ROUND_TO_INT_UNITS = set(["MPa", "kPa", "N"])


def get_unit_label(param):
    try:
        if USE_NEW_UNITS:
            spec = param.Definition.GetDataType()
            fmt = doc.GetUnits().GetFormatOptions(spec)
            unit_id = fmt.GetUnitTypeId()
            lbl = UNIT_ABBREV.get(unit_id, None)
            if not lbl:
                try:
                    lbl = LabelUtils.GetLabelForUnit(unit_id)
                except:
                    lbl = None
        else:
            unit_type = param.Definition.UnitType
            fmt = doc.GetUnits().GetFormatOptions(unit_type)
            dut = fmt.DisplayUnits
            lbl = UNIT_ABBREV.get(dut, None)
            if not lbl:
                try:
                    lbl = LabelUtils.GetLabelFor(dut)
                except:
                    lbl = None

        if lbl:
            text = lbl.strip()
            low = text.lower()
            if "megapascal" in low:
                return "MPa"
            if "kilopascal" in low:
                return "kPa"
            if "newton" in low:
                return "N"
            return text
    except:
        pass
    return DEFAULT_TEXT_UNIT


def convert_from_internal(value, param):
    try:
        if USE_NEW_UNITS:
            spec = param.Definition.GetDataType()
            fmt = doc.GetUnits().GetFormatOptions(spec)
            unit_id = fmt.GetUnitTypeId()
            return UnitUtils.ConvertFromInternalUnits(value, unit_id)
        else:
            unit_type = param.Definition.UnitType
            fmt = doc.GetUnits().GetFormatOptions(unit_type)
            dut = fmt.DisplayUnits
            return UnitUtils.ConvertFromInternalUnits(value, dut)
    except:
        return value


def format_number(value, unit_label=None):
    try:
        f = float(value)
    except:
        return str(value)

    if unit_label in ROUND_TO_INT_UNITS:
        return str(int(round(f)))

    if abs(f - int(round(f))) < 1e-9:
        return str(int(round(f)))

    return "{0:g}".format(f)


def build_token_from_param(param):
    stype = param.StorageType

    if stype == StorageType.Double:
        internal = param.AsDouble()
        unit_label = get_unit_label(param)
        display_value = convert_from_internal(internal, param)
        number_str = format_number(display_value, unit_label)
        return "[{0}{1},]".format(number_str, unit_label)

    elif stype == StorageType.Integer:
        val = param.AsInteger()
        unit_label = get_unit_label(param)
        number_str = format_number(val, unit_label)
        return "[{0}{1},]".format(number_str, unit_label)

    elif stype == StorageType.String:
        text_value = param.AsString()
        if not text_value:
            return None

        cleaned = (
            text_value.replace("[", "")
            .replace("]", "")
            .replace(",", "")
            .strip()
        )
        if not cleaned:
            return None

        if any(ch.isalpha() for ch in cleaned):
            value_with_unit = cleaned
        else:
            unit_label = get_unit_label(param)
            num_str = format_number(cleaned, unit_label)
            value_with_unit = "{0}{1}".format(num_str, unit_label)

        return "[{0},]".format(value_with_unit)

    return None


def merge_existing_and_new(existing_text, new_token):
    base = existing_text or ""
    base = TOKEN_PATTERN.sub("", base).strip()
    if base:
        return base + " " + new_token
    return new_token


def choose_source_param_name(default_name, sample_element):
    choice = forms.alert(
        "Use '{}' as source parameter?".format(default_name),
        options=[
            "Use '{}'".format(default_name),
            "Select From List…",
            "Cancel",
        ],
    )

    if not choice or choice == "Cancel":
        script.exit()

    if choice.startswith("Use"):
        return default_name

    names = set()

    try:
        for p in sample_element.Parameters:
            d = p.Definition
            if d:
                names.add(d.Name)
    except:
        pass

    try:
        type_id = sample_element.GetTypeId()
    except:
        type_id = ElementId.InvalidElementId

    if type_id and type_id != ElementId.InvalidElementId:
        t_elem = doc.GetElement(type_id)
        if t_elem:
            try:
                for p in t_elem.Parameters:
                    d = p.Definition
                    if d:
                        names.add(d.Name)
            except:
                pass

    name_list = sorted(names)
    if not name_list:
        forms.alert("No parameters found on the sample element.")
        script.exit()

    selected = forms.SelectFromList.show(
        name_list,
        title="Select Source Parameter",
        multiselect=False
    )
    if not selected:
        script.exit()

    try:
        # If options were strings, we get a string back
        if isinstance(selected, basestring):
            return selected
        n = getattr(selected, "name", None)
        if n:
            return n
        return str(selected)
    except:
        forms.alert("Could not read the selected parameter name.")
        script.exit()


def get_source_param(element, param_name):
    p = element.LookupParameter(param_name)
    if p:
        return p

    try:
        type_id = element.GetTypeId()
    except:
        type_id = ElementId.InvalidElementId

    if type_id and type_id != ElementId.InvalidElementId:
        t_elem = doc.GetElement(type_id)
        if t_elem:
            return t_elem.LookupParameter(param_name)

    return None


cat_filters = [ElementCategoryFilter(c) for c in CATEGORIES]
cat_filter = cat_filters[0]
for f in cat_filters[1:]:
    cat_filter = LogicalOrFilter(cat_filter, f)

elements = list(
    FilteredElementCollector(doc)
    .WherePasses(cat_filter)
    .WhereElementIsNotElementType()
)

if not elements:
    forms.alert("No elements found in the target categories.")
    script.exit()

source_param_name = choose_source_param_name(DEFAULT_SOURCE_PARAM, elements[0])

t = Transaction(doc, "Copy Magpie Group Data")
t.Start()
try:
    for element in elements:
        source_param = get_source_param(element, source_param_name)
        target_param = element.LookupParameter(TARGET_PARAM_NAME)

        if not source_param or not target_param:
            continue
        if target_param.IsReadOnly or target_param.StorageType != StorageType.String:
            continue

        new_token = build_token_from_param(source_param)
        if not new_token:
            continue

        existing_text = target_param.AsString() or ""
        final_text = merge_existing_and_new(existing_text, new_token)

        if final_text != existing_text:
            target_param.Set(final_text)

    t.Commit()
except:
    t.RollBack()
    raise
```

```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
try:
    import telemetry
    telemetry.track_tool_click(__file__)
except Exception:
    pass

from pyrevit import revit, DB, forms

doc = revit.doc


def pick_schedule():
    schedules = DB.FilteredElementCollector(doc) \
                  .OfClass(DB.ViewSchedule) \
                  .ToElements()

    # Revit 2024: IsInternalKeynoteSchedule is a property, not a method
    schedules = [vs for vs in schedules
                 if not vs.IsTemplate and not vs.IsInternalKeynoteSchedule]

    if not schedules:
        forms.alert('No schedules found in this project.', exitscript=True)

    sched = forms.SelectFromList.show(
        schedules,
        title='Select Schedule',
        name_attr='Name',
        multiselect=False
    )
    if not sched:
        forms.alert('Cancelled.', exitscript=True)

    if isinstance(sched, list):
        sched = sched[0]
    return sched


class ScheduleFieldOption(object):
    def __init__(self, index, field):
        self.index = index
        self.field = field
        self.display = self._build_display_name()

    def _build_display_name(self):
        name = self.field.GetName()
        heading = ''
        try:
            heading = self.field.ColumnHeading
        except:
            pass

        label = u'[{0}] {1}'.format(self.index + 1, name)
        if heading and heading != name:
            label += u'  |  Heading: {0}'.format(heading)
        return label

    def __str__(self):
        return self.display


class SchedulableFieldOption(object):
    def __init__(self, sched_field):
        self.sched_field = sched_field
        try:
            self.display = sched_field.GetName(doc)
        except:
            self.display = 'Field {}'.format(sched_field.GetHashCode())

        try:
            pid = sched_field.ParameterId
            if pid and pid.IntegerValue > 0:
                self.display += u'  | (ParamId: {})'.format(pid.IntegerValue)
        except:
            pass

    def __str__(self):
        return self.display


def pick_existing_field(vs):
    definition = vs.Definition
    count = definition.GetFieldCount()
    if count == 0:
        forms.alert('Selected schedule has no fields.', exitscript=True)

    options = [ScheduleFieldOption(i, definition.GetField(i))
               for i in range(count)]

    choice = forms.SelectFromList.show(
        options,
        title='Select Field (Column) to Change',
        name_attr='display',
        multiselect=False
    )
    if not choice:
        forms.alert('Cancelled.', exitscript=True)

    if isinstance(choice, list):
        choice = choice[0]

    return choice


def pick_replacement_schedulable_field(vs):
    definition = vs.Definition
    sched_fields = definition.GetSchedulableFields()
    if not sched_fields or len(sched_fields) == 0:
        forms.alert('No schedulable fields available for this schedule.', exitscript=True)

    options = [SchedulableFieldOption(sf) for sf in sched_fields]

    choice = forms.SelectFromList.show(
        options,
        title='Select Replacement Parameter',
        name_attr='display',
        multiselect=False
    )
    if not choice:
        forms.alert('Cancelled.', exitscript=True)

    if isinstance(choice, list):
        choice = choice[0]

    return choice.sched_field


def copy_basic_field_properties(src_field, dst_field):
    try:
        dst_field.ColumnHeading = src_field.ColumnHeading
    except:
        pass
    try:
        dst_field.IsHidden = src_field.IsHidden
    except:
        pass
    try:
        dst_field.GridColumnWidth = src_field.GridColumnWidth
    except:
        pass
    # Add more if needed for 2024 (alignment/format) once stable


def swap_field_parameter(vs, field_option, new_sched_field):
    definition = vs.Definition
    old_field = field_option.field
    target_index = field_option.index

    t = DB.Transaction(doc, 'Change Schedule Field Parameter')
    t.Start()
    try:
        new_field = definition.AddField(new_sched_field)

        try:
            definition.MoveField(new_field.FieldId, target_index)
        except:
            pass

        copy_basic_field_properties(old_field, new_field)

        try:
            definition.RemoveField(old_field.FieldId)
        except:
            pass

        t.Commit()
    except Exception as err:
        t.RollBack()
        forms.alert('Error changing field:\n{}'.format(err), exitscript=True)


def main():
    vs = pick_schedule()
    field_option = pick_existing_field(vs)
    new_sched_field = pick_replacement_schedulable_field(vs)

    msg = 'Schedule: {}\n\nChange column [{}] "{}"\n\nto parameter:\n"{}"\n\nProceed?'.format(
        vs.Name,
        field_option.index + 1,
        field_option.field.GetName(),
        new_sched_field.GetName(doc)
    )
    if not forms.alert(msg, yes=True, no=True, warn_icon=False):
        forms.alert('Cancelled.', exitscript=True)

    swap_field_parameter(vs, field_option, new_sched_field)
    forms.alert('Field updated successfully.')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
try:
    import telemetry
    telemetry.track_tool_click(__file__)
except Exception:
    pass

__title__ = "Param Copier"
__doc__ = "Copy parameter values from a source parameter to a target parameter across selected elements."

import clr
clr.AddReference('PresentationFramework')
clr.AddReference('PresentationCore')
clr.AddReference('WindowsBase')

from System.Collections.Generic import List
from System import String
from System.Windows import Visibility, Thickness, FontWeights
from System.Windows.Controls import (
    StackPanel, TextBlock, Expander, Orientation, Border as WpfBorder
)
from System.Windows.Media import Brushes, SolidColorBrush
from System.Windows.Media import Color as WpfColor

from Autodesk.Revit.DB import (
    ElementId, StorageType, Transaction, UnitUtils, LabelUtils
)
from Autodesk.Revit.UI.Selection import ObjectType
from pyrevit import forms, script

try:
    from GUI.style_guide_2026 import (
        apply_window_contract,
        apply_topmost_and_parent,
        apply_style_guide_resources,
    )
except Exception:
    def apply_window_contract(window):
        return
    def apply_topmost_and_parent(window):
        return
    def apply_style_guide_resources(window):
        return

try:
    from Autodesk.Revit.DB import UnitTypeId
    USE_NEW_UNITS = True
except Exception:
    USE_NEW_UNITS = False

uidoc = __revit__.ActiveUIDocument
doc = uidoc.Document

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Engine
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def _lookup_param(element, name):
    """Look up a parameter by name on instance, then fall back to type."""
    p = element.LookupParameter(name)
    if p:
        return p
    try:
        tid = element.GetTypeId()
        if tid and tid != ElementId.InvalidElementId:
            t = doc.GetElement(tid)
            if t:
                return t.LookupParameter(name)
    except Exception:
        pass
    return None


class ParamListItem(object):
    """Display item for parameter ListBoxes. Stores name with Shared/Project and Instance/Type tags."""

    def __init__(self, name, kind=u"?", binding=u"?"):
        self.Name = name
        self.Kind    = kind     # "S" = Shared, "P" = Project/Built-in, "?" = unknown
        self.Binding = binding  # "I" = Instance, "T" = Type, "?" = unknown

    def __str__(self):
        parts = []
        if self.Kind    in (u"S", u"P"):
            parts.append(self.Kind)
        if self.Binding in (u"I", u"T"):
            parts.append(self.Binding)
        tag = u"[{0}]".format(u"\u00b7".join(parts)) if parts else u""
        return u"{0}  {1}".format(tag, self.Name) if tag else self.Name


def _name_from_display(display_str):
    """Extract the raw parameter name from a display string like '[S\u00b7I]  Name' or 'Name'."""
    s = str(display_str) if display_str else u""
    idx = s.find(u"]  ")
    return s[idx + 3:] if idx != -1 else s


def _param_kind(param):
    """Return 'S' for shared parameters, 'P' for project/built-in parameters."""
    try:
        return u"S" if param.IsShared else u"P"
    except Exception:
        return u"?"


def collect_param_names(elements):
    """Return sorted unique parameter names from all elements (instance + type)."""
    names = set()
    for el in elements:
        try:
            for p in el.Parameters:
                if p.Definition:
                    names.add(p.Definition.Name)
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            tid = el.GetTypeId()
            if tid and tid != ElementId.InvalidElementId:
                t = doc.GetElement(tid)
                if t:
                    for p in t.Parameters:
                        if p.Definition:
                            names.add(p.Definition.Name)
        except Exception:
            pass
    return sorted(names)


def collect_param_items(elements, progress_cb=None):
    """
    Return sorted list of ParamListItem (name + kind + binding) from all elements.
    progress_cb(current, total) is called periodically if provided.
    """
    seen = {}  # name -> (kind, binding)
    total = len(elements)
    step  = max(1, total // 200)  # ~200 progress updates
    for i, el in enumerate(elements):
        try:
            for p in el.Parameters:
                if p.Definition and p.Definition.Name not in seen:
                    seen[p.Definition.Name] = (_param_kind(p), u"I")
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            tid = el.GetTypeId()
            if tid and tid != ElementId.InvalidElementId:
                t = doc.GetElement(tid)
                if t:
                    for p in t.Parameters:
                        if p.Definition and p.Definition.Name not in seen:
                            seen[p.Definition.Name] = (_param_kind(p), u"T")
        except Exception:
            pass
        if progress_cb and i % step == 0:
            try:
                progress_cb(i + 1, total)
            except Exception:
                pass
    return [ParamListItem(name, kind, binding)
            for name, (kind, binding) in sorted(seen.items())]


def _datatype_label(param):
    try:
        if USE_NEW_UNITS:
            spec = param.Definition.GetDataType()
            try:
                return LabelUtils.GetLabelForSpec(spec)
            except Exception:
                return str(spec).split(".")[-1]
        else:
            pt = param.Definition.ParameterType
            try:
                return LabelUtils.GetLabelFor(pt)
            except Exception:
                return str(pt)
    except Exception:
        return "Unknown"


def _unit_label(param):
    if param.StorageType != StorageType.Double:
        return ""
    try:
        if USE_NEW_UNITS:
            spec = param.Definition.GetDataType()
            fmt = doc.GetUnits().GetFormatOptions(spec)
            uid = fmt.GetUnitTypeId()
            try:
                return LabelUtils.GetLabelForUnit(uid)
            except Exception:
                return ""
        else:
            ut = param.Definition.UnitType
            fmt = doc.GetUnits().GetFormatOptions(ut)
            dut = fmt.DisplayUnits
            try:
                return LabelUtils.GetLabelFor(dut)
            except Exception:
                return ""
    except Exception:
        return ""


def _convert_from_internal(value, param):
    try:
        if USE_NEW_UNITS:
            spec = param.Definition.GetDataType()
            fmt = doc.GetUnits().GetFormatOptions(spec)
            uid = fmt.GetUnitTypeId()
            return UnitUtils.ConvertFromInternalUnits(value, uid)
        else:
            ut = param.Definition.UnitType
            fmt = doc.GetUnits().GetFormatOptions(ut)
            dut = fmt.DisplayUnits
            return UnitUtils.ConvertFromInternalUnits(value, dut)
    except Exception:
        return value


def _format_value(param):
    """Return a display string for the parameter's current value."""
    stype = param.StorageType
    if stype == StorageType.Double:
        raw = param.AsDouble()
        display = _convert_from_internal(raw, param)
        unit = _unit_label(param)
        try:
            f = float(display)
            num_str = str(int(round(f))) if abs(f - round(f)) < 1e-9 else "{0:g}".format(f)
        except Exception:
            num_str = str(display)
        return u"{0} {1}".format(num_str, unit).strip()
    elif stype == StorageType.Integer:
        return str(param.AsInteger())
    elif stype == StorageType.String:
        v = param.AsString()
        return v if v is not None else u"(empty)"
    elif stype == StorageType.ElementId:
        eid = param.AsElementId()
        if eid == ElementId.InvalidElementId:
            return u"(none)"
        el = doc.GetElement(eid)
        if el:
            try:
                from Autodesk.Revit.DB import Element as _Elem
                return u"{0} [id:{1}]".format(_Elem.Name.GetValue(el), eid.IntegerValue)
            except Exception:
                pass
        return u"id:{0}".format(eid.IntegerValue)
    return u"(no value)"


def _format_as_string(param, include_unit=True):
    """
    Format a parameter value as a plain string suitable for writing to a String target.
    When include_unit=False the display unit label is omitted from Double values.
    """
    stype = param.StorageType
    if stype == StorageType.Double:
        raw = param.AsDouble()
        display = _convert_from_internal(raw, param)
        unit = _unit_label(param) if include_unit else u""
        try:
            f = float(display)
            num_str = str(int(round(f))) if abs(f - round(f)) < 1e-9 else "{0:g}".format(f)
        except Exception:
            num_str = str(display)
        return (u"{0} {1}".format(num_str, unit).strip()) if unit else num_str
    elif stype == StorageType.Integer:
        return str(param.AsInteger())
    elif stype == StorageType.String:
        v = param.AsString()
        return v if v is not None else u""
    elif stype == StorageType.ElementId:
        eid = param.AsElementId()
        if eid == ElementId.InvalidElementId:
            return u"(none)"
        el = doc.GetElement(eid)
        if el:
            try:
                from Autodesk.Revit.DB import Element as _Elem
                return u"{0} [id:{1}]".format(_Elem.Name.GetValue(el), eid.IntegerValue)
            except Exception:
                pass
        return u"id:{0}".format(eid.IntegerValue)
    return u""


def get_param_info(elements, param_name):
    """
    Returns a dict:
      name, storage_type, storage_type_str, data_type_label, unit_label,
      is_read_only, sample_values, available_count, set_count
    """
    info = {
        "name": param_name,
        "storage_type": None,
        "storage_type_str": "—",
        "data_type_label": "—",
        "unit_label": "—",
        "is_read_only": False,
        "sample_values": [],
        "available_count": 0,
        "set_count": 0,
    }
    samples = []
    available = 0
    valued = 0

    for el in elements:
        p = _lookup_param(el, param_name)
        if not p:
            continue
        available += 1

        if info["storage_type"] is None:
            info["storage_type"] = p.StorageType
            info["storage_type_str"] = str(p.StorageType).split(".")[-1]
            info["data_type_label"] = _datatype_label(p)
            unit = _unit_label(p)
            info["unit_label"] = unit if unit else "—"
            info["is_read_only"] = bool(p.IsReadOnly)

        try:
            if p.HasValue:
                valued += 1
                if len(samples) < 5:
                    samples.append(_format_value(p))
        except Exception:
            pass

    info["available_count"] = available
    info["set_count"] = valued
    info["sample_values"] = samples
    return info


def build_preview(src_info, tgt_info, prefix=u"", suffix=u"", include_unit=True):
    """
    Return (preview_text, warning_text) describing what copy src→tgt would produce,
    accounting for any prefix, suffix, and include_unit format options.
    """
    src_st = src_info.get("storage_type")
    tgt_st = tgt_info.get("storage_type")

    if src_st is None or tgt_st is None:
        return (u"Cannot preview \u2014 parameter not found on current selection.", u"")

    sample = src_info.get("sample_values", [])
    sample_str = sample[0] if sample else u"(no sample available)"
    src_dt = src_info.get("data_type_label", "")
    tgt_dt = tgt_info.get("data_type_label", "")

    warning = u""
    preview = u""
    uses_format = bool(prefix or suffix or not include_unit)
    fmt_no_effect = u"\u26a0 Prefix / suffix / unit options have no effect for this type combination."

    def _wrap(val):
        return u"{0}{1}{2}".format(prefix, val, suffix)

    if src_st == StorageType.Double and tgt_st == StorageType.Double:
        if src_dt != tgt_dt:
            warning = (u"\u26a0 DataType mismatch: {0} \u2192 {1}.\n"
                       u"The raw internal (feet-based) value is copied directly. "
                       u"The display unit of the target will be applied.").format(src_dt, tgt_dt)
        if uses_format:
            note = u"\u26a0 Prefix / suffix / unit options have no effect on Double \u2192 Double copies."
            warning = (warning + u"\n" + note) if warning else note
        preview = u"Source sample: {0}\nTarget will receive the equivalent internal value.".format(sample_str)

    elif src_st == StorageType.Double and tgt_st == StorageType.String:
        # Approximate the no-unit sample by stripping the unit label
        val = sample_str
        if not include_unit:
            unit_lbl = src_info.get("unit_label", u"")
            if unit_lbl and unit_lbl != u"\u2014":
                val = sample_str.replace(unit_lbl, u"").strip()
        final = _wrap(val)
        preview = u'Source sample: {0}\nFormatted result: "{1}"'.format(sample_str, final)

    elif src_st == StorageType.Integer and tgt_st == StorageType.Integer:
        if uses_format:
            warning = fmt_no_effect
        preview = u"Source sample: {0}\nTarget receives the same integer value.".format(sample_str)

    elif src_st == StorageType.Integer and tgt_st == StorageType.Double:
        w2 = u"\u26a0 Integer \u2192 Double: value will be cast."
        if uses_format:
            warning = fmt_no_effect + u"\n" + w2
        else:
            warning = w2
        preview = u"Source sample: {0}\nTarget will receive: {0}.0".format(sample_str)

    elif src_st == StorageType.Integer and tgt_st == StorageType.String:
        final = _wrap(sample_str)
        preview = u'Source sample: {0}\nFormatted result: "{1}"'.format(sample_str, final)

    elif src_st == StorageType.String and tgt_st == StorageType.String:
        final = _wrap(sample_str)
        preview = u'Source sample: "{0}"\nFormatted result: "{1}"'.format(sample_str, final)

    elif src_st == StorageType.String and tgt_st == StorageType.Double:
        w2 = (u"\u26a0 String \u2192 Double: will attempt numeric parse. "
              u"Elements with non-numeric strings will be skipped.")
        warning = (fmt_no_effect + u"\n" + w2) if uses_format else w2
        preview = u'Source sample: "{0}"\nTarget will receive the parsed numeric value.'.format(sample_str)

    elif src_st == StorageType.String and tgt_st == StorageType.Integer:
        w2 = (u"\u26a0 String \u2192 Integer: will attempt integer parse. "
              u"Elements with non-numeric strings will be skipped.")
        warning = (fmt_no_effect + u"\n" + w2) if uses_format else w2
        preview = u'Source sample: "{0}"\nTarget will receive the parsed integer.'.format(sample_str)

    elif src_st == tgt_st:
        if uses_format:
            warning = fmt_no_effect
        preview = u"Types match ({0}). Source sample: {1}".format(
            src_info.get("storage_type_str", ""), sample_str)

    else:
        warning = (u"\u26a0 Incompatible types: {0} \u2192 {1}. "
                   u"These combinations will be skipped.").format(
            src_info.get("storage_type_str", ""),
            tgt_info.get("storage_type_str", ""))
        preview = u"Source sample: {0}".format(sample_str)

    return (preview, warning)


def execute_copy(elements, src_name, tgt_name, prefix=u"", suffix=u"", include_unit=True):
    """
    Returns (copied, skipped, errors, skip_log, error_log, copy_by_cat).
    skip_log    = {reason: {category: count}}
    error_log   = {error_type: {category: count}}
    copy_by_cat = {category: {"count": n, "samples": [(src_display, written_val)]}}
    """
    copied = 0
    skipped = 0
    errors = []
    skip_log = {}     # {reason: {cat: count}}
    error_log = {}    # {err_type: {cat: count}}
    copy_by_cat = {}  # {cat: {"count": n, "samples": [(src_disp, written_val)]}}
    _SAMPLE_LIMIT = 5

    def _cat(el):
        try:
            return el.Category.Name
        except Exception:
            return u"Uncategorized"

    def _log_skip(el, reason):
        cat = _cat(el)
        if reason not in skip_log:
            skip_log[reason] = {}
        skip_log[reason][cat] = skip_log[reason].get(cat, 0) + 1

    def _log_error(el, reason_type):
        cat = _cat(el)
        if reason_type not in error_log:
            error_log[reason_type] = {}
        error_log[reason_type][cat] = error_log[reason_type].get(cat, 0) + 1

    def _log_copy(el, src_display, written_val):
        cat = _cat(el)
        if cat not in copy_by_cat:
            copy_by_cat[cat] = {"count": 0, "samples": []}
        copy_by_cat[cat]["count"] += 1
        if len(copy_by_cat[cat]["samples"]) < _SAMPLE_LIMIT:
            copy_by_cat[cat]["samples"].append((src_display, written_val))

    t = Transaction(doc, u"Copy Parameter: {0} \u2192 {1}".format(src_name, tgt_name))
    t.Start()
    try:
        for el in elements:
            src = _lookup_param(el, src_name)
            tgt = _lookup_param(el, tgt_name)

            if not src:
                skipped += 1
                _log_skip(el, u"No source parameter")
                continue

            if not tgt:
                skipped += 1
                _log_skip(el, u"No target parameter")
                continue

            if tgt.IsReadOnly:
                skipped += 1
                _log_skip(el, u"Target is read-only")
                continue

            if not src.HasValue:
                skipped += 1
                _log_skip(el, u"Source has no value")
                continue

            try:
                s_st = src.StorageType
                t_st = tgt.StorageType
                src_disp = _format_value(src)

                if s_st == StorageType.Double and t_st == StorageType.Double:
                    tgt.Set(src.AsDouble())
                    _log_copy(el, src_disp, src_disp)
                    copied += 1

                elif s_st == StorageType.Integer and t_st == StorageType.Integer:
                    tgt.Set(src.AsInteger())
                    _log_copy(el, src_disp, src_disp)
                    copied += 1

                elif s_st == StorageType.Integer and t_st == StorageType.Double:
                    tgt.Set(float(src.AsInteger()))
                    _log_copy(el, src_disp, src_disp)
                    copied += 1

                elif s_st == StorageType.String and t_st == StorageType.String:
                    raw = src.AsString() or u""
                    written = u"{0}{1}{2}".format(prefix, raw, suffix)
                    tgt.Set(written)
                    _log_copy(el, src_disp, written)
                    copied += 1

                elif s_st == StorageType.Double and t_st == StorageType.String:
                    raw = _format_as_string(src, include_unit=include_unit)
                    written = u"{0}{1}{2}".format(prefix, raw, suffix)
                    tgt.Set(written)
                    _log_copy(el, src_disp, written)
                    copied += 1

                elif s_st == StorageType.Integer and t_st == StorageType.String:
                    written = u"{0}{1}{2}".format(prefix, str(src.AsInteger()), suffix)
                    tgt.Set(written)
                    _log_copy(el, src_disp, written)
                    copied += 1

                elif s_st == StorageType.String and t_st == StorageType.Double:
                    raw = src.AsString() or u""
                    try:
                        tgt.Set(float(raw))
                        _log_copy(el, src_disp, raw)
                        copied += 1
                    except Exception:
                        skipped += 1
                        _log_skip(el, u"String parse failed (not numeric)")

                elif s_st == StorageType.String and t_st == StorageType.Integer:
                    raw = src.AsString() or u""
                    try:
                        tgt.Set(int(round(float(raw))))
                        _log_copy(el, src_disp, raw)
                        copied += 1
                    except Exception:
                        skipped += 1
                        _log_skip(el, u"String parse failed (not integer)")

                else:
                    skipped += 1
                    _log_skip(el, u"Incompatible types ({0} \u2192 {1})".format(
                        str(s_st).split(".")[-1], str(t_st).split(".")[-1]))

            except Exception as ex:
                errors.append(u"id:{0} — {1}".format(el.Id.IntegerValue, str(ex)))
                skipped += 1
                _log_error(el, type(ex).__name__)

        t.Commit()

    except Exception as ex:
        try:
            t.RollBack()
        except Exception:
            pass
        errors.append(u"Transaction failed: {0}".format(str(ex)))

    return (copied, skipped, errors, skip_log, error_log, copy_by_cat)


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Element scope helpers (pre-launch)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def _safe_elements(raw_list):
    """Filter out None and invalid/deleted elements."""
    result = []
    for el in raw_list:
        try:
            if el is not None and el.IsValidObject:
                result.append(el)
        except Exception:
            if el is not None:
                result.append(el)
    return result


def _current_selection():
    try:
        ids = uidoc.Selection.GetElementIds()
        if not ids or ids.Count == 0:
            return []
        return _safe_elements([doc.GetElement(eid) for eid in ids])
    except Exception:
        return []


def _pick_interactively():
    """Launch Revit's interactive PickObjects. Returns list or [] on Esc/error."""
    try:
        refs = uidoc.Selection.PickObjects(
            ObjectType.Element,
            "Select elements for Parameter Copier — click to add, then Finish")
        return _safe_elements([doc.GetElement(r.ElementId) for r in refs])
    except Exception:
        # OperationCanceledException (Esc) lands here — silent return is correct
        return []


def _all_in_active_view():
    try:
        from Autodesk.Revit.DB import FilteredElementCollector
        view = doc.ActiveView
        return _safe_elements(
            list(FilteredElementCollector(doc, view.Id)
                 .WhereElementIsNotElementType()
                 .ToElements())
        )
    except Exception:
        return []


def _is_2d(el):
    """Return True if the element is view-specific (annotation/2D)."""
    try:
        return bool(el.ViewSpecific)
    except Exception:
        return False


def _all_2d_in_model():
    """All view-specific (annotation/2D) elements across the whole model."""
    try:
        from Autodesk.Revit.DB import FilteredElementCollector
        return _safe_elements(
            [e for e in FilteredElementCollector(doc)
                            .WhereElementIsNotElementType().ToElements()
             if _is_2d(e)]
        )
    except Exception:
        return []


def _all_3d_in_model():
    """All model (non-view-specific / 3D) elements in the whole model."""
    try:
        from Autodesk.Revit.DB import FilteredElementCollector
        return _safe_elements(
            [e for e in FilteredElementCollector(doc)
                            .WhereElementIsNotElementType().ToElements()
             if not _is_2d(e)]
        )
    except Exception:
        return []


def _all_2d_in_active_view():
    """View-specific (2D/annotation) elements visible in the active view."""
    try:
        from Autodesk.Revit.DB import FilteredElementCollector
        view = doc.ActiveView
        return _safe_elements(
            [e for e in FilteredElementCollector(doc, view.Id)
                            .WhereElementIsNotElementType().ToElements()
             if _is_2d(e)]
        )
    except Exception:
        return []


def _all_3d_in_active_view():
    """Model (3D/non-view-specific) elements visible in the active view."""
    try:
        from Autodesk.Revit.DB import FilteredElementCollector
        view = doc.ActiveView
        return _safe_elements(
            [e for e in FilteredElementCollector(doc, view.Id)
                            .WhereElementIsNotElementType().ToElements()
             if not _is_2d(e)]
        )
    except Exception:
        return []


def _all_in_model():
    try:
        from Autodesk.Revit.DB import FilteredElementCollector
        return _safe_elements(
            list(FilteredElementCollector(doc)
                 .WhereElementIsNotElementType()
                 .ToElements())
        )
    except Exception:
        return []


_OPT_PICK   = u"Pick elements interactively in view..."
_OPT_VIEW   = u"Use all elements in active view"
_OPT_MODEL  = u"Use all elements in model"
_OPT_CANCEL = u"Cancel"


def _choose_elements():
    """
    Show a pre-launch element-scope dialog.
    Returns a non-empty element list, or None to cancel.
    """
    current = _current_selection()

    opt_current = None
    options = []
    if current:
        opt_current = u"Use {0} currently selected element(s)".format(len(current))
        options.append(opt_current)
    options.extend([_OPT_PICK, _OPT_VIEW, _OPT_MODEL, _OPT_CANCEL])

    choice = forms.alert(
        u"Choose element scope for Parameter Copier:",
        title=u"Param Copier",
        options=options
    )

    if not choice or choice == _OPT_CANCEL:
        return None

    if opt_current and choice == opt_current:
        return current

    if choice == _OPT_PICK:
        picked = _pick_interactively()
        if not picked:
            forms.alert(u"No elements were picked or selection was cancelled.")
            return None
        return picked

    if choice == _OPT_VIEW:
        elems = _all_in_active_view()
        if not elems:
            forms.alert(u"No elements found in the active view.")
            return None
        if len(elems) > 2000:
            cont = forms.alert(
                u"{0} elements found in the active view.\n"
                u"Scanning this many may be slow. Continue?".format(len(elems)),
                options=[u"Continue", u"Cancel"]
            )
            if cont != u"Continue":
                return None
        return elems

    if choice == _OPT_MODEL:
        elems = _all_in_model()
        if not elems:
            forms.alert(u"No elements found in the model.")
            return None
        if len(elems) > 2000:
            cont = forms.alert(
                u"{0} elements found in the model.\n"
                u"Scanning this many may be slow. Continue?".format(len(elems)),
                options=[u"Continue", u"Cancel"]
            )
            if cont != u"Continue":
                return None
        return elems

    return None

                                        VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                        IsHitTestVisible="False"/>
                                    <ToggleButton Grid.Column="0" Grid.ColumnSpan="2"
                                        Background="Transparent" BorderThickness="0"
                                        IsChecked="{Binding IsDropDownOpen, Mode=TwoWay,
                                            RelativeSource={RelativeSource TemplatedParent}}"
                                        Focusable="False"/>
                                    <Path Grid.Column="1" Data="M 0 0 L 4 4 L 8 0 Z"
                                        Fill="#5E6A75" VerticalAlignment="Center"
                                          HorizontalAlignment="Center" IsHitTestVisible="False"/>
                                </Grid>
                            </Border>
                            <Popup x:Name="PART_Popup"
                                   IsOpen="{TemplateBinding IsDropDownOpen}"
                                   Placement="Bottom" AllowsTransparency="True" Focusable="False">
                                <Border Background="#FFF9FAFB" BorderBrush="#DDE1E6" BorderThickness="1"
                                        MinWidth="{TemplateBinding ActualWidth}"
                                        MaxHeight="{TemplateBinding MaxDropDownHeight}">
                                    <ScrollViewer CanContentScroll="True">
                                        <ItemsPresenter/>
                                    </ScrollViewer>
                                </Border>
                            </Popup>
                        </Grid>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>
        <Style TargetType="ComboBoxItem">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="#FFFFFFFF"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#1A1A1A"/>
            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="8,5"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="0"/>
            <Style.Triggers>
                <Trigger Property="IsHighlighted" Value="True">
                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="#E7EDFB"/>
                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#1640B0"/>
                </Trigger>
                <Trigger Property="IsEnabled" Value="False">
                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="#FFF9FAFB"/>
                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#8A8F98"/>
                    <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="10"/>
                    <Setter Property="Padding" Value="6,4"/>
                </Trigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style>

        <!-- Dark TabControl / TabItem -->
        <Style TargetType="TabControl">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="#FFFBFE"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="0"/>
            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="0"/>
        </Style>
        <Style TargetType="TabItem">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="#FFFFFFFF"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#5E6A75"/>
            <Setter Property="Padding" Value="14,7"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="0"/>
            <Setter Property="FontSize" Value="12"/>
            <Style.Triggers>
                <Trigger Property="IsSelected" Value="True">
                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="#FFFBFE"/>
                    <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#1A1A1A"/>
                </Trigger>
                <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                    <Setter Property="Background" Value="#FFF4F5F7"/>
                </Trigger>
            </Style.Triggers>
        </Style>
    </Window.Resources>

    <DockPanel>

        <Border DockPanel.Dock="Top" Background="#1A1A1A" Padding="24,16" Margin="10,10,10,0">
            <Grid>
                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>

                <Border Grid.Column="0" Width="38" Height="38" CornerRadius="12" Background="#1F4FD9">
                    <TextBlock Text="PC" Foreground="#FFFFFF" FontSize="14" FontWeight="Bold"
                               HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                </Border>
                <StackPanel Grid.Column="1" Margin="14,0,0,0" VerticalAlignment="Center">
                    <TextBlock Text="SJ-B+C · Parameter Copier" Foreground="#FFFFFF" FontSize="16" FontWeight="SemiBold"/>

                </StackPanel>

        </Border>

        <!-- Copy progress bar (bottom, shown during copy run) -->
        <ProgressBar DockPanel.Dock="Bottom" x:Name="pbarCopy"
                     Height="3" IsIndeterminate="True" Visibility="Collapsed"
                     Background="#FFFBFE" Foreground="#2EA043"/>

        <!-- Action buttons (bottom, above progress) -->
        <StackPanel DockPanel.Dock="Bottom" Orientation="Horizontal"
                    HorizontalAlignment="Right" Margin="10,8,10,8">
            <Button x:Name="btnCopy" Content="Copy Parameters"
                    Width="155" Margin="0,0,8,0" IsEnabled="False"/>
            <Button x:Name="btnCancel" Content="Close" Width="90" Style="{StaticResource SecondaryActionButton}"/>
        </StackPanel>

        <!-- Scope bar (top) -->
        <Border DockPanel.Dock="Top" Background="#FFF9FAFB" BorderBrush="#DDE1E6"
                BorderThickness="0,0,0,1" Padding="10,7">
            <StackPanel>
                <Grid>
                    <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="210"/>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                        <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                    </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <TextBlock Grid.Column="0" Text="Scope" Foreground="#5E6A75"

                    <ComboBox Grid.Column="1" x:Name="cmbScope" Margin="0,0,8,0"/>
                    <Button Grid.Column="2" x:Name="btnLoad"
                            Content="&#x21BA;  Load" Width="82" Padding="8,4"/>
                    <TextBlock Grid.Column="3" x:Name="txtElementCount"
                               Foreground="#5E6A75" FontSize="11"
                               VerticalAlignment="Center" HorizontalAlignment="Right"
                               Text="No scope loaded"/>
                </Grid>
                <TextBlock Foreground="#8A8F98" FontSize="10" Margin="0,5,0,0"
                           Text="Tags:  S = Shared  &#x00b7;  P = Project  &#x00b7;  I = Instance  &#x00b7;  T = Type"/>
            </StackPanel>
        </Border>

        <!-- Main TabControl -->
        <TabControl x:Name="tabMain">

            <!-- ═══ PARAMETERS TAB ════════════════════════════════════════ -->
            <TabItem Header="  Parameters  " x:Name="tabParams">
                <DockPanel Margin="10,8,10,6">

                    <!-- Format options (bottom) -->
                        <Border DockPanel.Dock="Bottom" Background="#FFF9FAFB" BorderBrush="#DDE1E6"
                            BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="8" Padding="12,8" Margin="0,4,0,0">
                        <Grid>
                            <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="130"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="130"/>
                                <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                            </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <TextBlock Grid.Column="0" Text="Prefix" Foreground="#5E6A75" FontSize="11"
                                       VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,6,0"/>
                            <TextBox Grid.Column="1" x:Name="txtPrefix" Margin="0,0,16,0"/>
                            <TextBlock Grid.Column="2" Text="Suffix" Foreground="#5E6A75" FontSize="11"
                                       VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,6,0"/>
                            <TextBox Grid.Column="3" x:Name="txtSuffix"/>
                            <CheckBox Grid.Column="4" x:Name="chkIncludeUnit"
                                      Content="Include display unit"
                                      Foreground="#1A1A1A" FontSize="12"

                    </Border>

                    <!-- Preview panel (bottom, above format options) -->
                    <Border DockPanel.Dock="Bottom" Style="{StaticResource PreviewPanel}">
                        <StackPanel>

                                       TextWrapping="Wrap"
                                       Text="(select both parameters to see preview)"/>
                            <TextBlock x:Name="txtWarning" Foreground="#B54708" FontSize="12"
                                       TextWrapping="Wrap" Margin="0,6,0,0"
                                       Visibility="Collapsed"/>
                        </StackPanel>
                    </Border>

                    <!-- Two-column param selector (fills remaining space) -->
                    <Grid>
                        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="48"/>
                            <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

                        <!-- LEFT: Source -->
                        <DockPanel Grid.Column="0">
                            <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Top" Style="{StaticResource SectionHeader}"
                                       Text="Source Parameter (Left — reads from here)"/>
                            <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Top" Foreground="#5E6A75" FontSize="11"
                                       Margin="0,0,0,3" Text="Filter"/>
                            <TextBox DockPanel.Dock="Top" x:Name="txtLeftFilter" Margin="0,0,0,6"/>
                            <Border DockPanel.Dock="Bottom" Style="{StaticResource MetaPanel}" MinHeight="148">
                                <ScrollViewer VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto">
                                    <StackPanel>
                                        <TextBlock Style="{StaticResource MetaLabel}" Text="Data Type"/>

                                        <TextBlock Style="{StaticResource MetaLabel}" Text="Read Only"/>
                                        <TextBlock x:Name="txtLeftReadOnly" Style="{StaticResource MetaValue}" Text="—"/>
                                        <TextBlock Style="{StaticResource MetaLabel}" Text="Sample Values (first 5 elements)"/>
                                        <TextBlock x:Name="txtLeftSamples" Style="{StaticResource MetaValue}" Text="—"/>
                                    </StackPanel>
                                </ScrollViewer>
                            </Border>
                            <ListBox x:Name="lstLeft"/>
                        </DockPanel>

                        <!-- ARROW -->
                        <TextBlock Grid.Column="1" Text="&#x2192;" FontSize="26"
                                   Foreground="#1F4FD9" HorizontalAlignment="Center"
                                   VerticalAlignment="Center" FontWeight="Bold"/>

                        <!-- RIGHT: Target -->
                        <DockPanel Grid.Column="2">
                            <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Top" Style="{StaticResource SectionHeader}"
                                       Text="Target Parameter (Right — writes to here)"/>
                            <TextBlock DockPanel.Dock="Top" Foreground="#5E6A75" FontSize="11"
                                       Margin="0,0,0,3" Text="Filter"/>
                            <TextBox DockPanel.Dock="Top" x:Name="txtRightFilter" Margin="0,0,0,6"/>
                            <Border DockPanel.Dock="Bottom" Style="{StaticResource MetaPanel}" MinHeight="148">
                                <ScrollViewer VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto">
                                    <StackPanel>
                                        <TextBlock Style="{StaticResource MetaLabel}" Text="Data Type"/>
                                        <TextBlock x:Name="txtRightDataType" Style="{StaticResource MetaValue}" Text="—"/>
                                        <TextBlock Style="{StaticResource MetaLabel}" Text="Storage Type"/>
                                        <TextBlock x:Name="txtRightStorageType" Style="{StaticResource MetaValue}" Text="—"/>
                                        <TextBlock Style="{StaticResource MetaLabel}" Text="Display Unit"/>
                                        <TextBlock x:Name="txtRightUnit" Style="{StaticResource MetaValue}" Text="—"/>
                                        <TextBlock Style="{StaticResource MetaLabel}" Text="Read Only"/>
                                        <TextBlock x:Name="txtRightReadOnly" Style="{StaticResource MetaValue}" Text="—"/>
                                        <TextBlock Style="{StaticResource MetaLabel}" Text="Sample Values (first 5 elements)"/>
                                        <TextBlock x:Name="txtRightSamples" Style="{StaticResource MetaValue}" Text="—"/>
                                    </StackPanel>
                                </ScrollViewer>

                </DockPanel>
            </TabItem>

            <!-- ═══ RESULTS TAB ══════════════════════════════════════════ -->
            <TabItem Header="  Results  " x:Name="tabResults" IsEnabled="False">
                <DockPanel Margin="10,8,10,6">
                        <Border DockPanel.Dock="Top" Background="#FFF9FAFB" BorderBrush="#DDE1E6"
                            BorderThickness="1" CornerRadius="8" Padding="12,10" Margin="0,0,0,8">
                        <StackPanel x:Name="pnlSummary"/>
                    </Border>
                    <ScrollViewer VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto">
                        <StackPanel x:Name="pnlResults"/>
                    </ScrollViewer>
                </DockPanel>
            </TabItem>

        </TabControl>
    </DockPanel>
</Window>
"""


class ParamCopierWindow(forms.WPFWindow):

    def __init__(self):
        forms.WPFWindow.__init__(self, WINDOW_XAML, literal_string=True)
        apply_style_guide_resources(self)
        apply_window_contract(self)
        apply_topmost_and_parent(self)

        self._elements = []
        self._all_items = []
        self._src_info = None
        self._tgt_info = None
        self.copy_result = None

        # Populate scope dropdown with grouped ComboBoxItem objects.
        # Header items (IsEnabled=False) act as section labels.
        from System.Windows.Controls import ComboBoxItem as _CBI
        _SCOPE_ITEMS = [
            (u"All 2D Elements",           u"all_2d_model",   False),
            (u"All 3D Elements",           u"all_3d_model",   False),
            (u"All 2D and 3D Elements",    u"all_model",      False),
            (u"\u2500\u2500  2D Element Selection  \u2500\u2500", u"", True),
            (u"    All in Active View",    u"2d_active_view",  False),
            (u"\u2500\u2500  3D Element Selection  \u2500\u2500", u"", True),
            (u"    All in Active View",    u"3d_active_view",  False),
            (u"    By Selection",          u"3d_selection",   False),
        ]
        for display, key, is_hdr in _SCOPE_ITEMS:
            ci = _CBI()
            ci.Content = display
            ci.Tag = key
            ci.IsEnabled = not is_hdr
            self.cmbScope.Items.Add(ci)
        # Default to "All 2D and 3D Elements" (index 2)
        self.cmbScope.SelectedIndex = 2

        # Wire events
        self.txtLeftFilter.TextChanged  += self._on_left_filter
        self.txtRightFilter.TextChanged += self._on_right_filter
        self.lstLeft.SelectionChanged   += self._on_left_select
        self.lstRight.SelectionChanged  += self._on_right_select
        self.btnLoad.Click              += self._on_load
        self.btnCopy.Click              += self._on_copy
        self.btnCancel.Click            += self._on_cancel
        self.txtPrefix.TextChanged      += self._on_format_changed
        self.txtSuffix.TextChanged      += self._on_format_changed
        self.chkIncludeUnit.Click       += self._on_format_changed
        # Initial data is injected by the entry point after ProgressBar scan;
        # user can click \u21ba Load at any time to rescan the selected scope.

    def _on_load(self, sender, e):
        self._load_scope()

    def _load_scope(self):
        """Collect elements for the selected scope and refresh both parameter lists."""
        try:
            selected = self.cmbScope.SelectedItem
            if not selected or not getattr(selected, 'IsEnabled', True):
                self._set_status(u"Select a scope and click \u21ba Load.")
                return
            key   = str(selected.Tag or u"")
            label = str(selected.Content or u"").strip()

            self._set_status(u"Loading: {0}...".format(label))
            self.txtElementCount.Text = u"Scanning..."

            if key == u"all_2d_model":
                elems = _all_2d_in_model()
            elif key == u"all_3d_model":
                elems = _all_3d_in_model()
            elif key == u"all_model":
                elems = _all_in_model()
            elif key == u"2d_active_view":
                elems = _all_2d_in_active_view()
            elif key == u"3d_active_view":
                elems = _all_3d_in_active_view()
            elif key == u"3d_selection":
                elems = _current_selection()
                if not elems:
                    self._set_status(
                        u"No elements selected in Revit. "
                        u"Select elements first, then click \u21ba Load.")
                    self.txtElementCount.Text = u"0 elements"
                    return
            else:
                elems = []

            if not elems:
                self._set_status(u"No elements found for: {0}".format(label))
                self.txtElementCount.Text = u"0 elements"
                return

            self._elements = elems
            if len(elems) > 5000:
                self._set_status(u"Scanning {0:,} elements...".format(len(elems)))

            items = collect_param_items(elems)
            self._all_items = items
            self._set_list(self.lstLeft,  items)
            self._set_list(self.lstRight, items)

            self.txtElementCount.Text = u"\u2713  {0:,} elements  \u00b7  {1:,} params  [{2}]".format(
                len(elems), len(items), label)

            self.lstLeft.SelectedItem  = None
            self.lstRight.SelectedItem = None
            self._src_info = None
            self._tgt_info = None
            self._clear_meta(u"left")
            self._clear_meta(u"right")
            self._refresh_preview()
            self._set_status(
                u"\u2713  {0:,} elements  \u00b7  {1:,} params  \u2014  {2}".format(
                    len(elems), len(items), label))
        except Exception as _ex:
            self._set_status(u"Load failed: {0}".format(str(_ex)))
            self.txtElementCount.Text = u"Error"

    def _set_list(self, listbox, items, scope=None):
        """Populate a ListBox using display strings from ParamListItem list."""
        try:
            elems = _all_in_active_view()
            if not elems:
                self._set_status(u"No elements found in the active view.")
                self.txtElementCount.Text = u"0 elements"
                return

            elif scope == u"Whole Model":
                elems = _all_in_model()
                if not elems:
                    self._set_status(u"No elements found in the model.")
                    self.txtElementCount.Text = u"0 elements"
                    return
                if len(elems) > 5000:
                    self._set_status(
                        u"Large scope: {0} elements — parameter scan may take "
                        u"several seconds.".format(len(elems)))
            else:
                elems = []

            self._elements = elems
            self.txtElementCount.Text = u"\u2713  {0:,} elements  \u00b7  {1:,} params  [{2}]".format(
                    len(elems), len(items), scope)

            items = collect_param_items(elems)
            self._all_items = items
            self._set_list(self.lstLeft,  items)
            self._set_list(self.lstRight, items)

            # Reset both sides
            self.lstLeft.SelectedItem  = None
            self.lstRight.SelectedItem = None
            self._src_info = None
            self._tgt_info = None
            self._clear_meta(u"left")
            self._clear_meta(u"right")
            self._refresh_preview()
            self._set_status(
                u"\u2713  {0:,} elements loaded \u00b7  {1:,} unique parameters  \u2014  scope: {2}".format(
                    len(elems), len(items), scope))
        except Exception as _ex:
            self._set_status(u"Load failed: {0}".format(str(_ex)))
            self.txtElementCount.Text = u"Error"

    # ── List helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _set_list(self, listbox, items):
        """Populate a ListBox using display strings from ParamListItem list."""
        col = List[String]()
        for item in items:
            col.Add(str(item))  # Python str() calls __str__ — avoids IronPython type-name bug
        listbox.ItemsSource = col

    def _filter_and_refresh(self, listbox, query):
        if query:
            q = query.lower()
            filtered = [item for item in self._all_items if q in item.Name.lower()]
        else:
            filtered = self._all_items
        self._set_list(listbox, filtered)

    # ── Event handlers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _on_left_filter(self, sender, e):
        self._filter_and_refresh(self.lstLeft, self.txtLeftFilter.Text)

    def _on_right_filter(self, sender, e):
        self._filter_and_refresh(self.lstRight, self.txtRightFilter.Text)

    def _on_format_changed(self, sender, e):
        """Re-render preview when prefix/suffix/unit options change."""
        self._refresh_preview()

    def _on_left_select(self, sender, e):
        try:
            selected = self.lstLeft.SelectedItem
            if not selected:
                self._src_info = None
                self._clear_meta("left")
                self._refresh_preview()
                return
            info = get_param_info(self._elements, _name_from_display(self.lstLeft.SelectedItem))
            self._src_info = info
            self._paint_meta("left", info)
            self._refresh_preview()
            self._set_status(
                u"Source: {name}  |  {available_count} elements have this param, "
                u"{set_count} have a value.".format(**info)
            )
        except Exception as _ex:
            self._set_status(u"Error loading source parameter: {0}".format(str(_ex)))

    def _on_right_select(self, sender, e):
        try:
            selected = self.lstRight.SelectedItem
            if not selected:
                self._tgt_info = None
                self._clear_meta("right")
                self._refresh_preview()
                return
            info = get_param_info(self._elements, _name_from_display(self.lstRight.SelectedItem))
            self._tgt_info = info
            self._paint_meta("right", info)
            self._refresh_preview()
            self._set_status(
                u"Target: {name}  |  {available_count} elements have this param, "
                u"{set_count} have a value.".format(**info)
            )
        except Exception as _ex:
            self._set_status(u"Error loading target parameter: {0}".format(str(_ex)))

    def _on_copy(self, sender, e):
        try:
            if not self._src_info or not self._tgt_info:
                return
            src_name = self._src_info["name"]
            tgt_name = self._tgt_info["name"]
            # Show indeterminate bar for the duration of the copy
            self.pbarCopy.Visibility = Visibility.Visible
            self.btnCopy.IsEnabled = False
            self._set_status(u"Copying {0} elements...".format(len(self._elements)))
            copied, skipped, errors, skip_log, error_log, copy_by_cat = execute_copy(
                self._elements, src_name, tgt_name,
                prefix=self.txtPrefix.Text or u"",
                suffix=self.txtSuffix.Text or u"",
                include_unit=bool(self.chkIncludeUnit.IsChecked))
            self.copy_result = (copied, skipped, errors, skip_log, error_log, copy_by_cat)

            # Populate Results tab and switch to it
            self._build_results(src_name, tgt_name, copied, skipped,
                                errors, skip_log, error_log, copy_by_cat)
            self.tabResults.IsEnabled = True
            self.tabMain.SelectedItem = self.tabResults

            self._set_status(u"Done: {0} copied, {1} skipped, {2} error(s).".format(
                copied, skipped, len(errors)))
        except Exception as _ex:
            self._set_status(u"Copy operation failed: {0}".format(str(_ex)))
        finally:
            self.pbarCopy.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed
            # Re-enable Copy if both params are still chosen
            try:
                self.btnCopy.IsEnabled = bool(
                    self._src_info and self._tgt_info
                    and not self._tgt_info.get('is_read_only'))
            except Exception:
                pass

    def _on_cancel(self, sender, e):
        self.Close()

    def _build_results(self, src_name, tgt_name, copied, skipped,
                        errors, skip_log, error_log, copy_by_cat):
        """Populate the Results tab with structured copy outcome data."""

        def _brush(hex_str):
            h = hex_str.lstrip('#')
            r, g, b = int(h[0:2], 16), int(h[2:4], 16), int(h[4:6], 16)
            return SolidColorBrush(WpfColor.FromArgb(255, r, g, b))

        def _tb(text, size=12, color="#1A1A1A", bold=False, margin=(0,0,0,0)):
            t = TextBlock()
            t.Text = text
            t.FontSize = size
            t.Foreground = _brush(color)
            if bold:
                t.FontWeight = FontWeights.SemiBold
            t.Margin = Thickness(margin[0], margin[1], margin[2], margin[3])
            return t

        def _sep():
            b = WpfBorder()
            b.Height = 1
            b.Background = _brush("#2A2A2A")
            b.Margin = Thickness(0, 8, 0, 8)
            return b

        def _make_exp(label, count, color, expanded=False):
            exp = Expander()
            exp.IsExpanded = expanded
            exp.Margin = Thickness(0, 2, 0, 0)
            hdr = StackPanel()
            hdr.Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal
            lbl = TextBlock()
            lbl.Text = label
            lbl.FontWeight = FontWeights.SemiBold
            lbl.Foreground = _brush(color)
            lbl.FontSize = 12
            cnt = TextBlock()
            cnt.Text = u"  \u2014  {0:,}".format(count)
            cnt.Foreground = _brush("#8A8F98")
            cnt.FontSize = 12
            hdr.Children.Add(lbl)
            hdr.Children.Add(cnt)
            exp.Header = hdr
            return exp

        def _cat_row(cat_name, count, color):
            row = StackPanel()
            row.Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal
            row.Margin = Thickness(16, 2, 0, 0)
            lbl = TextBlock()
            lbl.Text = cat_name
            lbl.Width = 300
            lbl.Foreground = _brush("#5E6A75")
            lbl.FontSize = 11
            cnt = TextBlock()
            cnt.Text = u"{0:,}".format(count)
            cnt.Foreground = _brush(color)
            cnt.FontSize = 11
            cnt.FontWeight = FontWeights.SemiBold
            row.Children.Add(lbl)
            row.Children.Add(cnt)
            return row

        total       = len(self._elements)
        error_count = len(errors)

        # Summary banner
        self.pnlSummary.Children.Clear()
        self.pnlSummary.Children.Add(
            _tb(u"{0}  \u2192  {1}".format(src_name, tgt_name),
                14, "#E0E0E0", True, (0, 0, 0, 10)))
        for label, value, clr in [
            (u"Total Elements", u"{0:,}".format(total),        "#5E6A75"),
            (u"Copied",         u"{0:,}".format(copied),       "#2EA043"),
            (u"Skipped",        u"{0:,}".format(skipped),      "#B54708"),
            (u"Errors",         u"{0:,}".format(error_count),  "#F44747" if errors else "#444"),
        ]:
            row = StackPanel()
            row.Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal
            row.Margin = Thickness(0, 2, 0, 2)
            lbl_tb = TextBlock()
            lbl_tb.Text = label
            lbl_tb.Width = 110
            lbl_tb.Foreground = _brush("#5E6A75")
            lbl_tb.FontSize = 12
            val_tb = TextBlock()
            val_tb.Text = value
            val_tb.Foreground = _brush(clr)
            val_tb.FontSize = 13
            val_tb.FontWeight = FontWeights.SemiBold
            row.Children.Add(lbl_tb)
            row.Children.Add(val_tb)
            self.pnlSummary.Children.Add(row)

        # Detail breakdown
        self.pnlResults.Children.Clear()

        # COPIED
        if copy_by_cat:
            self.pnlResults.Children.Add(
                _tb(u"\u2713  Copied", 13, "#2EA043", True, (0, 4, 0, 4)))
            for cat in sorted(copy_by_cat.keys()):
                entry   = copy_by_cat[cat]
                count   = entry["count"]
                samples = entry["samples"]
                cat_exp = _make_exp(cat, count, "#2EA043")
                content = StackPanel()
                content.Margin = Thickness(16, 4, 0, 6)
                for src_val, tgt_val in samples:
                    s_row = StackPanel()
                    s_row.Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal
                    s_row.Margin = Thickness(0, 2, 0, 0)
                    s_src = TextBlock()
                    s_src.Text = src_val
                    s_src.Foreground = _brush("#AAAAAA")
                    s_src.FontSize = 11
                    s_src.MaxWidth = 240
                    s_arr = TextBlock()
                    s_arr.Text = u"  \u2192  "
                    s_arr.Foreground = _brush("#2EA043")
                    s_arr.FontSize = 11
                    s_tgt = TextBlock()
                    s_tgt.Text = tgt_val
                    s_tgt.Foreground = _brush("#1A1A1A")
                    s_tgt.FontSize = 11
                    s_tgt.MaxWidth = 240
                    s_row.Children.Add(s_src)
                    s_row.Children.Add(s_arr)
                    s_row.Children.Add(s_tgt)
                    content.Children.Add(s_row)
                if count > len(samples):
                    content.Children.Add(
                        _tb(u"  + {0:,} more...".format(count - len(samples)),
                            10, "#444", margin=(0, 3, 0, 0)))
                cat_exp.Content = content
                self.pnlResults.Children.Add(cat_exp)
            self.pnlResults.Children.Add(_sep())

        # SKIPPED
        if skip_log:
            self.pnlResults.Children.Add(
                _tb(u"\u26a0  Skipped", 13, "#B54708", True, (0, 4, 0, 4)))
            for reason in sorted(skip_log.keys()):
                cats    = skip_log[reason]
                total_r = sum(cats.values())
                r_exp = _make_exp(reason, total_r, "#B54708")
                content = StackPanel()
                content.Margin = Thickness(0, 4, 0, 6)
                for cat in sorted(cats.keys()):
                    content.Children.Add(_cat_row(cat, cats[cat], "#B54708"))
                r_exp.Content = content
                self.pnlResults.Children.Add(r_exp)
            self.pnlResults.Children.Add(_sep())

        # ERRORS
        if error_log or errors:
            self.pnlResults.Children.Add(
                _tb(u"\u2717  Errors", 13, "#F44747", True, (0, 4, 0, 4)))
            for reason_type in sorted(error_log.keys()):
                cats    = error_log[reason_type]
                total_r = sum(cats.values())
                r_exp = _make_exp(reason_type, total_r, "#F44747")
                content = StackPanel()
                content.Margin = Thickness(0, 4, 0, 6)
                for cat in sorted(cats.keys()):
                    content.Children.Add(_cat_row(cat, cats[cat], "#F44747"))
                r_exp.Content = content
                self.pnlResults.Children.Add(r_exp)
            for err in errors[:20]:
                self.pnlResults.Children.Add(
                    _tb(u"  \u2022  {0}".format(err), 10, "#B54708", margin=(0, 2, 0, 0)))
    def _paint_meta(self, side, info):
        def ctrl(suffix):
            return getattr(self, "txt{0}{1}".format(
                "Left" if side == "left" else "Right", suffix))

        ctrl("DataType").Text = info.get("data_type_label") or u"—"
        ctrl("StorageType").Text = info.get("storage_type_str") or u"—"
        ctrl("Unit").Text = info.get("unit_label") or u"—"
        ctrl("ReadOnly").Text = u"Yes" if info.get("is_read_only") else u"No"
        samples = info.get("sample_values", [])
        ctrl("Samples").Text = u"\n".join(samples) if samples else u"(no values set)"

    def _clear_meta(self, side):
        for suffix in ("DataType", "StorageType", "Unit", "ReadOnly", "Samples"):
            try:
                getattr(self, "txt{0}{1}".format(
                    "Left" if side == "left" else "Right", suffix)).Text = u"—"
            except Exception:
                pass

    def _refresh_preview(self):
        try:
            can_copy = bool(self._src_info and self._tgt_info)
            self.btnCopy.IsEnabled = can_copy

            if not can_copy:
                self.txtPreview.Text = u"(select both parameters to see preview)"
                self.txtWarning.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed
                return

            # Disable copy if target is read-only
            if self._tgt_info.get("is_read_only"):
                self.btnCopy.IsEnabled = False
                self._set_status(
                    u"\u26a0 Target '{0}' is read-only. Copy is disabled.".format(
                        self._tgt_info["name"]))

            preview, warning = build_preview(
                self._src_info, self._tgt_info,
                prefix=self.txtPrefix.Text or u"",
                suffix=self.txtSuffix.Text or u"",
                include_unit=bool(self.chkIncludeUnit.IsChecked))
            self.txtPreview.Text = preview or u"(no preview available)"
            if warning:
                self.txtWarning.Text = warning
                self.txtWarning.Visibility = Visibility.Visible
            else:
                self.txtWarning.Text = u""
                self.txtWarning.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed
        except Exception as _ex:
            self._set_status(u"Preview error: {0}".format(str(_ex)))

    def _set_status(self, msg):
        try:
            self.txtStatus.Text = str(msg)
        except Exception:
            pass


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Entry point
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

try:
    win = ParamCopierWindow()
    win.ShowDialog()
except Exception as _launch_ex:
    forms.alert(
        u"Failed to open Parameter Copier window:\n\n{0}".format(str(_launch_ex)),
        exitscript=True
    )
# Results are displayed in the window's Results tab.
```
