# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
try:
    import telemetry
    telemetry.track_tool_click(__file__)
except Exception:
    pass

__title__ = "RevClouds ➜ Detail Groups"
__doc__ = """Version = 1.4
Date    = 25.02.2026
_____________________________________________________________________
Description:
Select a Revision and a Scope (Sheets only / Views only / ALL).
For each cloud in scope, create an equivalent Detail Group from the
cloud linework.
"""

# ---------------- Imports ----------------
import os
from Autodesk.Revit.DB import *
from Autodesk.Revit.DB import (Transaction, FilteredElementCollector, ElementTransformUtils,
                               CopyPasteOptions, ElementClassFilter, WorksharingUtils,
                               CheckoutStatus)
from pyrevit import forms

import clr
clr.AddReference("System")
from System.Collections.Generic import List

doc   = __revit__.ActiveUIDocument.Document
uidoc = __revit__.ActiveUIDocument
PATH_SCRIPT = os.path.dirname(__file__)

# ---------------- Helpers ----------------
def collect_all_revision_clouds(d):
    return list(FilteredElementCollector(d)
                .OfCategory(BuiltInCategory.OST_RevisionClouds)
                .WhereElementIsNotElementType()
                .ToElements())

def map_revisions_to_clouds(d, clouds):
    rev_to_clouds = {}
    for c in clouds:
        rev_to_clouds.setdefault(c.RevisionId, []).append(c)
    revs = [d.GetElement(rid) for rid in rev_to_clouds.keys() if d.GetElement(rid)]
    revs = [r for r in revs if isinstance(r, Revision)]
    revs.sort(key=lambda r: r.SequenceNumber)
    return rev_to_clouds, revs

class _RevisionItem(object):
    def __init__(self, rev): self.rev = rev
    def __str__(self):
        try:
            num = getattr(self.rev, "RevisionNumber", None) or getattr(self.rev, "Number", "")
        except: num = ""
        try: desc = self.rev.Description or ""
        except: desc = ""
        date_val, iss = "", ""
        try:
            if hasattr(self.rev, "IssuedDate") and self.rev.IssuedDate: date_val = self.rev.IssuedDate
            elif hasattr(self.rev, "RevisionDate") and self.rev.RevisionDate: date_val = self.rev.RevisionDate
        except: pass
        try: iss = "Issued" if self.rev.Issued else "Not Issued"
        except: pass
        parts = [u"[{}]".format(self.rev.SequenceNumber)]
        if num: parts.append(num)
        if desc: parts.append(u"— {}".format(desc))
        tail = []
        if iss: tail.append(iss)
        if date_val: tail.append(date_val)
        if tail: parts.append(u"({})".format(u" ".join(tail)))
        return u" ".join(parts)

def get_line_graphics_styles(d):
    res = []
    lines_cat = d.Settings.Categories.get_Item(BuiltInCategory.OST_Lines)
    if lines_cat:
        for subcat in lines_cat.SubCategories:
            gs = subcat.GetGraphicsStyle(GraphicsStyleType.Projection)
            if gs: res.append(gs)
    res.sort(key=lambda g: g.Name)
    return res

class _GSItem(object):
    def __init__(self, gs): self.gs = gs
    def __str__(self): return self.gs.Name

def safe_element_name(el):
    try:
        nm = el.Name
        if nm: return nm
    except: pass
    try:
        p = el.get_Parameter(BuiltInParameter.ALL_MODEL_TYPE_NAME)
        if p and p.HasValue:
            nm = p.AsString()
            if nm: return nm
    except: pass
    return u""

def unique_group_name(d, desired):
    if not desired: desired = u"Detail Group"
    existing = set()
    for gt in FilteredElementCollector(d).OfClass(GroupType):
        nm = safe_element_name(gt)
        if nm: existing.add(nm)
    if desired not in existing: return desired
    i = 2
    while True:
        cand = u"{} ({})".format(desired, i)
        if cand not in existing: return cand
        i += 1

def group_name_from_context(owner_view, revision):
    num = getattr(revision, "RevisionNumber", None) or getattr(revision, "Number", "")
    suffix = (u" ({})".format(num) if num else u"")
    if isinstance(owner_view, ViewSheet):
        base = u"{} - {}".format(owner_view.SheetNumber, owner_view.Name)
        return u"{} - RevSeq {}{}".format(base, revision.SequenceNumber, suffix)
    return u"{} - RevSeq {}{}".format(owner_view.Name, revision.SequenceNumber, suffix)

def make_group(d, ids_to_group, desired_name):
    ids_net = List[ElementId]()
    for _id in ids_to_group: ids_net.Add(_id)
    grp = d.Create.NewGroup(ids_net)  # detail vs model auto-resolved  # creates Detail Group for detail-only elements
    final_name = unique_group_name(d, desired_name)
    try:
        grp.GroupType.Name = final_name
    except:
        try:
            p = grp.GroupType.get_Parameter(BuiltInParameter.ALL_MODEL_TYPE_NAME)
            if p and not p.IsReadOnly: p.Set(final_name)
        except: pass
    return grp

def ensure_drafting_view_for_sheet(d, sheet):
    base_name = u"Sheet {} - {} - Clouds Staging".format(sheet.SheetNumber, sheet.Name)
    existing = [v for v in FilteredElementCollector(d).OfClass(ViewDrafting)
                if (not v.IsTemplate and v.Name == base_name)]
    if existing: return existing[0]
    vft = None
    for t in FilteredElementCollector(d).OfClass(ViewFamilyType):
        if t.ViewFamily == ViewFamily.Drafting:
            vft = t; break
    if not vft: raise Exception("No Drafting ViewFamilyType found.")
    dv = ViewDrafting.Create(d, vft.Id); dv.Name = base_name
    return dv

def create_detail_lines(d, target_view, curves, gs=None):
    new_ids = []
    for crv in curves:
        try:
            dl = d.Create.NewDetailCurve(target_view, crv)  # requires a 2D graphics view
            if gs:
                try: dl.LineStyle = gs
                except: pass
            new_ids.append(dl.Id)
        except:
            pass
    return new_ids

def set_line_style_for_detail_ids(d, ids_iterable, gs):
    if not gs: return
    for _id in ids_iterable:
        el = d.GetElement(_id)
        if isinstance(el, DetailCurve):
            try: el.LineStyle = gs
            except: pass

def get_cloud_dependent_curve_ids(cloud):
    """Return dependent CurveElement ids owned by the cloud (detail arcs/lines)."""
    return cloud.GetDependentElements(ElementClassFilter(CurveElement))  # IList[ElementId]

def copy_elements_in_view(d, view, ids_to_copy):
    """Duplicate view-specific elements in the SAME view (same place)."""
    ids_net = List[ElementId]()
    for _id in ids_to_copy: ids_net.Add(_id)
    opts = CopyPasteOptions()
    new_ids = ElementTransformUtils.CopyElements(view, ids_net, view, Transform.Identity, opts)
    return list(new_ids)

def copy_group_aligned_between_views(d, source_view, group_element, destination_view):
    ids_net = List[ElementId]()
    ids_net.Add(group_element.Id)
    opts = CopyPasteOptions()
    try:
        new_ids = ElementTransformUtils.CopyElements(source_view, ids_net, destination_view, Transform.Identity, opts)
        return [d.GetElement(nid) for nid in new_ids if isinstance(d.GetElement(nid), Group)]
    except:
        return []

def is_owned_by_other(d, el):
    """Check ownership; return (True/False, owner string). Must be called outside a transaction."""
    if el is None: return (False, u"")
    try:
        owner_ref = clr.Referencestr
        status = WorksharingUtils.GetCheckoutStatus(d, el.Id, owner_ref)  # cached, but OK for reporting  [8](https://help.autodesk.com/cloudhelp/2026/ENU/Revit-API-MainReference/files/html/8359bb9a-01d2-d595-c72b-718c70841511.htm)
        owner = owner_ref if isinstance(owner_ref, basestring) else owner_ref.Value
        # enum values: OwnedByCurrentUser, OwnedByOtherUser, NotOwned   [2](https://help.autodesk.com/cloudhelp/2026/ENU/Revit-API-MainReference/files/html/f6f6e300-5a37-7e44-7ee1-8dc0c016778a.htm)
        return (status == CheckoutStatus.OwnedByOtherUser, owner or u"(unknown)")
    except:
        return (False, u"")

# ---------------- Main ----------------
if __name__ == '__main__':
    clouds = collect_all_revision_clouds(doc)
    if not clouds: forms.alert("No Revision Clouds in this document.", exitscript=True)

    rev_to_clouds, revisions = map_revisions_to_clouds(doc, clouds)
    if not revisions: forms.alert("No Revisions with clouds found.", exitscript=True)

    # Scope selector
    scope_choice = forms.SelectFromList.show(
        ["Sheets only", "Views only", "ALL"],
        title="Scope for Conversion",
        button_name="Use Scope",
        multiselect=False
    )
    if not scope_choice: forms.alert("Cancelled.", exitscript=True)
    if isinstance(scope_choice, list): scope_choice = scope_choice[0]
    scope_choice = scope_choice.strip().lower()

    rev_pick = forms.SelectFromList.show([_RevisionItem(r) for r in revisions],
                                         title="Pick Revision (with clouds)", button_name="Select", multiselect=False)
    if not rev_pick: forms.alert("Cancelled.", exitscript=True)
    if isinstance(rev_pick, list): rev_pick = rev_pick[0]
    selected_revision = getattr(rev_pick, 'rev', rev_pick)

    target = rev_to_clouds.get(selected_revision.Id, [])
    if scope_choice == "sheets only":
        target = [c for c in target if isinstance(doc.GetElement(c.OwnerViewId), ViewSheet)]
    elif scope_choice == "views only":
        target = [c for c in target if not isinstance(doc.GetElement(c.OwnerViewId), ViewSheet)]

    if not target:
        forms.alert("No clouds match the chosen scope for the selected revision.", exitscript=True)

    # Ownership precheck (outside transaction) for each target cloud and its owner view
    ownership_skips = []  # tuples of (cloudId, ownerViewName, ownerUser)
    runnable_clouds = []
    for cloud in target:
        owner_view = doc.GetElement(cloud.OwnerViewId)
        owned_other_cloud, cloud_owner = is_owned_by_other(doc, cloud)
        owned_other_view,  view_owner  = is_owned_by_other(doc, owner_view)

        if owned_other_cloud:
            ownership_skips.append((cloud.Id.IntegerValue,
                                    owner_view.Name if owner_view else u"(no view)",
                                    cloud_owner))
            continue
        if owned_other_view:
            ownership_skips.append((cloud.Id.IntegerValue,
                                    owner_view.Name if owner_view else u"(no view)",
                                    view_owner))
            continue

        runnable_clouds.append(cloud)

    if not runnable_clouds and ownership_skips:
        # Nothing to run; show message and exit
        skip_lines = [u"Cloud Id {} on '{}' (owner: {})".format(cid, vname, own) for (cid, vname, own) in ownership_skips]
        forms.alert("All clouds in scope are owned by other users and were skipped:\n\n" + u"\n".join(skip_lines),
                    title="Clouds ➜ Detail Groups | Ownership", warn_icon=True, exitscript=True)

    # Optional Line Style
    gs_list = get_line_graphics_styles(doc)
    gs_default = next((gs for gs in gs_list if gs.Name.lower() == "thin lines"), None)
    gs_item = forms.SelectFromList.show([_GSItem(gs) for gs in gs_list],
                                        title="Choose Line Style for NEW Detail Lines (optional)",
                                        button_name="Use This Style", multiselect=False,
                                        default=(_GSItem(gs_default) if gs_default else None))
    chosen_gs = getattr(gs_item, 'gs', None) if gs_item else None

    made_groups, fallback_makes, skips = 0, 0, 0

    t = Transaction(doc, __title__)
    t.Start()
    try:
        for cloud in runnable_clouds:
            owner_view = doc.GetElement(cloud.OwnerViewId)
            if owner_view is None:
                skips += 1; continue

            grp_name = group_name_from_context(owner_view, selected_revision)

            # Strategy 1: duplicate dependent detail curves in-place
            dep_ids = get_cloud_dependent_curve_ids(cloud)
            if dep_ids and (hasattr(dep_ids, "Count") and dep_ids.Count > 0):
                new_ids = copy_elements_in_view(doc, owner_view, dep_ids)    # perfect alignment
                set_line_style_for_detail_ids(doc, new_ids, chosen_gs)      # optional restyle
                make_group(doc, new_ids, grp_name)
                made_groups += 1
                continue

            # Strategy 2: fallback via GetSketchCurves()
            try:
                curves = list(cloud.GetSketchCurves())
            except:
                skips += 1; continue

            if isinstance(owner_view, ViewSheet):
                try:
                    staging = ensure_drafting_view_for_sheet(doc, owner_view)
                except:
                    skips += 1; continue

                new_line_ids = create_detail_lines(doc, staging, curves, gs=chosen_gs)
                if not new_line_ids:
                    skips += 1; continue

                staging_grp = make_group(doc, new_line_ids, grp_name)
                pasted = copy_group_aligned_between_views(doc, staging, staging_grp, owner_view)
                try: doc.Delete(staging_grp.Id)
                except: pass

                if not pasted:
                    skips += 1; continue

                fallback_makes += 1

            else:
                new_line_ids = create_detail_lines(doc, owner_view, curves, gs=chosen_gs)
                if not new_line_ids:
                    skips += 1; continue
                make_group(doc, new_line_ids, grp_name)
                fallback_makes += 1

        # KEEP original clouds (no deletions)

    finally:
        t.Commit()

    num = getattr(selected_revision, "RevisionNumber", getattr(selected_revision, "Number", ""))
    # Compose ownership skip summary
    own_summary = ""
    if ownership_skips:
        lines = [u"• Cloud Id {} on '{}' (owner: {})".format(cid, vname, own) for (cid, vname, own) in ownership_skips]
        own_summary = u"\n\nSkipped (ownership): {}\n{}".format(len(ownership_skips), u"\n".join(lines))

    forms.alert(
        "Scope: {}\nRevision: [Seq {}] {}\nGroups created (direct): {}\nGroups created (fallback): {}\nOther skips: {}{}\n\nOriginal clouds have been kept."
        .format(scope_choice.upper(), selected_revision.SequenceNumber, num,
                made_groups, fallback_makes, skips, own_summary),
        title="Clouds ➜ Detail Groups | Completed",
        warn_icon=False
    )
```

# RevClouds to Detail Groups

## Purpose
Create detail-group equivalents of revision cloud linework for a selected revision and scope.

## Entry Points
- `script.py`

## Owning Dependencies
- Local revision-cloud collection, graphics-style selection, and copy/group logic in `script.py`

## Critical Constraints
- Preserve the revision-to-cloud mapping and scope selection workflow.
- Keep worksharing and copy/paste safety checks intact before creating detail groups.
- Maintain style-selection behavior so generated detail linework remains readable.

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
try:
    import telemetry
    telemetry.track_tool_click(__file__)
except Exception:
    pass

__title__ = "Elements by Level"
__doc__ = """Version = 1.1
Date    = 23.02.2026
_____________________________________________________________________
Description:
Select a Level and list all elements associated with it, grouped by
Category and sorted by Type Name. Outputs linkified rows to let you
zoom/select items directly from the report.
"""

# ╦╔╦╗╔═╗╔═╗╦═╗╔╦╗╔═╗
# ║║║║╠═╝║ ║╠╦╝ ║ ╚═╗
# ╩╩ ╩╩  ╚═╝╩╚═ ╩ ╚═╝
# ==================================================
# Regular + Autodesk
import os, sys
from Autodesk.Revit.DB import *
from Autodesk.Revit.DB import Transaction, FilteredElementCollector, ElementLevelFilter

# pyRevit
from pyrevit import revit, forms

try:
    from GUI.style_guide_2026 import (
        apply_window_contract,
        apply_topmost_and_parent,
        apply_style_guide_resources,
    )
except Exception:
    def apply_window_contract(window):
        return

    def apply_topmost_and_parent(window):
        return

    def apply_style_guide_resources(window):
        return

# .NET Imports
import clr
clr.AddReference("System")
clr.AddReference("PresentationFramework")
clr.AddReference("PresentationCore")
clr.AddReference("WindowsBase")
import System
from System.Collections.Generic import List
from System.Windows import Window, Thickness, GridLength, GridUnitType, Visibility
from System.Windows.Controls import (
    StackPanel, Grid, ColumnDefinition,
    TextBlock, Button, Expander
)
from System.Windows.Controls import Orientation as ControlOrientation
from System.Windows.Media import Brushes, SolidColorBrush, Color, BrushConverter
from System.Windows.Input import MouseButtonState
import wpf

# ╦  ╦╔═╗╦═╗╦╔═╗╔╗ ╦  ╔═╗╔═╗
# ╚╗╔╝╠═╣╠╦╝║╠═╣╠╩╗║  ║╣ ╚═╗
#  ╚╝ ╩ ╩╩╚═╩╩ ╩╚═╝╩═╝╚═╝╚═╝ 
# ==================================================
doc   = __revit__.ActiveUIDocument.Document
uidoc = __revit__.ActiveUIDocument
app   = __revit__.Application
PATH_SCRIPT = os.path.dirname(__file__)
_BRUSH_CONVERTER = BrushConverter()


def _brush(hex_value):
    return _BRUSH_CONVERTER.ConvertFromString(hex_value)

# Toggle options (extend as needed)
INCLUDE_VIEW_SPECIFIC = False      # include view-specific elements if True
INCLUDE_ANNOTATION    = False      # include annotation categories if True

# ╔═╗╦ ╦╔╗╔╔═╗╔╦╗╦╔═╗╔╗╔╔═╗
# ╠╣ ║ ║║║║║   ║ ║║ ║║║║╚═╗
# ╚  ╚═╝╝╚╝╚═╝ ╩ ╩╚═╝╝╚╝╚═╝ 
# ==================================================
def get_all_levels_sorted_by_elevation(revit_doc):
    """Return list of Level elements sorted by elevation then name."""
    levels = list(FilteredElementCollector(revit_doc).OfClass(Level))
    levels.sort(key=lambda lvl: (lvl.Elevation, lvl.Name))
    return levels

def extract_wrapped(obj):
    """Handle pyRevit SelectFromList returning wrapper or raw object."""
    if hasattr(obj, 'WrappedElement'):
        return obj.WrappedElement
    return obj

def get_type_name_for_element(revit_doc, element):
    """Robustly get Type Name for any element."""
    try:
        type_id = element.GetTypeId()
        if type_id and type_id != ElementId.InvalidElementId:
            type_elem = revit_doc.GetElement(type_id)
            if type_elem:
                param = type_elem.get_Parameter(BuiltInParameter.SYMBOL_NAME_PARAM)
                if param and param.HasValue:
                    return param.AsString()
                if hasattr(type_elem, "Name") and type_elem.Name:
                    return type_elem.Name
        if hasattr(element, "Symbol") and element.Symbol and hasattr(element.Symbol, "Name"):
            return element.Symbol.Name
    except:
        pass
    return "<No Type>"

def is_annotation_category(cat):
    """Return True if the category is annotation; stable across Revit versions."""
    try:
        if cat is None:
            return False
        return cat.CategoryType == CategoryType.Annotation
    except:
        return False

def param_equals_level_id(elem, built_in_param, level_id):
    """Return True if elem has built_in_param and it equals level_id."""
    try:
        p = elem.get_Parameter(built_in_param)
        if p and p.HasValue:
            pid = p.AsElementId()
            return pid == level_id
    except:
        pass
    return False

def collect_elements_on_level(revit_doc, target_level):
    """
    Collect elements associated to target_level.

    Primary: ElementLevelFilter (fast)
    Supplemental: Rooms and MEP Spaces by LevelId
    Extra pass: Parameter-based match for categories often missed by ElementLevelFilter:
        - LEVEL_PARAM / INSTANCE_REFERENCE_LEVEL_PARAM
        - WALL_BASE_CONSTRAINT
        - STAIR base/railing reference level (defensive)
    """
    level_id = target_level.Id
    result_ids = set()

    # 1) Primary model elements via ElementLevelFilter (excludes element types)
    lvl_filter = ElementLevelFilter(level_id)
    base_collector = (FilteredElementCollector(revit_doc)
                      .WherePasses(lvl_filter)
                      .WhereElementIsNotElementType())

    for el in base_collector:
        if not INCLUDE_VIEW_SPECIFIC and getattr(el, "ViewSpecific", False):
            continue
        cat = el.Category
        if cat and (not INCLUDE_ANNOTATION) and is_annotation_category(cat):
            continue
        result_ids.add(el.Id.IntegerValue)

    # 2) Rooms and MEP Spaces (SpatialElements) sometimes missed
    for rm in FilteredElementCollector(revit_doc).OfCategory(BuiltInCategory.OST_Rooms).WhereElementIsNotElementType():
        try:
            if rm.LevelId == level_id:
                result_ids.add(rm.Id.IntegerValue)
        except:
            pass
    try:
        for sp in FilteredElementCollector(revit_doc).OfCategory(BuiltInCategory.OST_MEPSpaces).WhereElementIsNotElementType():
            try:
                if sp.LevelId == level_id:
                    result_ids.add(sp.Id.IntegerValue)
            except:
                pass
    except:
        # Not all disciplines expose MEP Spaces; ignore gracefully
        pass

    # 3) Supplemental pass: parameter-based matching
    # Scan all instance elements (non-types) and match against common level params
    candidate_elems = FilteredElementCollector(revit_doc).WhereElementIsNotElementType()
    for el in candidate_elems:
        if el.Id.IntegerValue in result_ids:
            continue
        cat = el.Category
        if cat is None:
            continue
        if not INCLUDE_ANNOTATION and is_annotation_category(cat):
            continue
        if not INCLUDE_VIEW_SPECIFIC and getattr(el, "ViewSpecific", False):
            continue

        matched = False

        # Generic level parameters
        if not matched and param_equals_level_id(el, BuiltInParameter.LEVEL_PARAM, level_id):
            matched = True
        if not matched and param_equals_level_id(el, BuiltInParameter.INSTANCE_REFERENCE_LEVEL_PARAM, level_id):
            matched = True

        # Walls: Base Constraint
        if not matched and param_equals_level_id(el, BuiltInParameter.WALL_BASE_CONSTRAINT, level_id):
            matched = True

        # Stairs family (defensive against missing enums across versions)
        if not matched:
            try:
                if param_equals_level_id(el, BuiltInParameter.STAIRS_BASE_LEVEL_PARAM, level_id):
                    matched = True
            except:
                pass
        if not matched:
            try:
                if param_equals_level_id(el, BuiltInParameter.STAIRS_RAILING_REFERENCE_LEVEL, level_id):
                    matched = True
            except:
                pass

        if matched:
            result_ids.add(el.Id.IntegerValue)

    # Re-materialize as elements
    elements = []
    for int_id in result_ids:
        el = revit_doc.GetElement(ElementId(int_id))
        if el:
            elements.append(el)

    return elements

def build_grouped_dict(revit_doc, elements):
    """
    Group and sort elements by category.
    Returns OrderedDict-like list of (cat_name, [(elem, type_name), ...]) tuples,
    sorted by category name; within each group sorted by type name then element id.
    """
    grouped = {}
    for el in elements:
        cat_name = u"<No Category>"
        if el.Category and el.Category.Name:
            cat_name = el.Category.Name
        grouped.setdefault(cat_name, []).append(el)

    result = []
    for cat_name in sorted(grouped.keys(), key=lambda n: n.lower()):
        cat_elems = grouped[cat_name]
        cat_elems.sort(key=lambda e: (get_type_name_for_element(revit_doc, e).lower(), e.Id.IntegerValue))
        rows = [(el, get_type_name_for_element(revit_doc, el)) for el in cat_elems]
        result.append((cat_name, rows))
    return result

# ╦ ╦╔═╗╔═╗  ╦ ╦╦╔╗╔╔╦╗╔═╗╦ ╦
# ╠╣ ╠═╝╠╣   ║║║║║║║ ║║║ ║║║║
# ╚  ╩  ╚    ╚╩╝╩╝╚╝═╩╝╚═╝╚╩╝
# ==================================================
class SelectByLevelWindow(Window):
    """Modal WPF results window for SelectbyLevel.

    After ShowDialog() the caller should check self.pending_ids:
      - None  → user closed without a selection action
      - list  → ElementIds to select (and zoom to) in Revit
    """

    def __init__(self, level_name, grouped_data):
        """grouped_data: list of (cat_name, [(elem, type_name), ...]) tuples."""
        path_xaml = os.path.join(PATH_SCRIPT, "SelectByLevelWindow.xaml")
        wpf.LoadComponent(self, path_xaml)
        apply_style_guide_resources(self)
        apply_window_contract(self)
        apply_topmost_and_parent(self)

        self.pending_ids = None  # set by selection buttons before Close()
        self._all_ids = []       # flat list of all ElementIds

        # Populate header
        total = sum(len(rows) for _, rows in grouped_data)
        cat_count = len(grouped_data)
        self.TxtTitle.Text = u"Elements on {}".format(level_name)
        self.TxtSummary.Text = u"{} elements across {} categor{}".format(
            total, cat_count, "y" if cat_count == 1 else "ies"
        )

        # Footer buttons
        self.BtnSelectAll.Click += self._on_select_all
        self.BtnClose.Click     += self._on_close

        # Build category expanders
        for cat_name, rows in grouped_data:
            cat_ids = [r[0].Id for r in rows]
            self._all_ids.extend(cat_ids)
            self.CategoryPanel.Children.Add(
                self._build_category_block(cat_name, rows, cat_ids)
            )

    # ── builders ────────────────────────────────────────────────

    def _build_category_block(self, cat_name, rows, cat_ids):
        """Return an Expander for one category."""
        expander = Expander()
        expander.IsExpanded = True
        expander.Margin = Thickness(0, 0, 0, 10)
        expander.Background = _brush("#FFFBFE")

        # ── Expander header ──
        header = StackPanel()
        header.Orientation = ControlOrientation.Horizontal
        header.Margin = Thickness(4, 4, 4, 4)

        lbl_name = TextBlock()
        lbl_name.Text = cat_name
        lbl_name.FontWeight = System.Windows.FontWeights.Bold
        lbl_name.Foreground = _brush("#1A1A1A")
        lbl_name.VerticalAlignment = System.Windows.VerticalAlignment.Center
        lbl_name.Margin = Thickness(0, 0, 8, 0)
        header.Children.Add(lbl_name)

        lbl_count = TextBlock()
        lbl_count.Text = u"({} element{})".format(len(rows), "" if len(rows) == 1 else "s")
        lbl_count.Foreground = _brush("#8A8F98")
        lbl_count.VerticalAlignment = System.Windows.VerticalAlignment.Center
        lbl_count.Margin = Thickness(0, 0, 12, 0)
        lbl_count.FontSize = 11
        header.Children.Add(lbl_count)

        btn_cat = Button()
        btn_cat.Content = "Select All"
        btn_cat.Tag = cat_ids
        btn_cat.Click += self._on_select_category
        btn_cat.Style = self.FindResource("BtnCatSelect")
        header.Children.Add(btn_cat)

        expander.Header = header

        # ── Expander body: element rows ──
        body = StackPanel()
        body.Margin = Thickness(14, 2, 4, 6)

        for elem, type_name in rows:
            body.Children.Add(self._build_element_row(elem, type_name))

        expander.Content = body
        return expander

    def _build_element_row(self, elem, type_name):
        """Return a Grid row for a single element."""
        row = Grid()
        row.Margin = Thickness(0, 1, 0, 1)

        col0 = ColumnDefinition()
        col0.Width = GridLength(1, GridUnitType.Star)
        col1 = ColumnDefinition()
        col1.Width = GridLength(110)
        col2 = ColumnDefinition()
        col2.Width = GridLength(68)
        row.ColumnDefinitions.Add(col0)
        row.ColumnDefinitions.Add(col1)
        row.ColumnDefinitions.Add(col2)

        lbl_type = TextBlock()
        lbl_type.Text = u"{}".format(type_name)
        lbl_type.VerticalAlignment = System.Windows.VerticalAlignment.Center
        lbl_type.TextTrimming = System.Windows.TextTrimming.CharacterEllipsis
        lbl_type.Foreground = _brush("#1A1A1A")
        lbl_type.FontSize = 11
        Grid.SetColumn(lbl_type, 0)
        row.Children.Add(lbl_type)

        lbl_id = TextBlock()
        lbl_id.Text = u"{}".format(elem.Id.IntegerValue)
        lbl_id.VerticalAlignment = System.Windows.VerticalAlignment.Center
        lbl_id.Foreground = _brush("#1F4FD9")
        lbl_id.FontSize = 11
        Grid.SetColumn(lbl_id, 1)
        row.Children.Add(lbl_id)

        btn = Button()
        btn.Content = "Select"
        btn.Tag = elem.Id
        btn.Click += self._on_select_element
        btn.Style = self.FindResource("BtnElemSelect")
        Grid.SetColumn(btn, 2)
        row.Children.Add(btn)

        return row

    # ── event handlers ───────────────────────────────────────────

    def _on_select_all(self, sender, e):
        self.pending_ids = list(self._all_ids)
        self.Close()

    def _on_select_category(self, sender, e):
        self.pending_ids = list(sender.Tag)
        self.Close()

    def _on_select_element(self, sender, e):
        self.pending_ids = [sender.Tag]
        self.Close()

    def _on_close(self, sender, e):
        self.Close()


# ╔╦╗╔═╗╦╔╗╔
# ║║║╠═╣║║║║
# ╩ ╩╩ ╩╩╝╚╝ 
# ==================================================
if __name__ == '__main__':

    # 1) Ask user to pick a Level
    all_levels = get_all_levels_sorted_by_elevation(doc)
    if not all_levels:
        forms.alert("No Levels found in this document.", title=__title__, warn_icon=True)
        sys.exit()

    # Build list with elevation shown (legacy/new Units API guarded)
    level_items = []
    for lvl in all_levels:
        elev_str = None
        try:
            elev_val = UnitUtils.ConvertFromInternalUnits(lvl.Elevation, DisplayUnitType.DUT_METERS)
            elev_str = "{:.3f} m".format(elev_val)
        except:
            try:
                elev_str = "{:.3f}".format(lvl.Elevation)
            except:
                elev_str = "{}".format(lvl.Elevation)
        level_items.append({"label": "{}  |  {}".format(lvl.Name, elev_str), "level": lvl})

    class LevelListItem(object):
        def __init__(self, display_name, level):
            self.Display = display_name
            self.Level = level
        def __str__(self):
            return self.Display

    selectables = [LevelListItem(li["label"], li["level"]) for li in level_items]

    selected_item = forms.SelectFromList.show(
        selectables,
        title="Select Level",
        multiselect=False,
        name_attr="Display"
    )

    if not selected_item:
        forms.alert("No Level selected. Operation cancelled.", title=__title__)
        sys.exit()

    selected_level = extract_wrapped(getattr(selected_item, "Level", selected_item))

    # 2) Collect elements associated to selected level
    elements_on_level = collect_elements_on_level(doc, selected_level)

    if not elements_on_level:
        forms.alert(
            "No elements associated with {} were found.".format(selected_level.Name),
            title=__title__,
            warn_icon=True
        )
        sys.exit()

    # 3) Build grouped data and show WPF results window
    grouped_data = build_grouped_dict(doc, elements_on_level)
    win = SelectByLevelWindow(selected_level.Name, grouped_data)
    win.ShowDialog()

    # 4) Apply any pending selection action after dialog closes
    if win.pending_ids:
        id_list = List[ElementId](win.pending_ids)
        try:
            uidoc.Selection.SetElementIds(id_list)
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            uidoc.ShowElements(id_list)
        except Exception:
            pass
```

## FUNCTIONS: []
## CLASSES: []
```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
__title__ = "Grids: Set 3D (Fast)"

from Autodesk.Revit.DB import *
from pyrevit import script

doc = __revit__.ActiveUIDocument.Document
view = doc.ActiveView

# ---- Safety guard ----
if not view or not view.CanBePrinted:
    script.exit()

# ---- Collect visible grids ----
grids = list(
    FilteredElementCollector(doc, view.Id)
    .OfClass(Grid)
    .WhereElementIsNotElementType()
)

if not grids:
    script.exit()

# ---- Run in a batch transaction group to minimize regeneration ----
tg = TransactionGroup(doc, __title__)
tg.Start()

t = Transaction(doc, "Apply 3D Extents")
t.Start()

target = DatumExtentType.Model

for g in grids:
    try:
        # Apply directly (fastest: no checking)
        g.SetDatumExtentType(DatumEnds.End0, view, target)
        g.SetDatumExtentType(DatumEnds.End1, view, target)
    except:
        # Skip problematic grids silently
        pass

t.Commit()
tg.Assimilate()
```

## FILE_START: RBG_SYD_Tools.tab/RBG Tools_Views.panel/ShiftClick1.stack/LevelHeadSwitcher.pushbutton/config.py
## META: sha1=e10f69d9bae91cfa8b4c6987c3119fbe9c8397f2 size=2423
## TYPE: text
## IMPORTS: ["Autodesk.Revit.DB","pyrevit"]
## FUNCTIONS: ["_pick_level_line_in_view","_classify_left_right_end"]
## CLASSES: []
```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
__title__ = "Levels: Head Switcher (Right)"
from Autodesk.Revit.DB import *
from pyrevit import script

doc  = __revit__.ActiveUIDocument.Document
view = doc.ActiveView

# ---- Safety guards: printable + Section/Elevation only ----
if not view or not view.CanBePrinted:
    script.exit()
if not isinstance(view, ViewSection) or view.ViewType not in (ViewType.Section, ViewType.Elevation):
    script.exit()

# ---- Collect only levels visible in the active view ----
levels = list(
    FilteredElementCollector(doc, view.Id)
    .OfClass(Level)
    .WhereElementIsNotElementType()
)
if not levels:
    script.exit()

def _pick_level_line_in_view(lvl, v):
    """Return the visible Line for the level in this view without changing extents."""
    for extent in (DatumExtentType.ViewSpecific, DatumExtentType.Model):
        try:
            curves = lvl.GetCurvesInView(extent, v)  # DatumPlane.GetCurvesInView
        except:
            curves = None
        if curves:
            best, best_len = None, -1.0
            for c in curves:
                if isinstance(c, Line):
                    L = c.ApproximateLength
                    if L > best_len:
                        best, best_len = c, L
            if best:
                return best
    return None

def _classify_left_right_end(line, v):
    """
    Map 'left'/'right' to DatumEnds for THIS view using v.RightDirection.
    Smaller projection => left; larger => right.
    """
    start = line.GetEndPoint(0)
    end   = line.GetEndPoint(1)
    origin = v.Origin
    right  = v.RightDirection
    x0 = (start - origin).DotProduct(right)
    x1 = (end   - origin).DotProduct(right)
    if x0 <= x1:
        return (DatumEnds.End0, DatumEnds.End1)
    else:
        return (DatumEnds.End1, DatumEnds.End0)

# ---- Transaction: Right bubble ONLY (hide left) ----
t = Transaction(doc, "Levels: Right bubble only")
t.Start()
for lvl in levels:
    try:
        line = _pick_level_line_in_view(lvl, view)
        if not line:
            continue
        left_end, right_end = _classify_left_right_end(line, view)
        try: lvl.ShowBubbleInView(right_end, view)    # DatumPlane.ShowBubbleInView
        except: pass
        try: lvl.HideBubbleInView(left_end, view)     # DatumPlane.HideBubbleInView
        except: pass
    except:
        pass
t.Commit()
```
## FILE_END: RBG_SYD_Tools.tab/RBG Tools_Views.panel/ShiftClick1.stack/LevelHeadSwitcher.pushbutton/config.py

```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
__title__ = "Levels: Set 3D (Fast) (Sections & Elevations)"

from Autodesk.Revit.DB import *
from pyrevit import script

doc = __revit__.ActiveUIDocument.Document
view = doc.ActiveView

# ---- Safety guards: printable + Section/Elevation only ----
if not view or not view.CanBePrinted:
    script.exit()
if not isinstance(view, ViewSection) or view.ViewType not in (ViewType.Section, ViewType.Elevation):
    script.exit()

# ---- Collect only levels visible in the active view ----
levels = list(
    FilteredElementCollector(doc, view.Id)
    .OfClass(Level)
    .WhereElementIsNotElementType()
)
if not levels:
    script.exit()

tg = TransactionGroup(doc, __title__)
tg.Start()

t = Transaction(doc, "Apply 3D Extents to Levels")
t.Start()

to_model = DatumExtentType.Model
to_2d = DatumExtentType.ViewSpecific

for lvl in levels:
    # Try direct flip to Model first (fast path)
    changed = False
    for end in (DatumEnds.End0, DatumEnds.End1):
        try:
            lvl.SetDatumExtentType(end, view, to_model)
            changed = True
        except:
            # Some stubborn cases ignore direct Model; we'll nudge below
            pass

    # If neither end reported change (often means calls were ignored),
    # nudge to 2D, then back to 3D per end to "unstick" the datum.
    if not changed:
        for end in (DatumEnds.End0, DatumEnds.End1):
            try:
                lvl.SetDatumExtentType(end, view, to_2d)
            except:
                pass
        for end in (DatumEnds.End0, DatumEnds.End1):
            try:
                lvl.SetDatumExtentType(end, view, to_model)
            except:
                pass

t.Commit()
tg.Assimilate()
```

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
try:
    import telemetry
    telemetry.track_tool_click(__file__)
except Exception:
    pass

__title__ = "Levels: Set 2D Extents (Sections & Elevations)"

from Autodesk.Revit.DB import *
from pyrevit import script

doc = __revit__.ActiveUIDocument.Document
view = doc.ActiveView

# ---- Safety guards: printable + Section/Elevation only ----
if not view or not view.CanBePrinted:
    script.exit()
if not isinstance(view, ViewSection) or view.ViewType not in (ViewType.Section, ViewType.Elevation):
    script.exit()

# ---- Collect only levels visible in the active view ----
levels = list(
    FilteredElementCollector(doc, view.Id)
    .OfClass(Level)
    .WhereElementIsNotElementType()
)
if not levels:
    script.exit()

# ---- Batch transaction group to minimize regeneration ----
tg = TransactionGroup(doc, __title__)
tg.Start()

t = Transaction(doc, "Apply 2D Extents to Levels")
t.Start()
target = DatumExtentType.ViewSpecific  # 2D in this view

for lvl in levels:
    # Fast path like your Grid tool: set both ends, skip if any complaint
    try:
        lvl.SetDatumExtentType(DatumEnds.End0, view, target)
    except:
        pass
    try:
        lvl.SetDatumExtentType(DatumEnds.End1, view, target)
    except:
        pass

t.Commit()
tg.Assimilate()
```

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
try:
    import telemetry
    telemetry.track_tool_click(__file__)
except Exception:
    pass

__title__   = "Crop Views\nQuick Off"
__doc__     = """Version = 1.0
________________________________________________________________
Description:

Turn Crop Region Visibility (Off Only!)

For the Active View
OR
For ALL Views in the Active Sheet.

________________________________________________________________
"""

# ╦╔╦╗╔═╗╔═╗╦═╗╔╦╗╔═╗
# ║║║║╠═╝║ ║╠╦╝ ║ ╚═╗
# ╩╩ ╩╩  ╚═╝╩╚═ ╩ ╚═╝
#==================================================
from Autodesk.Revit.DB import *
from Autodesk.Revit.UI.Selection import ObjectType

from pyrevit import revit, DB, script, forms
from pyrevit.framework import List

#.NET Imports
import clr
clr.AddReference('System')
from System.Collections.Generic import List


# ╦  ╦╔═╗╦═╗╦╔═╗╔╗ ╦  ╔═╗╔═╗
# ╚╗╔╝╠═╣╠╦╝║╠═╣╠╩╗║  ║╣ ╚═╗
#  ╚╝ ╩ ╩╩╚═╩╩ ╩╚═╝╩═╝╚═╝╚═╝
#==================================================
app    = __revit__.Application
uidoc  = __revit__.ActiveUIDocument
doc    = __revit__.ActiveUIDocument.Document #type:Document


# ╔╦╗╔═╗╦╔╗╔
# ║║║╠═╣║║║║
# ╩ ╩╩ ╩╩╝╚╝
#==================================================

output = script.get_output()

try:
    sheet = doc.ActiveView
    if isinstance(sheet, ViewSheet):
        t = Transaction(doc, 'Toggle Crop Region Visibility - Sheet')
        t.Start()

        views_on_sheet = sheet.GetAllPlacedViews()
        for v_id in views_on_sheet:
            view = doc.GetElement(v_id)
            if hasattr(view, 'CropBoxVisible'):
                view.CropBoxVisible = 0
            else:
                output.print_md("### ⚠️ View '{}' does not support Crop Region visibility toggle.".format(view.Name))
        t.Commit()
    else:
        view = doc.ActiveView
        if hasattr(view, 'CropBoxVisible'):
            t = Transaction(doc, 'Toggle Crop Region Visibility - View')
            t.Start()

            view.CropBoxVisible = 0

            t.Commit()
        else:
            output.print_md("### ⚠️ The active view does not support Crop Region visibility toggle.")
except Exception as e:
    output.print_md("### ❌ Error has occurred:")
    import traceback
    output.print_md("```\n{}\n```".format(traceback.format_exc()))
```
