    def _get_element_line_filter_text(self):
        try:
            return (self.tbElementLineFilter.Text or "").strip().lower()
        except Exception:
            return ""

    def _get_element_line_bucket_mm(self):
        parsed = try_parse_positive_float(getattr(self.tbElementLineBucketMm, "Text", ""), 2000.0)
        return parsed if parsed else 2000.0

    def _get_selected_element_line_keys(self):
        keys = set()
        try:
            for item in self.lbElementLineGroups.SelectedItems:
                value = getattr(item, "Value", None)
                if value is not None:
                    keys.add(str(value))
        except Exception:
            pass
        return keys

    def _set_element_line_items_with_preserve(self, items, selected_keys):
        self._set_choice_items_with_preserve(self.lbElementLineGroups, items, selected_keys)

    def _element_line_mark(self, element_row):
        mark = (getattr(element_row, "RbgMark", "") or "").strip()
        if mark:
            return mark
        type_name = (getattr(element_row, "TypeName", "") or "").strip()
        if type_name:
            return type_name
        try:
            return "ID-{0}".format(int(getattr(element_row, "ElementId", 0)))
        except Exception:
            return "UNNAMED"

    def _element_line_xy_bucket_key(self, scope_frame, bucket_mm=2000.0):
        if not scope_frame or not getattr(scope_frame, "Center", None):
            return "0:0", "?"
        bucket_ft = max(mm_to_ft(bucket_mm), EPS)
        x_idx = int(round(float(scope_frame.Center.X) / bucket_ft))
        y_idx = int(round(float(scope_frame.Center.Y) / bucket_ft))
        return "{0}:{1}".format(x_idx, y_idx), "{0},{1}".format(x_idx, y_idx)

    def _build_element_line_groups(self, selected_element_rows):
        groups = {}
        bucket_mm = self._get_element_line_bucket_mm()
        line_filter = self._get_element_line_filter_text()
        for item in selected_element_rows:
            element = getattr(item, "Element", None)
            if not element:
                continue

            try:
                element_id = element.Id.IntegerValue
            except Exception:
                continue

            scope_frame = self.scope_frames.get(element_id)
            if not scope_frame:
                continue

            category = (getattr(item, "CategoryName", "") or "").strip() or "Element"
            mark = self._element_line_mark(item)
            xy_key, xy_label = self._element_line_xy_bucket_key(scope_frame, bucket_mm)

            if line_filter:
                haystack = u"{0} {1} {2} {3}".format(
                    category,
                    mark,
                    getattr(item, "TypeName", "") or "",
                    xy_label
                ).lower()
                if line_filter not in haystack:
                    continue

            group_key = u"{0}|{1}|{2}".format(category, mark, xy_key)

            if group_key not in groups:
                groups[group_key] = {
                    "key": group_key,
                    "category": category,
                    "mark": mark,
                    "xy_label": xy_label,
                    "items": [],
                    "levels": {},
                    "frames": []
                }

            data = groups[group_key]
            data["items"].append(item)
            data["frames"].append(scope_frame)

            primary_level = self._get_primary_level_for_element_row(item, scope_frame)
            if primary_level is not None:
                try:
                    data["levels"][primary_level.Id.IntegerValue] = primary_level
                except Exception:
                    pass

        return groups

    def _get_primary_level_for_element_row(self, element_row, scope_frame):
        base_name = (getattr(element_row, "BaseConstraint", "") or "").strip()
        top_name = (getattr(element_row, "TopConstraint", "") or "").strip()

        if base_name:
            level = self._find_level_by_name(base_name)
            if level is not None:
                return level

        if top_name:
            level = self._find_level_by_name(top_name)
            if level is not None:
                return level

        fallback = list(get_levels_in_scope(scope_frame, self.state.AllLevels) or [])
        if not fallback:
            return None
        fallback.sort(key=lambda x: float(getattr(x, "Elevation", 0.0)))
        return fallback[0]

    def _refresh_element_line_groups(self):
        if self._is_scope_source_mode():
            self._selected_element_line_keys = set()
            self._set_element_line_items_with_preserve([], set())
            return

        visible_rows = list(self.state.CreatorElementItems or [])
        if not visible_rows:
            self._selected_element_line_keys = set()
            self._set_element_line_items_with_preserve([], set())
            try:
                self.txtElementLineStatus.Text = "No filtered elements available. Select categories or adjust filters."
            except Exception:
                pass
            return

        groups = self._build_element_line_groups(visible_rows)
        items = []
        for key in sorted(groups.keys()):
            data = groups[key]
            level_count = len(data["levels"])
            label = u"{0} | {1} | XY {2} | Instances {3} | Levels {4}".format(
                data["category"],
                data["mark"],
                data["xy_label"],
                len(data["items"]),
                level_count
            )
            items.append(ChoiceItem(label, None, key))

        selected_keys = set(self._selected_element_line_keys or [])
        if not selected_keys:
            selected_keys = set([str(getattr(item, "Value", "")) for item in items])

        self._set_element_line_items_with_preserve(items, selected_keys)
        self._selected_element_line_keys = self._get_selected_element_line_keys()

        try:
            self.txtElementLineStatus.Text = "Line groups: {0}. Select one or more lines for Stage 1 view creation (from filtered elements, XY tol {1:.0f} mm).".format(len(items), self._get_element_line_bucket_mm())
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _set_element_grid_headers(self, base_header, base_off_header, top_header, top_off_header, mark_header):
        try:
            self.colElementBaseConstraint.Header = base_header
            self.colElementBaseOffset.Header = base_off_header
            self.colElementTopConstraint.Header = top_header
            self.colElementTopOffset.Header = top_off_header
            self.colElementMark.Header = mark_header
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _update_creator_element_column_headers(self):
        default_headers = (
            "Base Constraint/Level",
            "Base Off (mm)",
            "Top Constraint/Level",
            "Top Off (mm)",
            "RBG Mark"
        )

        if self._is_scope_source_mode():
            self._set_element_grid_headers(*default_headers)
            return

        category_ids = self._selected_creator_category_ids()
        if len(category_ids) != 1:
            self._set_element_grid_headers(*default_headers)
            return

        category_id = list(category_ids)[0]
        if category_id == int(BuiltInCategory.OST_Walls):
            self._set_element_grid_headers(
                "Base Constraint",
                "Base Offset (mm)",
                "Top Constraint",
                "Top Offset (mm)",
                "RBG_WL_Number"
            )
        elif category_id == int(BuiltInCategory.OST_StructuralColumns):
            self._set_element_grid_headers(
                "Base Level",
                "Base Offset (mm)",
                "Top Level",
                "Top Offset (mm)",
                "RBG_CO_MarkNo"
            )
        elif category_id == int(BuiltInCategory.OST_StructuralFraming):
            self._set_element_grid_headers(
                "Ref Level",
                "Start Off (mm)",
                "Ref/Top Level",
                "End Off (mm)",
                "RBG_FR_MarkNo"
            )
        elif category_id == int(BuiltInCategory.OST_Floors):
            self._set_element_grid_headers(
                "Level",
                "Offset (mm)",
                "Top Level",
                "Top Offset (mm)",
                "RBG_FL_Number"
            )
        elif category_id == int(BuiltInCategory.OST_GenericModel):
            self._set_element_grid_headers(
                "Level/Ref",
                "Offset (mm)",
                "Top Level",
                "Top Offset (mm)",
                "RBG_GM_Number"
            )
        else:
            self._set_element_grid_headers(*default_headers)

    def _get_selected_creator_items(self):
        if self._is_scope_source_mode():
            return self._normalize_selected_items(self.lbScopeBoxes)
        return self._normalize_selected_items(self.dgCreatorElements)

    def apply_creator_category_filters(self):
        filter_text = ""
        try:
            filter_text = (self.tbCreatorCategoryFilter.Text or '').strip().lower()
        except Exception:
            pass

        filtered = []
        for item in self.creator_category_items_all:
            if filter_text and filter_text not in (item.Label or '').lower():
                continue
            filtered.append(item)

        selected_values = set(self._selected_creator_category_values())
        prev_suspend = self.suspend_events
        self.suspend_events = True
        try:
            self.lbCreatorCategories.ItemsSource = None
            self.lbCreatorCategories.ItemsSource = filtered
            for item in filtered:
                if getattr(item, 'Value', None) in selected_values:
                    self.lbCreatorCategories.SelectedItems.Add(item)
        finally:
            self.suspend_events = prev_suspend

        self.state.CreatorCategoryItems = filtered

    def refresh_creator_elements_from_categories(self):
        category_values = self._selected_creator_category_values()
        self.creator_element_items_all = get_creator_elements_for_categories(category_values)
        for item in self.creator_element_items_all:
            try:
                element_id = item.Element.Id.IntegerValue
                if element_id not in self.scope_frames:
                    self.scope_frames[element_id] = build_scope_frame(item.Element)
            except Exception:
                pass
        self._rebuild_creator_type_items()
        self._update_creator_element_column_headers()
        self.apply_creator_element_filters()
        self._refresh_element_line_groups()

    def _rebuild_creator_type_items(self):
        selected_type_names = self._get_selected_creator_type_names()
        filter_text = self._get_creator_type_filter_text()
        filter_field = self._get_creator_group_filter_field()
        sort_mode = self._get_creator_group_sort_mode()

        counts = {}
        for item in self.creator_element_items_all:
            key = (getattr(item, "GroupNumber", "") or "Element", getattr(item, "GroupBaseLevel", "") or "(No Base Level)", getattr(item, "GroupTypeName", "") or "Element")
            if key not in counts:
                counts[key] = {
                    "count": 0,
                    "value": getattr(item, "GroupKey", "") or u"{0}|{1}|{2}".format(key[0], key[1], key[2])
                }
            counts[key]["count"] += 1

        keys = list(counts.keys())

        if sort_mode == 'Base Level A-Z':
            keys.sort(key=lambda k: ((k[1] or '').lower(), (k[0] or '').lower(), (k[2] or '').lower()))
        elif sort_mode == 'Type Name A-Z':
            keys.sort(key=lambda k: ((k[2] or '').lower(), (k[0] or '').lower(), (k[1] or '').lower()))
        elif sort_mode == 'Count Desc':
            keys.sort(key=lambda k: (-int(counts[k]["count"]), (k[0] or '').lower(), (k[1] or '').lower(), (k[2] or '').lower()))
        else:
            keys.sort(key=lambda k: ((k[0] or '').lower(), (k[1] or '').lower(), (k[2] or '').lower()))

        visible = []
        for key in keys:
            number_val, base_val, type_val = key
            if filter_text:
                if filter_field == 'Number':
                    haystack = (number_val or '').lower()
                elif filter_field == 'Base Level':
                    haystack = (base_val or '').lower()
                elif filter_field == 'Type Name':
                    haystack = (type_val or '').lower()
                else:
                    haystack = u"{0} {1} {2}".format(number_val, base_val, type_val).lower()
                if filter_text not in haystack:
                    continue

            group_value = counts[key]["value"]
            label = u"{0} | {1} | {2} ({3})".format(number_val, base_val, type_val, counts[key]["count"])
            if filter_text and filter_text not in label.lower() and filter_field == 'Any':
                continue
            visible.append(ChoiceItem(label, None, group_value))

        if not selected_type_names:
            selected_type_names = set([str(getattr(item, "Value", "")) for item in visible])

        self.creator_element_type_items_all = visible
        self.state.CreatorElementTypeItems = visible
        self._set_choice_items_with_preserve(self.lbCreatorElementTypes, visible, selected_type_names)

    def apply_creator_type_filters(self):
        self._rebuild_creator_type_items()
        self.apply_creator_element_filters()

    def apply_creator_element_filters(self):
        selected_ids = set()
        try:
            for row in self.dgCreatorElements.SelectedItems:
                selected_ids.add(row.Element.Id.IntegerValue)
        except Exception:
            pass

        filter_text = ""
        try:
            filter_text = (self.tbCreatorElementFilter.Text or '').strip().lower()
        except Exception:
            pass

        selected_group_keys = self._get_selected_creator_type_names()

        filtered = list(self.creator_element_items_all)
        if selected_group_keys:
            filtered = [
                x for x in filtered
                if str(getattr(x, 'GroupKey', '') or '') in selected_group_keys
            ]
        if filter_text:
            filtered = [
                x for x in filtered
                if (
                    filter_text in (x.Label or '').lower()
                    or filter_text in (x.CategoryName or '').lower()
                    or filter_text in (x.TypeName or '').lower()
                    or filter_text in (x.BaseConstraint or '').lower()
                    or filter_text in (x.TopConstraint or '').lower()
                    or filter_text in (x.RbgMark or '').lower()
                    or filter_text in str(getattr(x, 'ElementId', ''))
                )
            ]

        sort_mode = self._get_creator_element_sort_mode()
        if sort_mode == 'Name Z-A':
            filtered.sort(key=lambda x: ((x.CategoryName or '').lower(), (x.TypeName or '').lower(), x.ElementId), reverse=True)
        elif sort_mode == 'Element Id':
            filtered.sort(key=lambda x: x.ElementId)
        else:
            filtered.sort(key=lambda x: ((x.CategoryName or '').lower(), (x.TypeName or '').lower(), x.ElementId))

        if not self._creator_itemize_instances_enabled():
            grouped_first = {}
            for row in filtered:
                gk = str(getattr(row, 'GroupKey', '') or '')
                if gk and gk not in grouped_first:
                    grouped_first[gk] = row
            filtered = list(grouped_first.values())

        self.state.CreatorElementItems = filtered
        self._set_listbox_items_with_preserve(self.dgCreatorElements, filtered, selected_ids)
        self._refresh_element_line_groups()

    def update_creator_source_panels(self):
        is_scope = self._is_scope_source_mode()
        self.pnlScopeSource.Visibility = Visibility.Visible if is_scope else Visibility.Collapsed
        self.pnlElementSource.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed if is_scope else Visibility.Visible
        self.pnlScopeLevelSelection.Visibility = Visibility.Visible if is_scope else Visibility.Collapsed
        try:
            self.pnlElementMiddleSelection.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed if is_scope else Visibility.Visible
        except Exception:
            pass
        self.grpElementLineSelection.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed
        self._refresh_section_create_mode_options()
        self._update_creator_element_column_headers()
        self._refresh_element_line_groups()

    def update_workflow_stage_panels(self):
        try:
            stage_index = int(self.tabWorkflow.SelectedIndex)
        except Exception:
            stage_index = 0

        in_layout_stages = stage_index >= 1
        in_snapshot_stage = stage_index == 1
        in_sheet_stage = stage_index == 2

        self.stageSnapshotPane.Visibility = Visibility.Visible if in_snapshot_stage else Visibility.Collapsed
        self.stageLayoutPane.Visibility = Visibility.Visible if in_sheet_stage else Visibility.Collapsed
        self.btnPreview.Visibility = Visibility.Visible if in_layout_stages else Visibility.Collapsed
        self.btnCreate.Visibility = Visibility.Visible if in_sheet_stage else Visibility.Collapsed

        try:
            self.colStageGap.Width = GridLength(12 if in_layout_stages else 0)
            self.colStageRight.Width = GridLength(1.45, GridUnitType.Star) if in_layout_stages else GridLength(0)
            self.colStageLeft.Width = GridLength(1, GridUnitType.Star)
        except Exception:
            pass

        try:
            Grid.SetColumnSpan(self.stageInputPane, 1 if in_layout_stages else 3)
        except Exception:
            pass

        if not in_layout_stages:
            try:
                self.tabStage2Pane.SelectedIndex = 0
            except Exception:
                pass

        self._update_workflow_stepper(stage_index)

    def _update_workflow_stepper(self, stage_index=None):
        if stage_index is None:
            try:
                stage_index = int(self.tabWorkflow.SelectedIndex)
            except Exception:
                stage_index = 0

        step_keys = [
            (0, "brdWorkflowStep0Bubble", "txtWorkflowStep0Bubble", "txtWorkflowStep0Label"),
            (1, "brdWorkflowStep1Bubble", "txtWorkflowStep1Bubble", "txtWorkflowStep1Label"),
            (2, "brdWorkflowStep2Bubble", "txtWorkflowStep2Bubble", "txtWorkflowStep2Label"),
        ]
        conn_keys = [
            (0, "brdWorkflowConn0"),
            (1, "brdWorkflowConn1"),
        ]

        for index_value, bubble_name, bubble_text_name, label_name in step_keys:
            bubble = getattr(self, bubble_name, None)
            bubble_text = getattr(self, bubble_text_name, None)
            label = getattr(self, label_name, None)
            if not bubble or not bubble_text or not label:
                continue

            if index_value < stage_index:
                bubble.Style = self.FindResource("WizardStepBubbleDoneBorderStyle")
                bubble_text.Style = self.FindResource("WizardStepBubbleDoneTextStyle")
                label.Style = self.FindResource("WizardStepLabelDoneStyle")
                bubble_text.Text = u"✓"
            elif index_value == stage_index:
                bubble.Style = self.FindResource("WizardStepBubbleActiveBorderStyle")
                bubble_text.Style = self.FindResource("WizardStepBubbleActiveTextStyle")
                label.Style = self.FindResource("WizardStepLabelActiveStyle")
                bubble_text.Text = str(index_value + 1)
            else:
                bubble.Style = self.FindResource("WizardStepBubblePendingBorderStyle")
                bubble_text.Style = self.FindResource("WizardStepBubblePendingTextStyle")
                label.Style = self.FindResource("WizardStepLabelPendingStyle")
                bubble_text.Text = str(index_value + 1)

        for index_value, conn_name in conn_keys:
            connector = getattr(self, conn_name, None)
            if not connector:
                continue
            connector.Style = self.FindResource(
                "WizardStepConnectorDoneStyle" if index_value < stage_index else "WizardStepConnectorPendingStyle"
            )

    def workflow_step_click(self, sender, args):
        if self.suspend_events:

        try:
            stage_index = int(getattr(sender, "Tag", 0))
        except Exception:
            return
        try:
            self.tabWorkflow.SelectedIndex = stage_index
        except Exception:
            return

    def _update_layout_panels(self):
        layout_type = self._selected_value(self.cbLayoutType, "Grid")

        show_plan_layout = layout_type == "Plan Top + Sections Below"

        self.pnlPlanLayoutOptions.Visibility = Visibility.Visible if show_plan_layout else Visibility.Collapsed

            self.btnAlignViewsBottom.Visibility = Visibility.Visible if is_free_form else Visibility.Collapsed
            self.btnAlignViewsLeft.Visibility = Visibility.Visible if is_free_form else Visibility.Collapsed
            self.btnAlignTitlesBottom.Visibility = Visibility.Visible if is_free_form else Visibility.Collapsed
            self.btnAlignTitlesLeft.Visibility = Visibility.Visible if is_free_form else Visibility.Collapsed
            self.btnClearFreeFormSelection.Visibility = Visibility.Visible if is_free_form else Visibility.Collapsed

    def _is_free_form_layout(self, request=None):
        if request is None:
            request = self.get_layout_request()
        return (request.LayoutType == "Free Form")

    def _make_placement_key(self, placement):
        row = placement.SourceRow
        role = placement.Role or "Plan"

        if isinstance(row, AssignmentRow):
            return ("C", row.ScopeBox.Id.IntegerValue, row.Level.Id.IntegerValue, role)

        return ("S", row.View.Id.IntegerValue, role)

    def _apply_free_form_overrides(self, sequence, bounds, request):
        if not self._is_free_form_layout(request):
            return

        min_x, min_y, max_x, max_y = bounds
        width = max(EPS, max_x - min_x)
        height = max(EPS, max_y - min_y)

        for placement in sequence:
            key = self._make_placement_key(placement)
            norm = self.state.FreeFormPlacementNorm.get(key, None)
            if not norm:
                continue

            try:
                nx = max(0.0, min(1.0, float(norm[0])))
                ny = max(0.0, min(1.0, float(norm[1])))
            except:
                continue

            placement.TargetCenter = XYZ(min_x + (nx * width), max_y - (ny * height), 0.0)

    def _compute_creator_signature(self):
        selected_ids = []
        for item in self._get_selected_creator_items():
            try:
                selected_ids.append(item.Element.Id.IntegerValue)
            except Exception:
                pass
        selected_ids = sorted(selected_ids)

        if self._is_scope_source_mode():
            scope_level_sig = []
            selected_scope_levels = self._get_selected_scope_level_map()
            for scope_id in sorted(selected_scope_levels.keys()):
                scope_level_sig.append((scope_id, tuple(sorted(list(selected_scope_levels[scope_id])))))
            return ("Scope", tuple(selected_ids), tuple(scope_level_sig))

        filtered_ids = []
        for item in (self.state.CreatorElementItems or []):
            try:
                filtered_ids.append(int(getattr(item, "ElementId", 0)))
            except Exception:
                pass
        filtered_ids = tuple(sorted(filtered_ids))

        selected_ids = []
        try:
            for item in self.dgCreatorElements.SelectedItems:
                selected_ids.append(int(getattr(item, "ElementId", 0)))
        except Exception:
            pass
        selected_ids = tuple(sorted(selected_ids))

        selected_types = tuple(sorted(list(self._get_selected_creator_type_names())))

        line_keys = tuple(sorted(list(self._get_selected_element_line_keys())))
        split_mode = self._selected_value(self.cbElementSplitMode, "Per Number + Level")
        line_filter = self._get_element_line_filter_text()
        bucket_mm = round(self._get_element_line_bucket_mm(), 1)
        return ("Elements", filtered_ids, selected_types, selected_ids, line_keys, split_mode, line_filter, bucket_mm)

    def _invalidate_creator_rows(self):
        self.creator_rows_dirty = True

    def _ensure_creator_rows_current(self):
        if self.get_source_mode() != "Creator":
            return

        current_signature = self._compute_creator_signature()
        if (not self.creator_rows_dirty) and current_signature == self.last_creator_signature:
            return

        self._rebuild_creator_rows()
        self.last_creator_signature = current_signature
        self.creator_rows_dirty = False

    def get_source_mode(self):
        return "Selector" if self.rbSourceSelector.IsChecked else "Creator"

    def get_effective_source_mode(self):
        try:
            in_stage_layout = (self.tabWorkflow.SelectedIndex >= 1)
        except Exception:
            in_stage_layout = False
        if in_stage_layout and self._stage2_staged_view_mode:
            return "Selector"
        return self.get_source_mode()

    def _is_stage2_snapshot(self):
        try:
            return int(self.tabWorkflow.SelectedIndex) == 1
        except Exception:
            return False

    def _is_stage3_sheet_layout(self):
        try:
            return int(self.tabWorkflow.SelectedIndex) == 2
        except Exception:
            return False

    def _get_snapshot_temp_dir(self):
        base = os.environ.get("TEMP", THIS_DIR)
        path = os.path.join(base, "RBG_ViewCreatorSnapshots")
        if not os.path.exists(path):
            try:
                os.makedirs(path)
            except Exception:
                return THIS_DIR
        return path

    def _resolve_creator_row_snapshot_views(self, row, existing_views):
        plan_view = None
        section_view = None

        try:
            scope_id = row.ScopeBox.Id.IntegerValue
            level_id = row.Level.Id.IntegerValue
        except Exception:
            scope_id = None
            level_id = None

        if scope_id is not None and level_id is not None:
            plan_view = self._stage1_creator_view_map.get((scope_id, level_id, "Plan"), None)
            section_view = self._stage1_creator_view_map.get((scope_id, level_id, "Section"), None)
            if plan_view or section_view:
                return plan_view, section_view

        plan_name = self.get_plan_base_name(row)
        for candidate in existing_views.get(plan_name, []):
            try:
                if isinstance(candidate, ViewPlan) and view_matches_level(candidate, row.Level):
                    plan_view = candidate
                    break
            except Exception:
                pass

        section_name = self.get_section_base_name(row)
        for candidate in existing_views.get(section_name, []):
            try:
                if isinstance(candidate, ViewSection) and candidate.ViewType == ViewType.Section and view_matches_level(candidate, row.Level):
                    section_view = candidate
                    break
            except Exception:
                pass

        return plan_view, section_view

    def _build_stage2_snapshot_items(self):
        items = []

        if self.get_source_mode() != "Creator":
            self.state.Stage2SnapshotItems = []
            return items

        self._ensure_creator_rows_current()
        existing_views = {}
        use_existing_index = not bool(self._stage1_creator_view_map)
        if use_existing_index:
            _, existing_views = build_existing_view_map()

        for row in self.state.CreatorRows:
            if not (self.plans_enabled() or self.sections_enabled()):
                continue

            if use_existing_index:
                plan_view, section_view = self._resolve_creator_row_snapshot_views(row, existing_views)
            else:
                try:
                    key = (row.ScopeBox.Id.IntegerValue, row.Level.Id.IntegerValue)
                    plan_view = self._stage1_creator_view_map.get((key[0], key[1], "Plan"), None)
                    section_view = self._stage1_creator_view_map.get((key[0], key[1], "Section"), None)
                except Exception:
                    plan_view, section_view = None, None

            label = u"{0} | {1}".format(row.ScopeBoxName, row.LevelName)
            items.append(Stage2SnapshotItem(label, row, plan_view, section_view))

        self.state.Stage2SnapshotItems = items
        return items

    def _build_stage1_view_name_items(self):
        items = []

        if self.get_source_mode() != "Creator":
            self.state.Stage1ViewNameItems = []
            return items

        self._ensure_creator_rows_current()
        _, existing_views = build_existing_view_map()

        for row in self.state.CreatorRows:
            plan_view, section_view = self._resolve_creator_row_snapshot_views(row, existing_views)
            if not plan_view and not section_view:
                continue

            try:
                key = "{0}:{1}".format(row.ScopeBox.Id.IntegerValue, row.Level.Id.IntegerValue)
            except Exception:
                key = "{0}|{1}".format(row.ScopeBoxName, row.LevelName)

            items.append(Stage1ViewNameItem(key, row.ScopeBoxName, row.LevelName, plan_view, section_view))

        self.state.Stage1ViewNameItems = items
        return items

    def refresh_stage1_view_name_editor(self, preserve_status=False):
        previous_status = {}
        if preserve_status:
            for item in self.state.Stage1ViewNameItems:
                previous_status[item.Key] = item.Status

        items = self._build_stage1_view_name_items()
        if preserve_status:
            for item in items:
                if item.Key in previous_status:
                    item.Status = previous_status[item.Key]

        self._reload_stage1_view_name_grid()

    def refresh_stage2_snapshot_list(self, preserve_selection=False, force_render=False):
        self._record_stage2_diag("refresh_stage2_snapshot_list:start")
        selected_key = None
        if preserve_selection:
            selected_row = self._get_selected_stage2_row()
            if selected_row:
                try:
                    selected_key = self._make_creator_key(selected_row.ScopeBox, selected_row.Level)
                except Exception:
                    selected_key = None

        items = self._build_stage2_snapshot_items()
        self._record_stage2_diag("refresh_stage2_snapshot_list:items={0}".format(len(items)))
        if items and selected_key:
            for item in items:
                row = getattr(item, "Row", None)
                if not row:
                    continue
                try:
                    if self._make_creator_key(row.ScopeBox, row.Level) == selected_key:
                        self._select_stage2_row(row)
                        break
                except Exception:
                    pass
        elif items and not self._get_selected_stage2_row():
            self._select_stage2_row(getattr(items[0], "Row", None))

        self._sync_stage2_controls_from_selected_row()

        if self._skip_stage2_snapshot_render_once:
            self._skip_stage2_snapshot_render_once = False
            try:
                self.txtStage2SnapshotHint.Text = "Stage 2 ready. Select a row or click Refresh to load plan/section snapshot images."
            except Exception:
                pass
            try:
                self.spStage2SnapshotRows.Children.Clear()
            except Exception:
                pass
            return

        self._record_stage2_diag("refresh_stage2_snapshot_list:render_selected")
        self.render_stage2_snapshot_selected(force_render)
        self._record_stage2_diag("refresh_stage2_snapshot_list:done")

    def _find_stage2_snapshot_item_for_row(self, row):
        if not row:
            return None

        for item in list(self.state.Stage2SnapshotItems or []):
            if getattr(item, "Row", None) is row:
                return item

        return None

    def _get_selected_stage2_row(self):
        try:
            row = self.dgSectionSnapshot.SelectedItem
        except Exception:
            row = None
        return row if isinstance(row, AssignmentRow) else None

    def _select_stage2_row(self, row):
        if not row:
            return
        prev_suspend = self.suspend_events
        self.suspend_events = True
        try:
            self.dgSectionSnapshot.SelectedItem = row
            self.dgSectionSnapshot.ScrollIntoView(row)
        except Exception:
            pass
        finally:
            self.suspend_events = prev_suspend

    def _sync_stage2_controls_from_selected_row(self):
        row = self._get_selected_stage2_row()
        if not row:
            return

        prev_suspend = self.suspend_events
        self.suspend_events = True
        try:
            try:
                self._select_combo_value(self.cbStage2SectionSide, row.SectionDirection or "Front")
            except Exception:
                pass
            try:
                self._select_combo_value(self.cbStage2LowerLevel, row.SectionLowerLevelName or row.LevelName)
            except Exception:
                pass
            try:
                self._select_combo_value(self.cbStage2UpperLevel, row.SectionUpperLevelName or row.LevelName)
            except Exception:
                pass
            try:
                self.tbSectionBottomOffset.Text = str(getattr(row, "SectionBottomOffsetMm", 0.0))
            except Exception:
                pass
            try:
                self.tbSectionTopOffset.Text = str(getattr(row, "SectionTopOffsetMm", 0.0))
            except Exception:
                pass
        finally:
            self.suspend_events = prev_suspend

    def _export_view_snapshot_path(self, view):
        if not view:
            return None

        try:
            view_id = view.Id.IntegerValue
        except Exception:
            return None

        cached_path = self._snapshot_image_cache.get(view_id, None)
        if cached_path and os.path.exists(cached_path):
            return cached_path

        out_dir = self._get_snapshot_temp_dir()
        prefix = os.path.join(out_dir, "view_{0}".format(view_id))

        for stale in glob.glob(prefix + "*.png"):
            try:
                os.remove(stale)
            except Exception:
                pass

        options = ImageExportOptions()
        options.ExportRange = ExportRange.SetOfViews
        options.FilePath = prefix
        try:
            options.ZoomType = ZoomFitType.Zoom
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            options.Zoom = 100
        except Exception:
            try:
                options.ZoomType = ZoomFitType.FitToPage
                options.FitDirection = FitDirectionType.Horizontal
            except Exception:
                pass
        try:
            options.ImageResolution = ImageResolution.DPI_300
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            options.HLRandWFViewsFileType = ImageFileType.PNG
            options.ShadowViewsFileType = ImageFileType.PNG
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            options.PixelSize = 2200
        except Exception:
            pass

        ids = List[ElementId]()
        ids.Add(view.Id)
        options.SetViewsAndSheets(ids)

        try:
            doc.ExportImage(options)
        except Exception:
            return None

        exported = glob.glob(prefix + "*.png")
        if not exported:
            direct = prefix + ".png"
            if os.path.exists(direct):
                exported = [direct]

        if not exported:
            return None

        exported.sort(key=lambda p: os.path.getmtime(p), reverse=True)
        best = exported[0]
        self._snapshot_image_cache[view_id] = best
        return best

    def _set_image_source_from_path(self, image_control, image_path):
        if image_control is None:
            return
        if not image_path or not os.path.exists(image_path):
            image_control.Source = None
            return

        try:
            bitmap = BitmapImage()
            bitmap.BeginInit()
            bitmap.CacheOption = BitmapCacheOption.OnLoad
            bitmap.UriSource = Uri(image_path, UriKind.Absolute)
            bitmap.EndInit()
            image_control.Source = bitmap
        except Exception:
            image_control.Source = None

    def _apply_snapshot_image_rotation(self, image_control, angle_deg):
        if image_control is None:
            return
        try:
            image_control.RenderTransformOrigin = Point(0.5, 0.5)
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            image_control.RenderTransform = RotateTransform(float(angle_deg or 0.0))
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _pick_alignment_vector_xy(self, prompt_prefix):
        uidoc = revit.uidoc

        # First try: pick an edge and use its curve tangent.
        try:
            edge_ref = uidoc.Selection.PickObject(ObjectType.Edge, "{0}: pick element edge".format(prompt_prefix))
            if edge_ref:
                owner = doc.GetElement(edge_ref.ElementId)
                edge = owner.GetGeometryObjectFromReference(edge_ref) if owner else None
                curve = edge.AsCurve() if edge and hasattr(edge, "AsCurve") else None
                if curve:
                    p0 = curve.GetEndPoint(0)
                    p1 = curve.GetEndPoint(1)
                    vec = normalize_xy(sub_xyz(p1, p0))
                    if vec:
                        return vec
        except OperationCanceledException:
            return None
        except Exception:
            pass

        # Fallback: pick two points directly.
        try:
            p0 = uidoc.Selection.PickPoint("{0}: pick first point".format(prompt_prefix))
            p1 = uidoc.Selection.PickPoint("{0}: pick second point".format(prompt_prefix))
            vec = normalize_xy(sub_xyz(p1, p0))
            return vec
        except OperationCanceledException:
            return None
        except Exception:
            return None

    def _vector_to_angle_deg(self, vec):
        if not vec:
            return None
        try:
            return math.degrees(math.atan2(float(vec.Y), float(vec.X)))
        except Exception:
            return None

    def _get_stage2_target_rows(self):
        rows = []
        try:
            for row in self.dgSectionSnapshot.SelectedItems:
                if isinstance(row, AssignmentRow):
                    rows.append(row)
        except Exception:
            pass

        if not rows:
            rows = [row for row in self.state.CreatorRows if isinstance(row, AssignmentRow)]
        return rows

    def stage2_pick_plan_rotation_click(self, sender, args):
        vec = self._pick_alignment_vector_xy("Plan rotation")
        if not vec:
            return

        angle = self._vector_to_angle_deg(vec)
        if angle is None:
            forms.alert("Could not derive a valid plan rotation angle.", warn_icon=True)
            return

        rows = self._get_stage2_target_rows()
        if not rows:
            forms.alert("No rows available for plan rotation update.", warn_icon=True)
            return

        for row in rows:
            row.PlanRotationDeg = angle

        try:
            self.dgSectionSnapshot.Items.Refresh()
        except Exception:
            pass

        self.mark_preview_dirty()
        self.refresh_stage2_snapshot_list(True, True)

    def stage2_pick_section_alignment_click(self, sender, args):
        vec = self._pick_alignment_vector_xy("Section alignment")
        if not vec:
            return

        angle = self._vector_to_angle_deg(vec)
        if angle is None:
            forms.alert("Could not derive a valid section alignment angle.", warn_icon=True)
            return

        rows = self._get_stage2_target_rows()
        if not rows:
            forms.alert("No rows available for section alignment update.", warn_icon=True)
            return

        for row in rows:
            row.SectionDirection = "Aligned"
            row.SectionAlignmentAngleDeg = angle

        try:
            self.dgSectionSnapshot.Items.Refresh()
        except Exception:
            pass

        self._refresh_creator_warnings()
        self.mark_preview_dirty()
        self.refresh_stage2_snapshot_list(True, True)

    def _attach_snapshot_zoom_behavior(self, image_control):
        if image_control is None:
            return
        try:
            image_control.Tag = {"_snapshot_zoom": 1.0}
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            image_control.LayoutTransform = ScaleTransform(1.0, 1.0)
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            image_control.MouseWheel += self.snapshot_image_mouse_wheel
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            image_control.MouseLeftButtonDown += self.snapshot_image_mouse_left_button_down
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _set_snapshot_image_zoom(self, image_control, scale_value):
        if image_control is None:
            return
        clamped = max(0.35, min(8.0, float(scale_value)))
        try:
            scale = image_control.LayoutTransform if isinstance(image_control.LayoutTransform, ScaleTransform) else None
        except Exception:
            scale = None

        if scale is None:
            try:
                scale = ScaleTransform(clamped, clamped)
                image_control.LayoutTransform = scale
            except Exception:
                return

        try:
            scale.ScaleX = clamped
            scale.ScaleY = clamped
        except Exception:
            pass

        try:
            tag = image_control.Tag if isinstance(image_control.Tag, dict) else {}
            tag["_snapshot_zoom"] = clamped
            image_control.Tag = tag
        except Exception:
            pass

    def snapshot_image_mouse_wheel(self, sender, args):
        try:
            tag = sender.Tag if isinstance(sender.Tag, dict) else {}
            current = float(tag.get("_snapshot_zoom", 1.0))
            delta = float(getattr(args, "Delta", 0))
            factor = 1.18 if delta > 0 else (1.0 / 1.18)
            self._set_snapshot_image_zoom(sender, current * factor)
            args.Handled = True
        except Exception:
            pass

    def snapshot_image_mouse_left_button_down(self, sender, args):
        try:
            if int(getattr(args, "ClickCount", 0)) >= 2:
                self._set_snapshot_image_zoom(sender, 1.0)
                args.Handled = True
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _build_stage2_snapshot_row_card(self, item, is_selected):
        card = Border()
        card.BorderBrush = _brush("#E03C2C") if is_selected else _brush("#DDE1E6")
        card.BorderThickness = Thickness(2 if is_selected else 1)
        card.Background = _brush("#FFFFFFFF")
        card.Padding = Thickness(8)
        card.Margin = Thickness(0, 0, 0, 8)

        panel = StackPanel()
        card.Child = panel

        title = TextBlock()
        title.Text = item.Label
        title.FontWeight = FontWeights.Bold
        panel.Children.Add(title)

        sub = TextBlock()
        sub.Text = "Plan (left) | Section (right)"
        sub.Margin = Thickness(0, 2, 0, 6)
        sub.Foreground = _brush("#5E6A75")
        panel.Children.Add(sub)

        grid = Grid()
        grid.ColumnDefinitions.Add(ColumnDefinition())
        grid.ColumnDefinitions.Add(ColumnDefinition())
        panel.Children.Add(grid)

        plan_border = Border()
        plan_border.BorderBrush = _brush("#DDE1E6")
        plan_border.BorderThickness = Thickness(1)
        plan_border.Background = _brush("#FFF9FAFB")
        plan_border.Margin = Thickness(0, 0, 4, 0)
        Grid.SetColumn(plan_border, 0)
        grid.Children.Add(plan_border)

        section_border = Border()
        section_border.BorderBrush = _brush("#DDE1E6")
        section_border.BorderThickness = Thickness(1)
        section_border.Background = _brush("#FFF9FAFB")
        section_border.Margin = Thickness(4, 0, 0, 0)
        Grid.SetColumn(section_border, 1)
        grid.Children.Add(section_border)

        row = getattr(item, "Row", None)
        plan_view = getattr(item, "PlanView", None)
        section_view = getattr(item, "SectionView", None)

        plan_path = self._export_view_snapshot_path(plan_view) if plan_view else None
        section_path = self._export_view_snapshot_path(section_view) if section_view else None

        if plan_path:
            plan_panel = StackPanel()
            side = getattr(row, "SectionDirection", "Front") if row else "Front"
            aligned_angle = getattr(row, "SectionAlignmentAngleDeg", None) if row else None
            header = TextBlock()
            if side == "Aligned" and aligned_angle is not None:
                header.Text = "Plan snapshot | Section side: Aligned ({0:.1f} deg)".format(float(aligned_angle))
            else:
                header.Text = "Plan snapshot | Section side: {0}".format(side or "Front")
            header.FontWeight = FontWeights.Bold
            header.Margin = Thickness(0, 0, 0, 4)
            plan_panel.Children.Add(header)

            zoom_note = TextBlock()
            zoom_note.Text = "Mouse wheel: zoom | Double-click: reset"
            zoom_note.Foreground = _brush("#5E6A75")
            zoom_note.Margin = Thickness(0, 0, 0, 4)
            plan_panel.Children.Add(zoom_note)

            plan_img = Image()
            plan_img.Stretch = Stretch.Uniform
            self._set_image_source_from_path(plan_img, plan_path)
            self._apply_snapshot_image_rotation(plan_img, getattr(row, "PlanRotationDeg", 0.0) if row else 0.0)
            self._attach_snapshot_zoom_behavior(plan_img)

            plan_scroll = ScrollViewer()
            plan_scroll.Content = plan_img
            try:
                plan_scroll.HorizontalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Auto
                plan_scroll.VerticalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Auto
                plan_scroll.Height = 320
            except Exception:
                pass
            plan_panel.Children.Add(plan_scroll)
            plan_border.Child = plan_panel
        else:
            plan_border.Child = self._build_stage2_plan_schematic(row)

        if section_path:
            section_panel = StackPanel()
            header = TextBlock()
            header.Text = "Section snapshot"
            header.FontWeight = FontWeights.Bold
            header.Margin = Thickness(0, 0, 0, 4)
            section_panel.Children.Add(header)

            zoom_note = TextBlock()
            zoom_note.Text = "Mouse wheel: zoom | Double-click: reset"
            zoom_note.Foreground = _brush("#5E6A75")
            zoom_note.Margin = Thickness(0, 0, 0, 4)
            section_panel.Children.Add(zoom_note)

            section_img = Image()
            section_img.Stretch = Stretch.Uniform
            self._set_image_source_from_path(section_img, section_path)
            self._attach_snapshot_zoom_behavior(section_img)

            section_scroll = ScrollViewer()
            section_scroll.Content = section_img
            try:
                section_scroll.HorizontalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Auto
                section_scroll.VerticalScrollBarVisibility = ScrollBarVisibility.Auto
                section_scroll.Height = 320
            except Exception:
                pass
            section_panel.Children.Add(section_scroll)
            section_border.Child = section_panel
        else:
            section_border.Child = self._build_stage2_section_schematic(row, section_view)

        return card

    def _build_stage2_plan_schematic(self, row):
        host = Grid()
        canvas = Canvas()
        canvas.Width = 360
        canvas.Height = 210
        canvas.Background = _brush("#FFF9FAFB")

        outer = Rectangle()
        outer.Width = 300
        outer.Height = 150
        outer.Stroke = _brush("#1F4FD9")
        outer.Fill = _brush("#FFFFFFFF")
        outer.StrokeThickness = 1.5
        canvas.Children.Add(outer)
        Canvas.SetLeft(outer, 30)
        Canvas.SetTop(outer, 28)

        side = "Front"
        try:
            side = getattr(row, "SectionDirection", "Front") or "Front"
        except Exception:
            pass

        marker = Rectangle()
        marker.Fill = _brush("#E03C2C")
        marker.StrokeThickness = 0
        if side in ["Front", "Back"]:
            marker.Width = 170
            marker.Height = 4
            Canvas.SetLeft(marker, 95)
            Canvas.SetTop(marker, 34 if side == "Front" else 170)
        else:
            marker.Width = 4
            marker.Height = 100
            Canvas.SetTop(marker, 52)
            Canvas.SetLeft(marker, 34 if side == "Left" else 322)
        canvas.Children.Add(marker)

        side_text = TextBlock()
        side_text.Text = "Section Side: {0}".format(side)
        side_text.FontWeight = FontWeights.Bold
        side_text.Margin = Thickness(8, 0, 0, 0)

        label = TextBlock()
        label.Text = "Plan schematic with section cut marker"
        label.Foreground = _brush("#5E6A75")
        label.Margin = Thickness(8, 2, 0, 0)

        panel = StackPanel()
        panel.Children.Add(side_text)
        panel.Children.Add(label)
        panel.Children.Add(canvas)

        host.Children.Add(panel)
        return host

        lower = getattr(row, "SectionLowerLevelName", "") or getattr(row, "LevelName", "")
        upper = getattr(row, "SectionUpperLevelName", "") or lower
        detail = TextBlock()
        detail.Text = "Vertical range: {0} to {1}".format(lower, upper)
        detail.Foreground = _brush("#5E6A75")
        detail.Margin = Thickness(0, 2, 0, 6)
        panel.Children.Add(detail)

        canvas = Canvas()
        canvas.Width = 360
        canvas.Height = 210
        canvas.Background = _brush("#FFF9FAFB")

        frame = Rectangle()
        frame.Width = 230
        frame.Height = 160
        frame.Stroke = _brush("#E03C2C")
        frame.Fill = _brush("#FFFFFFFF")
        frame.StrokeThickness = 1.5
        canvas.Children.Add(frame)
        Canvas.SetLeft(frame, 60)
        Canvas.SetTop(frame, 24)

        bottom_text = TextBlock()
        bottom_text.Text = str(getattr(row, "SectionBottomOffsetMm", 0.0)) + " mm"
        bottom_text.Foreground = _brush("#5E6A75")
        canvas.Children.Add(bottom_text)
        Canvas.SetLeft(bottom_text, 8)
        Canvas.SetTop(bottom_text, 170)

        top_text = TextBlock()
        top_text.Text = str(getattr(row, "SectionTopOffsetMm", 0.0)) + " mm"

            panel.Children.Add(note)

        return panel

    def render_stage2_snapshot_selected(self, force=False):
        self._record_stage2_diag("render_stage2_snapshot_selected:start")
        if self._stage2_render_inflight:
            self._record_stage2_diag("render_stage2_snapshot_selected:skip_inflight")
            return

        self._stage2_render_inflight = True
        try:
            if not self._is_stage2_snapshot():
                self._record_stage2_diag("render_stage2_snapshot_selected:skip_not_stage2")
                return

            if self.get_source_mode() != "Creator":
                try:
                    self.txtStage2SnapshotHint.Text = "Stage 2 snapshot currently supports View Creator mode."
                except Exception:
                    pass
                self._record_stage2_diag("render_stage2_snapshot_selected:skip_not_creator")
                return

            items = list(self.state.Stage2SnapshotItems or [])
            selected_row = self._get_selected_stage2_row()
            if not items:
                try:
                    self.txtStage2SnapshotHint.Text = "No snapshot rows available. Run Stage 1 to create/select views first."
                except Exception:
                    pass
                self._record_stage2_diag("render_stage2_snapshot_selected:skip_no_items")
                return

            selected_item = self._find_stage2_snapshot_item_for_row(selected_row)
            if selected_item is None and items:
                selected_item = items[0]
                try:
                    self._select_stage2_row(getattr(selected_item, "Row", None))
                except Exception:
                    pass

            sig = None
            try:
                row = getattr(selected_item, "Row", None)
                sig = (
                    getattr(row.ScopeBox, "Id", None).IntegerValue if row and getattr(row, "ScopeBox", None) else 0,
                    getattr(row.Level, "Id", None).IntegerValue if row and getattr(row, "Level", None) else 0,
                    getattr(row, "SectionDirection", ""),
                    getattr(row, "SectionLowerLevelName", ""),
                    getattr(row, "SectionUpperLevelName", ""),
                    str(getattr(row, "SectionBottomOffsetMm", "")),
                    str(getattr(row, "SectionTopOffsetMm", ""))
                )
            except Exception:
                sig = None

            if (not force) and sig is not None and sig == self._stage2_last_render_signature:
                self._record_stage2_diag("render_stage2_snapshot_selected:skip_same_signature")
                return

            self._stage2_last_render_signature = sig

            try:
                self.spStage2SnapshotRows.Children.Clear()
            except Exception:
                pass

            rendered = 0
            missing_sections = 0
            for item in items:
                row = getattr(item, "Row", None)
                is_selected = bool(selected_row and row is selected_row)
                if not getattr(item, "SectionView", None):
                    missing_sections += 1
                card = self._build_stage2_snapshot_row_card(item, is_selected)
                try:
                    self.spStage2SnapshotRows.Children.Add(card)
                except Exception:
                    pass
                rendered += 1

            try:
                if missing_sections:
                    self.txtStage2SnapshotHint.Text = "Showing {0} snapshot rows. Missing section view on {1} rows.".format(rendered, missing_sections)
                else:
                    self.txtStage2SnapshotHint.Text = "Showing {0} snapshot rows. Change side in row manager or controls to update marker.".format(rendered)
            except Exception:
                pass
            self._record_stage2_diag("render_stage2_snapshot_selected:done")
        finally:
            self._stage2_render_inflight = False

    def _get_section_offsets_ft(self):
        bottom_mm = try_parse_float(getattr(self.tbSectionBottomOffset, "Text", "0"), 0.0)
        top_mm = try_parse_float(getattr(self.tbSectionTopOffset, "Text", "0"), 0.0)
        return mm_to_ft(bottom_mm), mm_to_ft(top_mm)

    def _find_level_by_name(self, level_name):
        if not level_name:
            return None
        for level in self.state.AllLevels:
            try:
                if get_name(level) == level_name:
                    return level
            except Exception:
                pass
        return None

    def _apply_vertical_mapping_rows(self, rows):
        if apply_vertical_mapping is None:
            return 0, 0

        success = 0
        failed = 0

        t_vertical = Transaction(doc, "Stage 2 - Update Section Vertical Crop")
        t_vertical.Start()
        try:
            for row in rows:
                try:
                    key = (row.ScopeBox.Id.IntegerValue, row.Level.Id.IntegerValue, "Section")
                except Exception:
                    row.Warning = combine_warning_text(row.Warning, "Section key unavailable for vertical mapping")
                    failed += 1
                    continue

                section_view = self._stage1_creator_view_map.get(key, None)
                if not section_view:
                    row.Warning = combine_warning_text(row.Warning, "Section view unavailable for vertical mapping")
                    failed += 1
                    continue

                lower_level = self._find_level_by_name(getattr(row, "SectionLowerLevelName", ""))
                upper_level = self._find_level_by_name(getattr(row, "SectionUpperLevelName", ""))
                lower_offset_ft = mm_to_ft(try_parse_float(getattr(row, "SectionBottomOffsetMm", 0.0), 0.0))
                upper_offset_ft = mm_to_ft(try_parse_float(getattr(row, "SectionTopOffsetMm", 0.0), 0.0))

                ok, error = apply_vertical_mapping(section_view, lower_level, lower_offset_ft, upper_level, upper_offset_ft)
                if ok:
                    success += 1
                else:
                    row.Warning = combine_warning_text(row.Warning, "Vertical crop: {0}".format(error or "Update failed"))
                    failed += 1

            t_vertical.Commit()
        except Exception:
            try:
                t_vertical.RollBack()
            except Exception:
                pass
            raise

        return success, failed

    def _read_vertical_mapping_into_rows(self, rows):
        if get_current_vertical_mapping_info is None:
            return 0, len(rows or [])

        self._ensure_creator_rows_current()
        _, existing_views = build_existing_view_map()

        updated = 0
        failed = 0

        for row in rows:
            if not isinstance(row, AssignmentRow) or not getattr(row, "CreateSection", False):
                continue

            try:
                key = (row.ScopeBox.Id.IntegerValue, row.Level.Id.IntegerValue, "Section")
            except Exception:
                row.Warning = combine_warning_text(row.Warning, "Section key unavailable for extent read")
                failed += 1
                continue

            section_view = self._stage1_creator_view_map.get(key, None)
            if not section_view:
                _, section_view = self._resolve_creator_row_snapshot_views(row, existing_views)
            if not section_view:
                row.Warning = combine_warning_text(row.Warning, "Section view unavailable for extent read")
                failed += 1
                continue

            try:
                info = get_current_vertical_mapping_info(section_view, self.state.AllLevels)
            except Exception as ex:
                row.Warning = combine_warning_text(row.Warning, "Vertical read: {0}".format(str(ex)))
                failed += 1
                continue

            lower_level = info.get("lower_level", None)
            upper_level = info.get("upper_level", None)
            lower_name = get_name(lower_level) if lower_level else ""
            upper_name = get_name(upper_level) if upper_level else ""

            if lower_name:
                row.SectionLowerLevelName = lower_name
            if upper_name:
                row.SectionUpperLevelName = upper_name

            row.SectionBottomOffsetMm = round(ft_to_mm(info.get("lower_offset_ft", 0.0)), 1)
            row.SectionTopOffsetMm = round(ft_to_mm(info.get("upper_offset_ft", 0.0)), 1)
            updated += 1

        return updated, failed

    def _prefer_summary_preview_mode(self):
        try:
            return bool(self.chkSummaryPreviewMode.IsChecked)
        except Exception:
            return False

    def _get_preview_card_limit(self, is_free_form=False):
        if is_free_form:
            return 9999

        default_limit = PREVIEW_CARD_LIMIT
        try:
            selected = self.cbPreviewCardLimit.SelectedItem
            if not selected:
                return default_limit
            content = str(getattr(selected, "Content", selected) or "").strip().lower()
            if content == "all":
                return 9999
            parsed = try_parse_positive_int(content, default_limit)
            return parsed if parsed else default_limit
        except Exception:
            return default_limit

    def _show_stage2_preview_tab(self):
        try:
            self.tabStage2Pane.SelectedIndex = 1
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _estimate_stage1_assoc_targets(self):
        count = 0
        for row in self.state.CreatorRows:
            if self.plans_enabled() and row.CreatePlan:
                count += 1
            if self.sections_enabled() and row.CreateSection:
                count += 1
        return count

    def _estimate_stage1_sectionmove_groups(self):
        scope_ids = set()
        for row in self.state.CreatorRows:
            if self.sections_enabled() and row.CreateSection:
                try:
                    scope_ids.add(row.ScopeBox.Id.IntegerValue)
                except Exception:
                    pass
        return len(scope_ids)

    def _estimate_stage1_create_operations(self):
        operations = 0
        if not self.state.CreatorRows:
            return operations

        section_seen = set()

        for row in self.state.CreatorRows:
            if self.plans_enabled() and row.CreatePlan:
                operations += 1

            if self.sections_enabled() and row.CreateSection:
                source_id = getattr(row, "SourceGroupKey", "") or row.ScopeBox.Id.IntegerValue
                if self._is_scope_grouped_section_mode() or self._is_element_grouped_section_mode():
                    if source_id in section_seen:
                        continue
                    section_seen.add(source_id)
                operations += 1

        return operations

    def get_create_mode(self):
        return "Views Only" if self.rbViewsOnly.IsChecked else "Views + Sheets"

    def get_sheet_mode(self):
        return "Existing Sheets" if self.rbExistingSheets.IsChecked else "New Sheets"

    def _default_viewport_type_name(self):
        return self._selected_value(self.cbDefaultViewportType, "")

    def _get_selected_scope_items(self):
        return self._normalize_selected_items(self.lbScopeBoxes)

    def _get_selected_level_items(self):
        return self._normalize_selected_items(self.lbLevels)

    def _get_selected_existing_sheet_items(self):
        return self._normalize_selected_items(self.lbExistingSheets)

    def _get_selected_selector_view_items(self):
        return self._normalize_selected_items(self.lbSelectedViews)

    def _get_selected_existing_sheet_ids(self):
