    def _get_filtered_level_text(self):
        try:
            return (self.tbLevelFilter.Text or "").strip().lower()
        except:
            return ""

    def _get_filtered_sheet_text(self):
        try:
            return (self.tbSheetFilter.Text or "").strip().lower()
        except:
            return ""

    def _get_filtered_selector_view_text(self):
        try:
            return (self.tbViewFilter.Text or "").strip().lower()
        except:
            return ""

    def _build_level_choice(self, level):
        return ChoiceItem(get_name(level), level)

    def _rebuild_scope_level_tree(self, selected_scope_items):
        self._scope_level_visible_pairs = []
        self._scope_level_checkbox_map = {}

        try:
            self.tvScopeLevels.Items.Clear()
        except Exception:
            return

        filter_text = self._get_filtered_level_text()

        for scope_item in sorted(selected_scope_items, key=lambda x: (x.Label or "").lower()):
            try:
                scope_id = scope_item.Element.Id.IntegerValue
            except Exception:
                continue

            applicable_levels = list(self.state.ScopeLevelMap.get(scope_id, []) or [])
            applicable_levels.sort(key=lambda x: float(getattr(x, "Elevation", 0.0)))
            applicable_level_ids = set([level.Id.IntegerValue for level in applicable_levels])
            assigned_ids = self._get_scope_assigned_level_ids(scope_id, applicable_level_ids)

            parent = TreeViewItem()
            selected_count = len([x for x in assigned_ids if x in applicable_level_ids])
            parent.Header = "{0} | Selected: {1}/{2}".format(scope_item.Label, selected_count, len(applicable_levels))
            parent.IsExpanded = True

            visible_count = 0
            for level in applicable_levels:
                level_name = get_name(level)
                if filter_text and filter_text not in level_name.lower():
                    continue

                level_id = level.Id.IntegerValue
                chk = CheckBox()
                chk.Content = level_name
                chk.IsChecked = bool(level_id in assigned_ids)
                chk.Tag = (scope_id, level_id)
                try:
                    chk.Checked += self.scope_level_checkbox_changed
                    chk.Unchecked += self.scope_level_checkbox_changed
                except Exception:
                    pass

                child = TreeViewItem()
                child.Header = chk
                parent.Items.Add(child)

                self._scope_level_checkbox_map[(scope_id, level_id)] = chk
                self._scope_level_visible_pairs.append((scope_id, level_id, chk))
                visible_count += 1

            if visible_count > 0:
                self.tvScopeLevels.Items.Add(parent)

    def _sync_scope_level_ids_from_tree(self):
        seen_scope_ids = set()
        for scope_id, level_id, chk in list(self._scope_level_visible_pairs or []):
            seen_scope_ids.add(scope_id)
            assigned = self.state.ScopeSelectedLevelIds.get(scope_id, set())
            if not isinstance(assigned, set):
                assigned = set(list(assigned or []))
            if bool(chk.IsChecked):
                assigned.add(level_id)
            else:
                if level_id in assigned:
                    assigned.remove(level_id)
            self.state.ScopeSelectedLevelIds[scope_id] = assigned

        if seen_scope_ids:
            self.state.SelectedLevelIds = set()
            for scope_id in seen_scope_ids:
                assigned = self.state.ScopeSelectedLevelIds.get(scope_id, set())
                if not self.state.SelectedLevelIds:
                    self.state.SelectedLevelIds = set(assigned)
                else:
                    self.state.SelectedLevelIds.intersection_update(set(assigned))

    def scope_level_checkbox_changed(self, sender, args):
        if self.suspend_events:
            return

        try:
            tag = sender.Tag
            scope_id = int(tag[0])
            level_id = int(tag[1])
        except Exception:
            return

        assigned = self.state.ScopeSelectedLevelIds.get(scope_id, set())
        if not isinstance(assigned, set):
            assigned = set(list(assigned or []))

        if bool(sender.IsChecked):
            assigned.add(level_id)
        else:
            if level_id in assigned:
                assigned.remove(level_id)

        self.state.ScopeSelectedLevelIds[scope_id] = assigned
        self._update_level_selection_status(self._get_selected_scope_items())
        self._invalidate_creator_rows()
        self.mark_preview_dirty()
        self.refresh_summary(False)

    def _format_scope_level_status_line(self, scope_name, selected_levels, applicable_levels):
        selected_names = [get_name(level) for level in selected_levels]
        preview_names = ", ".join(selected_names[:4])
        if len(selected_names) > 4:
            preview_names += ", ..."
        if not preview_names:
            preview_names = "None"

        return "{0} | Selected: {1}/{2} | {3}".format(
            scope_name,
            len(selected_levels),
            len(applicable_levels),
            preview_names
        )

    def _get_scope_level_map(self, selected_scope_items):
        result = {}
        union_ids = set()

        for scope_item in selected_scope_items:
            scope = scope_item.Element
            scope_frame = self.scope_frames.get(scope.Id.IntegerValue)
            levels = get_levels_in_scope(scope_frame, self.state.AllLevels)
            result[scope.Id.IntegerValue] = levels
            for level in levels:
                union_ids.add(level.Id.IntegerValue)

        return result, union_ids

    def _get_scope_assigned_level_ids(self, scope_id, applicable_level_ids):
        assigned_ids = self.state.ScopeSelectedLevelIds.get(scope_id, None)
        if assigned_ids is None:
            assigned_ids = set()
        else:
            assigned_ids = set([level_id for level_id in assigned_ids if level_id in applicable_level_ids])

        self.state.ScopeSelectedLevelIds[scope_id] = assigned_ids
        return assigned_ids

    def _get_selected_scope_level_map(self, selected_scope_items=None):
        if selected_scope_items is None:
            selected_scope_items = self._get_selected_scope_items()

        result = {}
        for scope_item in selected_scope_items:
            try:
                scope_id = scope_item.Element.Id.IntegerValue
            except:
                continue

            applicable_levels = self.state.ScopeLevelMap.get(scope_id, [])
            applicable_level_ids = set()
            for level in applicable_levels:
                try:
                    applicable_level_ids.add(level.Id.IntegerValue)
                except:
                    pass

            result[scope_id] = self._get_scope_assigned_level_ids(scope_id, applicable_level_ids)

        return result

    def _make_creator_key(self, scope_box, level):
        return (scope_box.Id.IntegerValue, level.Id.IntegerValue)

    def _make_selector_key(self, view):
        return view.Id.IntegerValue

    def _get_row_section_frame(self, row):
        return getattr(row, "SectionScopeFrame", None) or getattr(row, "ScopeFrame", None)

    def _compute_creator_warning(self, row):
        warnings = []

        if not row.ScopeFrame:
            warnings.append("Invalid scope frame")
            return combine_warning_text("", warnings)

        frame_ok, frame_messages = validate_scope_frame(row.ScopeFrame)
        if not frame_ok:
            warnings.extend(frame_messages)

        if self.sections_enabled() and row.CreateSection:
            dir_ok, dir_messages = validate_section_direction(
                self._get_row_section_frame(row),
                row.SectionDirection,
                getattr(row, "SectionAlignmentAngleDeg", None)
            )
            if not dir_ok:
                warnings.extend(dir_messages)

        return combine_warning_text("", warnings)

    def _refresh_creator_warnings(self):
        if self.creator_rows_dirty:
            return
        for row in self.state.CreatorRows:
            row.Warning = self._compute_creator_warning(row)
        prev_suspend = self.suspend_events
        self.suspend_events = True
        try:
            self.dgCreatorAssignments.Items.Refresh()
        except:
            pass
        finally:
            self.suspend_events = prev_suspend

    def _estimate_creator_counts(self):
        if not self._is_scope_source_mode():
            self._ensure_creator_rows_current()
            row_count = len(self.state.CreatorRows)
            plan_count = len([r for r in self.state.CreatorRows if getattr(r, "CreatePlan", False)]) if self.plans_enabled() else 0
            section_count = len([r for r in self.state.CreatorRows if getattr(r, "CreateSection", False)]) if self.sections_enabled() else 0
            return row_count, plan_count, section_count

        selected_scope_items = self._get_selected_creator_items()
        selected_scope_levels = self._get_selected_scope_level_map(selected_scope_items)

        row_count = 0
        for scope_item in selected_scope_items:
            scope_id = scope_item.Element.Id.IntegerValue
            scope_level_ids = selected_scope_levels.get(scope_id, set())
            applicable_levels = self.state.ScopeLevelMap.get(scope_id, [])
            for level in applicable_levels:
                try:
                    if level.Id.IntegerValue in scope_level_ids:
                        row_count += 1
                except:
                    pass

        plan_count = row_count if self.plans_enabled() else 0
        section_count = row_count if self.sections_enabled() else 0
        return row_count, plan_count, section_count

    def _rebuild_level_list(self):
        if not self._is_scope_source_mode():
            self.state.ScopeLevelMap = {}
            self.state.ApplicableLevelIds = set()
            self.state.LevelItemsVisible = []
            self.state.SelectedLevelIds = set()
            self._scope_level_visible_pairs = []
            self._scope_level_checkbox_map = {}
            try:
                self.lbLevels.ItemsSource = []
                self.lbScopeLevelStatus.ItemsSource = []
                self.tvScopeLevels.Items.Clear()
            except Exception:
                pass
            self._refresh_element_line_groups()
            return

        selected_scope_items = self._get_selected_creator_items()
        self.state.ScopeLevelMap, self.state.ApplicableLevelIds = self._get_scope_level_map(selected_scope_items)

        visible_items = []
        selected_for_display_ids = set()
        self._set_listbox_items_with_preserve(self.lbLevels, visible_items, selected_for_display_ids)
        self.state.LevelItemsVisible = visible_items

        self._rebuild_scope_level_tree(selected_scope_items)
        self._sync_scope_level_ids_from_tree()
        self._update_level_selection_status(selected_scope_items)

    def _update_level_selection_status(self, selected_scope_items=None):
        if selected_scope_items is None:
            selected_scope_items = self._get_selected_scope_items()

        status_items = []
        selected_scope_count = len(selected_scope_items)

        if selected_scope_count == 0:
            message = "Select one or more scope boxes to assign applicable levels."
        elif selected_scope_count == 1:
            scope_item = selected_scope_items[0]
            scope_id = scope_item.Element.Id.IntegerValue
            applicable_levels = self.state.ScopeLevelMap.get(scope_id, [])
            selected_ids = self._get_scope_assigned_level_ids(
                scope_id,
                set([level.Id.IntegerValue for level in applicable_levels])
            )
            selected_levels = [level for level in applicable_levels if level.Id.IntegerValue in selected_ids]
            message = "Editing levels for 1 scope box. Checked levels are assigned to this scope."
            status_items.append(ChoiceItem(self._format_scope_level_status_line(scope_item.Label, selected_levels, applicable_levels), None))
        else:
            message = "Editing levels for {0} scope boxes. Checked levels show only levels common to all selected scopes. Changes apply to all selected scopes."
            message = message.format(selected_scope_count)

            for scope_item in sorted(selected_scope_items, key=lambda x: (x.Label or "").lower()):
                scope_id = scope_item.Element.Id.IntegerValue
                applicable_levels = self.state.ScopeLevelMap.get(scope_id, [])
                selected_ids = self._get_scope_assigned_level_ids(
                    scope_id,
                    set([level.Id.IntegerValue for level in applicable_levels])
                )
                selected_levels = [level for level in applicable_levels if level.Id.IntegerValue in selected_ids]
                status_items.append(ChoiceItem(self._format_scope_level_status_line(scope_item.Label, selected_levels, applicable_levels), None))

        self.state.ScopeLevelStatusItems = status_items

        try:
            self.txtLevelSelectionStatus.Text = message
        except:
            pass

        try:
            self.lbScopeLevelStatus.ItemsSource = None
            self.lbScopeLevelStatus.ItemsSource = status_items
        except:
            pass

    def _apply_level_selection_to_selected_scopes(self):
        selected_scope_items = self._get_selected_creator_items()
        if not selected_scope_items:
            self.state.SelectedLevelIds = set()
            return

        selected_visible_ids = self._get_selected_level_ids()
        visible_ids = set()
        for item in self.state.LevelItemsVisible:
            try:
                visible_ids.add(item.Element.Id.IntegerValue)
            except:
                pass

        for scope_item in selected_scope_items:
            try:
                scope_id = scope_item.Element.Id.IntegerValue
            except:
                continue

            applicable_levels = self.state.ScopeLevelMap.get(scope_id, [])
            applicable_level_ids = set()
            for level in applicable_levels:
                try:
                    applicable_level_ids.add(level.Id.IntegerValue)
                except:
                    pass

            current_ids = self._get_scope_assigned_level_ids(scope_id, applicable_level_ids)
            visible_applicable_ids = set([level_id for level_id in visible_ids if level_id in applicable_level_ids])

            if visible_applicable_ids:
                next_ids = set(current_ids)
                next_ids.difference_update(visible_applicable_ids)
                for level_id in selected_visible_ids:
                    if level_id in applicable_level_ids:
                        next_ids.add(level_id)
                self.state.ScopeSelectedLevelIds[scope_id] = next_ids

        self.state.SelectedLevelIds = set(selected_visible_ids)
        self._update_level_selection_status(selected_scope_items)

    def _rebuild_creator_rows(self):
        if not self._is_scope_source_mode():
            self._rebuild_creator_rows_from_elements()
            return

        new_map = {}
        new_rows = []
        default_viewport_type = self._default_viewport_type_name()
        default_section_direction = self._selected_value(self.cbSectionDefaultDirection, "Front")
        sorted_levels = list(self.state.AllLevels or [])
        sorted_levels.sort(key=lambda x: float(getattr(x, "Elevation", 0.0)))
        level_name_choices = [get_name(level) for level in sorted_levels]
        next_level_name_by_id = {}
        for idx, level in enumerate(sorted_levels):
            try:
                current_id = level.Id.IntegerValue
            except Exception:
                continue
            next_name = get_name(level)
            if idx + 1 < len(sorted_levels):
                next_name = get_name(sorted_levels[idx + 1])
            next_level_name_by_id[current_id] = next_name

        selected_scope_items = self._get_selected_creator_items()
        selected_scope_levels = self._get_selected_scope_level_map(selected_scope_items)

        if not selected_scope_items:
            self.state.CreatorMap = {}
            self.state.CreatorRows = []
            self._reload_creator_grid()
            return

        for scope_item in selected_scope_items:
            scope_box = scope_item.Element
            scope_key = scope_box.Id.IntegerValue
            scope_frame = self.scope_frames.get(scope_key)
            applicable_levels = self.state.ScopeLevelMap.get(scope_key, [])
            selected_level_ids = selected_scope_levels.get(scope_key, set())

            for level in applicable_levels:
                if level.Id.IntegerValue not in selected_level_ids:
                    continue

                row = AssignmentRow(scope_box, scope_frame, level, default_viewport_type)
                row.ViewportTypeChoices = self.viewport_type_labels
                row.SectionDirection = default_section_direction
                row.LevelNameChoices = list(level_name_choices)
                row.SectionLowerLevelName = get_name(level)
                row.SectionUpperLevelName = next_level_name_by_id.get(level.Id.IntegerValue, row.SectionLowerLevelName)

                key = self._make_creator_key(scope_box, level)
                if key in self.state.CreatorMap:
                    row.copy_user_state_from(self.state.CreatorMap[key])

                row.Warning = self._compute_creator_warning(row)
                new_map[key] = row
                new_rows.append(row)

        new_rows.sort(key=lambda x: (x.ScopeBoxName.lower(), float(x.Level.Elevation)))

        if self._selected_value(self.cbSectionCreateMode, "Per Plan View") == "Per Source":
            first_by_source = set()
            for row in new_rows:
                source_id = row.ScopeBox.Id.IntegerValue
                if source_id not in first_by_source:
                    first_by_source.add(source_id)
                    row.CreateSection = True
                else:
                    row.CreateSection = False

        self.state.CreatorMap = new_map
        self.state.CreatorRows = new_rows
        self._reload_creator_grid()

    def _build_merged_scope_frame(self, frames):
        valid = [f for f in (frames or []) if f]
        if not valid:
            return None

        first = valid[0]
        center_x = sum([float(f.Center.X) for f in valid]) / float(len(valid))
        center_y = sum([float(f.Center.Y) for f in valid]) / float(len(valid))
        center_z = sum([float(f.Center.Z) for f in valid]) / float(len(valid))
        z_min = min([float(f.ZMin) for f in valid])
        z_max = max([float(f.ZMax) for f in valid])
        size_x = max([float(f.SizeX) for f in valid])
        size_y = max([float(f.SizeY) for f in valid])

        return ScopeFrame(
            XYZ(center_x, center_y, center_z),
            first.AxisX,
            first.AxisY,
            z_min,
            z_max,
            size_x,
            size_y,
            "ElementLine",
            []
        )

    def _rebuild_creator_rows_from_elements(self):
        new_map = {}
        new_rows = []
        default_viewport_type = self._default_viewport_type_name()
        default_section_direction = self._selected_value(self.cbSectionDefaultDirection, "Front")
        split_mode = self._selected_value(self.cbElementSplitMode, "Per Number")

        selected_rows = []
        try:
            selected_rows = [row for row in self.dgCreatorElements.SelectedItems if row]
        except Exception:
            selected_rows = []

        source_rows = list(selected_rows)
        if not source_rows:
            self.state.CreatorMap = {}
            self.state.CreatorRows = []
            self._reload_creator_grid()
            return

        groups = self._build_element_line_groups(source_rows)
        selected_line_keys = set(groups.keys())

        sorted_levels = list(self.state.AllLevels or [])
        sorted_levels.sort(key=lambda x: float(getattr(x, "Elevation", 0.0)))
        level_name_choices = [get_name(level) for level in sorted_levels]

        grouped_section_mode = self._is_element_grouped_section_mode()
        first_section_row_by_group = {}

        for group_key in sorted(groups.keys()):
            if group_key not in selected_line_keys:
                continue

            data = groups[group_key]
            group_levels = list(data.get("levels", {}).values())
            group_levels.sort(key=lambda x: float(x.Elevation))
            if not group_levels:
                continue

            merged_frame = self._build_merged_scope_frame(data.get("frames", []))
            line_name = data.get("mark", "") or getattr(data.get("items", [None])[0], "TypeName", "") or "Element"
            section_source_name = u"{0} | XY {1}".format(line_name, data.get("xy_label", "?"))

            for source_item in data.get("items", []):
                source_element = getattr(source_item, "Element", None)
                if not source_element:
                    continue

                try:
                    source_element_id = source_element.Id.IntegerValue
                except Exception:
                    continue

                instance_frame = self.scope_frames.get(source_element_id)
                if not instance_frame:
                    continue

                primary_level = self._get_primary_level_for_element_row(source_item, instance_frame)
                if not primary_level:
                    continue

                row = AssignmentRow(source_element, instance_frame, primary_level, default_viewport_type)
                row.ViewportTypeChoices = self.viewport_type_labels
                row.SectionDirection = default_section_direction
                row.LevelNameChoices = list(level_name_choices)
                row.ScopeBoxName = u"{0} [{1}]".format(source_item.InstanceLabel or source_item.TypeName or "Element", source_element_id)
                row.SourceGroupKey = group_key
                row.SourceLineNumber = line_name
                row.SectionSourceName = section_source_name
                row.SectionScopeFrame = merged_frame if grouped_section_mode and merged_frame else instance_frame
                row.SuppressLevelInName = (split_mode == "Per Number")

                lower_name = (getattr(source_item, "BaseConstraint", "") or "").strip() or get_name(primary_level)
                upper_name = (getattr(source_item, "TopConstraint", "") or "").strip() or lower_name
                if grouped_section_mode:
                    lower_name = get_name(group_levels[0])
                    upper_name = get_name(group_levels[-1])
                row.SectionLowerLevelName = lower_name
                row.SectionUpperLevelName = upper_name

                key = self._make_creator_key(source_element, primary_level)
                if key in self.state.CreatorMap:
                    row.copy_user_state_from(self.state.CreatorMap[key])

                if grouped_section_mode:
                    if group_key not in first_section_row_by_group:
                        first_section_row_by_group[group_key] = key
                    row.CreateSection = (first_section_row_by_group[group_key] == key)

                row.Warning = self._compute_creator_warning(row)
                new_map[key] = row
                new_rows.append(row)

        new_rows.sort(key=lambda x: (x.ScopeBoxName.lower(), float(x.Level.Elevation)))

        if self._is_scope_grouped_section_mode():
            first_by_source = set()
            for row in new_rows:
                source_id = row.SourceGroupKey or str(row.ScopeBox.Id.IntegerValue)
                if source_id not in first_by_source:
                    first_by_source.add(source_id)
                    row.CreateSection = True
                else:
                    row.CreateSection = False

        self.state.CreatorMap = new_map
        self.state.CreatorRows = new_rows
        self._reload_creator_grid()

    def _selector_view_matches_filters(self, item):
        text_filter = self._get_filtered_selector_view_text()
        if text_filter and text_filter not in item["Label"].lower():
            return False

        type_filter = self._selected_value(self.cbSelectorViewType, "All")
        if type_filter != "All" and item["TypeLabel"] != type_filter:
            return False

        placed_filter = self._selected_value(self.cbSelectorPlacedFilter, "All")
        if placed_filter == "Placed Only" and not item["Placed"]:
            return False
        if placed_filter == "Unplaced Only" and item["Placed"]:
            return False

        level_filter = self._selected_value(self.cbSelectorLevelFilter, "All")
        if level_filter != "All" and (item["LevelName"] or "") != level_filter:
            return False

        return True

    def refresh_selector_views_only(self):
        self._ensure_selector_cache_loaded()
        selected_ids = self._get_selected_selector_view_ids()
        visible = []

        for view_info in self.state.SelectorAllViewItems:
            if self._selector_view_matches_filters(view_info):
                visible.append(ChoiceItem(view_info["Label"], view_info["View"]))

        self.state.SelectorVisibleItems = visible
        self._set_listbox_items_with_preserve(self.lbSelectedViews, visible, selected_ids)

    def _rebuild_selector_rows(self):
        self._rebuild_selector_rows_from_items(self._get_selected_selector_view_items())

    def _rebuild_selector_rows_from_items(self, selected_items):
        new_map = {}
        new_rows = []
        default_viewport_type = self._default_viewport_type_name()

        if not selected_items:
            self.state.SelectorMap = {}
            self.state.SelectorRows = []
            self._reload_selector_grid()
            return

        for item in selected_items:
            view = item.Element
            key = self._make_selector_key(view)
            row = SelectorRow(view, default_viewport_type)
            row.ViewportTypeChoices = self.viewport_type_labels

            if key in self.state.SelectorMap:
                row.copy_user_state_from(self.state.SelectorMap[key])

            try:
                row.IsPlaced = any(v["View"].Id.IntegerValue == view.Id.IntegerValue and v["Placed"] for v in self.state.SelectorAllViewItems)
                row.PlacedText = "Yes" if row.IsPlaced else "No"

                match = None
                for v in self.state.SelectorAllViewItems:
                    try:
                        if v["View"].Id.IntegerValue == view.Id.IntegerValue:
                            match = v
                            break
                    except:
                        pass

                if match:
                    row.CurrentSheetNumber = match.get("CurrentSheetNumber", "") or ""
                    row.CurrentSheetName = match.get("CurrentSheetName", "") or ""
                    row.CurrentSheetLabel = match.get("CurrentSheetLabel", "") or ""
                    row.CurrentSheetId = match.get("CurrentSheetId", None)
            except:
                row.IsPlaced = False
                row.PlacedText = "No"
                row.CurrentSheetNumber = ""
                row.CurrentSheetName = ""
                row.CurrentSheetLabel = ""
                row.CurrentSheetId = None

            new_map[key] = row
            new_rows.append(row)

        new_rows.sort(key=lambda x: (safe_int(x.Order, 0), x.LevelElevation, x.ViewName.lower()))
        self.state.SelectorMap = new_map
        self.state.SelectorRows = new_rows
        self._reload_selector_grid()

    def _set_stage2_views(self, views):
        if self.get_source_mode() == "Selector":
            self._ensure_selector_cache_loaded(True)
        else:
            self.state.SelectorAllViewItems = []
        info_by_id = {}
        for item in self.state.SelectorAllViewItems:
            try:
                info_by_id[item["View"].Id.IntegerValue] = item
            except Exception:
                pass

        selected_items = []
        selected_ids = set()
        for view in views:
            try:
                view_id = view.Id.IntegerValue
                selected_ids.add(view_id)
            except Exception:
                continue

            info = info_by_id.get(view_id, None)
            if info:
                label = info.get("Label", get_name(view))
            else:
                label = get_name(view)
            selected_items.append(ChoiceItem(label, view))

        selected_items.sort(key=lambda x: (get_name(x.Element) or "").lower())
        self.state.SelectorVisibleItems = list(selected_items)
        self._set_listbox_items_with_preserve(self.lbSelectedViews, selected_items, selected_ids)
        self._rebuild_selector_rows_from_items(selected_items)
        self._stage2_staged_view_mode = True

    def refresh_scope_and_levels(self):
        self.last_creator_signature = None
        self._rebuild_level_list()
        self._invalidate_creator_rows()
        self.mark_preview_dirty()
        self.refresh_summary(False)

    def refresh_selector_only(self):
        self._rebuild_selector_rows()
        self.mark_preview_dirty()
        self.refresh_summary(False)

    def get_layout_request(self):
        request = LayoutRequest()
        request.LayoutType = self._selected_value(self.cbLayoutType, "Grid")
        request.GridColumns = try_parse_positive_int(self.tbGridColumns.Text, DEFAULT_GRID_COLUMNS)
        request.GridRows = try_parse_positive_int(self.tbGridRows.Text, DEFAULT_GRID_ROWS)
        request.UnequalRowPattern = self._parse_unequal_row_pattern(self.tbUnequalRowPattern.Text)
        request.HorizontalGapMm = try_parse_positive_float(self.tbHorizontalGap.Text, DEFAULT_GAP_MM)
        request.VerticalGapMm = try_parse_positive_float(self.tbVerticalGap.Text, DEFAULT_GAP_MM)
        request.MarginMm = try_parse_positive_float(self.tbSheetMargin.Text, DEFAULT_MARGIN_MM)
        request.PlanPosition = self._selected_value(self.cbPlanPosition, "Top Left")
        request.FlowDirection = self._selected_value(self.cbFlowDirection, "Row Major")
        return request

    def _parse_unequal_row_pattern(self, pattern_text):
        values = []
        for token in str(pattern_text or "").split(","):
            token = token.strip()
            if not token:
                continue
            parsed = try_parse_positive_int(token, None)
            if parsed:
                values.append(parsed)
        return values

    def get_reserved_offsets_mm(self):
        return (
            try_parse_non_negative_float(self.tbReservedLeft.Text, DEFAULT_RESERVED_LEFT_MM),
            try_parse_non_negative_float(self.tbReservedRight.Text, DEFAULT_RESERVED_RIGHT_MM),
            try_parse_non_negative_float(self.tbReservedTop.Text, DEFAULT_RESERVED_TOP_MM),
            try_parse_non_negative_float(self.tbReservedBottom.Text, DEFAULT_RESERVED_BOTTOM_MM)
        )

    def get_usable_sheet_bounds(self, sheet):
        bounds = get_sheet_rect_bounds(sheet)
        margin_ft = mm_to_ft(try_parse_positive_float(self.tbSheetMargin.Text, DEFAULT_MARGIN_MM))
        left_mm, right_mm, top_mm, bottom_mm = self.get_reserved_offsets_mm()

        min_x = bounds[0] + margin_ft + mm_to_ft(left_mm)
        min_y = bounds[1] + margin_ft + mm_to_ft(bottom_mm)
        max_x = bounds[2] - margin_ft - mm_to_ft(right_mm)
        max_y = bounds[3] - margin_ft - mm_to_ft(top_mm)

        if max_x <= min_x or max_y <= min_y:
            min_x = bounds[0] + margin_ft
            min_y = bounds[1] + margin_ft
            max_x = bounds[2] - margin_ft
            max_y = bounds[3] - margin_ft

        return (min_x, min_y, max_x, max_y)

    def _get_view_outline_size_ft(self, view):
        return get_view_outline_size_ft(view)

    def _build_viewport_index_by_view_id(self):
        return build_viewport_index_by_view_id()

    def _get_preview_sheet_bounds(self):
        if self.get_create_mode() == "Views + Sheets" and self.get_sheet_mode() == "Existing Sheets":
            selected_sheets = self.get_selected_existing_sheets()
            if selected_sheets:
                try:
                    return self.get_usable_sheet_bounds(selected_sheets[0])
                except:
                    pass

        return DEFAULT_PREVIEW_SHEET_BOUNDS

    def _get_creator_row_actual_outline_size_ft(self, row, role):
        if not isinstance(row, AssignmentRow):
            return None, None

        role_key = "Plan" if role == "Plan" else "Section"
        try:
            key = (row.ScopeBox.Id.IntegerValue, row.Level.Id.IntegerValue, role_key)
            view = self._stage1_creator_view_map.get(key, None)
        except Exception:
            view = None

        if view:
            width, height = self._get_view_outline_size_ft(view)
            if width and height:
                return width, height

        return None, None

    def _estimate_row_sheet_footprint_ft(self, row, role):
        if isinstance(row, SelectorRow):
            width, height = self._get_view_outline_size_ft(row.View)
            if width and height:
                return width, height

            try:
                scale = max(1.0, float(getattr(row.View, "Scale", 100) or 100))
            except:
                scale = 100.0

            if role == "Section":
                return (max(0.20, 30.0 / scale), max(0.20, 50.0 / scale))
            return (max(0.25, 50.0 / scale), max(0.20, 35.0 / scale))

        # Creator mode: prefer actual Stage 1 view extents when available.
        width, height = self._get_creator_row_actual_outline_size_ft(row, role)
        if width and height:
            return width, height

        # Creator mode fallback: approximate from scope dimensions and a reference scale.
        scale = 100.0
        try:
            scale = max(1.0, float(doc.ActiveView.Scale))
        except:
            pass

        if not isinstance(row, AssignmentRow) or not row.ScopeFrame:
            return (0.35, 0.25) if role == "Plan" else (0.25, 0.35)

        if role == "Plan":
            width_model = max(EPS, float(row.ScopeFrame.SizeX))
            height_model = max(EPS, float(row.ScopeFrame.SizeY))
        else:
            section_frame = self._get_row_section_frame(row)
            if not section_frame:
                return (0.25, 0.35)
            if row.SectionDirection in ["Front", "Back"]:
                width_model = max(EPS, float(section_frame.SizeX))
            else:
                width_model = max(EPS, float(section_frame.SizeY))
            min_height_ft = mm_to_ft(try_parse_positive_float(self.tbMinSectionHeight.Text, DEFAULT_MIN_SECTION_HEIGHT_MM))
            height_model = max(min_height_ft, max(EPS, float(section_frame.ZMax - section_frame.ZMin)))

        width = max(0.15, width_model / scale)
        height = max(0.15, height_model / scale)
        return width, height

    def _build_weighted_grid_positions(self, bounds, placements, columns, hgap_ft, vgap_ft):
        count = len(placements)
        if count <= 0:
            return []

        min_x, min_y, max_x, max_y = bounds
        usable_w = max(0.0, max_x - min_x)
        usable_h = max(0.0, max_y - min_y)
        columns = max(1, int(columns))
        rows = int(math.ceil(float(count) / float(columns)))

        col_widths = [0.0] * columns
        row_heights = [0.0] * rows

        for index, placement in enumerate(placements):
            row_index = int(index / columns)
            col_index = int(index % columns)
            item_w, item_h = self._estimate_row_sheet_footprint_ft(placement.SourceRow, placement.Role)
            col_widths[col_index] = max(col_widths[col_index], item_w)
            row_heights[row_index] = max(row_heights[row_index], item_h)

        total_gap_w = max(0.0, float(columns - 1) * hgap_ft)
        total_gap_h = max(0.0, float(rows - 1) * vgap_ft)
        content_w = sum(col_widths)
        content_h = sum(row_heights)

        scale_w = (usable_w - total_gap_w) / content_w if content_w > EPS and usable_w > total_gap_w else 1.0
        scale_h = (usable_h - total_gap_h) / content_h if content_h > EPS and usable_h > total_gap_h else 1.0
        scale = min(1.0, scale_w, scale_h)
        if scale <= EPS:
            scale = 1.0

        if scale < 1.0:
            col_widths = [w * scale for w in col_widths]
            row_heights = [h * scale for h in row_heights]

        used_w = sum(col_widths) + total_gap_w
        used_h = sum(row_heights) + total_gap_h

        start_x = min_x + max(0.0, (usable_w - used_w) * 0.5)
        start_y = max_y - max(0.0, (usable_h - used_h) * 0.5)

        col_starts = []
        cursor_x = start_x
        for width in col_widths:
            col_starts.append(cursor_x)
            cursor_x += width + hgap_ft

        row_tops = []
        cursor_y = start_y
        for height in row_heights:
            row_tops.append(cursor_y)
            cursor_y -= (height + vgap_ft)

        centers = []
        for index in range(count):
            row_index = int(index / columns)
            col_index = int(index % columns)
            center_x = col_starts[col_index] + (col_widths[col_index] * 0.5)
            center_y = row_tops[row_index] - (row_heights[row_index] * 0.5)
            centers.append(XYZ(center_x, center_y, 0.0))

        return centers

    def _build_weighted_rows_positions(self, bounds, placements, row_columns, hgap_ft, vgap_ft):
        count = len(placements)
        if count <= 0:
            return []

        if not row_columns:
            return self._build_weighted_grid_positions(bounds, placements, max(1, int(self.tbGridColumns.Text or DEFAULT_GRID_COLUMNS)), hgap_ft, vgap_ft)

        normalized = [max(1, int(x)) for x in row_columns]
        rows = []
        index = 0

        while index < count:
            for cols in normalized:
                if index >= count:
                    break
                end_index = min(count, index + cols)
                rows.append((index, end_index, cols))
                index = end_index

        min_x, min_y, max_x, max_y = bounds
        usable_w = max(0.0, max_x - min_x)
        usable_h = max(0.0, max_y - min_y)

        row_heights = []
        row_col_widths = []

        for start_index, end_index, cols in rows:
            row_items = placements[start_index:end_index]
            widths = [0.0] * cols
            row_h = 0.0

            for i, placement in enumerate(row_items):
                item_w, item_h = self._estimate_row_sheet_footprint_ft(placement.SourceRow, placement.Role)
                col_index = i if i < cols else cols - 1
                widths[col_index] = max(widths[col_index], item_w)
                row_h = max(row_h, item_h)

            row_col_widths.append(widths)
            row_heights.append(row_h)

        max_cols = max([len(x) for x in row_col_widths]) if row_col_widths else 1
        global_col_widths = [0.0] * max_cols
        for widths in row_col_widths:
            for i, w in enumerate(widths):
                global_col_widths[i] = max(global_col_widths[i], w)

        total_gap_w = max(0.0, float(max_cols - 1) * hgap_ft)
        total_gap_h = max(0.0, float(len(rows) - 1) * vgap_ft)
        content_w = sum(global_col_widths)
        content_h = sum(row_heights)

        scale_w = (usable_w - total_gap_w) / content_w if content_w > EPS and usable_w > total_gap_w else 1.0
        scale_h = (usable_h - total_gap_h) / content_h if content_h > EPS and usable_h > total_gap_h else 1.0
        scale = min(1.0, scale_w, scale_h)
        if scale <= EPS:
            scale = 1.0

        if scale < 1.0:
            global_col_widths = [w * scale for w in global_col_widths]
            row_heights = [h * scale for h in row_heights]

        used_w = sum(global_col_widths) + total_gap_w
        used_h = sum(row_heights) + total_gap_h

        start_x = min_x + max(0.0, (usable_w - used_w) * 0.5)
        start_y = max_y - max(0.0, (usable_h - used_h) * 0.5)

        col_starts = []
        cursor_x = start_x
        for width in global_col_widths:
            col_starts.append(cursor_x)
            cursor_x += width + hgap_ft

        centers = []
        cursor_y_top = start_y
        for row_index, (start_index, end_index, cols) in enumerate(rows):
            row_h = row_heights[row_index]
            row_items = placements[start_index:end_index]
            for item_index, _ in enumerate(row_items):
                center_x = col_starts[item_index] + (global_col_widths[item_index] * 0.5)
                center_y = cursor_y_top - (row_h * 0.5)
                centers.append(XYZ(center_x, center_y, 0.0))
            cursor_y_top -= (row_h + vgap_ft)

        return centers

    def apply_layout_preset(self, preset_name):
        self.suspend_events = True
        try:
            preset_name = preset_name or "Grid - Equal"

            if preset_name == "Grid - Unequal":
                self._select_combo_value(self.cbLayoutType, "Grid - Unequal")
                self.tbGridColumns.Text = "3"
                self.tbGridRows.Text = ""
                self.tbHorizontalGap.Text = "20"
                self.tbVerticalGap.Text = "20"
                self.tbSheetMargin.Text = "15"
            elif preset_name == "Stack Vertical":
                self._select_combo_value(self.cbLayoutType, "Vertical Stack")
                self.tbGridColumns.Text = "1"
                self.tbGridRows.Text = ""
                self.tbHorizontalGap.Text = "20"
                self.tbVerticalGap.Text = "20"
                self.tbSheetMargin.Text = "15"
            elif preset_name == "Free Form":
                self._select_combo_value(self.cbLayoutType, "Free Form")
                self.tbGridColumns.Text = "3"
                self.tbGridRows.Text = ""
                self.tbHorizontalGap.Text = "20"
                self.tbVerticalGap.Text = "20"
                self.tbSheetMargin.Text = "15"
            elif preset_name == "Plan Top + Sections":
                self._select_combo_value(self.cbLayoutType, "Plan Top + Sections Below")
                self.tbGridColumns.Text = "3"
                self.tbGridRows.Text = ""
                self.tbHorizontalGap.Text = "20"
                self.tbVerticalGap.Text = "20"
                self.tbSheetMargin.Text = "15"
                self._select_combo_value(self.cbPlanPosition, "Top Left")
            elif preset_name == "Dense Sections":
                self._select_combo_value(self.cbLayoutType, "Grid")
                self.tbGridColumns.Text = "4"
                self.tbGridRows.Text = ""
                self.tbHorizontalGap.Text = "12"
                self.tbVerticalGap.Text = "12"
                self.tbSheetMargin.Text = "12"
            else:
                self._select_combo_value(self.cbLayoutType, "Grid")
                self.tbGridColumns.Text = "3"
                self.tbGridRows.Text = ""
                self.tbHorizontalGap.Text = "20"
                self.tbVerticalGap.Text = "20"
                self.tbSheetMargin.Text = "15"

            self._update_layout_panels()
        finally:
            self.suspend_events = False

    def get_active_rows(self):
        return self.state.SelectorRows if self.get_effective_source_mode() == "Selector" else self.state.CreatorRows

    def _should_keep_scope_groups(self):
        if self.get_source_mode() != "Creator":
            return False
        try:
            return bool(self.chkKeepScopeGroups.IsChecked)
        except:
            return False

    def get_active_groups(self):
        if self.get_effective_source_mode() == "Selector":
            return [{"name": "Selected Views", "rows": list(self.state.SelectorRows)}]

        if not self._should_keep_scope_groups():
            return [{"name": "Combined Scope Boxes", "rows": list(self.state.CreatorRows)}]

        groups = {}
        for row in self.state.CreatorRows:
            key = row.ScopeBox.Id.IntegerValue
            if key not in groups:
                groups[key] = {"name": row.ScopeBoxName, "rows": []}
            groups[key]["rows"].append(row)

        ordered = list(groups.values())
        ordered.sort(key=lambda x: x["name"].lower())
        return ordered

    def build_layout_for_rows(self, rows, bounds, request=None):
        request = request or self.get_layout_request()
        hgap_ft = mm_to_ft(request.HorizontalGapMm)
        vgap_ft = mm_to_ft(request.VerticalGapMm)

        plans = []
        sections = []

        for row in rows:
            if isinstance(row, AssignmentRow):
                if self.plans_enabled() and row.CreatePlan:
                    plans.append(PlannedPlacement("Plan", row, safe_int(row.PlanOrder, 0)))
                if self.sections_enabled() and row.CreateSection:
                    sections.append(PlannedPlacement("Section", row, safe_int(row.SectionOrder, 0)))
            else:
                role = row.Role or "Plan"
                order_value = safe_int(row.Order, 0)
                if role == "Plan" and self.plans_enabled():
                    plans.append(PlannedPlacement("Plan", row, order_value))
                elif role != "Plan" and self.sections_enabled():
                    sections.append(PlannedPlacement("Section", row, order_value))

        plans.sort(key=lambda x: (x.Order, getattr(x.SourceRow, "LevelName", "").lower(), getattr(x.SourceRow, "ViewName", "").lower()))
        sections.sort(key=lambda x: (x.Order, getattr(x.SourceRow, "LevelName", "").lower(), getattr(x.SourceRow, "ViewName", "").lower()))

        sequence = plans + sections
        return self._layout_existing_placements(sequence, bounds, request)

    def _layout_existing_placements(self, sequence, bounds, request):
        request = request or self.get_layout_request()
        hgap_ft = mm_to_ft(request.HorizontalGapMm)
        vgap_ft = mm_to_ft(request.VerticalGapMm)

        plans = [placement for placement in sequence if placement.Role == "Plan"]
        sections = [placement for placement in sequence if placement.Role != "Plan"]
        sequence = plans + sections

        if request.LayoutType == "Vertical Stack":
            centers = self._build_weighted_grid_positions(bounds, sequence, 1, 0.0, vgap_ft)
        elif request.LayoutType == "Plan Top + Sections Below":
            centers = build_plan_top_sections_positions(
                bounds,
                len(plans),
                len(sections),
                max(1, int(request.GridColumns)),
                hgap_ft,
                vgap_ft,
                request.PlanPosition
            )
        elif request.LayoutType == "Grid":
            centers = build_grid_positions_with_rows(
                bounds,
                len(sequence),
                max(1, int(request.GridColumns)),
                request.GridRows,
                hgap_ft,
                vgap_ft
            )
        elif request.LayoutType == "Grid - Unequal":
            centers = self._build_weighted_rows_positions(bounds, sequence, request.UnequalRowPattern, hgap_ft, vgap_ft)
        else:
            if request.UnequalRowPattern:
                centers = self._build_weighted_rows_positions(bounds, sequence, request.UnequalRowPattern, hgap_ft, vgap_ft)
            else:
                centers = self._build_weighted_grid_positions(bounds, sequence, max(1, int(request.GridColumns)), hgap_ft, vgap_ft)

        for index in range(min(len(sequence), len(centers))):
            sequence[index].TargetCenter = centers[index]

        self._apply_free_form_overrides(sequence, bounds, request)

        return sequence

    def _wrap_sheet_overflow_enabled(self):
        try:
            return bool(self.chkWrapSheetOverflow.IsChecked)
        except Exception:
            return False

    def _layout_within_bounds(self, placements, bounds):
        min_x, min_y, max_x, max_y = bounds
        for placement in placements:
            if not getattr(placement, "TargetCenter", None):
                return False

            est_w_ft, est_h_ft = self._estimate_row_sheet_footprint_ft(placement.SourceRow, placement.Role)
            half_w = max(EPS, float(est_w_ft) * 0.5)
            half_h = max(EPS, float(est_h_ft) * 0.5)

            cx = float(placement.TargetCenter.X)
            cy = float(placement.TargetCenter.Y)
            if (cx - half_w) < (min_x - EPS):
                return False
            if (cx + half_w) > (max_x + EPS):
                return False
            if (cy - half_h) < (min_y - EPS):
                return False
            if (cy + half_h) > (max_y + EPS):
                return False

        return True

    def _build_wrapped_grid_sheet_layouts(self, placements, bounds, request, capacity_hint):
        placements = list(placements or [])
        if not placements:
            return []

        min_x, min_y, max_x, max_y = bounds
        usable_w = max(EPS, max_x - min_x)
        usable_h = max(EPS, max_y - min_y)
        hgap_ft = mm_to_ft(request.HorizontalGapMm)
        vgap_ft = mm_to_ft(request.VerticalGapMm)
        cols = max(1, int(request.GridColumns or 1))
        capacity_hint = max(1, int(capacity_hint or 1))

        layouts = []

        state = {
            "current_rows": [],  # list[(row_items, row_h)] where row_items is list[(placement,w,h)]
            "current_row": [],
            "current_row_w": 0.0,
            "current_row_h": 0.0,
            "used_h": 0.0,
            "sheet_items_count": 0
        }

        def _row_width(row_items):
            if not row_items:
                return 0.0
            return sum(item[1] for item in row_items) + (max(0, len(row_items) - 1) * hgap_ft)

        def _emit_current_sheet():
            current_rows = state["current_rows"]
            if not current_rows:
                return

            total_h = sum(rh for _, rh in current_rows)
            total_h += max(0, len(current_rows) - 1) * vgap_ft
            top_y = max_y - max(0.0, (usable_h - total_h) * 0.5)

            sheet_layout = []
            cursor_y = top_y
            for row_items, row_h in current_rows:
                rw = _row_width(row_items)
                start_x = min_x + max(0.0, (usable_w - rw) * 0.5)

                cursor_x = start_x
                cy = cursor_y - (row_h * 0.5)
                for placement, pw, _ph in row_items:
                    cx = cursor_x + (pw * 0.5)
                    placement.TargetCenter = XYZ(cx, cy, 0.0)
                    sheet_layout.append(placement)
                    cursor_x += pw + hgap_ft

                cursor_y -= (row_h + vgap_ft)

            layouts.append(sheet_layout)

        def _commit_current_row_or_new_sheet():
            current_rows = state["current_rows"]
            current_row = state["current_row"]
            current_row_h = state["current_row_h"]
            used_h = state["used_h"]

            if not current_row:
                return

            projected_h = used_h + (vgap_ft if current_rows else 0.0) + current_row_h
            if current_rows and projected_h > (usable_h + EPS):
                # Current row does not fit this sheet; emit current rows and start new sheet.
                _emit_current_sheet()
                current_rows = []
                used_h = 0.0
                state["sheet_items_count"] = 0

            row_len = len(current_row)
            current_rows.append((list(current_row), current_row_h))
            used_h += (vgap_ft if len(current_rows) > 1 else 0.0) + current_row_h
            state["sheet_items_count"] = state["sheet_items_count"] + row_len

            state["current_rows"] = current_rows
            state["used_h"] = used_h
            state["current_row"] = []
            state["current_row_w"] = 0.0
            state["current_row_h"] = 0.0

        for placement in placements:
            if state["sheet_items_count"] >= capacity_hint and (state["current_rows"] or state["current_row"]):
                _commit_current_row_or_new_sheet()
                _emit_current_sheet()
                state["current_rows"] = []
                state["used_h"] = 0.0
                state["sheet_items_count"] = 0

            w, h = self._estimate_row_sheet_footprint_ft(placement.SourceRow, placement.Role)
            pw = max(EPS, min(float(w), usable_w))
            ph = max(EPS, min(float(h), usable_h))

            requires_new_row = False
            if state["current_row"]:
                if len(state["current_row"]) >= cols:
                    requires_new_row = True
                else:
                    candidate_w = state["current_row_w"] + hgap_ft + pw
                    if candidate_w > (usable_w + EPS):
                        requires_new_row = True

            if requires_new_row:
                _commit_current_row_or_new_sheet()

            if (not state["current_row"]) and state["current_rows"]:
                projected_h = state["used_h"] + vgap_ft + ph
                if projected_h > (usable_h + EPS):
                    _emit_current_sheet()
                    state["current_rows"] = []
                    state["used_h"] = 0.0
                    state["sheet_items_count"] = 0

            if not state["current_row"]:
                state["current_row_w"] = pw
                state["current_row_h"] = ph
            else:
                state["current_row_w"] = state["current_row_w"] + hgap_ft + pw
                state["current_row_h"] = max(state["current_row_h"], ph)

            state["current_row"].append((placement, pw, ph))

        _commit_current_row_or_new_sheet()
        _emit_current_sheet()

        return layouts

    def _pack_placements_to_sheet_layouts(self, placements, bounds, request, capacity_hint):
        placements = list(placements or [])
        if not placements:
            return []

        capacity_hint = max(1, int(capacity_hint or 1))

        if not self._wrap_sheet_overflow_enabled():
            layouts = []
            for chunk in chunk_list(placements, capacity_hint):
                layouts.append(self._layout_existing_placements(list(chunk), bounds, request))
            return layouts

        if request.LayoutType == "Grid":
            return self._build_wrapped_grid_sheet_layouts(placements, bounds, request, capacity_hint)

        layouts = []
        start = 0
        total = len(placements)

        while start < total:
            best_layout = None
            best_count = 0
            max_end = min(total, start + max(1, capacity_hint * 2))

            for end in range(start + 1, max_end + 1):
                candidate = [placements[i] for i in range(start, end)]
                candidate_layout = self._layout_existing_placements(candidate, bounds, request)
                if self._layout_within_bounds(candidate_layout, bounds):
                    best_layout = candidate_layout
                    best_count = end - start

            if best_layout is None:
                # Keep progress guaranteed even for a single oversized view.
                best_layout = self._layout_existing_placements([placements[start]], bounds, request)
                best_count = 1

            layouts.append(best_layout)
            start += best_count

        return layouts

    def _build_sheet_layouts_for_rows(self, rows, bounds, request, capacity_hint):
        placements_full = self.build_layout_for_rows(rows, bounds, request)
        return self._pack_placements_to_sheet_layouts(placements_full, bounds, request, capacity_hint)

    def estimate_total_required_sheets(self):
        if self.get_create_mode() == "Views Only":
            return 0

        if self.get_source_mode() == "Creator" and self.creator_rows_dirty:
            capacity = estimate_layout_capacity(self.get_layout_request())
            selected_scope_items = self._get_selected_creator_items()
            selected_scope_levels = self._get_selected_scope_level_map(selected_scope_items)

            if self._should_keep_scope_groups():
                total = 0
                for scope_item in selected_scope_items:
                    scope_id = scope_item.Element.Id.IntegerValue
                    scope_level_ids = selected_scope_levels.get(scope_id, set())
                    scope_rows = 0
                    for level in self.state.ScopeLevelMap.get(scope_id, []):
                        try:
                            if level.Id.IntegerValue in scope_level_ids:
                                scope_rows += 1
                        except:
                            pass

                    scope_views = 0
                    if self.plans_enabled():
                        scope_views += scope_rows
                    if self.sections_enabled():
                        scope_views += scope_rows

                    total += len(chunk_list(range(scope_views), capacity))

                return total

            total_rows = 0
            for scope_item in selected_scope_items:
                scope_id = scope_item.Element.Id.IntegerValue
                scope_level_ids = selected_scope_levels.get(scope_id, set())
                for level in self.state.ScopeLevelMap.get(scope_id, []):
                    try:
                        if level.Id.IntegerValue in scope_level_ids:
                            total_rows += 1
                    except:
                        pass

            total_views = 0
            if self.plans_enabled():
                total_views += total_rows
            if self.sections_enabled():
                total_views += total_rows

            return len(chunk_list(range(total_views), capacity))

        self._ensure_creator_rows_current()

        capacity = estimate_layout_capacity(self.get_layout_request())
        if self._wrap_sheet_overflow_enabled():
            total = 0
            bounds = self._get_preview_sheet_bounds()
            request = self.get_layout_request()
            for group in self.get_active_groups():
                layouts = self._build_sheet_layouts_for_rows(group["rows"], bounds, request, capacity)
                total += len(layouts)
            return total

        total = 0
        for group in self.get_active_groups():
            total += self._estimate_group_preview_meta(group["rows"], capacity)["sheet_count"]
        return total

    def update_sheet_panel_visibility(self):
        create_sheets = (self.get_create_mode() == "Views + Sheets")
        self.chkCreateSheets.IsChecked = create_sheets
        self.chkCreateSheets.IsEnabled = False

        panel_vis = Visibility.Visible if create_sheets else Visibility.Collapsed
        self.pnlSheetMode.Visibility = panel_vis
        self.grpNewSheets.Visibility = panel_vis if create_sheets and self.rbNewSheets.IsChecked else Visibility.Collapsed
        self.grpExistingSheets.Visibility = panel_vis if create_sheets and self.rbExistingSheets.IsChecked else Visibility.Collapsed
        self.grpUsableRegion.Visibility = panel_vis

    def update_advanced_mode(self):
        vis = Visibility.Visible if bool(self.chkAdvancedMode.IsChecked) else Visibility.Collapsed
        try:
            self.colCreatorPlanOrder.Visibility = vis
            self.colCreatorSectionOrder.Visibility = vis
            self.colCreatorWarning.Visibility = vis
        except:
            pass

    def mark_preview_dirty(self):
        self.state.PreviewDirty = True
        self.state.PreviewSignature = None
        self.txtPreviewHint.Text = "Preview out of date. Click Preview."

    def clear_preview(self):
        self.spPreviewCards.Children.Clear()
        self._freeform_preview_items = {}
        self._freeform_selected_view_keys = set()
        self._freeform_selected_title_keys = set()

    def get_selected_existing_sheets(self):
        result = []
        for item in self._get_selected_existing_sheet_items():
            try:
                result.append(item.Element)
            except:
                pass
        return result

    def refresh_summary(self, force_full):
        if not force_full:
            try:
                now = time.time()
                if now - float(self._last_summary_refresh_at) < SUMMARY_REFRESH_MIN_INTERVAL_SEC:
                    return
            except:
                pass

        source_mode = self.get_effective_source_mode()
        scopes_count = len(self._get_selected_creator_items()) if source_mode == "Creator" else 0
        levels_count = 0
        if source_mode == "Creator":
            selected_scope_levels = self._get_selected_scope_level_map()
            levels_count = sum(len(level_ids) for level_ids in selected_scope_levels.values())

        warnings = []

        if source_mode == "Creator" and self.creator_rows_dirty:
            row_count, plan_count, section_count = self._estimate_creator_counts()
        else:
            rows = self.get_active_rows()
            row_count = len(rows)
            plan_count = 0
            section_count = 0

            for row in rows:
                if isinstance(row, AssignmentRow):
                    if self.plans_enabled() and row.CreatePlan:
                        plan_count += 1
                    if self.sections_enabled() and row.CreateSection:
                        section_count += 1
                else:
                    if row.Role == "Plan" and self.plans_enabled():
                        plan_count += 1
                    elif row.Role != "Plan" and self.sections_enabled():
                        section_count += 1

        if force_full:
            self.state.CachedRequiredSheets = self.estimate_total_required_sheets()

        parts = [
            "Source Mode: {0}".format(source_mode),
            "Sources: {0}".format(scopes_count),
            "Levels: {0}".format(levels_count),
            "Rows: {0}".format(row_count),
            "Plans: {0}".format(plan_count),
            "Sections: {0}".format(section_count),
            "Create Mode: {0}".format(self.get_create_mode())
        ]

        if self.get_create_mode() == "Views + Sheets":
            parts.append("Sheet Mode: {0}".format(self.get_sheet_mode()))
            if source_mode == "Creator":
                packing_mode = "Separate Scope Groups" if self._should_keep_scope_groups() else "Combined Scope Packing"
                parts.append("Packing: {0}".format(packing_mode))
            parts.append("Estimated Sheets Required: {0}".format(self.state.CachedRequiredSheets))

            if self.get_sheet_mode() == "Existing Sheets":
                selected_count = len(self.get_selected_existing_sheets())
                parts.append("Selected Existing Sheets: {0}".format(selected_count))
                if force_full and selected_count < self.state.CachedRequiredSheets:
                    warnings.append("Selected existing sheets may be insufficient.")

            if self.get_sheet_mode() == "New Sheets" and not self._selected_element(self.cbTitleBlock):
                warnings.append("Select a title block.")
        else:
            parts.append("Sheeting: disabled")

        if source_mode == "Creator":
            if self.plans_enabled() and not self._selected_element(self.cbPlanType):
                warnings.append("Select a structural plan type.")
            if self.sections_enabled() and not self._selected_element(self.cbSectionType):
                warnings.append("Select a section type.")

        if not self.plans_enabled() and not self.sections_enabled():
            warnings.append("Enable Plans and/or Sections.")
        if row_count == 0:
            warnings.append("No rows to create/place.")

        self.txtSummary.Text = " | ".join(parts)

        if warnings:
            self.bdrWarnings.Visibility = Visibility.Visible
            self.txtWarnings.Text = "\n".join(warnings)
        else:
            self.bdrWarnings.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed
            self.txtWarnings.Text = ""

        self._refresh_stage1_name_summary(row_count, plan_count, section_count)

        try:
            self._last_summary_refresh_at = time.time()
        except:
            pass

    def _refresh_stage1_name_summary(self, row_count=0, plan_count=0, section_count=0):
        try:
            self.txtPlanViewCount.Text = "Plan views: {0}".format(int(plan_count))
        except Exception:
            pass

        try:
            self.txtSectionViewCount.Text = "Section views: {0}".format(int(section_count))
        except Exception:
            pass

        sample_row = None
        try:
            if self.state.CreatorRows:
                sample_row = self.state.CreatorRows[0]
        except Exception:
            sample_row = None

        plan_example = "automatic"
        section_example = "automatic"
        if isinstance(sample_row, AssignmentRow):
            try:
                plan_example = self.get_plan_base_name(sample_row)
            except Exception:
                plan_example = "automatic"
            try:
                section_example = self.get_section_base_name(sample_row)
            except Exception:
                section_example = "automatic"

        try:
            self.txtPlanNameExample.Text = "Plan example: {0} | Tokens: {{source}}, {{level}}, {{id}}".format(plan_example)
        except Exception:
            pass

        try:
            self.txtSectionNameExample.Text = "Section example: {0} | Tokens: {{section_source}}, {{source}}, {{level}}, {{side}}, {{id}}".format(section_example)
        except Exception:
            pass
